documents: Bismillahirrahmanirrahim JANNAT-KE-HASEEN MANAZIR ۞ Dozakh mai Bilbilane Wale Do Shakhsho Ka Jannat mai Dakhila Hazrat Abu Huraira Raziyallahu Anhu se Rivayat hai k Janabe Rasulallah Sallallahu Alaihivasallam ne irshad farmaya - "__Jo log Dozakh mai dakhil kiye jayenge Unme se Do Aadmiyo'n ki Cheekh v Pukaar bahut badhi hui hogi , Allah Ta'ala hukm denge in dono ko baahar nikaalo , Jab unko baahar nikaala jayega aur Allah Ta'ala puchhenge Kis vajah se tumhari Cheekh v Pukaar bahut sakht ho gayi thi ? WO arz karenge k humne ye isliye kiya tha k Aap hum per Raham farmaye , __Allah Ta'ala farmayenge Tum dono per meri Rahamat ye hai k tum waapas chale jao aur Dozakh mai jaha'n per mojood they wahi per apne Aapko gira do ,Chunache WO Dono chal padenge ,unme se ek to khud ko Dozakh mai gira dega aur us per Dozakh ko thandak aur salaamti kar diya jayega Magar doosra Shakhs khud ko nahi girayega , __Allah Ta'ala puchhenge tumhe kis baat ne mana kiya k tumne apne Aapko is tarah se nahi giraya jis tarah se tere saathi ne gira diya ,? WO arz karega Ya Rab Mai'n ummeed karta hu'n k Aap mujhe Dozakh se nikaalne ke baad dobara usme dakhil nahi karenge , To Allah Ta'ala usse farmayenge Tere liye Teri Ummeed ke mutabiq maamla karte hai'n, Chunache un dono ko Allah Ta'ala ki Rahamat ke saath Jannat mai dakhil kar diya jayega , . Musnad Ahmad ,3 230 Tazkiratul Qurtubi ,2 428 ۞ Akheer mai Do or Shakhso Ke Jannat mai Dakhil hone Ki Haalat Hazrat Abu Saied Khudri Raziyallahu Anhu aur Hazrat Abu Huraira Raziyallahu Anhu se Rivayat hai k Janabe Rasulallah Sallallahu Alaihivasallam ne irshad farmaya - "__Akheer mai Jo Do Aadmi Dozakh se niklenge Unme se ek se Allah Ta'ala farmayenge -Ey ibne Aadam tumne is Din ( Yani Akhirat ) ke liye kya taiyaari ki thi ? Tumne kabhi Nek Amal kiya tha ? Tumne kabhi mujhse ( Khair ki ) ummeed ki thi ? _WO arz karega Ya Rab ! Maine kuchh nahi kiya sirf Aapse Neki ki ummeed ki thi , _Huzoor Sallallahu Alaihivasallam farmate hai'n k uske saamne ek darakht laa kar qareeb kiya jayega To WO dozakhi kahega Ya Rab ! Aap mujhe is darakht ke niche bitha de taki mai iska saaya haasil kar saku ,Uska Phal kha saku aur uska Paani pi saku aur WO Muahida karega k mai'n Allah Ta'ala se iske alawa kuchh nahi maagunga , __To Allah Ta'ala usko us darakht ke niche pahuncha denge ,Uske baad ek or darakht uske saamne pesh kiya jayega Jo Pehle se nihayat darza Haseen hoga aur paani ki bahut farawani hogi , __Ye arz karega Ya Rab Aap mujhe uske niche bitha de Mai'n Aapse koi sawal nahi karunga ,Uske saaye mai pada rahunga aur uska paani pita rahunga , Allah Ta'ala farmayenge Ey ibne Aadam Kya tune mere saath Muahida nahi kiya tha k iske alawa mujhse kuchh or talab nahi karega , __Fir Allah Ta'ala usko us darakht ke niche jagah denge , Fir uske saamne jannat ke darwaze ke saamne ek darakht pesh kiya jayega Jo Pehle wale dono darakhto se zyada Haseen v jameel hoga aur bahut paani wala hoga ,WO arz karega Ya Rab mujhe Uske niche pahuncha de To Allah Ta'ala usko uske paas pahuncha denge Ye us waqt Muahida karega k Allah Ta'ala se or kuchh nahi maangega , __Fir jab WO Jannat walo ki awaaz sunega to usse Sabr nahi ho sakega fir arz karega ,Ey Parwardigaar Aap mujhe Jannat mai dakhil kar de , Ab Allah Ta'ala farmayenge k maang aur Tamanna karta ja To WO ( unko bhi ) maangta rahega aur tamanna karta rahega hattaki Duniya ke Teen Dino ke barabar ka arsa guzar jayega aur Allah Ta'ala usko un inamaat ki talqeen karte rahenge Jinka usko ilm nahi hoga , Chunache WO maangta rahega aur Tamanna karta rahega jab WO ( maang kar ) faarig hoga Allah Ta'ala farmayenge tujhe WO Sab kuchh ataa kiya Jiska tune sawal kiya , __Hazrat Abu Saied khudri Raziyallahu ki Rivayat mai hai k ek gunaa mazeed bhi usko ataa kiya jayega , Hazrat Abu Huraira Raziyallahu Anhu ki Rivayat mai hai k usko ( uske maangne ke hisaab se ) das guna zyada ataa kiya jayega , . Musnad Ahmad ,3 70-74 , ۞ Momino Ki Sifarish Aur Allah Ki Ek Mutthi se Dozakhiyo ki Bakhshish, Hazrat Abu Saied Khudri Raziyallahu Anhu Aap Sallallahu Alaihivasallam se ek taveel Rivayat mai naqal karte hue farmate hai'n k Aap Sallallahu Alaihivasallam ne irshad farmaya - "__ Jab Musalman Jahannam se paar ho jayenge to Mujhe qasam hai us zaat ki Jisne qabze mai meri jaan hai Tumme se har ek se zyada Haq ki adaygi mai momino ke liye Roze Qayamat Allah Ta'ala ko qasam dilane wala Koi nahi hoga Ye Apne un Musalman Bhaiyo ki Sifarish karte hue arz karenge "__Ey hamare Rab ye ( Jahannam mai Jo mojood Momin hazraat ) hamare saath Roze rakha karte they Namaze Padha karte they aur Hajj kiya karte they ( isliye unhe maaf farma kar Jahannam se nikaal le aur Jannat mai dakhil farma de ) __To unhe farmaya jayega Jinhe tum jaante ho unko nikaal lao Unke Jism Jahannam per haraam hai'n ,Pas WO log bahut si Khalqat ko nikaal layenge Jinhe Jahannam ne aadhi pindliyo tak ya ghutno tak garq kiya hua tha , Pas ye log arz karenga Ey hamare Parwardigaar Jinka Aapne hume farmaya tha Unme se koi bhi baqi nahi raha , __Fir Allah Ta'ala unko hukm farmayenge Tum waapas lot jao aur jiske Dil mai ek Dinaar ke barabar bhi khair paate ho use ( bhi Jahannam se ) nikaal lao , Pas WO bahut si makhlooq ko nikaal layenge aur kahenge Ey hamare Parwardigaar Humne kisi ko usme nahi chhoda Jiska bhi Aapne hume Hukm farmaya ( hum usko nikaal laye hai'n ) , __Fir Allah Ta'ala farmayenge ( ab bhi ) waapas lot jao aur Jiske Dil mai aadhe Dinaar ke Vazan ke barabar bhalaai jano use bhi nikaal lo , Pas WO bahut se makhlooq ko baahar nikaal layenge Fir kahenge Ey hamare Parwardigaar Humne usme Kisi ko nahi chhoda Jiske nikaalne ka Aapne Hume hukm diya , __Fir Allah Ta'ala farmayenge ( ab bhi ) waapas lot jao aur Jiske Dil mai ek zarra barabar bhi bhalaai ( imaan ) pao use bhi nikaal lao ,Tab bhi WO bahut si makhlooq ko baahar nikaal layenge aur kahenge Ey hamare Parwardigaar Humne isme bhalaai karne wali ( imaan lane wali ) makhlooq bilkul nahi rehne di ( Sab ko Jahannam se nikaal liya hai ) Hazrat Abu Saied Khudri Raziyallahu Anhu is Rivayat ko bayan karne ke baad farmaya karte they agar tum is Hadees ke bare mai meri tasdeeq na kao to chaho to ye Aayat padhlo lo __ "__( Tarjuma ) Bila Shubha Allah Ta'ala kisi per zarra barabar bhi zulm nahi farmayenge agar ek Neki ( bhi ) hogi to use bhi ajro Sawab mai do guna karenge aur Apni taraf se ajre azeem ataa farmayenge ,( Surah An Nisa 40 ) Fir Allah Ta'ala farmayenge Farishto se shafa'at ki , Ambiya Alaihissalam ne bhi Shafa'at ki aur Momino ne bhi Shafa'at ki ab sivae Ar-Rahmaan Ar- Raheem ke koi nahi bacha to ( Khud Allah Ta'ala ) Aag se ( Momin ki )ek Mutthi bharenge aur uske zariye esi qaum ko baahar nikaalenge Jinhone imaan ke alawa aur koi bhalaai na ki hogi aur Woh Koyla ban chuke honge __Fir Allah Ta'ala unko Jannat ke saamne Nahar mai daal denge us Nahar ka Naam Nahare Hayaat hai to WO ( usse is haalat mai ) niklenge Jese sailaab khushk hone ke baad daana nikalta hai , . Bukhari v Muslim ۞ Momin Sirf Imaan Ki Badolat Dozakh se Niklenge , Jin logo ne kabhi bhalaai na ki hogi isse muraad ye hai k Apne A'aza se koi Amal na kiya hoga agarche unke saath Toheed ki haqeeqat mojood hogi , Jesa k us Aadmi ki us Aadmi ki Hadees mai bhi Vaarid hai Jisne Apne ghar walo se kaha tha Use maut aane ke baad jala daale , Usne bhi koi nek Amal kabhi nahi kiya tha sivae Toheed ke , Musnad Ahmad , iski taaiyd is Hadees se bhi hoti hai Jisme hai k Huzoor Sallallahu Alaihivasallam ne farmaya - "__Mai'n Allah Ta'ala ke saamne arz karunga Ey mere Parwardigaar Mujhe un logo ke mutalliq ( bhi ) Shafa'at karne ki ijazat de Jo Laa ilaaha illallaah kehte they , _To Allah Ta'ala farmayenge mujhe meri izzat v jalaal ,Kibriyai aur azmat ki qasam hai Mai'n zaroor ese Aadmi ko Jahannam se nikaal lunga ( Jisne Laa ilaaha illallaah kaha tha )_, At Takhweef minannaar Ba hawala Bukhari v Muslim, Ye Hadees bhi is baat ki wazahat karti hai k jin logo ne kabhi bhi apne A'aza se nek Amal nahi kiya hoga lekin sirf Ahle Kalma they Unko Allah Ta'ala Apni Rahmat se bager kisi ki Shafa'at ke Jahannam se nikaalenge , . Jannat Ke Haseen Manazir, 269 ۞ Farishte bhi Dozakhiyo ko Nikaal Lenge , Hazrat Abu Huraira Raziyallahu Anhu se marvi hai k Rasulallah Sallallahu Alaihivasallam ne ek taveel Hadees mai ye bhi farmaya - "__Hattaki Jab Allah Ta'ala Bando ke darmiyan insaaf kar ke faarig ho jayenge aur iraada farmayenge k Apni Rahmat se bade gunaaho ke murtakib logo ko Jahannam se nikaal le to farishto ko hukm farmayenge k woh har us Aadmi ko nikaal le Jo Allah ke saath kisi ko shareek nahi karta tha _ (Ye Farishte ) unhe Sajde ke nishaan se pehchanenge ( Kyunki ) Jahannam ibne Aadam ke Tamaam hisso ko jalayegi Magar sajde ke muqaam ko baqi chhod degi , _Isliye Allah Ta'ala ne Aag per haraam kar diya hai k WO Sajdo ke muqamaat ko jala sake , Jab WO Jahannam se niklenge to Koyla ho chuke honge Fir un per Aabe Hayaat palta jayega to WO usse is tarah taro taza ho jayenge Jis tarah daana sailaab se khushk hone ke baad ( Zameen se ) ug padta hai , . Bukhari v Muslim , ۞ Gunahgaar Dozakhi Shafa'at se bhi Jannat mai Jayenge , Hazrat Abu Saied Raziyallahu Anhu se marvi hai k Nabi Kareem Sallallahu Alaihivasallam ne irshad farmaya - "__Dozakhi Jo Jahannam ke Ahal honge WO na to usme marenge aur na jiyenge Lekin Kuchh Log ese honge Jinhe Aag unke gunaaho ke hisaab se jalayegi , __Fir Allah Ta'ala unko maut de denge yaha'n tak k Jab WO Koyla ban jayenge to Shafa'at ki ijazat de di jayegi to unko Jama'ato ki shakl mai laya jayega aur Jannat ki Nahro per bikher diya jayega , __Fir Ahle Jannat ko hukm diya jayega k in per ( Aabe Hayaat ) palto to woh usse taro taza ho jayenge Jis tarah sailaab mai behne wala daana ( sailaab khushk hone ke baad Zameen per thehar ta hai aur ) ug padta hai , Muslim ( At-takhweef minan naar ) Faayda , _is Hadees se maloom hota hai k gunahgaar Musalman Jahannam mai haqeeqi tor per faut honge aur unki Roohe'n unke Jismo se juda hongi , Tambeeh , _ is per ye Shubha na kiya jaye k Jab maut ko bhi maut aa jayegi to ye kese marenge , isliye k Momino per maut aane ki ye haalat maut ko zibah hone se Pehle ki hai , Maut ke Zibah hone ke baad qat'an kisi ko maut nahi aayegi , Jannat Ke Haseen Manazir, 270 ۞ Dozakh se Nijaat Paa kar Jannat mai Jane Wale Adna Jannati honge, Hazrat Abu Huraira Raziyallahu Anhu farmate hai'n k Janabe Rasulallah Sallallahu Alaihivasallam ne irshad farmaya - "__Ahle Jannat mai Kam Naseeb Wali WO Qaum hogi Jinko Allah Ta'ala Aag se nikaalenge aur ( Jahannam se) Azaad kar denge aur unhe Raahat pahunchayenge , __Aur ye WO log honge Jo Allah ke saath kisi ko shareek nahi thehrate they , Unhe Khule maidaan mai faink diya jayega to ye taro taza ho kar ubharne lagenge Jese sabza ugta hai Yaha'n tak k Jab Roohe'n ajsaam mai dakhil hongi to Woh arz karenge Ey hamare Rab Jis tarah Aapne hume Aag se nikaala hai aur Rooho ko ajsaam mai lotaya hai usi tarah hamare rukh bhi Aag se fayr dijiye To unke Rukh bhi aag se fayr diye jayenge , . Musnad Bizzar ( At- Takhweef minan naar ) ۞ Dozakh mai Momino Ki Haalat , Muhammad bin Ali ( imaam Baaqar Reh. ) apne Baap se WO Apne Dada se Rivayat karte hai'n k Nabi Kareem Sallallahu Alaihivasallam ne irshad farmaya - "__Tamaam Ummato Ke mohideen bade gunaaho ke murtakab jab Apne gunaaho ki mojoodgi mai bager sharmindgi aur bager Tauba ke faut ho jayenge ( fir ) unme se Jo log Dozakh ke Pehla darwaze se aag mai dakhil honge ,na to unki binaai chheeni jayegi ,na unke moonh kaale honge na Shaitano ke saath jakde jayenge , na zanjeero se baandhe jayenge ,na jalta hua paani pilaye jayenge aur na zakhm mai taarkol ka libaas pehnaye jayenge , __Allah ne Toheed ki Vajah se unke Jismo ko aag per haraam kiya hai , unme se kisi ko bad A'amaliyo ke hisaab se aag ne qadmo tak pakda hoga , Kisi ko Kamar tak aur kisi ko gardan tak , unme se koi ek maah Jahannam mai rahega fir Bilaal liya jayega Unme se Jahannam mai sabse Zyada muddat tak rehne wala Duniya ki Umar ( ke barabar rahega Yani k ) Jabse Duniya bani yaha'n tak k WO jab tabaah hogi , __Jab Allah Ta'ala iraada karenge unko Jahannam se nikaale to Yahoodi aur Eysaai aur baqi dozakhi Jo mukhtalif baatil adyaan ya But parasto se talluq rakhte honge ( bator taana ) mohideen ko kahenge k tum ( Allah per imaan laye iski kitaabo per bhi Uske Rasoolo per bhi lekin hum aur Tum Aaj Dozakh mai ek Haal mai hai'n, __Pas Allah Ta'ala un per itna gussa aalood honge k aur guzishta Awqaat mai itna gussa aalood kabhi na hue honge , Pas unko Jannat ke ek chashme ki taraf nikaal lenge, isi ke mutalliq Allah Ta'ala ka farmaan hai k WO log bhi khwahish karenge k Kaash WOh ( bhi ) Musalman hote , . At- Takhweef Minan Naar , 263 ۞ Andheri Raat mai Namaz Ko Jane Walo Ko Dozakh mai band nahi kiya Jayega, Hazrat Hasan Basri Reh . farmate hai'n k Ahle Toheed ( Gunahgaar Musalman ) ko aag mai band nahi kiya jayega ( ye Soorat dekh kar ) Jahannam ki Police ek Doosre se kahegi in ( Kuffaar ) ki haalat to ye hai k unhe aag mai band kiya hua hai aur inhe band nahi kiya gaya ? __To Unhe ek munaadi Nida karega ( Isliye ) k ye log Masajid mai andheri Raat mai ( bhi ) jaya karte they , At - Takhweef Minan Naar ,264 Hazrat Hasan Basri Reh farmate hai'n k ek Shakhs ko ek hazaar saal ke baad bhi nikaala jayega Fir Hazrat Hasan Basri Reh ne ( Shiddate khof se ) farmaya Kaash k Woh Aadmi mai'n hota _, At - Takhweef Minan Naar ,264 ۞ Jannat Bharne Ke Liye Nayi Makhlooq Paida Hogi , Hazrat Anas bin Maalik Raziyallahu Anhu se Rivayat hai k Janabe Rasulallah Sallallahu Alaihivasallam ne irshad farmaya - "__Jannat mai se Jitna hissa Allah Ta'ala chahenge Khaali rahega Fir Allah Subhana v Ta'ala iske liye ek Makhlooq Paida karenge Jisse chahenge aur Unko Jannat ke Faarig hisse mai basa denge , Muslim ,40 Musnad Ahmad ,3 265 Kanzul Ummaal, 3940 Faayda _ Qayamat ke Roz aur Jannat mai dakhil ho chukne ke baad Ahle Dozakh Musalmano ke liye Allah Ta'ala ki Rahmat aur Bakhshish ka koi andaza nahi lagaya ja sakta itni kasrat se Jannat mai dakhile ke bavjood Jannat fir bhi khaali reh jayegi kyunki Jannat Allah Ta'ala ka fazal hai Jiski koi inteha nahi Usko ye makhlooq mukammal tor per nahi bhar sakegi isliye Usko bharne ke liye Allah nayi makhlooq paida kar ke usme basayenge , . Jannat Ke Haseen Manazir ,277 ۞ Mardo'n Ka Husn v Jamaal - Hazrat Abu Huraira Raziyallahu Anhu farmate hai'n mujhe us zaat ki qasam Jisne Qur'an e Paak Hazrat Muhammad Sallallahu Alaihivasallam per naazil farmaya hai Jannat mai rehne wale ( Mard v Aurat , Hooro Gulaamo ke ) Husn v Jamaal mai is tarah se izafa hota rahega Jis tarah se unka Duniya mai ( Akhir Umar mai ) Bad Soorti aur Budhape mai izafa hota rehta hai , Musannif ibne Abi Sheeba ,13 114 Safatul Jannah Abu Naiem ,264 Irshade Khudawandi hai k " Goya k woh ( Khidmatgaar ) ladke mehfooz rakhe hue moti Hai'n ," is irshad ki tafseer mai Hazrat Qatada Raziyallahu Anhu farmate hai'n k "__Mujhe ye baat pahunchi hai k Arz kiya gaya Ya Rasulallah Sallallahu Alaihivasallam ! Ye to Nokar Aur Khidmatgaar Hai'n Lo Lo Moti ki tarah To makhdoom kese honge ? Aapne irshad farmaya - Mujhe us zaat ki qasam jiske qabze mai meri Jaan hai Unke darmiyan esi fazilat hai Jese Chohdhvi Raat ke chaand ki sitaaro per hoti hai , . Durre Mansoor ,6 116 Ba hawala ibne jareer ,27 29 Safatul Jannat Abu Naiem ,265 Hazrat Anas bin Maalik Raziyallahu Anhu se Rivayat hai k Janabe Rasulallah Sallallahu Alaihivasallam ne irshad farmaya - "__Jannat mai ek Bazaar hoga ,Jannati har Juma ko usme aaya karenge , Shumaal se ek khushbu chalegi Jo unke chehro aur Libaas per padegi aur ye Husn v Jamaal mai badh jayenge , __Fir ye Apne ghar walo ke paas lotenge Jabki ye Husno Jamaal mai khoob taraqqi kiye hue honge Unko Biviya'n kahengi Aap to hum se Juda hone ke baad Husno Jamaal mai bahut badh gaye Hai'n , To ye Mard kahenge Aap bhi khuda ki qasam Husno Jamaal mai badh chuki ho , Safatul Jannat Abu Naiem ,417 Muslim ,2833 Ahmad ,3 284 Kanzul Ummaal ,14 486 Faayda _ Ye hawa Mushk ke teelo se chalayi jayegi , Jannati Mard v Aurte'n har ghadi Husn v Jamaal mai taraqqi karte rahenge Jab ek Doosre se kuchh der ojhal honge to Chunki is haalat mai bhi unke Husno Jamaal mai izafa hota rahega iski vajah se WO ek Doosre ke Husno Jamaal ko dekh kar hairaan aur lutf andoz honge , "__ Jannat Ke bazaar mai Husno Jamaal mai man pasand Haseen v Jameel Soorte'n bhi hongi ,Jannati Jis Soorat ko pasand karega Usme tabdeel ho sakega , . Jannat Ke Haseen Manazir, 279 ۞ Husne Yusuf Alaihissalam , Miqdaam bin M'adi Karb Raziyallahu Anhu se Rivayat hai k Janabe Rasulallah Sallallahu Alaihivasallam ne irshad farmaya - "__Zaay hone wale Bachche se le kar Budhe tak ( Momin ) qayamat ke din Hazrat Aadam Alaihissalam Ki Soorat ,Hazrat Ayyub Alaihissalam Ke Dil aur Hazrat Yusuf Alaihissalam ke Husn per bager Dadhi ke Aankho mai Surma lagaye hue ( qabro se ) uthaye jayenge , Tabrani Kabeer ( 20 255,280,281) Majmauz Zawa'id ( 10 334) Abu Naiem (258 ) ۞ Taaj Ki Shaan v Shokat , Hazrat Abu Saied Khudri Raziyallahu Anhu se Rivayat hai k Janabe Rasulallah Sallallahu Alaihivasallam ne irshad farmaya - "__Jannatiyo'n ( Ke sar ) per Taaj saje honge Unme se ( har ek Taaj ka ) adna darje ka Moti WO hoga Jo Mashriq v Magrib ke darmiyan faasle ko Roshan karta hoga , . Tirmizi ( 2562) Haakim ( 2 426 ) Durre Mansoor ( 5 253 ) ۞ Jannatiyo Ka Qad aur Shakl v Soorat, Hazrat Abu Huraira Raziyallahu Anhu farmate hai'n k Janabe Rasulallah Sallallahu Alaihivasallam ne irshad farmaya - "___Allah Ta'ala ne Hazrat Aadam Alaihissalam ko unki ( Behtreen ) Soorat per paida farmaya Unka Qad (60) Saath Haath tha , Jab Allah Ta'ala ne unko paida kiya to farmaya Aap jaa kar us jama'at ko salaam kijiye ,Ye Farishto Ki ek Jama'at thi Jo bethi hui thi aur ( unse ) suniye ye Aapko kya jawab dete hai'n Yahi Aapka aur Aapki Aulaad ka Salaam hoga , Huzoor Sallallahu Alaihivasallam irshad farmate hai'n - Chunache Hazrat Aadam Alaihissalam tashreef le gaye aur Farmaya Assalamu Alaikum _ To unhone jawab mai Kaha Assalamu Alaikum Wa Rahmatullahi wa Barakatuh, Un Farishto ne Salaam mai Wa Rahmatullahi wa Barakatuh ka izafa kiya , Huzoor Sallallahu Alaihivasallam irshad farmate hai'n k pas Jo bhi Jannat mai dakhil hoga WO Hazrat Aadam Alaihissalam Ki Shakl v Shabahat per hoga Uske ( Qad Ki lambaai ) Saath Haath hogi , Lekin ( Hazrat Aadam ke ( Duniya se tashreef le ) Jane ke baad ab tak Husno Jamaal aur Qad kaathi kam hi hota ja raha hai , . Jannat Ke Haseen Manazir ,283 Ba Hawala - Musannif AbdurRazaq ( 10 384) Musnad Ahmad ( 2 315) Bukhari Shareef ( 3326 )Muslim ( 2841) ۞ Chaand Sitaaro Jesi Shakle, Hazrat Abu Huraira Raziyallahu Anhu farmate hai'n k Janabe Rasulullah Sallallahu Alaihivasallam ne irshad farmaya "__ Pehla giroh jo jannat mai dakhil hoga uski soorat chohdhvi Raat ke chaand ki tarah hogi aur wo log jo unke baad dakhil honge unki soorat ki chamak damak Asmaan mai tez roshan sitaare ki tarah hogi, Ye Jannati na peshab karenge na pakhaana na thook na naak ki galazat, unki kangiya'n sone ki hongi, Unka Paseena Kastoori ka hoga, Unki angetbiya agar ki hongi, Unki Biviya'n hoore'n hongi, Unke Akhlaaq ek hi Aadmi ke khalq jese honge Unki Soorte'n Apne Abba Hazrat Aadam Alaihissalam ki soorat per hogi, Lambaai mai Saath (60) haath qad hoga, . . Bukhari ,3327 Muslim , ۞ Kaali Rangat walo Ka Husn, Hazrat ibne Umar Raziyallahu Anhu farmate hai'n k ek ( Habshi ) Shakhs Janabe Rasulallah Sallallahu Alaihivasallam Ki khidmat mai haazir ho kar kuchh sawal karne laga , Aap Sallallahu Alaihivasallam ne irshaf farmaya - Poochh lo aur Khoob Samajh lo , To usne arz kiya - Ya Rasulallah ! Aapko hum per shakl v Soorat mai khoobsurati aur Nabuwat mai hum per fazilat bakhshi gayi hai ,Aap kya farmate hai'n agar mai is tarah se imaan le aau Jis tarah se Aap Allah Ta'ala per imaan laaye aur mai'n bhi wese hi Amal karu Jis tarah ke A'amaal Aap karte hai'n to kya mai'n Jannat mai Aapke saath hounga ? Aap Sallallahu Alaihivasallam ne irshad farmaya - Haa'n , Fir Aapne irshad farmaya - Mujhe us zaat Ki qasam Jiske qabze mai meri jaan hai , Kaale Rang wale Shakhs Ki Safedi Jannat mai ek hazaar saal Ki musafat se dekhi jati hogi , "__Fir Aap Sallallahu Alaihivasallam ne irshad farmaya - Jisne " Laa ilaaha illallaah " padha uske liye Allah Ta'ala ke paas ( Nijaat aur Jannat ka ) ek parwana likh diya jata hai ,aur Jisne " Subhanallahi Wabihamdihi " padha uske liye iske badle mai ek laakh Chobees Hazaar nekiya'n likh di jati hai'n , ( Ye Sun kar ) Us Shakhs ne kaha - Ya Rasulallah ! Ese ( inamaat haasil karne ) ke baad hum kis tarah se halaak ho sakte hai'n ? "__To Janabe Rasulallah Sallallahu Alaihivasallam ne irshad farmaya - Qayamat ke Din Aadmi esa Amal kar ke layega k agar usko pahaad per rakh diya jaye to us per bhi bojhal ho jayega ( Yani Pahaad bhi us Amal ke vazan ko uthane Ki taaqat nahi rakhe ) fir Allah Ta'ala Ki niyamato mai se ( Koi si Duniya Ki ) ek niyamat muqable mai pesh hogi Jo uski tamaam neki ko be vazan kar degi magar ye k Allah Ta'ala Apni Rehmat ke saath ( Bande Ki ) dastgeeri karenge ( aur uske Nek Amaal ka darja badha kar usko Jannat ka mustahiq kar diya jayega ) , "_ Us Habshi ne arz kiya - kya meri Aankh bhi WO kuchh dekhegi Jo Aapki Aankhe Jannat mai dekhengi ? Aap Hazrat Sallallahu Alaihivasallam ne irshad farmaya - haa'n , To WO Habshi ( Khushi ke maare ) itna Roya k uski jaan nikal gayi ,Hazrat ibne Umar Raziyallahu Anhu farmate hai'n k Maine Aap Hazrat Sallallahu Alaihivasallam ko dekha k Aap khud Apne daste Mubarak se us Habshi ko qabr mai utaar rahe they, Majmauz Zawa'id ,10 420 Ba hawala Tabrani ,12 436 , ۞ Mardo'n Ki Umar , Hazrat Mu'az bin Jabal Raziyallahu Anhu se Rivayat hai k Janabe Rasulallah Sallallahu Alaihivasallam ne irshad farmaya - "__Jannati Hazraat Jannat mai is haalat mai jayenge k na to unke Jismo per Baal honge na dadhi hogi , Aankho mai surma lagaye gaye honge 30 saal Ki ya 33 saal Ki Umar mai honge ,_" Musnad Ahmad ,5 243 Tirmizi ,2545 _ Hazrat Anas bin Maalik Raziyallahu Anhu farmate hai'n k Janabe Rasulallah Sallallahu Alaihivasallam ne irshad farmaya - "_ Jannatiyo ko Hazrat Aadam Alaihissalam Ki Shakl v Soorat mai 33 saal Ki Umar mai bager Jismani Baalo aur Daadhi ke ( Qabro se ) uthaya jayega , Fir unko Jannat mai ek darakht ke paas le jaya jayega Jisse WO libaas ko pehnenge fir na to unke Kapde purane honge na Jawani mai Farq aayega ," Kanzul Ummaal , Haadi Al Ravaah ,203 ,Abu Naiem ,155 ,Majmauz Zawa'id ,10 398 Hazrat Abu Saied Khudri Raziyallahu Anhu farmate hai'n k Janabe Rasulallah Sallallahu Alaihivasallam ne irshad farmaya - "_ Jannatiyo mai se Jo Aadmi Chhoti Umar ka ya Badi Umar ka faut hota hai Unko 30 saal Ki Umar mai Jannat dakhil kiya jayegi Unki Umar isse zyada kabhi nahi badhegi , Dozakhiyo Ki Umar bhi esi hi hogi ,_" . Sunan Tirmizi ,2562 Haadi Al Ravaah ,203 ۞ Chehro mai Niyamato Ki Tarotaazgi, Allah Ta'ala irshad farmate hai'n - إِنَّ الْأَبْرَارَ لَفِي نَعِيمٍ .عَلَى الْأَرَائِكِ يَنظُرُونَ .تَعْرِفُ فِي وُجُوهِهِمْ نَضْرَةَ النَّعِيمِ Surah Al-Mutaffifin, Aayat - 22-23 -24 Tarjuma _ "__Nek Log badi Aasa'ish mai honge , Masahriyo per ( bethe bahisht ke ajaebaat ) dekhte honge , ( Ey mukhatib ) Tu unke Chehro mai Aasaish Ki bashashat pehchanega , Tafseer _ ْ نَضْرَةَ النَّعِيمِ Ki Tafsesr mai Allama Mavardi farmate hai'n k iski Chaar tafseere hai'n , 1- Jannatiyo ke Chehro Ki tarotaazgi aur Khush haali muraad hai , 2- Jannatiyo ke Chehro Ki chamak damak muraad hai , 3- Jannat mai ek Chashma hai Jab Jannati Hazraat usse vazu karenge aur gusl karenge to unke chehro per niyamato Ki tarotaazgi Aashkaar hogi , 4- Daaymi Niyamat Ki vajah se Chehre per hamesha khushi chhaayi rahegi , . Jolaat Fi Riyazul Jannat ,63 ۞ Hanste Muskurate Chehre, Allah Ta'ala irshad farmate hai'n - لِّلَّذِينَ أَحْسَنُوا الْحُسْنَىٰ وَزِيَادَةٌ وَلَا يَرْهَقُ وُجُوهَهُمْ قَتَرٌ وَلَا ذِلَّةٌ أُولَٰئِكَ أَصْحَابُ الْجَنَّةِ هُمْ فِيهَا خَالِدُونَ Surah Yunus, Aayat 26 Tarjuma _ "__Jin logo ne Neki Ki unke waaste Jannat hai aur mazeed Bara'a ( Allah Ta'ala ka Didaar ) bhi aur Unke chehro per na kadorat ( Gam Ki ) chhayegi aur na Zillat , Ye log Jannat mai rehne wale hai'n WO isme hamesha rahenge , Allah Ta'ala mazeed irshad farmate hai'n - وُجُوهٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ مُّسْفِرَةٌ .ضَاحِكَةٌ مُّسْتَبْشِرَةٌ Surah Abasa, Aayat 38-39, وُجُوهٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ نَّاعِمَةٌ. لِّسَعْيِهَا رَاضِيَةٌ. فِي جَنَّةٍ عَالِيَةٍ Surah Al-Ghashiya, Aayat 8-9-10, Tarjuma_ "__Bahut se Chehre us Din ( imaan Ki vajah se ) Roshan ( aur masraat se ) kanda'n aur Shadaa'n honge_," "_____ Bahut se Chehre us Roz Ba Ronaq ( aur ) Apne ( Nek ) kaamo Ki badolat khush honge ( aur ) Bahishte Bari ( Jannat ) mai honge , . Jannat Ke Haseen Manazir ,290 ۞ Libaas aur Poshaak, Allah Ta'ala irshad farmate hai'n - "__ Tarjuma _ Beshak Jo log imaan laye aur unhone Nek Amal kiye to hum eso ka ajr zaaya na karenge Jo achchhi tarah se ( nek ) kaam kare ( pas ) ese logo ke liye hamesha rehne ke baag hai'n Unke ( masakin )ke niche nehre behti hongi , Unko waha'n sone ke kangan pehnaye jayenge ,aur Sabz rang ke Kapde bareek aur mote resham ke pehnenge ( aur ) Waha'n masahriyo per takiye lagaye bethe honge Kya hi achchha silah hai aur ( bahisht ) kya hi achchhi jagah hai _," Surah Kahaf - 30-31 Hazrat ibne Umar Raziyallahu Anhu farmate hai'n k ek Shakhs ne arz kiya Ya Rasulallah ! Aap Hume Jannat wali ke kapdo ke mutalliq irshad farmaiye Kya Unki naye sire se paida kiya jayega Ya Unko bana jayega ? To hazireen mai se baaz hazraat hans pade , To Janabe Rasulallah Sallallahu Alaihivasallam ne irshad farmaya - "__Tum is na waqif ke mutalliq Jo jaanne wale se sawal kar raha Hai Kyu hanste ho ! Fir Aapne irshad farmaya k Jannat ka phal Libaas ko zaahir karega ,Aapne ye baat Do martaba irshad farmayi , Musnad Ahmad ,2 203,224,225 ,Zuhad Ibne Mubarak ,2 75 Hazrat Murahid bin Abdullah farmate hai'n k Jannat mai ek darakht hai Jisse sandas ( Bareek Resham ) ugega ,Yahi Jannat walo ka Libaas hoga _" . Badorul Safrah ,1949 - Bahawala Musnad, Bizzar ,Abu Ya'ala ,Tabrani , ۞ Jannat ki Aurto'n v Hooro'n Ka Libaas, Hazrat Abu Huraira Raziyallahu Anhu farmate hai'n k Janabe Rasulallah Sallallahu Alaihivasallam ne irshad farmaya - "__.......Jannat Ki Khatoon ka ek Dupatta Duniya aur is jesi aur Duniya se zyada qeemti hai _," Musnad Ahmad ,2 483 Abu Naiem ,59 Hazrat Abdullah bin Masoud Raziyallahu Anhu se Rivayat hai k Janabe Rasulallah Sallallahu Alaihivasallam irshad farmate hai'n - "__Pehli Jama'at Jo Jannat mai dakhil hogi unke Chehre chohdhvi raat ke chaand Ki tarah chamakte honge aur Doosri Jama'at Asmaan mai Khoob chamakne wale sitaare Ki tarah bahut zyada chamakne wale ( Chehro Ki ) hogi , Unme se har ek ke liye Hoore'n mai se Do Do Biviya'n hongi , Har Bivi per Sattar poshaake hongi Fir bhi unki Pindliyo ka gooda unke gosht ( ke andar se ) aur Poshako ke andar se Aashkaar hota hoga Jese k Surkh Sharaab Safed Sheeshe mai Nazar aati hai ," . Tabrani Kabeer ,10 198 Musnad Ahmad ,3 16 ,Tirmizi ,2522 ۞ Jannatiyo Ke Zever , "Allah Ta'ala un logo ko Jo imaan laye aur unhone Nek kaam kiye ( Bahisht ke )ese baago mai dakhil karega Jinke niche nehre jaari hongi ( aur ) unko waha'n Sone ke kangan aur Moti pehnaye jayenge aur Poshaak unki waha'n Resham hogi _," Surah Hajj 23_ Hazrat Abu Saied Khudri Raziyallahu Anhu se Rivayat hai k Janabe Rasulallah Sallallahu Alaihivasallam ne Wa jannaate Adn tilawat tilawat kar ke irshad farmaya - "__Un Jannatiyo per Taaj honge Un ( per jade hue motiyo'n ) mai se adna moti mashriq aur Magrib Ki musafat jitna chamakta hoga _," Ba-hawala Tirmizi ,2562 ,Musnad Ahmad ,3 175 Hazrat Abu Huraira Raziyallahu Anhu farmate hai'n k Janabe Rasulallah Sallallahu Alaihivasallam ne irshad farmaya - "__Agar Adna darje ke zever wale Jannati ke zever ko tamaam Duniya walo ke zever se muqabla kiya jaye to Jo Zever Allah Ta'ala us jaanati ko Akhirat mai pehnayenge WO tamaam Duniya walo ke zevero se Afzal hoga _," Ba Hawala Majmauz Zawa'id ,10 401 Durre Mansoor ,5 235 Hazrat Ka'ab Ahbaab Reh. farmate hai'n k Allah Ta'ala ka ek fariahta hai Jo Jannat walo ke liye Jab se WO paida hua hai qayamat tak zever taiyaar karta rahega ,Agar Jannat Walo ke Zevero mai se koi zever ( Duniya mai ) zaahir kar diya jaye to Suraj Ki Roshni ko maand kar de _," . Safatul Jannah ibne Abi Addunya ,218 , ۞ Zannati Ka Kangan Suraj se zyada Roshan , Hazrat Sa'ad bin Abi Waqaas Raziyallahu Anhu se Rivayat hai k Janabe Rasulallah Sallallahu Alaihivasallam ne irshad farmaya - "__Agar Jannatiyo se koi Aadmi ( Duniya mai ) jhaank le aur uska Kangan zaahir ho jaye to WO Suraj Ki Roshni ko be-noor kar de ,Jese Suraj Sitaaro Ki Roshni ko be-noor kar deta hai ," Safatul Jannat ibne Abid Dunya ,220 ,Durre Mansoor ,221 Sunan Tirmizi ,2538 Aurto'n se Zyada Mardo'n Ko Zever Khoobsurat lagenge , Hazrat Hasan Basri Reh .farmate hai'n k Jannat ke Zever Aurto'n Ki ba-nisbat Mardo'n ko zyada khoobsurat lagenge , Safatul Jannat ibne Abid Dunya ,219 ,Nihaya ibne Kaseer 2 442 Kholdaar Moti Ka Mahal, Hazrat Abdullah bin Qais Ash'ari Raziyallahu Anhu se Rivayat hai k Janabe Rasulallah Sallallahu Alaihivasallam ne irshad farmaya - "__( Jannati Ke liye ) Ek Khaima Kholdaar Moti ka hoga Jiski Lambaai saath meel hogi , Uske har Kone mai Momin Ki koi na koi Bivi hogi Jisko Doosri Biviya'n ( aur Khidmatgaar ladke aur Naukraniya nahi dekhti hogi ) _ Bukhari ,4 142 -143 Muslim ,4 2182 Tazkiratul Qurtubi ,2 467 Faayda _ Ye Ek hi Moti se Taiyaar Shuda ek Kholdaar Mahal hoga Jisme Jannati ke liye Aish v Nishaat ka Samaan mayassar hoga , Jannat Ke Haseen Manazir, 303 ۞ Jannat mai Neend Nahi Hogi , Hazrat Jaabir bin Abdullah Raziyallahu Anhu farmate hai'n k Janabe Rasulallah Sallallahu Alaihivasallam se sawal kiya gaya k Kya Jannati log soyenge bhi ? To Aap Sallallahu Alaihivasallam ne irshad farmaya - Neend maut Ki Bhai hai isliye Jannat wale nahi soyenge _," Zuhad imaam Ahmad ,15 Majmauz Zawa'id, 10 415 Hazrat Abdullah bin Abi Awfi Raziyallahu Anhu farmate hai'n k ek Shakhs ne arz kiya - Ya Rasulallah ! Neend ek esi ni'amat hai Jisse Duniya mai hamari Aankhe thandi hoti hai , to kya Jannat mai Neend bhi hogi ? To Aap Sallallahu Alaihivasallam ne irshad farmaya -Nahi ( Neend nahi aayegi ) Kyunki Neend maut Ki shareek hai aur Jannat mai maut nahi hogi ( balki ) Hume Jannat mai na to koi takleef pahunchegi aur na usme Hume koi khastgi pahunchegi , . Al Badro Saafrah ,2196 Ba hawala ibne Abi Haatim v Bahyqi ,489 , Durre Mansoor ,5 254 ۞ Jannat mai Sab Kuchh Milega, Allah Ta'ala irshad farmate hai'n - "__Jin logo ne ( Dil se ) iqraar kar liya k hamara Rab ( Haqeeqi sirf ) Allah hai ( matlab ye k Shirk chhod kar Toheed akhtyar kar li ) fir ( is per ) mustaqeem rahe ( Yani isko chhoda nahi ) un per ( Allah Ki taraf se Rahmat v Basharat ke ) farishte utrenge ( Avval ) maut ke waqt ,Fir qabr mai ,Fir qayamat mai , __Ye kahenge k tum ( Ahvaal Akhirat se ) koi andesha na karo aur na ( Duniya chhodne per ) ranj karo aur ( balki ) tum Jannat ke milne per khush raho Jiska Tumse Vaada kiya jaya karta tha , __Hum Tumhare Rafeeq they Duniyavi Zindgi mai bhi aur Akhirat mai bhi Rafeeq rahenge , Aur Tumhare liye is ( Jannat ) mai Jis cheez ko tumhara Ji chahega mojood hai aur neez Tumhare liye isme Jo maangoge mojood hai ,( yani Jo kuchh zubaan se maangoge WO to milega ho balki maangne Ki bhi zarurat na hogi ) Jis cheez ko tumhara Dil chahega mojood hogi ye bator mehmani ke hoga Gafoorur Raheem Ki taraf se , ( Yani ye ni'amate ikraam v aizaaz ke saath is tarah milengi jis tarah Mehmaan ko milti hai ) ," Surah Hameem Sajda ,30-31-32, Hazrat Ataa bin Maysarah Reh farmate hai'n k Jannati Hazraat mai se Jo Jannati Apne Mahal se niklega aur Kisi darakht ya Nahar ko dekh kar ye chahega k usko is jagah nahi hona chahiye, Abhi usne ye baat zubaan se nahi nikaali hogi balki Dil hi mai hogi magar Allah Ta'ala us ( darakht ya Nahar vagera ) ko wahi muntaqil kar denge Jaha'n WO pasand karta hoga , . Safatul Jannat Abu Naiem, 2 127 Kya Jannat Ki Ni'amate Duniya Ke mushabe Hogi , Hazrat Ibne Abbaas Raziyallahu Anhu farmate hai'n k Jaanat mai koi cheez Duniya Ki cheez ke mushabe nahi hogi Sirf Naamo mai mushabhat hogi , Abu Naiem ,124 Tafseer ibne Kaseer ,1 91 Hazrat Mujahid Reh farmate hai'n k Jannat Ki cheeze dekhne mai ek doosri se milti julti hongi magar zaayqa mai mukhtalif hongi , Abu Naiem ,126 Tafseer Tibri ,1 173 ۞ Haseen v Dilkash Awaaz mai Daowd Alaihissalam Ki Hamd Sunenge, ( Hazrat Daowd Alaihissalam Ke liye Hamare Paas qurb ka martaba hai aur Laut jane ki behtreen jagah hai ) is Aayat ki Tafseer mai Hazrat Maalik bin Dinaar Reh farmate hai'n qayamat ke Din Hazrat Daowd Alaihissalam ko arsh ke paaye ke paas khada kiya jayega aur Unko Hukm diya jayega k Ey Daowd ! Us Haseen aur Narm v Naazuk awaaz mai meri buzurgi bayan karo Jis tarah se Duniya mai Bayan kiya karte they , WO arz karenge - Ey Rab Kese hamd karu Aapne to meri Khush ilhani waapas le li hai ? To Allah Ta'ala farmayenge mai usko aaj fir waapas karta hu'n , Chunache Hazrat Daowd Alaihissalam esi esi awaaz ke saath Hamd ada karenge K Jannat ki ni'amato ko bhi bhula denge , Note - Hazrat Daowd Alaihissalam Jannat mai bhi Khoobsurat Awaaz mai Allah Ta'ala ki tasbeeh v tehleel baja layenge , . Zuhad imaam Ahmad v Hakeem Tirmizi v ibne Abi haatim ( Durre Mansoor, 5 305 ) Haadi Al Ravaah ,327 ۞ Ladkiyo'n Ki Awaaz mai Tarana Hamd, Hazrat Saied bin Juber reh. farmate hai'n k Hazrat ibne Abbaas Raziyallahu Anhu ne farmaya - Tum Humse sawal karo Kyunki tum humse kisi esi cheez ka sawal nahi karoge magar humne uske baare mai poochh rakha hai , To ek Shakhs ne arz kiya - Kya Jannat mai nagma sarayi hogi ? Aapne farmaya - Kastoori ke koze honge Jinke paas ladkiya'n hongi Jo Allah Ta'ala ki esi awaaz mai buzurgi bayan karengi k unki misl kaano ne kabhi nahi suni hogi , Al Ba'as Wal Nusoor ,422 ,Al Badro Safrah ,2091 ۞ Darakht Ki Tarannum Ke Saath Tasbeeh v Taqdees , Hazrat Abu Huraira Raziyallahu Anhu farmate hai'n k ek Shakhs ne arz kiya - Ya Rasulallah ! Kya Jannat mai geet hoga ? Kyunki mai'n geet ko pasand karta hu'n , Aap Sallallahu Alaihivasallam ne irshad farmaya - Mujhe qasam hai us zaat ki jiske qabze mai meri jaan hai Allah Ta'ala Jannat ke darakht ki taraf paygaam bhejenge k mere in Bando ko Jinhone Apne Aapko baaju aur gaano ke bajaye ( Duniya mai ) mere zikr ke saath masroof rakha to inko esi awaaz mai unko ESE tarannum mai Tasbeeh v Taqdees suna k esi makhlooqaat ne kabhi na suni ho , Targeeb v Tarheeb , Durre Mansoor ,5 153 Darakht se Khoobsurat Awaaz kese Paida hogi _ Hazrat Abu Huraira Raziyallahu Anhu Anhu farmate hai'n k Janabe Rasulallah Sallallahu Alaihivasallam ne irshad farmaya - Jannat mai ek darakht jiske tane sone ke honge aur Shaakhe zabarjad aur lo lo ki hongi Us per Hawa chalegi to WO ( Shaakhe ) Harkat mai aayengi ( usko ) sunne wale isse zyada lazeez koi Awaaz nahi sunenge , . Abu Naiem ,433, Al Badro Safrah ,2098, Haadi Al Ravaah ,323 , Targeeb v Tarheeb ,4 523 ۞ Duniya Mai Gaane Baaje Wale Jannat Ke Tarano se Mehroom, Hazrat Abu Moosa Ash'ari Raziyallahu Anhu farmate hai'n k Janabe Rasulallah Sallallahu Alaihivasallam ne irshad farmaya "__Jo Shakhs Gaane Ki awaaz Sunega Usko Roohaniyo ki khush alhani sunne ki ijazat nahi di jayegi , Sahaba Kiraam Raziyallahu Anhum ne arz kiya Ya Rasulallah ! Roohaniyo kon hai ? Aap Sallallahu Alaihivasallam ne irshad farmaya - ( Ye ) Jannat Walo ( ke saamne ) Qur'an padhne wale ( farishte ) hai'n , Al Badro Safrah , 2101 ,Durre Mansoor ,5 153 Kanzul Ummaal ,40660 ,Tafseer Qurtubi ,14 54 Tabai Mufassir Muhaddis Hazrat Mujahid Reh farmate hai'n k qayamat ke Din ek munadi Nida karega k WO log kaha hai'n Jo Apni Awaazo ko aur Apne Kaano ko Fizuliyaat aur Shaitaan ke bajoo se mehfooz rakhte they ? Farmaya k Fir Allah Ta'ala un Hazraat ko kastoori ke baag mai Rukhsat kar denge aur Farishto se farmayenge k Tum mere ( in ) Bando ke saamne meri hamd aur buzurgi bayan karo aur unko ye khush khabri suna do k un per koi khof ki baat nahi aur na hi koi gam ki baat hai , . Al Badro Safrah , 2100 ,Durre Mansoor ,5 153 ۞ Jannat Ke Husn mai izaafa hota Rahega, Hazrat Ka'ab Reh.farmate hai'n k Allah Ta'ala Jan bhi Jannat Ki taraf Nazar farmate hai'n to Hukm dete hai'n k , "_Tu Apne Makeeno ke liye aur Pakeeza aur Umdah ho ja , To Woh Husn v Pakeezgi mai aur Umdah ho jati hai Hattaki Jannati usme dakhil ho jaye _," Abu Naiem ,21 Haadi Al Ravaah, 483 ۞ Ahle Jannat Ko Sirf Ek Hasrat Hogi, Hazrat Mu'az bin Jabal Raziyallahu Anhu farmate hai'n k Janabe Rasulallah Sallallahu Alaihivasallam ne irshad farmaya - "__Ahle Jannat ko kisi Qism ki hasrat Nahi hogi magar us ghadi per WO Hasrat karte rahenge Jo unko ( Duniya mai ) haasil hogi magar usme unhone Allah ko yaad nahi kiya tha , Al Badro Safrah ,2192 Ba hawala - Tabrani v Bahyqi , Hazrat Abu Huraira Raziyallahu Anhu se Rivayat hai k Janabe Rasulallah Sallallahu Alaihivasallam ne irshad farmaya - "__Jo Qaum Kisi majlis mai beth ti hai lekin usme Allah Ta'ala ka zikr nahi karti aur Janabe Kareem Sallallahu Alaihivasallam per Darood Shareef nahi bhejti to ye ( majlis ) qayamat ke Din un per hasrat ka baa'is hogi ( K haay agar is majlis mai zikr ya Darood Shareef padhte to Aaj uska bhi inaam milta ) aur agar WO Jannat mai dakhil ho jayenge to ( uske Sawab paane ki Hasrat karenge ), . Al Badro Safrah, 2193 Musnad Ahmad ,2 463 ,Tirmizi 3380 ۞ Jannat Ke Mahallaat- , Nabi ,Siddiq aur Shaheed Ka Mahal Hazrat Umar bin Khattaab Raziyallahu Anhu farmate hai'n k Janabe Rasulallah Sallallahu Alaihivasallam ne irshad farmaya - "_Jannat mai ek Mahal esa hai Jisme Sivaye Nabi ya Siddiq ya Shaheed Ya Aadil Hukmraan ke koi dakhil nahi ho sakega, To Hazrat Umar Raziyallahu Anhu ne farmaya - "__Jo Allah Chahe ,Nabuwat ko to Allah ne ( Aap Sallallahu Alaihivasallam per )tamaam kar diya hai aur Shahadat to WO mere Naseeb mai kaha'n ( Lekin Hazrat Umar Shaheed bhi hue they ) aur imaam Aadil to agar Allah Ta'ala ne chaha , To Aap Sallallahu Alaihivasallam ne Dua farmayi ," Ey Allah ! Umar ko bhi ye Mahal ata farma ," . Wasful Firdaus ,(25) safa ,13 Ek Mahal mai 40 Mahallaat , Hazrat Abu Huraira Raziyallahu Anhu se Rivayat hai k Janabe Rasulallah Sallallahu Alaihivasallam ne irshad farmaya - "__Momin Ka ghar Jannat mai ek hi chamakdaar moti ka hoga Jisme 40 Mahallaat honge Unke darmiyan mai ek darakht hoga Jo Libaas ugayega aur Lo Lo aur Marjaan se ghira hua hoga , Wasful Firdaus,( 26) safa 13 , Momin Ke Mahal Ki Shaan,, Hasan Basri Reh se Rivayat hai k Janabe Rasulallah Sallallahu Alaihivasallam ne irshad farmaya - "__Jannat Ke Mahallaat mai har musalman ke liye no Mahal honge ,Ek Mahal Chaandi ka hoga Jiske Kangoore sone ke honge , Ek Mahal Sone ka hoga Jiske Kangoore Chaandi ke honge , Ek Mahal Lo Lo ( moti ) ka hoga Jiske Kangoore yaqoot ke honge , Ek Mahal Yaqoot ka hoga Jiske kangaroo Lo Lo ke honge , Ek Mahal zabar jad ka hoga Jiske Kangaroo yaqoot ke honge , Ek Mahal Yaqoot ka hoga Jiske Kangaroo Zabar jad ke honge , Ek Mahal ese noor ka hoga k ( Duniyavi ) aankhe uske nazare ki taab nahi rakhti aur Ek Mahal arsh ke rang ki tarah ka hai aur har Mahal Aath Aath so kilometre mai hai aur unme se har ek Mahal ke hazaar darwaze ke pat hai'n ," Wasful Firdaus, (31) safa 14, Hazrat Lais bin Abdullah bin Jaafar se Rivayat hai k Janabe Rasulallah Sallallahu Alaihivasallam ne irshad farmaya - "__Jannat Ke Mahallaat ka Zaahiri hissa surkh sone ka hai aur unka andaruni hissa sabz zabar jad ka hai ,Unke Gumbad Yaqoot ke hai'n aur Kangaroo moti ke hai'n , Wasful Firdaus, (30) safa 14, ۞ Huzoor Akram Sallallahu Alaihivasallam Ke Liye Ek Hazaar Mahallaat, irshade baari Ta'ala " Aur Akhirat Aap ke liye Duniya se ba-darjaha behtar hai ," ( Surah Addhuha 5 ) iski Tafseer mai Hazrat Abdullah bin Abbaas Raziyallahu Anhu farmate hai'n k , "__Allah Ta'ala Huzoor Akram Sallallahu Alaihivasallam ko Jannat mai Lo lo ke ek Hazaar Mahallaat ataa farmayenge Jinki Mitti Kastoori ki hogi aur Har Mahal ke liye Zaibo Zeenat Asaa'ish v Araam ki Sab cheeze mojood hongi ," . Wasful Firdaus, (35) safa 15 ,Tafseer ibne Abi Sheeba ( 15827) ,Tafseer Tabree ,30 128 ۞ Ibrahim Alaihissalam aur Hazrat Umar Raziyallahu Anhu Ka Mahal, Hazrat Abu Huraira Raziyallahu Anhu se Rivayat hai k Janabe Rasulallah Sallallahu Alaihivasallam ne irshad farmaya - "__Jannat mai Lo Lo ka ek Mahal hai Jisme na to koi fatan hai aur na ( Tameer ki )koi kamzori hai , isko Allah Ta'ala ne Apne Khaleel Hazrat Ibrahim Alaihissalam ke liye Taiyaar farmaya hai ," Safatul Jannat ibne Abiddunya ,(171) ,Haadi Al Ravaah ,193,Majmauz Zawa'id, 8 201 Hazrat Jaabir bin Abdullah Raziyallahu Anhu farmate hai'n k Janabe Rasulallah Sallallahu Alaihivasallam ne irshad farmaya - "__Maine Khud ko dekha k Jannat mai dakhil hua hu'n aur ek Mahal dekha jiske Sahan mai ek Ladki mojood thi ,Maine puchha ye Mahal kiska hai ? To unhone bataya k Umar bin Khattaab Raziyallahu Anhu ka hai to Maine chaha k isme dakhil ho kar dekhu magar mujhe tumhari gairat yaad aa gayi _" To Hazrat Umar Raziyallahu Anhu ne arz kiya - mere Maa'n Baap Aap per qurban Ya Rasulallah Mai'n Aap per gairat khaunga ? . Safatul Jannat ibne Abiddunya ,( 173) ,Sahih Bukhari ( 3679, 5262,7024) ۞ Ek Arab Hooren Wala Mahal , Hazrat Umar bin Khattaab Raziyallahu Anhu ne Ye Aayat Padhi ," Jannaati Adn " fir farmaya - "__Jannat mai ek ( Qism ka ) Mahal hai Jiske Chaar Hazaar Darwaze ke Pat hai'n , Har Darwaze per Pachchees Hazaar Hooren hai'n , isme koi dakhil nahi ho sakega magar Nabi , _Fir Farmaya - Ya Rasulallah Aapko Mubarak ho , Ya Siddiq Dakhil hoga , Fir farmaya ,Ey Abu Bakar Aapko bhi Mubarak ho ,Ya Shaheed dakhil hoga magar Umar ke liye Shahadat ka rutba kaha'n , Fir Farmaya - WO zaat jisne mujhe ( Kufr ki ) Badhaali se nikaala WO is per bhi qaadir hai k mujhe Shahadat ka Rutba ataa farmaye ( Chunache Aapki ye tamanna bhi poori hui aur Aap Shahadat ke rutbe per faa'iz hue ) , Safatul Jannat Abid Duniya ,174 , Musannif ibne Abi Sheeba ,15879, Kitabul Zuhad ibne Mubarak ,535 ,Kanzul Ummaal, 7 275 ۞ Mahallaat Ki Mitti aur Pahaad, Hazrat Mugees bin Sami Reh .farmate hai'n - "__Jannat mai Kuchh Mahallaat Sone ke hai'n aur Kuchh Mahallaat Zabar Jad Ke hai'n, Unke Pahaad Kastoori Ke hai'n aur Mitti Wars ( Ek Qism Ki Ghaas Jo Kapda rangne ke kaam aati hai ) aur Zafraan ki hai _," Musannif ibne Abi Sheeba ,13 124 , Safatul Jannat ibne Abid Duniya ,(177) Haadi al Ravaah, 194 Mahallaat Ki Chhato Ka Noor, Ek Hadees mai Vaarid hai k Jannat ki baaz Chhate ( Roof ) ese noor ki hongi Jo Aankho ko chundhiya dene wali Bijli ki tarah chamakti hogi , Agar Allah Ta'ala Jannatiyo ki nigaaho ki Hifazat na kare to WO Bijli unki Aankho ko uchak le _," . Safatul Jannat ibne Kaseer ,51 ۞ Jannat Ke Baala Khaane, Allah Ta'ala irshad farmate hai'n ," Lekin Jo log Apne Rab se darte rahe unke liye ( Jannat ke ) Baala Khaane mai hai'n Jinke ouper Baala Khaane hai'n Jo bane banaye Taiyaar hai'n ," ( Surah Az-Zumar 20 ) Hazrat Ali Raziyallahu Anhu farmate hai'n k Janabe Rasulallah Sallallahu Alaihivasallam ne irshad farmaya - "_Jannat mai kuchh ese Baala Khaane hai'n k unka Baahar Andar se aur Andar Baahar se Nazar aayega , Ek Dehati ne khade ho kar kaha - Ya Rasulallah ! Ye kiske liye honge ? Aap Sallallahu Alaihivasallam ne irshad farmaya, uske Liye Jo Paakiza guftgu karega aur Khaana khilayega aur Hamesha Roza rakhega aur Us waqt jab log sote ho ye raat ke waqt Namaz padhega ," Tirmizi ,1984 , Haadi Al Ravaah ,191 is Hadees ki Tashreeh darje zel Hadees ke saath kuchh is tarah se hai k Janabe Rasulallah Sallallahu Alaihivasallam ne irshad farmaya k Jannat mai kuchh ESE Baala Khaane honge k jab uska makeen uske andar hoga to usko iska koi khof nahi hoga k uske pichhe kya hai ( kyunki uske andar se baahar Nazar aata hoga ) aur Agar uske Bahar hoga to usko iska khof nahi hoga k Andar ( Baala Khaane mai ) kya hai , ( Kyunki usko Baala Khaane ke baahar se Baala Khaane ka andaruni hissa Nazar aata hoga ), __Arz kiya gaya Ya Rasulallah ! Ye kinke liye honge ? Aapne irshad farmaya ," Jo Achche Bol bolega ,musalsal Roze rakhega aur Khaana Khilayega ,Salaam ko felayega aur Namaz padhega Jab log so rahe ho , Arz kiya gaya ,achchhe bol kya hai ? Irshad farmaya , Subhanallaahi Walhamdulillaahi Wa Laailaha illallaahu Wallaahu Akbar , Kyunki ye kalmaat qayamat ke Din is haalat mai aayenge k kuchh aage honge aur pehluo'n mai aur Kuchh pichhe , Arz kiya gaya musalsal Roze rakhna kese hai ? Aapne irshad farmaya, " WO Shakhs Jo Maahe Ramzan ke Roze rakhega fir uske baad ek aur maahe ramazan paya to uske bhi Roze rakhe ," ( is tarah har aane wale Ramzan Ke Roze raha ye musalsal Roze rakhna Hai ) , Arz kiya gaya ,Khaana khilana kya hai ? Irshad farmaya, Jisne Apne Baal Bachcho ki Hifazat ki aur unko khilata raha , Arz kiya gaya ,Salaam felana kya hai ? Irshad farmaya, " Apne Bhai ( musalman ) se musafa karna aur Salaam karna ," Arz kiya gaya, Jab Log Sote ho us waqt ki Namaz kya hai ? Irshad farmaya, " Isha Ki Namaz ( Padhna ) ," . Al Ba'as Wal Nushoor ( 280) ,Ibne Adi ,2 795 , Tareekh Bagdaad ,4 178 ,179 ,Hila Abu Naiem ,2 356 ۞ 70 Hazaar Baala Khaane, Hazrat Abdullah ibne Masoud Raziyallahu Anhu se Rivayat hai k Janabe Rasulullah Sallallahu Alaihivasallam ne irshad farmaya - "__Allah Ki Razajoi mai Aapas mai muhabbat karne wale ( Musalman ) surkh Yaqoot ke ek Sutoon per faa'iz honge ,Us Sutoon ke sire per Sattar Hazaar Baala Khaane honge , Unka Husn Jannat walo ke liye esa Roshan hoga Jese Duniya walo ke liye Suraj chamakta hai, Jannati Ek Doosre se kahenge hamare Saath chalo taki hum Allah Ta'ala ke liye aapas mai muhabbat Karne Walo Ki ziyarat kar aaye , Pas Jab ye log unko jhaank kar dekhenge to unka Husn Jannat Walo ke saamne ese chamkega Jis tarah se Suraj Duniya walo ke liye chamakta hai , __Un per Sandas ka sabz libaas hoga ,unki peshaniyo per likha hoga " Ye log Allah Ta'ala Ki Raza aur muhabbat Ki talash ke liye aapas mai muhabbat karte they , Tazkiratul Qurtubi ,2 464 ,Zuhad Ibne Mubarak ,522 ۞ Jannat Ke Khaime, Hazrat Abu Moosa Ash'ari Raziyallahu Anhu se Rivayat hai k Janabe Rasulullah Sallallahu Alaihivasallam ne irshad farmaya - "__Jannat mai momin ke liye ek hi moti ka ek Kholdaar Khaima hoga Jiski Lambaai Saath meel tak hogi , Usme Momin Ki Biviya'n hongi , Momin Un sab ke paas Jaa kar Sohbat karega , Biviya'n ek doosre ko ( is haalat mai ) nahi dekh sakegi ," Bukhari , Muslim ,2838 ,Haadi Al Ravaah ,275 ,Targeeb ,4 116 ,Mishkaat ,5616 ,Kanzul Ummaal ,39297 ,39275 Ye Khaime Na to Baala Khane honge aur na mahallaat balki ye bagaat mai aur Nehro ke Kinaare per qaa'im kiye gaye honge , Haadi Al Ravaah ,275 Hazrat Abu Suleman ( Darani ) Reh farmate hai'n Hooren az sar no paida Ki jati hai Jab uski takhleeq mukammal ho jati hai to Farishte un per Khaime nasb kar dete hai'n , . Safatul Jannat ibne Abid Duniya ,311 ۞ Khaime Kaise Honge, Hazrat Ayesha Raziyallahu Anha farmati hai'n k maine arz kiya Ya Rasulallah ! Maine suna Allah Ta'ala irshad farmate hai'n ," Hooren hongi Khaimo mai Thehri hui ," Ye Khaime kya hai'n ? "__Mujhe us zaat Ki qasam hai Jiske qabze mai meri jaan hai Jannat ke khaimo mai se ek khaima ek hi Gohar ka hoga andar se kholdaar Battees kilometer lamba Battees Kilometer choda ( Yani Lambaai aur Chodaai barabar hogi ) Yaqoot aur Zabar jad ka ( Us Khaime ko ) taaj pehnaya gaya hoga , Uske Sone ke Sattar Darwaze honge ," . Wasful Firdaus ,(38) safa 16, ۞ Qubba, Hazrat Abu Saied Khudri Raziyallahu Anhu se Rivayat hai k Janabe Rasulullah Sallallahu Alaihivasallam ne irshad farmaya - "__Adna darje ke Jannati ka martaba ye hoga k uske liye ek Qubba lo lo aur Yaqoot aur Zabar jad ka tiyaar kiya jayega ( Jo Taveel mai ) Jaabiya se San'a Jitna hoga ," Faayda _ Jaabiya mulke Shaam mai Mashhoor Shahar Damishq ke qareeb ek Shahar hai aur San'a Mulke Yaman ka Darul Khilafa hai , Wasful Firdaus (37) Safatul Jannat ibne Abid Duniya (206) ,Majmuaz Zawa'id (10 401),Targeeb v Tarheeb ( 4 508) ۞ Resham Ke Bistar , Allah Ta'ala irshad farmate hai'n - "( Aur )WO log ( Jannat mai ) Takiya lagaye ESE Farsho ( Bichhono aur Bistaro ) per bethe honge jinke Astar mote resham ke honge , ( Aur qa'ada hai k ouper ka kapda banisbat astar ke zyada nafees hota hai ,Pas jab astar mote resham ka hoga to ouper ka kesa Kuchh hoga ), __Surah Ar Rahman 54 Faayda _ Aayat se maloom hua k Jannat ke bichhone Ki shakl ye hogi k uska nichla hissa mote resham ka hoga aur ouper ka hissa usse zyada nafees aur zeenat mai zyada badh kar hoga , Haadi Al Ravaah - 269, Haakim -6 475, Safatul jannat ibne abid duniya - 155 ,Targeeb v Tarheeb -4 531, Hazrat Saied Reh .farmate hai'n k unka zahiri ( ouper wala ) hissa Noor ka hoga , Safatul Jannat ibne Abid Duniya- 156, Abu Naiem -4 286, Hazrat Abu Umama Raziyallahu Anhu farmate hai'n k agar us bichhone ke ouper wala hissa giraya jaye to uske nichle hisse tak 40 Saal tak na pahunche _, Safatul Janbat ibne Abid

Lekin kya aap jante hain ki aapko hamesha physical card sath rakhne ki zarurat nahi hai? Aap e-Aadhaar ka istemal kar sakte hain. What is e-Aadhaar? (e-Aadhaar Kya Hai?) Ye aapke physical Aadhaar card ki ek password-protected electronic copy hai, jise UIDAI ke competent authority dwara digitally sign kiya jata hai. Aadhaar Act ke mutabiq, e-Aadhaar physical copy ke barabar hi valid mana jata hai. Aadhaar Card Download Kaise Karein? (Online Process) Agar aapka Aadhaar card kho gaya hai ya aapke paas physical copy nahi hai, to ghabrayein nahi. Aap niche diye gaye aasaan steps ko follow karke 2 minute mein apna e-Aadhaar PDF download kar sakte hain. Official Website Upar diye gaye orange color ke Download Now button par click karein. Enter Details Yahan aapke paas 3 option honge Aadhaar Number, Enrolment ID (EID), ya Virtual ID (VID). Apna 12-digit Aadhaar number dalein. Captcha Verification Screen par dikh raha security code (Captcha) dhyan se bharein. OTP Verification Send OTP button dabayein. Aapke registered mobile number par ek 6-digit ka OTP aayega. Verify Download OTP enter karein aur Verify Download par click karein. Aapka e-Aadhaar PDF format mein download ho jayega. e-Aadhaar PDF Password Kya Hota Hai? Bahut se log Aadhaar download to kar lete hain lekin PDF khul nahi pati kyunki wo password-protected hoti hai. Iska password bahut simple hota hai. Retrieve UID EID How to Retrieve Lost Aadhaar Number (UID) or Enrolment ID (EID) Have you lost your physical Aadhaar card and cannot remember your 12-digit Aadhaar number? Or perhaps you have applied for a new Aadhaar card but lost the acknowledgement slip containing the Enrolment ID (EID)? Do not worry. The Retrieve Aadhaar number EID SID service allows you to recover these details online instantly. This feature is a lifesaver for those who have misplaced their documents and need to download their e-Aadhaar urgent. By using this facility, your lost Aadhaar number or EID is sent directly to your registered mobile number. Important Prerequisite To use this online facility, your Mobile Number or Email ID MUST be registered and linked with your Aadhaar. If your mobile number is not linked, you cannot receive the OTP required for retrieval. Difference Between UID and EID Term Full Form Description UID Unique ID This is your final 12-digit Aadhaar Number . Select this if you already had a card. EID Enrolment ID This is the 28-digit number from your acknowledgement slip (for new applications). Step-by-Step Process to Retrieve Lost Aadhaar (UID) Visit the Official Portal Click on the Retrieve UID EID button above to open the official page. Select Retrieval Option Choose Aadhaar Number to find your main ID or Enrolment ID if you are tracking a new application. Enter Personal Details Enter your Full Name exactly as it is printed on your Aadhaar card. Enter Contact Info Captcha Enter your Registered Mobile Number or Email ID, fill the Captcha, and click Send OTP . Get SMS After OTP verification, your Aadhaar Number (UID) or EID will be sent to your mobile via SMS. Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs) Q Can I retrieve my Aadhaar if I don t have my mobile number? Ans No, the online facility works strictly via OTP. If your mobile is not linked, you must visit an Aadhaar Enrollment Center with your identity proof. Q Is there any fee for this service? Ans No, the Retrieve Aadhaar EID service is completely free of cost on the myAadhaar portal. Verify Mobile Email Not sure which mobile number is linked to your Aadhaar? Verify it instantly to ensure you receive OTPs for all government services. Verify Now How to Verify Mobile Number Email Linked with Aadhaar In today s digital India, your Registered Mobile Number is the key to accessing almost all Aadhaar services. Whether you want to download your e-Aadhaar, update your address online, or verify your ITR, the OTP (One Time Password) is sent to this linked number. However, people often change their SIM cards or forget which mobile number they gave at the time of enrollment years ago. The Verify Email Mobile service on the myAadhaar portal solves this confusion. It allows you to check if the mobile number or email ID you currently possess is the one linked to your Aadhaar database. ℹ Important Clarification This service does NOT show you the mobile number linked to your Aadhaar (for privacy reasons). Instead, YOU have to enter a mobile number, and the system will tell you if it matches the records or not. It is a verification tool, not a search tool. Step-by-Step Process to Verify Mobile Number Follow this simple procedure to confirm your linked contact details Access the Service Click on the green Verify Now button above. Select Verification Type You will see two options Verify Mobile Number and Verify Email Address . Select the one you want to check. Enter Details First, enter your 12-digit Aadhaar Number . Then, enter the Mobile Number (or Email) that you think is linked. Security Check Enter the Captcha code exactly as shown in the image box. Send OTP Click on the Send OTP button. Check the Result The system will display a success or error message based on your input (explained below). Understanding the Result Messages After submitting, you will see one of these two messages. Here is what they mean Scenario 1 Match Found (Success) The mobile number you have entered is already verified with our records. Meaning Congratulations! The mobile number you typed IS the one linked to your Aadhaar. You can receive OTPs on this number. Scenario 2 No Match (Failure) The mobile number you have entered does not match with our records. Meaning The number you typed is NOT linked. Either you linked a different family member s number, or an old number that you have lost. Why is this Verification Important? 1. Fraud Prevention Ensuring that no unknown mobile number or email is linked to your ID protects your biometric and demographic data. 2. Banking Services To link Aadhaar with a bank account or PAN card, the OTP validation is mandatory. Verifying ensures you are using the correct SIM. 3. Updates You cannot update your address or download Aadhaar online if you don t know which number receives the OTP. Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs) Q The system says Record not found . What should I do? Ans This means the mobile number you are entering is incorrect. Try entering mobile numbers of your family members. If none match, you must visit an Aadhaar Seva Kendra to check or update your number. Q Can I update my mobile number using this service? Ans No. This service is only for verification . To update or change your mobile number, biometric authentication is required, which can only be done offline at a center. Report Death Deactivate Aadhaar Secure the identity of your deceased family member. Officially report the death to UIDAI to prevent misuse of documents. Report Now How to Report Death of a Family Member for Aadhaar Deactivation The Aadhaar card is a unique identity proof that remains valid for a lifetime. However, in the unfortunate event of a family member s demise, it is the responsibility of the legal heir or guardian to inform the Unique Identification Authority of India (UIDAI). The Report death of a family member service allows you to officially flag an Aadhaar number for deactivation. This is a crucial step to ensure that the deceased person s identity documents are not misused for financial fraud, illegal SIM card issuance, or identity theft. Why is Deactivating Aadhaar Important? Many people often overlook this step, but keeping a deceased person s Aadhaar active can lead to several complications Prevent Misuse Scammers often look for dormant identities to open fake bank accounts or take loans. Subsidies Benefits To prevent the continued transfer of government benefits (like pensions) to a deceased person, which can later lead to legal recovery issues. Closure of Records It helps in closing other linked official documents like PAN Card and Voter ID systematically. Important Requirement To use this service, you MUST have a valid Death Certificate issued by the Registrar of Births and Deaths. The details on the Death Certificate must match the Aadhaar details of the deceased. Procedure to Report Death Online UIDAI has simplified the process by allowing family members to initiate this request via the myAadhaar portal. Follow these steps Login to Portal The reporting family member (Applicant) must login to the myAadhaar portal using their Own Aadhaar Number and OTP. You cannot login using the deceased person s Aadhaar. Select the Service On the dashboard, locate and click on the Report death of a family member card. Enter Details of Deceased Enter the 12-digit Aadhaar Number of the deceased family member. You may also need to provide their Name and Date of Birth as per records. Upload Document Upload a clear scanned copy (PDF JPG) of the Death Certificate . Ensure the file size is within the permissible limit (usually 2MB). Review Submit Verify all the details entered. Once submitted, you will receive a Service Request Number (SRN) to track the status. What Happens Next? (Verification) Reporting the death online does not instantly deactivate the Aadhaar. The request goes through a verification process 1. Registrar Verification The details are cross-verified with the birth and death registration records. 2. Deactivation Once verified, the UIDAI will permanently deactivate the Aadhaar number of the deceased. 3. Confirmation You can check the status using the Check deceased Aadhaar deactivation status service on the same portal. Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs) Q Can anyone report the death? Ans Usually, only immediate family members (spouse, children, parents) whose mobile numbers are linked or who can prove the relationship can initiate this request. Q Is it mandatory to deactivate Aadhaar after death? Ans While there is no strict penalty currently, it is highly recommended for safety and to close the financial and legal footprint of the deceased. Q Can I reactivate the Aadhaar later if reported by mistake? Ans No. Once an Aadhaar is marked as Deceased and deactivated after proper verification, it cannot be reactivated. Proof of Address (PoA) To verify your Current Address. Electricity Bill ( 3 months) Water Bill ( 3 months) Gas Connection Bill Bank Passbook Statement Passport (Address page) Voter ID Step-by-Step Process to Update Documents Online Take advantage of the free window and update your documents from home using these steps Login to myAadhaar Click the Update Now button above and login using your Aadhaar Number OTP. Online vs Offline Update Comparison Feature Online (myAadhaar Portal) Offline (Aadhaar Center) Cost FREE (till 14 06 2026) 50 (Service Charge) Convenience From Home (24 7) Visit Wait in Queue Documents Self Scan Upload Originals Verified by Operator Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs) Q My address has changed. Can I use this service? Ans No. This service is ONLY to upload documents for existing details. To change your address, use the Address Update service. Q What happens if I don t update? Ans Your Aadhaar might get suspended or face difficulties in KYC authentication for banks or ration services. Generate Virtual ID (VID) Protect your privacy! Create a temporary 16-digit Virtual ID to use instead of your Aadhaar Number for authentication. Generate VID VID Generator Create Virtual ID to Hide Aadhaar Number Are you worried about sharing your 12-digit Aadhaar number everywhere? Do you want to protect your privacy while performing e-KYC? The Virtual ID (VID) is the solution. The VID Generator service allows you to create a temporary, revocable 16-digit random number mapped to your Aadhaar number. It can be used in lieu of your Aadhaar number for authentication services. This ensures your actual Aadhaar number remains hidden from the service provider. Privacy Feature When you use a VID, the agency (like a telecom operator or bank) cannot store your Aadhaar number. They only get a UID Token , which makes your data much more secure against leaks. Difference Aadhaar Number vs Virtual ID (VID) Feature Aadhaar Number (UID) Virtual ID (VID) Length 12 Digits (Permanent) 16 Digits (Temporary) Validity Lifetime valid Valid until you generate a new one Security Directly linked to biometric data Masks the actual Aadhaar number How to Generate or Retrieve VID Online You can generate a new VID or retrieve an existing one using the myAadhaar portal. Follow these steps Login to Portal Visit the myAadhaar dashboard by clicking the Generate VID button above. Select VID Generator Click on the VID Generator icon from the services menu. Choose Option You will see two options 1. Generate New VID If you want to create a fresh 16-digit number. 2. Retrieve Existing VID If you already generated one but forgot it. Confirm Receive Select your choice. Your 16-digit Virtual ID will be sent immediately to your Registered Mobile Number via SMS. Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs) Q Is VID accepted everywhere? Ans Yes, as per government regulations, all agencies (Banks, Telecom, Govt) must accept VID for authentication. Q What happens if I generate a new VID? Ans The moment you generate a new VID, your old VID gets automatically cancelled. You can only have one active VID at a time. Q Does VID expire? Ans No, a VID does not expire by itself. It remains valid until you choose to generate a new one. Lock Unlock Aadhaar Worried about identity theft? Temporarily Lock your Biometrics or Aadhaar Number instantly for maximum security. Secure Now Lock Unlock Aadhaar Secure Your Biometrics Instantly Security is a major concern for Aadhaar holders. What if someone gets hold of your Aadhaar number and tries to misuse it? To prevent unauthorized authentication, UIDAI provides a powerful feature Lock Unlock Aadhaar . This service allows you to temporarily Lock your UID (Aadhaar Number). Once locked, no one (not even you) can perform authentication using the Aadhaar number. It acts as a digital shield against identity theft. You can Unlock it whenever you need to use it. MUST READ BEFORE LOCKING Do not lock your Aadhaar without generating a Virtual ID (VID). Once your Aadhaar is locked, you CANNOT use your Aadhaar number to unlock it (because the number itself is locked). You will compulsorily need a 16-digit Virtual ID (VID) to perform the Unlock process. Difference Aadhaar Lock vs Biometric Lock Many people confuse these two services. Here is the difference Feature UID Lock (Aadhaar Lock) Biometric Lock What it blocks? Blocks ALL authentication (Demographic, Biometric, OTP). Blocks ONLY Fingerprint and Iris scan. OTP still works. How to use when locked? You must use Virtual ID (VID) . You must temporarily Unlock biometrics to use fingerprint iris. Security Level Highest (Total Lock) Medium (Protects Biometrics only) Step-by-Step Guide to LOCK Aadhaar Generate VID First As mentioned, ensure you have a valid VID. If not, use the VID Generator service first. Open Lock Service Click the Secure Now button above and select the Lock UID option. Enter Details Enter your 12-digit Aadhaar Number, Full Name, and Pin Code. Verify OTP Enter the security captcha and click Send OTP . Enter the OTP received on your mobile. Confirmation Your Aadhaar Number is now LOCKED. You will not be able to perform authentication using the UID anymore. Step-by-Step Guide to UNLOCK Aadhaar Select Unlock UID Go to the same service page and select the Unlock UID tab. Enter VID (Not Aadhaar Number) Here, you CANNOT enter your Aadhaar number. You must enter your 16-digit Virtual ID (VID) . Verify Unlock Enter the Captcha and OTP. Once verified, your Aadhaar number will be active again. Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs) Q Can I download e-Aadhaar if my UID is locked? Ans Yes, but you will have to use your Virtual ID (VID) to download it, as the Aadhaar number will not be accepted by the system. Q I forgot my VID and my Aadhaar is locked. What do I do? Ans You can use the Retrieve VID service via SMS. Send an SMS RVID Last 4 digits of Aadhaar to 1947 from your registered mobile number. Bank Seeding Status Are you receiving government subsidies? Check if your Aadhaar is successfully linked and mapped with your bank account for Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT). Check Status Bank Seeding Status Check Aadhaar-Bank Linking for DBT Many government schemes in India transfer money directly to beneficiaries bank accounts using the Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) system. This money is sent using the Aadhaar Payment Bridge (APB). For this to work, simply having a bank account is not enough. Your Aadhaar number must be seeded or mapped with that specific bank account in the NPCI (National Payments Corporation of India) database. The Bank Seeding Status service helps you check which of your bank accounts is currently linked to receive government funds. Why is Bank Seeding Essential? If your Bank Seeding Status is Inactive , you will NOT receive funds for PM Kisan Samman Nidhi LPG Gas Subsidy (PAHAL) Scholarships Pension Schemes (Old Age Widow) MNREGA Wages How to Check Bank Linking Status Online You can verify your current NPCI mapping status instantly through the myAadhaar portal. Follow these steps Login to Portal Click the Check Status button above and login using your Aadhaar Number OTP. Select Bank Seeding Status Locate and click on the Bank Seeding Status icon on the dashboard. View Result The system will display the Bank Name, Seeding Status (Active Inactive), and the Date of Linking. Understanding Your Status Result Status ACTIVE Your Aadhaar is successfully mapped. You are eligible to receive DBT funds in the mentioned bank account. Status INACTIVE Your mapping has been disabled or expired. You will NOT receive subsidies until you re-link it. My Status is Inactive Not Linked. How to Link? Note You CANNOT link your bank account to Aadhaar online via the UIDAI website. This must be done through your bank. Method 1 Visit Bank Branch (Recommended) Go to your bank branch, fill out the Aadhaar Seeding Form (DBT Mandate form), and attach a copy of your e-Aadhaar. Ask the official to Enable DBT specifically. Method 2 Net Banking Mobile App Some banks (like SBI, HDFC, ICICI, PNB) offer an option in their Net Banking App under Service Request Link Aadhaar Enable DBT . Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs) Q I have accounts in 3 banks. Which one will receive the money? Ans Government benefits are sent to the Last Seeded Bank Account . If you recently linked a new bank account, the money will start coming to that new account automatically. Q My bank says Aadhaar is linked (KYC done), but status shows Inactive. Why? Ans Linking for KYC and Linking for DBT are different. You must specifically ask the bank to Map Aadhaar to NPCI for DBT . Q How long does it take to update the status? Ans Once the bank processes your request, it usually takes 2-3 working days for the status to reflect on the myAadhaar portal. Track Your PVC Card Ordered your Aadhaar PVC Card? Track its printing and delivery status in real-time. Know exactly when it will reach your doorstep. Track Order Check Aadhaar PVC Card Order Status Track Delivery Have you recently ordered the new, durable Aadhaar PVC Card online by paying 50? If yes, you might be wondering when it will reach your home. The Check Aadhaar PVC card order status service allows you to track the progress of your printing request and its dispatch status. The entire process, from ordering to delivery, typically takes 5 to 15 working days . This tool helps you know exactly where your card is whether it is still printing or has been handed over to the post office. You Need Your SRN (Service Request Number) To check the status, you must have the 28-digit SRN . This number was generated when you successfully placed the order and paid the fees. It is available on the acknowledgement slip you downloaded. How to Check PVC Order Status Online Follow these simple steps to track your application Open the Tool Click on the Track Order button above. Enter SRN Enter the 28-digit Service Request Number (SRN) carefully. Security Check Type the Captcha code shown on the screen. Submit Click on Submit . The system will verify your request and display the current status. Understanding the Status Meanings Payment Successful Your order has been received by UIDAI. In Process Your data has been sent for printing. Dispatched Your card has been printed and handed over to India Post. (This is the most important status). How to Track via India Post (Speed Post) Once the status shows Dispatched , the portal will display an Airway Bill Number (AWB) . This is your tracking ID. Copy the Airway Bill Number (AWB). Visit the India Post Tracking website (indiapost.gov.in). Enter the AWB number in the Consignment Number field. You will see the exact location of your card and the expected delivery date. Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs) Q I lost my SRN. How can I check the status? Ans If you lost the SRN, check your SMS history for messages from UIDAI. Or check the Payment History section if you were logged in. Q The status says Dispatched but I haven t received it yet. Ans Delivery speed depends on India Post services. Use the Airway Bill Number to track it on the India Post website for real-time updates. Check Aadhaar Status Applied for a new Aadhaar or updated details? Track your application status in real-time using your Enrolment ID (EID) or URN. Check Status Check Aadhaar Enrolment Update Status Online Have you recently applied for a new Aadhaar card? Or have you updated your Name, Address, or Date of Birth at an Aadhaar Center? If yes, you don t need to visit the center again to know if your request is processed. The Check Enrolment Update Status service allows you to track your application in real-time. Whether you did the update online (via myAadhaar portal) or offline (at a Seva Kendra), you can track it here. Which Number Do You Need for Tracking? Depending on how you applied, you will have one of the following numbers 1. Enrolment ID (EID) Found on the top of the Acknowledgement Slip given at the Aadhaar Center. It contains 14-digit Enrolment No. 14-digit Date Time. 2. Service Request Number (SRN) Generated when you initiate an Online Update (like Address or Document Update) on the myAadhaar portal. It starts with S . 3. Update Request Number (URN) Generated via SMS if you updated details using the Self Service Update Portal (SSUP) in the past. How to Enter EID Correctly (Very Important) Most users fail to check status because they enter the EID incorrectly. The 28-digit EID is a combination of the Enrolment Number and Timestamp. Format Enrolment Number Year Month Day Time Example If slip says Date 15 08 2024, Time 14 30 55, Enrolment 1234 56789 01234 Enter like this 12345678901234 20240815 143055 (Notice the Date is reversed YYYY-MM-DD). Step-by-Step Tracking Process Follow these steps to know your current status Open the Tool Click on the Check Status button above. Enter ID Type your EID (28 digits), SRN, or URN in the box provided. Ensure there are no spaces or slashes. Security Check Enter the Captcha code exactly as shown. Submit Click Submit . The status will appear on the screen. What Does Your Status Mean? In Process Your application is still being verified by the backend team. This usually takes 5-30 days. Completed Congratulations! Your update is successful. You can now Download Aadhaar to see the changes. Rejected Your request was declined. This usually happens due to wrong documents or data mismatch. You will have to apply again. Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs) Q I lost my Acknowledgement Slip. How can I get my EID? Ans You can use the Retrieve EID UID service to get your Enrolment ID on your registered mobile number. Q How many days does it take to update Aadhaar? Ans As per UIDAI guidelines, up to 90 of updates are processed within 30 days. However, in some cases, it can take up to 90 days. Q Status shows Completed but I didn t get the card by post. Ans Completed means the data is updated online. The physical letter delivery takes extra time. You can download the e-Aadhaar immediately. Check Deceased Aadhaar Deactivation Status Once you have formally reported the death of a family member to UIDAI for Aadhaar deactivation, it is important to verify if the request has been processed. (Single Sign-On Login) SSO (Single Sign-On) ek aisa digital authentication system hai jo users ko sirf ek ID aur Password ke zariye kai saari sarkari aur private websites par login karne ki suvidha deta hai. HOME NEWS Sonam Wangchuk Ka Hunger Strike Delhi High Court Health Monitoring Order 2026 Climate activist Sonam Wangchuk, 19 din se bhookh hartal par hain Jantar Mantar mein. Delhi High Court ne health monitoring ka order diya. July 20 tak rahnege veh kahte hain. Kaif Shah Published on 17 Jul 2026 Follow Advertisement Delhi High Court ne ek ahem order pass kiya hai jisme Sonam Wangchuk, jo Jantar Mantar par bhookh hartal par the, unke health monitoring ke liye directive di gayi hai. Sonam Wangchuk, jo ek renowned educator aur environmental activist hain, unhe July 20, 2026 tak apna jeevan bachchane ke liye determined rakha gaya tha. Is case mein Delhi High Court ne sawal kiya tha ki ek vyaktik protest mein government se kitni demanding ho sakti hai aur kya judiciary ko intervention karna chahiye. Yeh order sarkari naukri seekers, students, aur general public ke liye zaroori ban gaya kyunki isme education policy aur civil protest ke beech ka relationship samjhaya gaya hai. Poori Khabar Kya Hai? Sonam Wangchuk, jo India ke sabse famous educators mein se ek hain aur unka naam Bollywood movie "3 Idiots" se vi connected hai, unhone ek powerful protest shuru kiya tha Jantar Mantar, Delhi ke paas. Yeh protest primarily ek bahut badi issues ke against tha NEET exam (National Eligibility cum Entrance Test) aur uske implementation ko lekar. Sonam Wangchuk ka main argument tha ki NEET exam se India ke Ladakh region ke schools aur colleges mein bahut negative impact pad raha tha. Woh kehte the ki is exam system se ladakh ke local students ko disadvantage mil raha tha kyunki unhe preparation ke liye proper resources nahi mil rahe the. Sonam Wangchuk ne apna bhookh hartal (hunger strike) Jantar Mantar par July 2026 mein shuru kiya tha. Unhone kahlara tha ki woh "July 20 tak jeevan bachchane ke liye try karenge, par agar government unke demands ko nahi maanti, to woh apna jaan tak de denge." Yeh ek bahut hi radical step tha aur is protest se Delhi mein bahut bada political discussion shuru ho gaya. Hazaron log Jantar Mantar par aake Sonam Wangchuk ke protest ko support karte the. News channels, social media, aur political leaders sab mein is issue ko lekar bahas ho rahi thi. Jab Sonam Wangchuk ki health rapidly worsen hone lagi, tab Delhi High Court ko intervention karna pada. Court ne apni concern express ki kyunki ek insaan ki jaan par baat thi. Delhi High Court ne suna ki Sonam Wangchuk ke liver mein problem ho gaya tha aur unke kidney functions bi shakti ho sakte the agar woh bhookh hartal continue karate rahe. Court ne order pass kia tha ki Government ko chaiye ki woh Sonam Wangchuk se proper medical care de aur unke health ko monitor kare. Court ne simultaneously Sonam Wangchuk ko bi advice di thi ki woh apne aap ko government ke custody mein admit kren taaki treatment mil sake. Is High Court order mein ek very important legal precedent set ho gaya tha. Court ne kaha tha ki "Right to Protest" aur "Right to Life" dono fundamental rights hain, par jab tak insaan ka life immediately danger mein ho, tab government ko responsibility hoti hai protect karna. Delhi High Court mein Chief Justice ne khud ise handle kiya aur counsel ko appoint kiya jo dono parties ke beech mein negotiate kar sake. Court mein government side se Ministry of Education ke representatives aaye the, aur Sonam Wangchuk ke lawyers bi the jo unhe defend kar rahe the. July 17, 2026 ko Delhi High Court ne final order pass karte hue kaha tha ki Sonam Wangchuk ko Delhi ke Ram Manohar Lohia Hospital mein admit kiya jayega jahan pe 24 7 medical monitoring ho sakegi. Court ne order kia tha ki government ke doctors ko regular check-up karna hoga aur health vitals ko record rakhna hoga. Saath saath, Court ne ye bi kaha tha ki government ko Sonam Wangchuk ke legitimate demands par seriousness se consider karna chahiye aur within reasonable time frame mein some decision lena chahiye. Iska matlab yeh tha ki protest to ho sakta hai, par life risk nahi leni chahiye, aur government ko bi show karna chahiye ki woh public ke concerns ko seriously le raha hai.
