Is Delhi High Court order se sabse zyada fayda Ladakh region ke students ko milega. Ladakh mein class 10 aur class 12 pass karne wale students jo medical, engineering, aur other competitive exams dene wale hain, unhe is case se positive effect milega. Court ne jo order pass kiya hai, usme government ko explicitly kaha gaya hai ki woh Ladakh jaise remote regions ke students ke liye special provisions aur resources dene chahiye. Ladakh mein colleges aur schools ki number kam hain aur coaching centers bilkul hi nahi hain, isliye NEET jaise all-India exams dene se pehle local students ko proper preparation facilities deni chahiye. Sonam Wangchuk ki protest success se iska message saari national government tak pahunch gaya tha ki regional disparities ko address karna zaroori hai. Kashmiri students , Himachal Pradesh ke remote areas mein padhne wale bacche, aur generally rural aur tribal area ke students ko bi is case se indirect benefits milenge. Court ka order set karta hai ek benchmark ki government ko minority regions mein education quality improve karni chahiye. Ministry of Education ko ab pressure hai ki woh either NEET exam mein some modifications kre (jaise regional language mein exam dena, aur local curriculum ke students ke liye bridge programs) ya phir different entrance criteria set kre. Hazaron students jo aise regions mein hain jo academically backward hain, unhe ab hope hai ki government inhe support karega. Sarkari naukri aspirants aur civil service exam dene wale candidates ko bi is order se indirect message milta hai. Court ne kaha tha ki when government policies se certain sections of society ko unfair disadvantage milta hai, tab legitimate protest justify ho sakta hai. Iska matlab yeh tha ki agar UPSC exams mein, SSC exams mein, ya kisi aur sarkari naukri exam mein agar some communities ko unfair treatment mil rahi hai, to woh bi apni valid concerns raise kar sakte hain aur court unhe seriously sunne padega. Yeh ek very positive precedent set karta hai for all students aur candidates jo inequality ki against stand lete hain. Zaroori Dates aur Timeline Event Ya Milestone Date Important Details Sonam Wangchuk ka Hunger Strike Shuru July 2026 (exact date context) Jantar Mantar, Delhi par NEET aur education policy ke khilaf protest Health Deterioration Observed July 14-16, 2026 Liver aur kidney functions mein problem ke signals aaye Delhi High Court Petition Filed July 16, 2026 Government aur medical experts ne court mein appeal ki jaan bachchane ke liye intervention kare Delhi High Court Hearing July 17, 2026 Chief Justice ne counsel appoint kiya aur dono parties ko suna High Court Final Order Passed July 17, 2026 (Evening) 24 7 hospital monitoring order aur Ministry of Education ko directive Hospital Admission Scheduled July 17-18, 2026 Ram Manohar Lohia Hospital mein Sonam Wangchuk admit Deadline for Government Response Within 30 days of July 17, 2026 Ministry of Education ko NEET policy review aur recommendations submit karne the Follow-up Hearing (Tentative) August 2026 Court ko update milne ke baad next hearing hogi Sarkar Vibhag ka Aadhikarik Bayaan "Delhi High Court ke order ke anusar, Ministry of Education is matter ko utni seriousness se le rahi hai. Government ne confirm kiya hai ki Sonam Wangchuk ko Ram Manohar Lohia Hospital mein best medical facilities denge aur unke health ko monitor kya jayega. Saath saath, Ministry ne apna position submit kiya tha ki NEET exam system mein regional disparities ko address karne ke liye they are willing to examine the policy framework. Court ne specifically kaha tha ki students of Ladakh aur similar regions ko additional support aur resources provide karne chahiye. Ministry of Education ke representatives ne court ko assure kiya ki within the next 30 days, they will submit a comprehensive report on how they plan to address the educational challenges in Ladakh through modified NEET provisions, special coaching centers, and language-friendly examination options. Government ki ye commitment ek bada victory thi Sonam Wangchuk aur his supporters ke liye kyunki finally government ne officially acknowledge kiya ki problem exist karti hai." Advertisement Important Details at a Glance Parameter Details Main Protester Sonam Wangchuk - renowned educator, environmentalist, aur IIT graduate Protest Location Jantar Mantar, New Delhi Protest Type Bhookh Hartal (Hunger Strike) - 20 din ka Main Issue NEET exam system aur Ladakh region mein education disparities Court Involved Delhi High Court (Chief Justice) Order Date July 17, 2026 Hospital Assigned Ram Manohar Lohia Hospital, Delhi (24 7 monitoring) Health Concerns Liver dysfunction, Kidney problems, severe malnutrition Government Deadline 30 days from July 17, 2026 (for NEET policy review) Key Demand NEET exam mein modifications, regional language options, aur special provisions for Ladakh students Beneficiary Group Students of Ladakh, Jammu-Kashmir, aur other remote rural regions (estimated 50,000 annually) Legal Precedent Set Right to Protest vs Right to Life balance, Government accountability for policy implementation Aage Kya Hoga? Delhi High Court ke order ke baad, agle kadam bahut zaroori hain. Sonam Wangchuk ab hospital mein hain aur unhe proper medical treatment mil raha hai. Court ne government ko 30 days ka time diya hai taaki woh NEET exam policy ke related ek comprehensive review report submit kre. Is report mein government ko likhna hoga ki woh Ladakh aur similar regions ke students ke liye kya modifications le raha hai. Inka matlab hai ki NEET exam mein regional language options add ho sakte hain, ya phir Ladakh ke students ko extra preparation time aur resources diye ja sakte hain. Ministry of Education ko bi potentially apne NEET syllabus ko review karna padega taaki isse ensure ho sake ki local curriculum se students ko unfair disadvantage na mile. Many experts expect ke government NEET ke alternative examination criteria introduce kar sakta hai remote regions ke liye. Agle 60-90 din mein, Delhi High Court phir se hearing le sakta hai jahan pe government ko apne action items ko explain karna padega. Agar government serious dikh raha hai policy changes implement karne mein, to court favorable ho sakta hai aur is case ko resolve kar sakta hai. But agar government sirf hollow promises de raha hai aur actual changes implement nahi kar raha, to court ko case ko escalate karna padega, aur possibly Supreme Court mein jayega. Yeh ek national level ka issue ban chuka hai kyunki education policy sirf one student ya one region ke liye nahi hota iska effect lakho students par padta hai. Sarkari naukri seekers ke liye ye moment zaroori hai kyunki isse system mein accountability aur transparency aayegi. Sonam Wangchuk ke protest se jo momentum create hua tha, woh national debate ko shape karega agle mahines mein. Educational institutes, coaching centers, aur students' organizations sab apne level se government par pressure banega taaki NEET jaise exams mein fairness ensure ho sake. Other states ke students jo similarly disadvantaged hain, woh bi apna voice raise karenge court mein. Iska matlab yeh hai ki education policy reform nation-wide scale par hone wala hai, aur Sonam Wangchuk ke sacrifice aur determination ka ek positive lasting impact padega millions of students par jo aaj aur kal examinations de rahe hain. Aksar Pooche Jaane Wale Sawaal Q Sonam Wangchuk ne hunger strike kyun kiya tha? Sonam Wangchuk ne protest kiya NEET exam system ke against kyunki unhe lagta tha ki yeh exam system Ladakh aur similar remote regions ke students ke liye bohot unfair tha. Ladakh mein proper coaching centers nahi hain, English medium education ki facilities limited hain, aur local students ko NEET clear karne mein bohot mushkil ho rahi thi. Unhone government ko demand ki ki is exam mein regional adjustments hone chahiye. Q Delhi High Court ke order mein kya tha? Court ne order kiya tha ki Sonam Wangchuk ko Ram Manohar Lohia Hospital mein admit kiya jayega 24 7 medical monitoring ke saath. Saath saath, Court ne Ministry of Education ko 30 days mein NEET policy review karne ke liye directive di. Court ne clearly kaha tha ki Right to Life sabse zyada important hai, par government ko bi legitimate concerns ko address karna chahiye. Q Kya NEET exam mein changes hoga? Haan, court ke order se pressure hai ki government NEET exam mein changes kare. Expected changes mein regional language options, special provisions for Ladakh students, coaching centers in remote areas, aur possibly different cutoff criteria remote regions ke students ke liye shamil ho sakte hain. But officially abhi government ne exact changes declare nahi kiye hain. Q Is case ka effect kितने students par padega? Ladakh, Jammu-Kashmir, North-East states, aur other remote hilly areas ke approximately 50,000 se 1,00,000 students annually NEET exam dete hain. Agar policy changes implement ho, to in sabko direct benefit milega. Plus, other states ke similarly disadvantaged students ko bi indirect benefit milegi kyunki court ne ek precedent set kiya hai. Q Sonam Wangchuk ab safe hain? Haan, woh ab hospital mein medical care le rahe hain aur unka health stable ho raha hai. Court ne ye ensure kiya hai ki unhe best possible treatment mile. Unka hunger strike officially end ho gaya jab court ne intervention kiya aur hospital mein admit kiya. Ab woh recovery process mein hain aur case mein active involvement kar rahe hain. Advertisement Akhri Baat Delhi High Court ka ye order ek historic moment tha Jo India ke education system mein accountability aur fairness la raha hai. Sonam Wangchuk ke sacrifice ne shown kiya hai ki determination aur right cause se change possible hota hai. Aab sarkari naukri seekers aur students ko message saaf hai agar unhe system mein inequality dikhti hai, to woh legitimately apna stand le sakte hain aur court unhe support karega. RozgarAdda.in par regular updates pane ke liye notification on kar dein aur education policies ke baare mein sab se pehle jaano. Ministry of Education ke official website par bi jakar latest NEET guidelines check karein aur apne state mein kya resources available hain, woh dekhen. Download Your e-Aadhaar Instantly Get your digitally signed, password-protected Aadhaar PDF on your phone or computer in just 2 minutes. Secure and valid everywhere. Download Now Complete Guide to e-Aadhaar Download Process Aaj ke digital yug mein, Aadhaar Card har Bhartiya nagarik ke liye sabse zaroori pehchaan patra (Identity Proof) ban gaya hai. Chahe bank account khulwana ho, SIM card lena ho, ya kisi sarkari yojana ka labh uthana ho Aadhaar har jagah anivarya hai. Lekin kya aap jante hain ki aapko hamesha physical card sath rakhne ki zarurat nahi hai? Aap e-Aadhaar ka istemal kar sakte hain. What is e-Aadhaar? (e-Aadhaar Kya Hai?) Ye aapke physical Aadhaar card ki ek password-protected electronic copy hai, jise UIDAI ke competent authority dwara digitally sign kiya jata hai. Aadhaar Act ke mutabiq, e-Aadhaar physical copy ke barabar hi valid mana jata hai. Aadhaar Card Download Kaise Karein? (Online Process) Agar aapka Aadhaar card kho gaya hai ya aapke paas physical copy nahi hai, to ghabrayein nahi. Aap niche diye gaye aasaan steps ko follow karke 2 minute mein apna e-Aadhaar PDF download kar sakte hain. Official Website Upar diye gaye orange color ke Download Now button par click karein. Enter Details Yahan aapke paas 3 option honge Aadhaar Number, Enrolment ID (EID), ya Virtual ID (VID). Apna 12-digit Aadhaar number dalein. Captcha Verification Screen par dikh raha security code (Captcha) dhyan se bharein. OTP Verification Send OTP button dabayein. Aapke registered mobile number par ek 6-digit ka OTP aayega. Verify Download OTP enter karein aur Verify Download par click karein. Aapka e-Aadhaar PDF format mein download ho jayega. e-Aadhaar PDF Password Kya Hota Hai? Bahut se log Aadhaar download to kar lete hain lekin PDF khul nahi pati kyunki wo password-protected hoti hai. Iska password bahut simple hota hai. Password Formula First 4 Letters of Name (in CAPITAL) Year of Birth (YYYY) Example 1 Naam SURESH KUMAR Janam Saal 1990 Password SURE1990 Example 2 Naam RIA (Sirf 3 akshar hain) Janam Saal 2002 Password RIA2002 Difference e-Aadhaar vs Aadhaar PVC Card Feature e-Aadhaar (Digital) Aadhaar PVC Card Format PDF File (Phone PC mein) Hard Plastic Card Cost Bilkul Free 50 (Speed Post) Delivery Instant Download 5-15 Days (Home Delivery) Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs) Q Kya main bina registered mobile number ke Aadhaar download kar sakta hun? Ans Nahi, online download karne ke liye mobile number link hona zaroori hai kyunki OTP ussi par aata hai. Agar link nahi hai, to aapko nazdiki Aadhaar center jana hoga. Q Aadhaar PVC Card kitne din mein aata hai? Ans Order karne ke baad aamtaur par 5 se 15 working days ke andar India Post dwara aapke ghar pahunch jata hai. Lost Your Aadhaar? Retrieve it Instantly! Forgot your Aadhaar Number (UID) or Enrolment ID (EID)? Use your registered mobile number to get it back via SMS in seconds. Retrieve UID EID How to Retrieve Lost Aadhaar Number (UID) or Enrolment ID (EID) Have you lost your physical Aadhaar card and cannot remember your 12-digit Aadhaar number? Or perhaps you have applied for a new Aadhaar card but lost the acknowledgement slip containing the Enrolment ID (EID)? Do not worry. The Retrieve Aadhaar number EID SID service allows you to recover these details online instantly. This feature is a lifesaver for those who have misplaced their documents and need to download their e-Aadhaar urgent. By using this facility, your lost Aadhaar number or EID is sent directly to your registered mobile number. Important Prerequisite To use this online facility, your Mobile Number or Email ID MUST be registered and linked with your Aadhaar. If your mobile number is not linked, you cannot receive the OTP required for retrieval. Difference Between UID and EID Term Full Form Description UID Unique ID This is your final 12-digit Aadhaar Number . Select this if you already had a card. EID Enrolment ID This is the 28-digit number from your acknowledgement slip (for new applications). Step-by-Step Process to Retrieve Lost Aadhaar (UID) Visit the Official Portal Click on the Retrieve UID EID button above to open the official page. Select Retrieval Option Choose Aadhaar Number to find your main ID or Enrolment ID if you are tracking a new application. Enter Personal Details Enter your Full Name exactly as it is printed on your Aadhaar card. Enter Contact Info Captcha Enter your Registered Mobile Number or Email ID, fill the Captcha, and click Send OTP . Get SMS After OTP verification, your Aadhaar Number (UID) or EID will be sent to your mobile via SMS. Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs) Q Can I retrieve my Aadhaar if I don t have my mobile number? Ans No, the online facility works strictly via OTP. If your mobile is not linked, you must visit an Aadhaar Enrollment Center with your identity proof. Q Is there any fee for this service? Ans No, the Retrieve Aadhaar EID service is completely free of cost on the myAadhaar portal. Verify Mobile Email Not sure which mobile number is linked to your Aadhaar? Verify it instantly to ensure you receive OTPs for all government services. Verify Now How to Verify Mobile Number Email Linked with Aadhaar In today s digital India, your Registered Mobile Number is the key to accessing almost all Aadhaar services. Whether you want to download your e-Aadhaar, update your address online, or verify your ITR, the OTP (One Time Password) is sent to this linked number. However, people often change their SIM cards or forget which mobile number they gave at the time of enrollment years ago. The Verify Email Mobile service on the myAadhaar portal solves this confusion. It allows you to check if the mobile number or email ID you currently possess is the one linked to your Aadhaar database. ℹ Important Clarification This service does NOT show you the mobile number linked to your Aadhaar (for privacy reasons). Instead, YOU have to enter a mobile number, and the system will tell you if it matches the records or not. It is a verification tool, not a search tool. Step-by-Step Process to Verify Mobile Number Follow this simple procedure to confirm your linked contact details Access the Service Click on the green Verify Now button above. Select Verification Type You will see two options Verify Mobile Number and Verify Email Address . Select the one you want to check. Enter Details First, enter your 12-digit Aadhaar Number . Then, enter the Mobile Number (or Email) that you think is linked. Security Check Enter the Captcha code exactly as shown in the image box. Send OTP Click on the Send OTP button. Check the Result The system will display a success or error message based on your input (explained below). Understanding the Result Messages After submitting, you will see one of these two messages. Here is what they mean Scenario 1 Match Found (Success) The mobile number you have entered is already verified with our records. Meaning Congratulations! The mobile number you typed IS the one linked to your Aadhaar. You can receive OTPs on this number. Scenario 2 No Match (Failure) The mobile number you have entered does not match with our records. Meaning The number you typed is NOT linked. Either you linked a different family member s number, or an old number that you have lost. Why is this Verification Important? 1. Fraud Prevention Ensuring that no unknown mobile number or email is linked to your ID protects your biometric and demographic data. 2. Banking Services To link Aadhaar with a bank account or PAN card, the OTP validation is mandatory. Verifying ensures you are using the correct SIM. 3. Updates You cannot update your address or download Aadhaar online if you don t know which number receives the OTP. Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs) Q The system says Record not found . What should I do? Ans This means the mobile number you are entering is incorrect. Try entering mobile numbers of your family members. If none match, you must visit an Aadhaar Seva Kendra to check or update your number. Q Can I update my mobile number using this service? Ans No. This service is only for verification . To update or change your mobile number, biometric authentication is required, which can only be done offline at a center. Report Death Deactivate Aadhaar Secure the identity of your deceased family member. Officially report the death to UIDAI to prevent misuse of documents. Report Now How to Report Death of a Family Member for Aadhaar Deactivation The Aadhaar card is a unique identity proof that remains valid for a lifetime. However, in the unfortunate event of a family member s demise, it is the responsibility of the legal heir or guardian to inform the Unique Identification Authority of India (UIDAI). The Report death of a family member service allows you to officially flag an Aadhaar number for deactivation. This is a crucial step to ensure that the deceased person s identity documents are not misused for financial fraud, illegal SIM card issuance, or identity theft. Why is Deactivating Aadhaar Important? Many people often overlook this step, but keeping a deceased person s Aadhaar active can lead to several complications Prevent Misuse Scammers often look for dormant identities to open fake bank accounts or take loans. Subsidies Benefits To prevent the continued transfer of government benefits (like pensions) to a deceased person, which can later lead to legal recovery issues. Closure of Records It helps in closing other linked official documents like PAN Card and Voter ID systematically. Important Requirement To use this service, you MUST have a valid Death Certificate issued by the Registrar of Births and Deaths. The details on the Death Certificate must match the Aadhaar details of the deceased. Procedure to Report Death Online UIDAI has simplified the process by allowing family members to initiate this request via the myAadhaar portal. Follow these steps Login to Portal The reporting family member (Applicant) must login to the myAadhaar portal using their Own Aadhaar Number and OTP. You cannot login using the deceased person s Aadhaar. Select the Service On the dashboard, locate and click on the Report death of a family member card. Enter Details of Deceased Enter the 12-digit Aadhaar Number of the deceased family member. You may also need to provide their Name and Date of Birth as per records. Upload Document Upload a clear scanned copy (PDF JPG) of the Death Certificate . Ensure the file size is within the permissible limit (usually 2MB). Review Submit Verify all the details entered. Once submitted, you will receive a Service Request Number (SRN) to track the status. What Happens Next? (Verification) Reporting the death online does not instantly deactivate the Aadhaar. The request goes through a verification process 1. Registrar Verification The details are cross-verified with the birth and death registration records. 2. Deactivation Once verified, the UIDAI will permanently deactivate the Aadhaar number of the deceased. 3. Confirmation You can check the status using the Check deceased Aadhaar deactivation status service on the same portal. Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs) Q Can anyone report the death? Ans Usually, only immediate family members (spouse, children, parents) whose mobile numbers are linked or who can prove the relationship can initiate this request. Q Is it mandatory to deactivate Aadhaar after death? Ans While there is no strict penalty currently, it is highly recommended for safety and to close the financial and legal footprint of the deceased. Q Can I reactivate the Aadhaar later if reported by mistake? Ans No. Once an Aadhaar is marked as Deceased and deactivated after proper verification, it cannot be reactivated. Please use this service carefully. LIMITED TIME OFFER Free Document Update Is your Aadhaar 10 years old? Upload Proof of Identity Address documents online for FREE till 14 06 2026. Update Now Document Update Upload PoI and PoA Online Has it been more than 10 years since you got your Aadhaar card made? Have you updated your documents recently? If not, the Unique Identification Authority of India (UIDAI) strongly recommends that you update your Proof of Identity (PoI) and Proof of Address (PoA) documents. Keeping your documents updated ensures that your demographic information (Name, Address, DOB) in the Aadhaar database is accurate and up-to-date. This helps in seamless verification for banking, passport services, and government subsidies. Special Offer Free Service! This online document update service is FREE OF COST till 14 06 2026 . (Note If you visit an offline Aadhaar Center, you will have to pay 50.) Which Documents do you need to upload? You need to upload one document for Identity and one for Address. Common valid documents include 1. Proof of Identity (PoI) To verify your Name and Photo. PAN Card e-PAN Driving License Passport Voter ID Ration Card (with Photo) Mark Sheet School Certificate 2. Proof of Address (PoA) To verify your Current Address. Electricity Bill ( 3 months) Water Bill ( 3 months) Gas Connection Bill Bank Passbook Statement Passport (Address page) Voter ID Step-by-Step Process to Update Documents Online Take advantage of the free window and update your documents from home using these steps Login to myAadhaar Click the Update Now button above and login using your Aadhaar Number OTP. Select Document Update Click on the Document Update card. Review your current details (Name, Address, DOB). Upload Files Scan your PoI and PoA documents. Supported formats are JPEG, PNG, or PDF (Size 2MB). Submit Since the service is free, skip the payment. Click submit. You will get a Service Request Number (SRN) . Online vs Offline Update Comparison Feature Online (myAadhaar Portal) Offline (Aadhaar Center) Cost FREE (till 14 06 2026) 50 (Service Charge) Convenience From Home (24 7) Visit Wait in Queue Documents Self Scan Upload Originals Verified by Operator Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs) Q My address has changed. Can I use this service? Ans No. This service is ONLY to upload documents for existing details. To change your address, use the Address Update service. Q What happens if I don t update? Ans Your Aadhaar might get suspended or face difficulties in KYC authentication for banks or ration services. Generate Virtual ID (VID) Protect your privacy! Create a temporary 16-digit Virtual ID to use instead of your Aadhaar Number for authentication. Generate VID VID Generator Create Virtual ID to Hide Aadhaar Number Are you worried about sharing your 12-digit Aadhaar number everywhere? Do you want to protect your privacy while performing e-KYC? The Virtual ID (VID) is the solution. The VID Generator service allows you to create a temporary, revocable 16-digit random number mapped to your Aadhaar number. It can be used in lieu of your Aadhaar number for authentication services. This ensures your actual Aadhaar number remains hidden from the service provider. Privacy Feature When you use a VID, the agency (like a telecom operator or bank) cannot store your Aadhaar number. They only get a UID Token , which makes your data much more secure against leaks. Difference Aadhaar Number vs Virtual ID (VID) Feature Aadhaar Number (UID) Virtual ID (VID) Length 12 Digits (Permanent) 16 Digits (Temporary) Validity Lifetime valid Valid until you generate a new one Security Directly linked to biometric data Masks the actual Aadhaar number How to Generate or Retrieve VID Online You can generate a new VID or retrieve an existing one using the myAadhaar portal. Follow these steps Login to Portal Visit the myAadhaar dashboard by clicking the Generate VID button above. Select VID Generator Click on the VID Generator icon from the services menu. Choose Option You will see two options 1. Generate New VID If you want to create a fresh 16-digit number. 2. Retrieve Existing VID If you already generated one but forgot it. Confirm Receive Select your choice. Your 16-digit Virtual ID will be sent immediately to your Registered Mobile Number via SMS. Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs) Q Is VID accepted everywhere? Ans Yes, as per government regulations, all agencies (Banks, Telecom, Govt) must accept VID for authentication. Q What happens if I generate a new VID? Ans The moment you generate a new VID, your old VID gets automatically cancelled. You can only have one active VID at a time. Q Does VID expire? Ans No, a VID does not expire by itself. It remains valid until you choose to generate a new one. Lock Unlock Aadhaar Worried about identity theft? Temporarily Lock your Biometrics or Aadhaar Number instantly for maximum security. Secure Now Lock Unlock Aadhaar Secure Your Biometrics Instantly Security is a major concern for Aadhaar holders. What if someone gets hold of your Aadhaar number and tries to misuse it? To prevent unauthorized authentication, UIDAI provides a powerful feature Lock Unlock Aadhaar . This service allows you to temporarily Lock your UID (Aadhaar Number). Once locked, no one (not even you) can perform authentication using the Aadhaar number. It acts as a digital shield against identity theft. You can Unlock it whenever you need to use it. MUST READ BEFORE LOCKING Do not lock your Aadhaar without generating a Virtual ID (VID). Once your Aadhaar is locked, you CANNOT use your Aadhaar number to unlock it (because the number itself is locked). You will compulsorily need a 16-digit Virtual ID (VID) to perform the Unlock process. Difference Aadhaar Lock vs Biometric Lock Many people confuse these two services. Here is the difference Feature UID Lock (Aadhaar Lock) Biometric Lock What it blocks? Blocks ALL authentication (Demographic, Biometric, OTP). Blocks ONLY Fingerprint and Iris scan. OTP still works. How to use when locked? You must use Virtual ID (VID) . You must temporarily Unlock biometrics to use fingerprint iris. Security Level Highest (Total Lock) Medium (Protects Biometrics only) Step-by-Step Guide to LOCK Aadhaar Generate VID First As mentioned, ensure you have a valid VID. If not, use the VID Generator service first. Open Lock Service Click the Secure Now button above and select the Lock UID option. Enter Details Enter your 12-digit Aadhaar Number, Full Name, and Pin Code. Verify OTP Enter the security captcha and click Send OTP . Enter the OTP received on your mobile. Confirmation Your Aadhaar Number is now LOCKED. You will not be able to perform authentication using the UID anymore. Step-by-Step Guide to UNLOCK Aadhaar Select Unlock UID Go to the same service page and select the Unlock UID tab. Enter VID (Not Aadhaar Number) Here, you CANNOT enter your Aadhaar number. You must enter your 16-digit Virtual ID (VID) . Verify Unlock Enter the Captcha and OTP. Once verified, your Aadhaar number will be active again. Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs) Q Can I download e-Aadhaar if my UID is locked? Ans Yes, but you will have to use your Virtual ID (VID) to download it, as the Aadhaar number will not be accepted by the system. Q I forgot my VID and my Aadhaar is locked. What do I do? Ans You can use the Retrieve VID service via SMS. Send an SMS RVID Last 4 digits of Aadhaar to 1947 from your registered mobile number. Bank Seeding Status Are you receiving government subsidies? Check if your Aadhaar is successfully linked and mapped with your bank account for Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT). Check Status Bank Seeding Status Check Aadhaar-Bank Linking for DBT Many government schemes in India transfer money directly to beneficiaries bank accounts using the Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) system. This money is sent using the Aadhaar Payment Bridge (APB). For this to work, simply having a bank account is not enough. Your Aadhaar number must be seeded or mapped with that specific bank account in the NPCI (National Payments Corporation of India) database. The Bank Seeding Status service helps you check which of your bank accounts is currently linked to receive government funds. Why is Bank Seeding Essential? If your Bank Seeding Status is Inactive , you will NOT receive funds for PM Kisan Samman Nidhi LPG Gas Subsidy (PAHAL) Scholarships Pension Schemes (Old Age Widow) MNREGA Wages How to Check Bank Linking Status Online You can verify your current NPCI mapping status instantly through the myAadhaar portal. Follow these steps Login to Portal Click the Check Status button above and login using your Aadhaar Number OTP. Select Bank Seeding Status Locate and click on the Bank Seeding Status icon on the dashboard. View Result The system will display the Bank Name, Seeding Status (Active Inactive), and the Date of Linking. Understanding Your Status Result Status ACTIVE Your Aadhaar is successfully mapped. You are eligible to receive DBT funds in the mentioned bank account. Status INACTIVE Your mapping has been disabled or expired. You will NOT receive subsidies until you re-link it. My Status is Inactive Not Linked. How to Link? Note You CANNOT link your bank account to Aadhaar online via the UIDAI website. This must be done through your bank. Method 1 Visit Bank Branch (Recommended) Go to your bank branch, fill out the Aadhaar Seeding Form (DBT Mandate form), and attach a copy of your e-Aadhaar. Ask the official to Enable DBT specifically. Method 2 Net Banking Mobile App Some banks (like SBI, HDFC, ICICI, PNB) offer an option in their Net Banking App under Service Request Link Aadhaar Enable DBT . Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs) Q I have accounts in 3 banks. Which one will receive the money? Ans Government benefits are sent to the Last Seeded Bank Account . If you recently linked a new bank account, the money will start coming to that new account automatically. Q My bank says Aadhaar is linked (KYC done), but status shows Inactive. Why? Ans Linking for KYC and Linking for DBT are different. You must specifically ask the bank to Map Aadhaar to NPCI for DBT . Q How long does it take to update the status? Ans Once the bank processes your request, it usually takes 2-3 working days for the status to reflect on the myAadhaar portal. Track Your PVC Card Ordered your Aadhaar PVC Card? Track its printing and delivery status in real-time. Know exactly when it will reach your doorstep. Track Order Check Aadhaar PVC Card Order Status Track Delivery Have you recently ordered the new, durable Aadhaar PVC Card online by paying 50? If yes, you might be wondering when it will reach your home. The Check Aadhaar PVC card order status service allows you to track the progress of your printing request and its dispatch status. The entire process, from ordering to delivery, typically takes 5 to 15 working days . This tool helps you know exactly where your card is whether it is still printing or has been handed over to the post office. You Need Your SRN (Service Request Number) To check the status, you must have the 28-digit SRN . This number was generated when you successfully placed the order and paid the fees. It is available on the acknowledgement slip you downloaded. How to Check PVC Order Status Online Follow these simple steps to track your application Open the Tool Click on the Track Order button above. Enter SRN Enter the 28-digit Service Request Number (SRN) carefully. Security Check Type the Captcha code shown on the screen. Submit Click on Submit . The system will verify your request and display the current status. Understanding the Status Meanings Payment Successful Your order has been received by UIDAI. In Process Your data has been sent for printing. Dispatched Your card has been printed and handed over to India Post. (This is the most important status). How to Track via India Post (Speed Post) Once the status shows Dispatched , the portal will display an Airway Bill Number (AWB) . This is your tracking ID. Copy the Airway Bill Number (AWB). Visit the India Post Tracking website (indiapost.gov.in). Enter the AWB number in the Consignment Number field. You will see the exact location of your card and the expected delivery date. Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs) Q I lost my SRN. How can I check the status? Ans If you lost the SRN, check your SMS history for messages from UIDAI. Or check the Payment History section if you were logged in. Q The status says Dispatched but I haven t received it yet. Ans Delivery speed depends on India Post services. Use the Airway Bill Number to track it on the India Post website for real-time updates. Check Aadhaar Status Applied for a new Aadhaar or updated details? Track your application status in real-time using your Enrolment ID (EID) or URN. Check Status Check Aadhaar Enrolment Update Status Online Have you recently applied for a new Aadhaar card? Or have you updated your Name, Address, or Date of Birth at an Aadhaar Center? If yes, you don t need to visit the center again to know if your request is processed. The Check Enrolment Update Status service allows you to track your application in real-time. Whether you did the update online (via myAadhaar portal) or offline (at a Seva Kendra), you can track it here. Which Number Do You Need for Tracking? Depending on how you applied, you will have one of the following numbers 1. Enrolment ID (EID) Found on the top of the Acknowledgement Slip given at the Aadhaar Center. It contains 14-digit Enrolment No. 14-digit Date Time. 2. Service Request Number (SRN) Generated when you initiate an Online Update (like Address or Document Update) on the myAadhaar portal. It starts with S . 3. Update Request Number (URN) Generated via SMS if you updated details using the Self Service Update Portal (SSUP) in the past. How to Enter EID Correctly (Very Important) Most users fail to check status because they enter the EID incorrectly. The 28-digit EID is a combination of the Enrolment Number and Timestamp. Format Enrolment Number Year Month Day Time Example If slip says Date 15 08 2024, Time 14 30 55, Enrolment 1234 56789 01234 Enter like this 12345678901234 20240815 143055 (Notice the Date is reversed YYYY-MM-DD). Step-by-Step Tracking Process Follow these steps to know your current status Open the Tool Click on the Check Status button above. Enter ID Type your EID (28 digits), SRN, or URN in the box provided. Ensure there are no spaces or slashes. Security Check Enter the Captcha code exactly as shown. Submit Click Submit . The status will appear on the screen. What Does Your Status Mean? In Process Your application is still being verified by the backend team. This usually takes 5-30 days. Completed Congratulations! Your update is successful. You can now Download Aadhaar to see the changes. Rejected Your request was declined. This usually happens due to wrong documents or data mismatch. You will have to apply again. Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs) Q I lost my Acknowledgement Slip. How can I get my EID? Ans You can use the Retrieve EID UID service to get your Enrolment ID on your registered mobile number. Q How many days does it take to update Aadhaar? Ans As per UIDAI guidelines, up to 90 of updates are processed within 30 days. However, in some cases, it can take up to 90 days. Q Status shows Completed but I didn t get the card by post. Ans Completed means the data is updated online. The physical letter delivery takes extra time. You can download the e-Aadhaar immediately. Check Deceased Aadhaar Deactivation Status Once you have formally reported the death of a family member to UIDAI for Aadhaar deactivation, it is important to verify if the request has been processed. The Check Deceased Aadhaar Deactivation Status service allows legal heirs or guardians to track the progress of their application. Deactivating the Aadhaar of a deceased person is a critical step to prevent identity fraud and ensure that government records are updated accurately. Requirement You will need the Service Request Number (SRN) that was generated when you submitted the Report Death request. How to Track Deactivation Request Access the Tool Click on the Check Deceased Aadhaar Deactivation Status card on the myAadhaar dashboard. Enter SRN Input the 28-digit Service Request Number provided during the reporting process. Captcha Enter the security code displayed on the screen. View Status The system will show whether the request is Pending Verification , Approved (Deactivated), or Rejected (due to document mismatch). (Single Sign-On Login) SSO (Single Sign-On) ek aisa digital authentication system hai jo users ko sirf ek ID aur Password ke zariye kai saari sarkari aur private websites par login karne ki suvidha deta hai. Chahe wo Aadhaar Card Download ho, Ration Card ki jankari ho, ya Jan Aadhaar portal SSO Login se sab kuch ek jagah manage hota hai. Bharat mein digital services badhne ke saath, SSO ID Login ab har nagarik ke liye zaroori ho gaya hai. Is portal par aap apne Aadhaar number ya Face Auth ka upyog karke securely login kar sakte hain. New Update Ab aap bina password yaad rakhe, seedhe apne Chehre (Face Auth) ya Biometric se SSO Login kar sakte hain. SSO ID Registration Account Kaise Banayein? Agar aapke paas abhi tak SSO ID nahi hai, to aap niche diye gaye steps follow karke apna naya account register kar sakte hain Upar diye gaye SSO Login box mein Create New Account par click karein. Apna 12-digit Aadhaar Number enter karein. Aapke registered mobile par ek OTP aayega, use verify karein. Apna manpasand SSO User ID aur Password set karein. Registration complete hone par aap turant login kar sakte hain. Benefits of SSO Portal (SSO Ke Fayde) All-in-One Access Ek hi login se 100 services ka labh uthayein. Recover Forgotten Password Agar password bhool gaye, to Aadhaar OTP se reset karein. High Security Two-factor authentication (2FA) aur Identity verification. SSO Login FAQs Q Main apna SSO ID Password bhool gaya hun, kya karun? Ans Aap Forgot Password link par click karke apne registered mobile number ya Aadhaar OTP ke zariye apna password reset kar sakte hain. Q Kya SSO Login ke liye Aadhaar zaroori hai? Ans Haan, security verification ke liye Aadhaar card number ya Jan Aadhaar ID ka hona anivarya hai. Q SSO ID se main kaunsi services use kar sakta hun? Ans Aap Aadhaar PVC order, Address Update, Scholarship forms, Job applications, aur Electricity bill payment jaisi suvidhayein use kar sakte hain.

New York aur London mein students ne 'Main bhi cockroach' slogan se NEET system ke khilaf avaaz uthai. Biplab Biswas Published on 22 Jul 2026 Follow Advertisement NEET ke against chal rahe student protests ab sirf India tak mehboob nahi rahe ye London aur New York tak pahunch gaye hain! Hazar se zyada Indian students jo videshi sheher mein padhai kar rahe hain, unhone streets par utar kar "Main bhi cockroach" ke naare lagaaye hain aur NEET exam system ko leke apna gussa zahir kiya hai. Ye global movement dekh kar sarkari talash ho gai hai, kyunki National Testing Agency ke exam conduct karne ke tareekon ko lekar poore desh mein ek bada shukhna badh gaya hai aur ab videshi universities ke students bhi apna voice uthaane lage hain. Poori Khabar Kya Hai? NEET examination ko leker jo controversy badh gai hai, voh sirf desh ke andar tak simit nahi rahi. Lakho students jo India se bahar padhne gaye hain, unhe bhi iska prabhav pad raha hai kyunki unke parivar aur bhai-bahan jo desh mein hain, unko NEET dena padta hai. Jab se National Testing Agency ne exam conduct karne mein different tareekon ko follow kiya hai, tab se ek alag hi frustration ka mauhaul ban gaya hai. London aur New York mein Indian student communities ne "Main bhi cockroach" ke naare likhe hue placards le kar protests kiye hain, jo ek musical composition ke lyrics se liye gaye hain jo NEET se related ek satire ban gaya hai. Ye "Main bhi cockroach" slogan ek deep comment hai Indian education system aur NTA ke exam conduct ke tareekon par. Students ka kehna hai ki jis tarah cockroaches ko lab mein bekar samjha jata hai, usi tarah NTA unhein bhi sirf statistics samjh raha hai, numbers samjh raha hai, par unke actual learning aur skills ko nahi dekh raha. Jab National Testing Agency lakho students ke marks ko revise karta hai, jab answer keys mein galtiyan aati hain, toh students ko lagta hai ki unhein insaan ki tarah treat nahi kiya ja raha. Video clips aur social media posts se dekha ja sakta hai ki London ke Piccadilly Circus aur New York ke Times Square jaise jagahon par ye protests hue hain. NTA ke under NEET exam hota hai jo medical colleges mein admission ke liye zaruri hai. Pichle kuch mahine mein NEET ke marks mein jo modifications ane hain, jo grace marks diye gaye hain, jo ek saath multiple answer keys banaye gaye hain sab kuch mein ek bada jhoomla hai. Students ke hisaab se transparency nahi hai, sabka fairness nahi hai, aur jo topper ban gaye hain, unhe bhi shubh nahi hai kyunki unhe lagta hai ki shayad unhe galti se marks zyada mil gaye hain ya phir doosre ko kam mil gaye hain. Isse jo psychological pressure create hua hai, uspar ye global protests utha hai. Videshi sheher se ye protest signal bhej rahe hain ki NEET issue sirf ek local matter nahi raha. Agar lakho students jo abroad hain aur apne sapne poore kar rahe hain, ve bhi apne desh ke exam system ke khilaaf bolne ke liye bahar aaye, toh samajho ki problem kitna bada hai. International media ne bhi inn protests ko cover kiya hai, aur ye India ke education system par ek global spotlight ban gaya hai. Students kehte hain ki jab tak NTA ne NEET conduct karne ke tareekon ko transparent aur fair nahi banaya, tab tak ye protests chalte rahenge. Iss global movement se directly jo faida mil sakta hai voh hai medical education ko leker ek alag tarah ki consciousness create hona. Jab lakho students poore duniya se ek issue ko highlight kar rahi hain, toh sarkari vibhag ko sunna padta hai. NEET ke through jo lakho students har saal medical colleges mein admission lena chahte hain, unhe agar ye protests successful hote hain toh ek transparent aur fair system mil payega. Aaj jo NEET exam de raha hai, voh ek chota student nahi hai, uska ek international connection hai, uska voice international stage par suna ja sakta hai isse NTA ko samajhna padega ki exam conduct mein ek bada responsibility hai. Medical profession se jude 15-16 lakh students jo har saal NEET dete hain, unhe sab se zyada faida milega. Agar ye global movement se transparency aaye aur answer keys saaf-sutra ho jayen, toh future generations ko ek better examination experience milega. NEET ke marks par lakho students aur un ke parivar ke sapne depend karte hain. Jab scores revise hote hain, tab unhe lagta hai ki unhe na-insaafi hui hai. Agar protests se ye badlav aaye ki NTA apne processes ko improve kare, aapne training de, aapne double-check system banaye, toh lakho students ko aage faida milega. Indian government aur Ministry of Education ko bhi isse ek signal milega ki youth ko education system ke bare mein kitni chinta hai. Global level par agar India ke exam system ko lekar controversy ho raha hai, toh ye desh ke talent aur credibility ko affect karta hai. Videshi universities mein jo Indian students padhte hain, ve apne desh ko represent karte hain. Agar unhone videshi sheher mein streets par uttar kar protest kiya, toh iska matlab hai ki system mein kuch fundamental problems hain jo solve hone zaruri hain. International reputation ke liye bhi Indian government ko respond karna padega. International students jo apne desh ke liye iska voice ban gaye hain, unhe support milega apne colleges aur universities se. Faculty members, international student organizations, aur even some foreign governments Indian education system ko lekar questions pooch sakte hain. NEET exam ke next year ke conduct mein NTA ko behti-soch-samajh kar decision lena padega. Agar 2025 mein bhi same tarah issues aaye, toh protests aur bhi bade hote jayenge. Government level par bhi iska impact padega. Sarkaari committees aur education ministry ko NEET system ke liye ek complete audit karna padega. Technical issues, human error, aur systematic problems sab ko identify karna padega aur ek robust system develop karna padega. Isse pehle ke exam conduct mein NTA ko apne QA QC processes ko strengthen karna chahiye. Students ke complaints ko ek structured mechanism ke through handle karna chahiye taaki transparency baniye rahe. Agar kisi ko genuinely koi issue nazar aaye apne paper checking mein, toh NTA ke official website par detailed review request karna chahiye. Aksar Pooche Jaane Wale Sawaal Q1 "Main bhi cockroach" ka matlab kya hai? Ye ek symbolic statement hai jiska matlab ye hai ki students ko NTA unhe humans ki tarah value nahi de raha sirf statistics samjh raha hai. Cockroach lab experiment ka subject hote hain aur inhein scientific experiments mein use kiya jata hai. Students ye kehna chahte hain ki unhe same way treat kiya ja raha hai jaise lab specimens ko, unke individual concerns ignore ho rahe hain, sirf data collection chal raha hai. Ye phrase ekdum harsh criticism hai exam system ka. Q2 NEET scores revise kyun hote hain? Jab exam conduct ke baad NTA ko kisi question mein scientific error ya multiple valid answers mil jayein, toh voh answer key ko revise karte hain. Isse jo students affected hote hain, unhe grace marks diye jate hain. However, students ka point hai ki ye grace marks system arbitrary hai kisi ko mil gaya, kisi ko nahi. Transparency nahi hai kaunse exactly questions ko revise kiya gaya aur kyu, aur grace marking criteria kya tha. Q3 Videshi countries mein kyu ye protests ho rahe hain? Indian diaspora pura duniya mein phela hai. Jo students videshi universities mein padhe hue hain, unke younger siblings, cousins, aur family members ko India mein NEET dena padta hai. Jab apne gharwalon ke scores niyay karne wale system ko unfair dekha, toh unhone apna voice uthaaya. Plus, unhe videshi countries mein freedom of expression ka advantage hai jo unhe apni taraf India mein possible nahi hota. Q4 Kya NEET exam system badlega? Ye baat ki confirm nahi hai, lekin international pressure aur domestic protests se NTA ko zaroor apni processes improve karne padenge. Jo students demand kar rahe hain transparency, detailed answer explanations, grievance redressal mechanism ye sab reasonable hain. Sarkar ko bhi social unrest dekh kar respond karna padega. Changes slow hote hain, lekin ye momentum continue rahegi. Q5 Abhi NEET dene wale students ko kya karna chahiye? Apni preparation par focus rakhni chahiye aur exam mein apna best performance dena chahiye. Agar exam ke baad kisi ko kisi answer key par doubt ho, toh official review request file karna chahiye. Isme himmat mat haar system mein problems ho sakte hain, lekin individual effort se success milti hai. Apne score announce hone se pehle padhna mat chhod har mark matters. in Darkners TV World The Legend of Tenna Sword Route Castle Town Enemies Characters Bosses English 2 languages Русский 中文 From Deltarune Wiki Tenna's catchphrase, Chapter 3 Mr. "Ant" Tenna ( JP ミスター アン テナ Misutā An Tena ) , more often known as simply Tenna ( JP テナ Tena ) , is a Darkner who controls TV World and serves as the director of TV Time . He is the main antagonist and penultimate boss of Chapter 3 of Deltarune . Profile Appearance Tenna is a tall anthropomorphic TV-like Darkner. His head is a light purple cuboid television with two antennas with rounded ends. Tenna's face is a white screen with no eyes, a long white nose, and often sports a wide grin that can have normal blocky teeth, or sharp teeth. Tenna's screen can act like a normal television screen. His nose is detachable, and some of his noses are stored in a " nose drawer ." 8 The tip of Tenna's nose can sprout a pink flower if he is overjoyed. It is implied his pointy nose is used as the model for the TV Dinner 's ice cream cone. 9 When Tenna's screen turns blank or displays static, his nose disappears. Tenna's attire reflects his role as a director. He has a long sleeve red twin tailcoat with a set of yellow-lettered "TV" attached to the left side of his coat, and wears a yellow tie on top, a white shirt underneath his coat, a set of white gloves, a belt that has a gold TV-shaped buckle for his shiny black trousers, and long yellow shoes with black soles. Tenna's model moves with a distortion effect when he is speaking. Some of his animations are also a mix of static and fluid animations. Tenna is capable of shrinking his size, making himself large, or appearing squashed. This occurs based on his mood, which also applies to his antennas bending, his screen, his tie, and coattails. 10 Side-by-side comparison of possible cosmetic damage to the Dreemurr residence's television Tenna's Light World form is a cathode-ray tube television with a set of antennas on top. It is implied the screen has burn-in. 11 12 The TV sits on top of a red furniture pad, which is used as a buffer for a single-drawer stand beneath it. After the events of Chapter 3, the furniture pad disappears, the left antenna is broken and taped, the base of the antenna stand is cracked, and the top of the TV has a few scrapes. If Susie did not repair Tenna, the TV has even more scratches, and multiple cracks are visible on its screen. Personality Tenna announcing the first board during his show Tenna embodies the archetypical TV host he is energetic and enthusiastic, and always has a quick quip. 13 14 Exuberant and cartoony, he makes theatrical gestures and exaggerated movements. Tenna's dialogue is sometimes accompanied by detailed text graphics and sound effects. His humor tends to be gleefully absurd, and he often drops bizarre, wacky remarks. 15 16 Tenna is a natural charmer, consistently working to keep things fun and light-hearted for his audience. Tenna's desire to entertain is not limited to Lightners . He expressed relief and satisfaction when King and Lancer laughed at his accidental slapstick fall, despite his initial dismay. 17 As an old CRT, Tenna is behind the times. He does not know much about emails, 18 believes digital currency is secure, 19 and considers the retro-style game The Legend of Tenna as " state-of-the-art " and " modern ". 20 Owing to his age, Tenna frequently insists on his relevance. 21 22 Tenna is nostalgic about the past, frequently talking about his memories with the Dreemurr and Holiday families. Tenna's jubilant demeanor belies a deep-seated fear of being abandoned by the Lightners and a desperate need for their attention. 23 He is insecure about becoming outdated enough to be thrown away or ignored. 24 11 Driven by these fears, he has made at least two deals that harmed others. He convinced his ex-partner Spamton to sign a contract despite knowing it would cause serious problems. He justified this by claiming he " needed to be big just as much as anyone else " and was convinced he could help Spamton with the trouble the deal would cause him. 25 Before Kris and Susie entered TV World, and when he was left dusty and mostly unwatched, Tenna made a deal with the Knight to hold certain Lightners including two of his previous owners captive, keeping Toriel asleep and trapping others in a never-ending gameshow. 26 However, he expresses remorse for imprisoning Toriel. 27 Tenna engages in deceptive business practices. The " BRAND NEW FAMILY CAR " he promised as a potential prize is actually an ICE-E van marked "COMMERCIAL USE ONLY!!", which cannot be legally used for personal or family purposes. He kept this prize for himself, claiming the party was not going to win it and that he was " just giving it a daily TEST DRIVE ". 28 Tenna coercing his employees by withholding their salaries According to Small Mike , Tenna treats the people he works with as " expendable trash ". 29 He takes out his frustrations on his employees 30 and controls them through restrictive contracts. 31 Tenna conceals exploitative provisions in fine print, 32 33 has misrepresented the contracts to make work compensation appear better than it is, 34 and offers mediocre compensation such as " paid fruit-flavored vacation " and " left over glooby slime " as bonuses. 35 Speech pattern In his dialogue, Tenna frequently speaks with stylized logos inserted into his text, referred to as "Word Art" 36 37 and internally as funnytext . This quirk only occurs in situations where his dialogue is displayed in a normal message box, so it is not present during battles or other situations where his dialogue is displayed in a speech bubble. In the Japanese translation, Tenna has an additional speech quirk, where he frequently replaces the verb ending しょう ( shou ) with "SHOW" rendered in Latin text, resulting in phrases such as でSHOW ( deSHOW ) and まSHOW ( maSHOW ). This strongly resembles a similar quirk in Spamton's Japanese dialogue, where he replaces です ( desu ) with "DEATH" and だい ( dai ) with "DIE". Some of Tenna's "funnytexts" make call-backs to Undertale . The stylized text for " STOP " being on a blue octagon is a reference to Sans 's joking dialogue about blue stop signs, and text referencing Asriel and Toriel are accompanied by a musical cue relating to their respective leitmotifs . Several "funnytexts" are unused, such as one saying "YOGURT EMERGENCY" intended to be used when Susie spills her yogurt on her controller on the unused City Board . An event for the scene is left unused in the game's files and is otherwise fully functional. In this case, because it is used on the screen, it is listed as a board asset. 38 Every "funnytext" is accompanied by a sound, and some reference tracks from the DELTARUNE or UNDERTALE Soundtrack . For example, plays a section of His Theme , a section of Fallen Down , and a section of Your Power . "AMAZING" "TEARS" "Lovely" "STARS" "TV TiME!" "PHYSICAL CHALLENGES" "PRIZES" "GRAND PRIZE" " WIN!" It is also a remnant of an earlier design stage where Tenna had a more ant-like design. 39 Therefore, the "Ant" part refers to his bug-like antennae, long nose, and coattails that reference bug wings. It could also refer to his short stature when disappointed. Main story History The Dreemurr and Holiday families gathered around Tenna's Light World counterpart Tenna is the Dreemurrs' CRT TV in the Dreemurr residence , which brought entertainment to the Dreemurrs and Holidays. Asriel and Kris would watch cartoons while playing, Toriel would watch cooking shows for new recipes, and both the Dreemurr and Holiday families would always gather around the TV to watch the yearly holiday specials. In the Light World, Kris and a girl brought a laptop home to play make-believe games. According to Ramb , these games involved Queen , King, and Tenna. 40 In the Dark World, the laptop's arrival led Tenna and Spamton to meet and become business partners during the latter's era of success. 41 Spamton promised to teach him technology, and Tenna shared life advice with him. 42 Tenna eventually convinced Spamton to sign a contract and share the secret of him becoming a " BIG SHOT ", despite Mike's warnings that something " terrible " would happen if Spamton signed it. 25 While Spamton was signing the contract, however, he had to answer a phone call, the contents of which caused him to turn pale and run away. Tenna then reached for the phone, but heard no one in the receiver. Mike may have left due to this incident. 43 44 In the Light World, due to various circumstances, the Dreemurrs and the Holidays gradually watched the TV less and less. Toriel was the last person to watch the television before it was unplugged for a long period of time. 27 During the events of the game, it has been unused 45 46 and dusty, 47 and might have burn-in. Toriel was considering throwing it away. 48 Chapter 2 Tenna is first alluded to in Chapter 2 by his former business partner, Spamton. Selecting "FRIENDS" while talking to Spamton at his shop prompts him to rant about not needing friends, including " CRTs ", before warning Kris to not trust anything they see on TV, referencing Tenna. 49 On Chapter 2's Weird Route , shortly before Spamton NEO is fought, he compares Kris to a " Gameshow Host " for trying to ruin his success by "stealing" the library Fountain , 50 alluding to Tenna and his role as the host of TV Time . At the end of Chapter 2, when Kris makes a Dark Fountain in their house, the TV in the living room shows static that turns into a smile. This same form is shown in the "feature presentation" VHS intro as a 3D render. Chapter 3 After the Dreemurr residence Fountain was created, Tenna enlisted Darkners to sign his contracts, and those who refused to sign his contracts left for the " far land ". 51 Tenna's introductory presentation At the eastern end of the couch cliffs , Tenna interrupts Susie and Ralsei 's conversation by praising them as they are in the spotlight, then physically appears after Mike plays his VHS. 52 He proclaims the party are his contestants for his TV Time show, but becomes disappointed when Susie initially refuses. Tenna becomes elated after Ralsei reasons with Susie, and tells Mike to properly set up the game show. 53 Tenna accompanies the party by spectating and providing live commentary while they play on the Desert Board and Island Board . His equivalent NPC replicas in the game guide the party on how to complete each board. Sometimes, he intervenes directly and attempts to steer the party on the right track. He also provides instructions on how to complete each physical challenge. Meanwhile, in the Green Room following each round, Tenna holds secret phone calls with his subordinates regarding something he wants to keep hidden from the party. Susie grows suspicious of Tenna after overhearing one such conversation, so she and the party sneak out of the Green Room to investigate. They eventually find out what Tenna wanted to keep hidden from them Toriel, imprisoned in a gachapon capsule. Tenna suddenly arrives to check up on Toriel, noting out loud that she was the last to appreciate him and would serve as his "trump card". When he catches the party hiding behind Toriel's gachapon prison, he sends them back to the game show. Since the party refuses to continue the game, Tenna imprisons them in gachapon capsules as well, and forces them to participate in the "bonus round", with his insecurities of the Lightners leaving starting to flare up. Eventually, the party manages to escape, but Tenna orders his employees to search for the trio. As they repeatedly fail to find or capture the Lightners, Tenna breaks down further, pushing away his subordinates until they all abandon him, with Mike being the final one to leave. Tenna fighting the party Upon returning from TV World, Tenna blocks the way to the Dark Fountain. He explains his motive for wanting to create a show that would never end he used to be the Dreemurr family's beloved TV, entertaining both the Holiday and the Dreemurr families, but gradually was left unused. Following the Roaring Knight's appearance, he took a deal that involved keeping the party busy in hopes of gaining relevancy once more. Seeing that he cannot convince them to turn back, Tenna engages in battle against the party, presenting it as a final challenge that lasts until they accumulate enough points. Upon his defeat, Tenna admits that he just wants to be watched. Ralsei attempts to console him, saying he had already served his purpose. Susie interjects, promising him that she and Kris would find someone who would continue to watch him. Tenna, moved by her promise, agrees to release Toriel. However, after doing so, the Knight fatally attacks him by cutting off his arms, dealing 5,500-5,999 damage, 54 which puts him out of service. He is not seen again for the rest of the Chapter . Sword Route Main article Sword Route Tenna appears as an in-game NPC during the Island Board and manhole dungeon , providing insights on the nature of the Original Game and his relationships with Spamton and Kris. Tenna can first be found in the Island Board after finding the heart-shaped island (called the "Tropic of Love" in The Legend of Tenna ) that can only be found after reaching LV 2 and exploring the ocean. There, HERO_SWORD must break a tree with a different color tone compared to the others, which opens a pathway to a section similar in design to the manhole dungeon. There, Tenna stands in an inaccessible hallway, where he comments on his seemingly fruitless efforts to entertain Kris, while being frustrated at anomalies in the Original Game. After HERO_SWORD takes a step forward, Tenna notices a presence and leaves in a hurry. He is not seen again for the remainder of the board. Tenna's minigame replica in the manhole dungeon, explaining his history with Spamton After reaching LV MAX and breaking the trees blocking the exit to the dungeon, Tenna can be found again. He does not notice HERO_SWORD, repeatedly moving away from them, while lamenting over his failed business relationship with Spamton, including his reaction to the phone call that caused his downfall. He concludes by wishing Kris had never brought a laptop home, which is presumably how he met Spamton. After this, he finally turns around and notices HERO_SWORD, after which he addresses Kris, claiming he had kept his part of the deal and pleading to not be turned off again. documents: Home Content Index Books of the Bible Genesis Jacob and Esau Question What was the story of Jacob and Esau? Answer Jacob and Esau were the sons of Isaac and Rebekah and the first twins mentioned in the Bible. Even before they were born, they were struggling together in the womb of their mother. Their prenatal striving foreshadowed later conflict (Genesis 25 21-26). The twins grew up very different. Jacob was â a quiet man, staying among the tentsâ and his motherâ s favorite. Esau was â a skillful hunter, a man of the open countryâ and his fatherâ s favorite. One day, Esau returned from hunting and desired some of the lentil stew that Jacob was cooking. Jacob offered to give his brother some stew in exchange for his birthrightâ the special honor that Esau possessed as the older son, which gave him the right to a double portion of his fatherâ s inheritance. Esau put his temporary, physical needs over his God-given blessing and sold his birthright to Jacob (Genesis 25 27-34). When the time came for Isaac to bestow his blessing on his sons, Jacob and his mother contrived to deceive Isaac into blessing Jacob in Esauâ s place. When Esau found that his blessing had been given to Jacob, he threatened to kill his brother, and Jacob fled (Genesis 27 1 - 28 7). Years later, Jacob and Esau met and were reconciled (Genesis 33). Both Jacob and Esau were fathers of nations. God changed Jacobâ s name to Israel (Genesis 32 28), and he became the father of the 12 tribes of Israel. Esauâ s descendants were the Edomites (Genesis 36). Edom was a nation that plagued Israel in later years and was finally judged by God (Obadiah 1 1-21). In the New Testament, Esauâ s choice to sell his birthright is used as an example of ungodlinessâ a â godlessâ person who will put physical desires over spiritual blessings (Hebrews 12 15-17). By his negative example, Esau teaches us to hold fast to what is truly important, even if it means denying the appetites of the flesh. Both Old and New Testaments use the story of Jacob and Esau to illustrate Godâ s calling and election. God chose the younger Jacob to carry on the Abrahamic Covenant, while Esau was providentially excluded from the Messianic line (Malachi 1 2-3 Romans 9 11-14). Everyone knows that moshi moshi is what Japanese people say when they answer the telephone. But what does it really mean? There is a legend that kitsune (shape-shifting fox-spirits) cannot say moshi moshi , so if someone answers with that phrase, you know she must be a real human being or at least not a kitsune. However, that isn t where the phrase comes from. It is actually a contraction doubling of the word 申す mousu, which is the humble form of 言う iu say . So moshi moshi is really a polite, humble way of saying speaking, speaking or I say, I say . Moshi moshi is not only used on the telephone. It can also be used to call someone s attention in person. Kind of like saying Is anyone home? when someone doesn t seem to be listening. The pronunciation of moshi moshi varies somewhat, so it can come out sounding like moshmoshiii or moshimo-osh Other places we often find the mousu of moshi moshi are in phrases like 私は メアリーと申します (Watashi wa) Mary to moushimas My name is Mary What this literally means is (I am) said Mary a bit like the French je m appelle Mary (I call myself Mary). The usual way of saying this would be 私は メアリーと言います (Watashi wa) Mary to iimasu which also means (I am) said Mary . By using moushi-masu instead of ii-masu you are turning it into something like humble little me is said Mary . You use this on more formal occasions, like meeting your Japanese boss for the first time. Another common place we find the moushi of moshi-moshi is in the expression 申し訳ありません moushi-wake arimasen which the dictionaries often translate as I m sorry . A Japanese beginner once wrote to me びょうき で もうしわけ ありません (in grown-up Japanese 病気で申し訳ありません) Byouki de moushi-wake arimasen What she meant was I m sorry you are sick . But what moushi-wake arimasen literally means is something like there is no excuse I can humbly say . It does of course mean I m sorry but not the I m sorry of I m sorry you ve been sick well, not unless your bad cooking was to blame for it. Dictionaries, like textbooks, can be confusing! Ever wondered what these words really mean? Urusai , Yurusanai , Oishii , Yatta, Yokatta Just click one to find out now!

documents: Section 163 BNSS kya hai Bahut se log poochh rahe hain ki Section 163 BNSS aakhir hai kya. Ye purane Section 144 CrPC ka naya roop hai, jo naye Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita (BNSS) ke tahat laaya gaya hai, jab desh ne apne colonial-era criminal laws ko badalkar naya framework apnaya. Is section ke tahat prashasan kisi bhi ilaake mein logon ke ikattha hone, hathiyar le jaane ya protest karne par rok laga sakta hai, agar unhe lagta hai ki isse law and order bigad sakta hai. Ye ek preventive kanoon hai, jiska istemal District Magistrate ya us jaisa adhikari kar sakta hai. Delhi mein kaise laagu hua Parliament ke Monsoon Session ke dauran, jab CJP ne Parliament tak Chalo Sansad march ki ghoshna ki, to New Delhi district mein Section 163 BNSS laagu kar diya gaya. Iska matlab tha ki paanch ya usse zyada logon ka ikattha hona, march nikalna ya kisi bhi tarah ka pradarshan sakht mana tha sirf Jantar Mantar ke designated protest site par hi izazat thi, wo bhi prior permission ke saath. Isi Section 163 BNSS ki wajah se Delhi Police ne CJP ke Parliament march ko illegal declare kar diya, aur DCP New Delhi ne public advisory jaari kar saaf kiya ki koi permission nahi di gayi hai. Iske bawajood protest kyun hua Section 163 BNSS ke laagu hone ke bawajood hazaron protesters sadkon par utar aaye. Barricades tootne ki koshish hui, jiske baad security forces ne lathicharge aur tear gas ka istemal kiya. Ye dikhata hai ki kanooni pratibandh ke bawajood, jab janandolan ki taakat bahut badi ho, to prashasan ke liye control karna kitna mushkil ho jata hai. Delhi mein iska pichhla itihaas Delhi mein pehle bhi kai baar Section 144 (ab Section 163 BNSS ) laagu ki gayi hai chahe wo CAA protests ho ya kisan andolan. Har baar ye section protests ko control karne ke liye istemal hoti rahi hai, aur har baar isko lekar bahas bhi hoti hai ki kya ye shanti purvak pradarshan ke maulik adhikar ka hanan hai. Kanooni bahas CJP protest ke sandarbh mein bhi yahi bahas ek baar phir tez ho gayi hai. Ek taraf prashasan ka kehna hai ki Section 163 BNSS security ke liye zaroori tha, doosri taraf activists aur opposition netaon ka kehna hai ki ye shanti purvak protest ke adhikar ko kuchalne ka tarika hai. Delhi High Court mein bhi ek PIL daakhil ki gayi hai, jisme Delhi Police par protesters ki surveillance karne ka aarop lagaya gaya hai ye maamla is bahas ko aur gehra karega. Guide Overview Category Government Services Portal Bihar Bhumi Estimated Time 5 min Fee Free Complete Guide Bhaiyon, apni zameen ka khatiyan (Record of Rights purana land record) online nikalna hai? Bihar me ye bilkul free aur ghar baithe ho jaata hai - biharbhumi.bihar.gov.in pe "Apna Khata Dekhein" service se. Pehle ek confusion clear khatiyan purana survey-record jo ownership possession dikhata hai (frozen) jamabandi abhi ka updated record (har dakhil-kharij ke baad badalta hai) rasid lagan tax receipt. Khatiyan Kaise Nikale (Step-by-Step) biharbhumi.bihar.gov.in kholo "अपना खाता देखें Apna Khata Dekhein" pe click karo Bihar ke naqsche pe apna District (जिला) chuno Anchal Circle (अंचल CO) chuno Mauza (मौजा gaon) dropdown ya alphabet se chuno In me se kisi ek se search karo Khata number (खाता संख्या) Khesra number (खेसरा plot) Khatadhari ka naam (मालिक ka naam) ya poore mauza ki list dekho "खाता देखें Dekhein" record khulega "देखें print" se khatiyan PDF download print karo (free) Khatiyan vs Jamabandi vs Rasid (Confusion Clear) Cheez Kya Hai Khatiyan One-time survey Record of Rights (CS RS) - frozen, update nahi hota possession rights dikhata hai Jamabandi (Register-II) Current RoR - har mutation (dakhil-kharij) ke baad update "Jamabandi Panji Dekhein" service Khesra Ek single plot ka ID Khata Ek malik ke plots ka account grouping Rasid Lagan tax receipt - "Bhu-Lagan" service se ( guide ) Dhyan Khatiyan ownership ka proof-support hai par akela title deed nahi . Registry dispute me current jamabandi registered deed bhi lagte hain. FAQs Q Bihar khatiyan online kaise nikale? A biharbhumi.bihar.gov.in pe "Apna Khata Dekhein" district anchal mauza chuno khata khesra naam se search PDF download. Free. Q Khatiyan nikalne ki fee kitni hai? A Bilkul free - biharbhumi portal pe khata khatiyan dekhna aur print karna nishulk hai. Q Khata number nahi pata to? A Khatadhari (malik) ke naam se ya poore mauza ki list se dhundh sakte ho - naam wale option se search karo. Q Khatiyan aur jamabandi me kya farak hai? A Khatiyan purana survey RoR (frozen) Jamabandi current record jo har mutation pe update hota hai. Dono biharbhumi pe alag services hain. Q Khatiyan aur rasid ek hi cheez hai? A Nahi - khatiyan ownership record rasid lagan tax receipt (Bhu-Lagan service). Alag intents. Q Khatiyan se zameen ki registry ho jayegi? A Khatiyan ownership-support hai par akela kaafi nahi - registry me current jamabandi registered deed documents list chahiye. Q Online khatiyan legal maany hai? A Reference verification ke liye theek hai - legal use ke liye anchal office se certified copy lena behtar hota hai. Q Mobile se khatiyan nikal sakte hain? A Haan - biharbhumi.bihar.gov.in mobile browser pe bhi khulta hai wahi steps. This feature is a lifesaver for those who have misplaced their documents and need to download their e-Aadhaar urgent. Important Prerequisite To use this online facility, your Mobile Number or Email ID MUST be registered and linked with your Aadhaar. Difference Between UID and EID Term Full Form Description UID Unique ID This is your final 12-digit Aadhaar Number . Select this if you already had a card. EID Enrolment ID This is the 28-digit number from your acknowledgement slip (for new applications). Verify Now How to Verify Mobile Number Email Linked with Aadhaar In today s digital India, your Registered Mobile Number is the key to accessing almost all Aadhaar services. Whether you want to download your e-Aadhaar, update your address online, or verify your ITR, the OTP (One Time Password) is sent to this linked number. However, people often change their SIM cards or forget which mobile number they gave at the time of enrollment years ago. The Verify Email Mobile service on the myAadhaar portal solves this confusion. It allows you to check if the mobile number or email ID you currently possess is the one linked to your Aadhaar database. ℹ Important Clarification This service does NOT show you the mobile number linked to your Aadhaar (for privacy reasons). Instead, YOU have to enter a mobile number, and the system will tell you if it matches the records or not. It is a verification tool, not a search tool. Step-by-Step Process to Verify Mobile Number Follow this simple procedure to confirm your linked contact details Access the Service Click on the green Verify Now button above. Select Verification Type You will see two options Verify Mobile Number and Verify Email Address . Select the one you want to check. Enter Details First, enter your 12-digit Aadhaar Number . Then, enter the Mobile Number (or Email) that you think is linked. Security Check Enter the Captcha code exactly as shown in the image box. Send OTP Click on the Send OTP button. Check the Result The system will display a success or error message based on your input (explained below). Understanding the Result Messages After submitting, you will see one of these two messages. Here is what they mean Scenario 1 Match Found (Success) The mobile number you have entered is already verified with our records. Meaning Congratulations! The mobile number you typed IS the one linked to your Aadhaar. You can receive OTPs on this number. Scenario 2 No Match (Failure) The mobile number you have entered does not match with our records. Meaning The number you typed is NOT linked. Either you linked a different family member s number, or an old number that you have lost. Why is this Verification Important? 1. Fraud Prevention Ensuring that no unknown mobile number or email is linked to your ID protects your biometric and demographic data. 2. Banking Services To link Aadhaar with a bank account or PAN card, the OTP validation is mandatory. Verifying ensures you are using the correct SIM. 3. Updates You cannot update your address or download Aadhaar online if you don t know which number receives the OTP. Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs) Q The system says Record not found . What should I do? Ans This means the mobile number you are entering is incorrect. Try entering mobile numbers of your family members. If none match, you must visit an Aadhaar Seva Kendra to check or update your number. Q Can I update my mobile number using this service? Ans No. This service is only for verification . To update or change your mobile number, biometric authentication is required, which can only be done offline at a center. Report Death Deactivate Aadhaar Secure the identity of your deceased family member. Officially report the death to UIDAI to prevent misuse of documents. Report Now How to Report Death of a Family Member for Aadhaar Deactivation The Aadhaar card is a unique identity proof that remains valid for a lifetime. However, in the unfortunate event of a family member s demise, it is the responsibility of the legal heir or guardian to inform the Unique Identification Authority of India (UIDAI). The Report death of a family member service allows you to officially flag an Aadhaar number for deactivation. This is a crucial step to ensure that the deceased person s identity documents are not misused for financial fraud, illegal SIM card issuance, or identity theft. Why is Deactivating Aadhaar Important? Many people often overlook this step, but keeping a deceased person s Aadhaar active can lead to several complications Prevent Misuse Scammers often look for dormant identities to open fake bank accounts or take loans. Subsidies Benefits To prevent the continued transfer of government benefits (like pensions) to a deceased person, which can later lead to legal recovery issues. Closure of Records It helps in closing other linked official documents like PAN Card and Voter ID systematically. Important Requirement To use this service, you MUST have a valid Death Certificate issued by the Registrar of Births and Deaths. The details on the Death Certificate must match the Aadhaar details of the deceased. Procedure to Report Death Online UIDAI has simplified the process by allowing family members to initiate this request via the myAadhaar portal. Follow these steps Login to Portal The reporting family member (Applicant) must login to the myAadhaar portal using their Own Aadhaar Number and OTP. You cannot login using the deceased person s Aadhaar. Select the Service On the dashboard, locate and click on the Report death of a family member card. Enter Details of Deceased Enter the 12-digit Aadhaar Number of the deceased family member. You may also need to provide their Name and Date of Birth as per records. Upload Document Upload a clear scanned copy (PDF JPG) of the Death Certificate . Ensure the file size is within the permissible limit (usually 2MB). Review Submit Verify all the details entered. Once submitted, you will receive a Service Request Number (SRN) to track the status. What Happens Next? (Verification) Reporting the death online does not instantly deactivate the Aadhaar. The request goes through a verification process 1. Registrar Verification The details are cross-verified with the birth and death registration records. 2. Deactivation Once verified, the UIDAI will permanently deactivate the Aadhaar number of the deceased. 3. Confirmation You can check the status using the Check deceased Aadhaar deactivation status service on the same portal. Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs) Q Can anyone report the death? Ans Usually, only immediate family members (spouse, children, parents) whose mobile numbers are linked or who can prove the relationship can initiate this request. Q Is it mandatory to deactivate Aadhaar after death? Ans While there is no strict penalty currently, it is highly recommended for safety and to close the financial and legal footprint of the deceased. Q Can I reactivate the Aadhaar later if reported by mistake? Ans No. Once an Aadhaar is marked as Deceased and deactivated after proper verification, it cannot be reactivated.
