The chief minister of Rajasthan is the chief executive of the Indian state of Rajasthan. In accordance with the Constitution of India, the governor is a state's de jure head, but de facto executive authority rests with the chief minister. Following elections to the Rajasthan Legislative Assembly, the state's governor usually invites the party (or coalition) with a majority of seats to form the government. The governor appoints the chief minister, whose council of ministers are collectively responsible to the assembly. Given the confidence of the assembly, the chief minister's term is for five years and is subject to no term limits.Chief Minister also serves as Leader of the House in the Legislative Assembly. At the time of India's independence in 1947, the region known as Rajputana included various princely states and the province of Ajmer-Merwara. Over time, these areas were gradually integrated to form the modern Indian state of Rajasthan. The integration occurred in seven stages, from March 1948 to November 1956. On 18 March 1948, the states of Alwar, Bharatpur, Dholpur, and Karauli merged their territories to form the Matsya Union, with Shobha Ram becoming its prime minister. Shortly after, on 25 March 1948, the Rajasthan Union was formed by the states of Bundi, Kota, Jhalawar, Dungarpur, Banswara, Pratapgarh, Kishangarh, Tonk, Shahpura and the chiefship of Lawa, with Gokul Lal Asava serving as its first prime minister. On 18 April 1948, Udaipur State joined the Union, and Prime Minister Jawaharlal Nehru inaugurated the newly named United State of Rajasthan, with Manikya Lal Verma becoming its prime minister. Later, on 30 March 1949, the states of Jaipur, Jodhpur, Bikaner, and Jaisalmer merged into the union, which was then renamed the United State of Greater Rajasthan. Hiralal Shastri became the prime minister on 7 April 1949. On 15 May 1949, the Matsya Union joined the United State of Greater Rajasthan. From 26 January 1950, the state officially came to be known as Rajasthan, with Shashtri continuing as its first chief minister. On 3 March 1952, following the first legislative assembly election, Tika Ram Paliwal of the Indian National Congress became the first elected chief minister of the state. Since 1949, three people have served as Prime Minister and fourteen people have served as chief minister of Rajasthan. Mohan Lal Sukhadia of the Congress party is the longest-serving chief minister, having been sworn in four times and serving for over sixteen years. Vasundhara Raje Scindia of the Bharatiya Janata Party is the only female to have held this position. Since 1998, no chief minister or political party has retained power after completing one term, a trend that continued in the recent elections. After a victory with 115 seats in the 2023 assembly elections, Bhajan Lal Sharma of the Bharatiya Janata Party succeeded Ashok Gehlot of the Indian National Congress. Oath as the state chief minister The chief minister serves five years in the office. The following is the oath of the chief minister of state I, Name of Chief Minister , do swear in the name of God solemnly affirm that I will bear true faith and allegiance to the Constitution of India as by law established, that I will uphold the sovereignty and integrity of India, that I will faithfully and conscientiously discharge my duties as a Minister for the State of () and that I will do right to all manner of people in accordance with the Constitution and the law without fear or favour, affection or ill-will.Oath of Secrecy "I, Name , do swear in the name of God solemnly affirm that I will not directly or indirectly communicate or reveal to any person or persons any matter which shall be brought under my consideration or shall become known to me as a Minister for the State of Name of State except as may be required for the due discharge of my duties as such Minister."Pad ki Shapath (Oath of Office) "Main, CM ka Naam , Ishwar ki shapath leta hoon satyanishtha se pratigyan karta hoon ki main vidhi dwara sthapit Bharat ke Samvidhan ke prati sachi shraddha aur nishtha rakhunga. Main Bharat ki prabhuta aur akhandta akshunn rakhunga. Main State ka Naam ke Rajya ke Mukhya Mantri ke roop mein apne kartavyon ka shraddhapoorvak aur shuddh antahkaran se nirvahan karunga, tatha main bhay ya pakshpat, anurag ya dwesh ke bina, sabhi prakar ke logon ke prati Samvidhan aur vidhi ke anusar nyay karunga." B. Gopniyata ki Shapath (Oath of Secrecy) "Main, CM ka Naam , Ishwar ki shapath leta hoon satyanishtha se pratigyan karta hoon ki jo vishay State ka Naam ke Rajya ke Mukhya Mantri ke roop mein mere vichar ke liye laya jayega athva mujhe gyaat hoga, use kisi vyakti ya vyaktityon ko, tab ke sivay jab ki aise Mukhya Mantri ke roop mein apne kartavyon ke uchit nirvahan ke liye aisa karna apekshit ho, main pratyaksh (directly) ya apratyaksh (indirectly) roop mein sansuchit ya prakat nahi karunga." Instagram Trending Ai Poster Photo Editing Prompt - Doston agar aap bhi apne normal photo ko trending Instagram poster mein badalna chahte ho to aaj ke is article mein main aapke liye lekar aaya hoon Instagram trending poster photo prompts, jinka istemal karke aap ai ki madad se sirf one click mein apna poster bana sakte ho. Aur agar aap bhi seekhna chahte ho ya phir apna photo banana chahte ho to bas article ko dhyan se aur last tak zarur padhein, kyunki article mein maine aapko step by step poori acchi tarike se bataya hai ki kaise aap is prompt ka istemal karke photo create kar sakte ho Google Gemini aur ChatGPT mein. Instagram par aapne abhi dekha hi hoga ki sabhi log apne Instagram profile ka photo wala poster, jo ki 3D dikhta hai, use banakar upload kar rahe hain aur un sab ka photo viral ho raha hai. To chaliye main aapko bilkul sahi tarike se batata hoon ki kaise aap is prompt ki help se photo bana sakte ho. Trending Prompt What Is a Trending Ai Poster Editing Prompt? Poster editing prompt ek poori detail mein bataya gaya instruction hota hai jisme light, face, background, clothes sab pehle se hi explain kiya hua rehta hai. Aapko bas is prompt ko copy karna rehta hai aur Google Gemini ya ChatGPT mein jaakar apne clear face wala photo upload karke is prompt ko paste karna rehta hai aur kuch hi second mein aapki photo ban jaati hai. Is prompt mein aap thode bahut changes karke aur bhi acche-acche photo auto create kar sakte ho. Aur doston aajkal creators is prompt ki madad se apna photo banakar acche khaase followers badha rahe hain aur aise photo par likes bhi bahut zyada aate hain. Why Ai Poster Editing Is So Popular? Doston Instagram par sabhi ko bilkul perfect photo pasand aata hai jisme color grading aur lighting matlab photo bilkul perfect ho. Tabhi log use like karte hain aur us par comment karte hain aur unhe scroll karne se rok dete hain. Isse photo ke viral hone ke chances bhi badh jaate hain. Social Media Branding Doston ek acchi DP aapki profile ko professional banati hai aur aap in posters ko bhi laga sakte ho jisse aapki profile creative aur acchi lagegi. Viral Visual Appeal Isme istemal kiye gaye 3D elements aur glow effects audience ko attract karte hain. Luxury Aesthetic Doston isme text se followers likha rehta hai aur ek side mein Instagram profile photo hota hai jo ekdum luxury feel deta hai. Creative Freedom Agar aap mere diye gaye is prompt ko thoda bahut change karke aur add karke istemal karte ho to aapko bahut hi behtar result milenge. Fast Editing Aur doston iske liye aapko koi bhi editing karne ki zarurat nahi padti hai. Bina editing ke hi bilkul professional poster ready ho jaata hai. Professional Trending Poster Prompt ChatGPT Photo Editing Prompt (100 Working) Prompt Ultra realistic Instagram milestone celebration poster design. A stylish Indian teenage boy wearing black sunglasses, black white check shirt, blue jeans and white sneakers. Two different poses of the same person - one upper-body stylish portrait looking sideways at the top right, and one full-body sitting pose on giant metallic 3D "1.5M" text at the bottom center. Bright orange cinematic gradient background on top with smoky dark grey background at bottom separated by torn paper effect. Include realistic Instagram profile Ul on left side with username, followers count, reels creator details, bio text and social icons. Add floating 3D Instagram logos around the scene with depth blur. Add glowing orange sparks, cinematic lighting, dramatic shadows, high contrast, ultra HD 8K quality, realistic skin texture, DSLR depth of field, stylish influencer vibe. The giant "1.5M" text should 100k metallic steel with orange glowing edges and circular platform below it. Add "FOLLOWERS" text below. Add handwritten signature style text and Generate Image Instagram Trending Poster Photo Editing Prompt Prompt "CREATE A SURREAL, CINEMATIC IMAGE IN HIGH 4K RESOLUTION." KEEP THE PERSON'S FACE IN THE ORIGINAL PHOTO UNCHANGED. WITHOUT ALTERING ANY FACIAL FEATURES OR STRUCTURE AN ASIAN WOMAN, AS PICTURED, IS STRIDING CONFIDENTL Y OUT OF A GIANT SOCIAL MEDIA SCREEN (A FACEBOOK-STYLE PROFILE INTERFACE) THE 3D PAPER-TEARING EFFECT IS INCREDIBLY REALISTIC THE SCREEN IS RIPPED OPEN. AND PIECES OF TORN PAPER FLY AROUND, CREATING A SENSE OF SPATIAL DEPTH. THE WOMA SEEMS TO BREAK FREE FROM THE DIGITAL WORLD AND STEP INTO REAL LIFE DYNAMIC POSE ONE FOOT STEPS FORWARD. ONE ARM REACH ES TOWARDS THE CAMERA, CREATING A SENSE OF MOVEMENT AND STRONG DEPTH. BEHIND IT IS THE PERSONAL PROFILE INTERFACE WITH DETAILS AS SHOWN IN THE IMAGE AVATAR USER NAME NUMBER OF FOLLOWERS CONTROL BUTTONS (DASHBOARD. REELS. IMAGES.... MINIMALIST GRAY STUDIO BACKGROUND, CINEMATIC LIGHTING. STRONG. HIGH CONTRAST. SHARP SHADOWS HIGHLIGHTING THE CHARACTER. STYLE PHOTOREALISTIC. CINEMATIC. SURREAL. HIGH-END ADVERTISING. ULTRA-DETAILE Generate Image Designer-Level Editing Tips Use High-Resolution Photos Guys, low quality ya phir blur image poster ko kharab bana deti hai. Ya phir side pose ya piche ke pose ka istemal karne se bhi acche result nahi milte. Face Details Preserve Karo Agar aapko exact face ke saath result chahiye to clear face wala HD photo istemal karna hai jisse aapka face change nahi hoga aur photo real face ke saath poster mein banega. Over Editing Avoid Karo Photo create ho jaane ke baad aapko usmein zyada editing nahi karni hai. Bas thoda bahut color grading karte hi aapka photo accha ban jaega kyunki zyada editing karne se photo ka look kharab ho jaata hai. Shadows Highlights Balance Karo Agar poster mein light ya shadows ka balance kharab ho jaata hai to use aap kisi bhi editing app mein jaakar apne hisaab se light aur shadows increase ya decrease karke sahi kar sakte ho. Best AI Tools for Poster Editing Doston maine aapko niche kuch AI tools bataye hain jo ki aajkal kaafi zyada popular ho rahe hain aur adhikansh log inka istemal karke apni photo banate hain. ChatGPT Google Gemini Canva AI Grok AI Aap bilkul realistic poster bana sakte ho jo ki dekhne mein kaafi kamal ka lagega aur inmein aapko kuch free credits bhi mil jaate hain jinse aap kuch photos create kar sakte ho. How Create Trending Poster Doston to chaliye ab main aapko batata hoon ki kaise aap bhi trending poster bana sakte ho. Sabse pehle aapko article mein diye gaye prompt ko copy kar lena hai. Uske baad kisi bhi image generator AI tool ko open karna hai. Aur wahan par apna koi bhi photo upload karke copy kiye gaye prompt ko paste kar dena hai. Aur send par click karte hi thodi der mein aapka photo bankar ready ho jaega. Jise aap download par click karke apni gallery mein save kar sakte ho. Final Conclusion Doston trending AI poster editing ek trend nahi hai, balki aane wale future mein sabse zyada use hone wala poster editing style hai jise aap sirf prompt likhkar bana sakte ho. Bas aapko apna simple clear face wala photo upload karna hai aur prompt paste karke aap bilkul perfect trending poster create kar sakte ho. Aur agar aap aise hi aur photo edits create karna chahte ho to aapko meri website par kaafi saare alag-alag styles ke prompts mil jaenge jinka istemal karke aap alag-alag style mein apni photo create kar sakte ho. Guide Overview Category Government Services Portal Academic Bank of Credits Estimated Time 10 min Fee Free Complete Guide Students, ABC ID (Academic Bank of Credits) ke baare me sun rahe ho aur confuse ho ki ye APAAR se alag hai ya wahi? Clear karte hain ABC ID 12-digit "digital vault" jismein tumhare college university ke credits store, transfer aur redeem hote hain (NEP 2020 ke tahat). Ye higher-education (college university) students ke liye hai aur admission enrolment me increasingly mandatory ho raha hai. Banana free hai - abc.gov.in ya DigiLocker se. Poora tarika ABC vs APAAR ka farak neeche. ABC ID Kaise Banaye (DigiLocker Se) abc.gov.in kholo (ya DigiLocker Education tab Academic Bank of Credits) Aadhaar-linked mobile number se DigiLocker pe sign-in register DigiLocker KYC authenticate karo Profile bharo apni Higher Education Institution (university college) list se chuno Generate 12-digit ABC ID ban jayegi save download karo Validity credits 7 saal tak accessible ID institutions ke beech transferable ABC ID vs APAAR ID (Confusion Clear) Cheez ABC ID APAAR ID Kya Credit vault (credits store transfer) Permanent student ID (lifelong) Kiske liye Higher-ed (college university) School se college tak, school records NEP role Credit accumulation transfer "Student account number" Link ABC APAAR ID use karta hai credits track karne ke liye Base student identifier Dono linked hain par alag - ABC credits ka bank hai, APAAR permanent identity hai. FAQs Q ABC ID card kaise banaye? A abc.gov.in ya DigiLocker (Education tab) pe Aadhaar-linked mobile se login, KYC, institution chuno, 12-digit ABC ID generate . Q ABC ID banane ki fee kitni hai? A Bilkul free - abc.gov.in DigiLocker official hai. Q ABC ID aur APAAR ID ek hi cheez hai? A Nahi - ABC ID credit vault (credits store), APAAR permanent student ID . Linked hain par alag kaam. Q ABC ID kiske liye zaroori hai? A Higher-education (college university) students ke liye - admission enrolment me increasingly mandatory. Q ABC ID kitne digit ka hota hai? A 12-digit unique ID - DigiLocker se generate hota hai. Q ABC ID DigiLocker ke bina ban sakta hai? A DigiLocker-based Aadhaar KYC hi standard rasta hai - abc.gov.in bhi DigiLocker se connect karta hai. Q Credits kitne saal tak store rehte hain? A 7 saal tak accessible ID institutions ke beech transferable hai (transfer re-admission me kaam aata hai). Q ABC ID ka photo card download hota hai? A Haan - generate hone ke baad ID card DigiLocker abc.gov.in se download save kar sakte ho. Ye Bhi Zaroor Padhein APAAR ID Card (One Nation One Student ID) - permanent student ID DigiLocker Bihar Board Marksheet - documents digilocker me Bihar Graduation Scholarship Rs 50,000 - students ke liye Bihar Post Matric Scholarship - college students Bihar Government Job Portals - saari services Source UGC Ministry of Education (abc.gov.in, DigiLocker). ABC ID 12-digit credit vault (NEP 2020), higher-ed students distinct from APAAR (permanent ID) but linked. Free via DigiLocker Aadhaar KYC credits 7-year accessible. Students, ABC ID free me ban jaati hai aur aage credit transfer re-admission me kaam aati hai - DigiLocker se 10 minute me banao, dalaal ko paisa mat do! Share with a colleague! Mr. Alexander Hellmers CEO Alexander tell us about your background in freight forwarding shipping and how did you end up in working for Project Logistics Alliance? Who are the owners of the network and what is your vision in the company? The Project logistics Alliance (PLA) was initiated by a group of forwarders who are also founding members of PLA. Mr. Juergen Weyhausen who is working at Alexander Global Logistics took a leading role in setting up the network. He has over 44 years of industry knowledge and consults PLA. My personal background is in supply chain management and finance. The PLA ownership structure is split between my father Carsten Hellmers and myself. In addition, a minority share is held by the Kutzner Process optimization, a company whose main business is software development and process optimization. Our long term strategic direction, apart from being the first highly specilised project network is as follows We strive to create a platform where members can offer projects to other members, particularly for cross-trades. This platform has now been launched and is gaining traction Further, a platform to collaboratively buy freight rates to get better discounts is planned Workshops targeted at special countries and areas Networking sessions for emerging markets and for countries with special demands i.e. customs requirements in Brazil India, permit procedures in China Nigeria, etc. We understand that PLA is a new network tell us in layman s terms what a freight forwarding network actually is doing? We created the network to form an alliance of truly skilled project cargo experts. The founding members who are also members of other networks felt that these networks are collecting members without properly controlling the quality of the members. PLA is certainly not a Pay to Join network. We started on the 20th of December 2016 and have now 54 individual members, covering more than 86 countries. PLA membership is limited to two members per country to ensure sufficient coverage, larger markets such as (USA, China, and India) may need more representation. The strategic vision of the network is to go further than just an annual meeting per year. We provide a distinct business environment through the quality of our members Potential members have to undergo a strict admission process and meet certain requirements to qualify (please see below) This ensures a high quality business network made by professionals for professionals with 100 project cargo no common forwarders PLA thereby strives to unite the best companies in the industry in one network. I hear that the market is saturated with networks and that forwarders are inundated with emails asking them to join this or that network. What is your comment to this? I think this statement is true and it is exactly why we decided to start a network which aspires to much higher standards. Most networks are run by people who are experts at marketing or event management. The majority of the networks are not run by industry experts. This certainly does not mean that other networks are not beneficial for their members. However, we thrive to be more focused and niche. In our opinion the most important thing is to create value for the member, not for the network as such. We aim to keep the cost for our members to a minimum. At our events, we focus on connecting the right people in the right location. Since the start we received an incredible amount of positive feedback and support, and we are working hard on improving the network continuously. On a weekly basis we get approached by people who have heard about PLA and would like to have more information. That is a great feeling and confirms that there is demand for such a highly specialised network. What makes you different from the others? We have created a community of true project cargo professionals. Unlike other networks our members have to demonstrate a track record of projects they have handled. In our opinion, a 40 flat rack with 45 tons weight does not count as a project. This would not be enough to qualify as a PLA member. Since we started we turned down the applications of 24 companies. Our application process is strict and every applicant has to provide 2 reference projects or case studies 2 customer references A company presentation containing financial information, number of employees, geographical coverage, and annual number of projects Tell us about the value that you believe you provide members with. Continuously securing the strictly professional quality of our members is key. That level of quality and business skills together with the membership limit (regular limit is 2 members per country) ensures a certain exclusiveness. Our project platform for enhanced communication among our members Elevated exposure within the market publishing of company news Do you have regular meetings where members meet up and are you also present at the various expos around the world? Yes, we have an annual conference every year. Each member can schedule appointments upfront to meet with other members. In addition to the meeting there are presentations on topics of interest. We held our first annual meeting in April 2017 in Antwerp and 45 people attended, which was a great success for us. Our next meeting is going to be in Vietnam in September 2018. In Addition to that we will host a dinner event and one day of one to one meetings in May 2018 in Bremen prior to the Breakbulk conference. There would certainly be interested parties among our readers, how to approach you if anyone would like to become a member? Yes certainly anybody interested in PLA is more than welcome to contact me at the details below. طه ١ مَآ أَنزَلۡنَا عَلَيۡكَ ٱلۡقُرۡءَانَ لِتَشۡقَىٰٓ ٢ إِلَّا تَذۡكِرَةٗ لِّمَن يَخۡشَىٰ ٣ تَنزِيلٗا مِّمَّنۡ خَلَقَ ٱلۡأَرۡضَ وَٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ ٱلۡعُلَى ٤ "Taha" Hum ne tujh par ye quran isliye naazil nahi kiya ke tu musibat me padd jaye. Balke nasihat karne ke liye, usko jo darta hai. Us ki taraf se utaara hua hai jis ne zameen ko aur oonche aasmano ko paida kiya" Allah Taala ne Nabi Kareem (ﷺ) ko mukhatib karke farmaya ke ye Quran aap aur aapke sahaba ke liye shiqawat o badbakhti ka sabab nahi hai, balke ye to Allah Taala se darne walo ke liye apni aayato me moazzat o nasihat liye hue hai, taakey wo isse istefadah karte hue khuloos niyat ke sath Allah ki bandagi kare aur is raah me kuffar o mushrekeen ki janib se jo bhi takleef pahuche use khandah peshani se bardasht kare. Aakhri aayat me Quran kareem ki azmat aur shaan ko bayaan kiya gaya hai ke Aey Mere Nabi! Ye Quran aap par aap ke Rab ki janib se naazil hua hai , jis ne zameen aur oonche aasman paida kiye hain. Makhlooqat me se zameen o aasman ka bataur khaas isliye zikar aaya ke bande Allah ki azeem makhlooqat ka har waqt mushahidah karte rehte hain. مَآ أَنزَلۡنَا عَلَيۡكَ ٱلۡقُرۡءَانَ لِتَشۡقَىٰٓ Saiyyada Aayesha (Razi Allahu anha) bayan karti hain ke Nabi Kareem (ﷺ) unke paas tashreef laye, tab unke paas ek aurat baithi hui thi. Aap ne poochha "Ye kaun hai?" Maine jawab diya, ye fala'n aurat hai jo raat bhar nahi soti aur inn ki namaz (tahajjud) ka zikar kiya gaya, to Aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya "Bas tumhe itna hi amal karna chahiye jitne ki tum me taqat ho, kyonki Allah ki kasam! Allah (sawab dene se) nahi uktata, lekin tum khud hi (amal karte karte) ukta jaoge aur Allah Taala ko sab se zyada mehboob ibadat o itaat wo hai jis par amal karne wala hameshgi kare." Bukhari 1151, Muslim 785 221 Saiyyadna Abu Huraira'h (Razi Allahu anhu) bayan karte hain ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ) ne farmaya "Yaqeenan deen aasan hai aur jo deen mein beja sakhti karta hai to deen uspar ghalib aajata hai. Pas tum seedhe raste par raho myanarawi ikhtiyaar karo aur (apne rab ki tarf se milne wale ajar par) khush ho jao aur subah o shaam aur raat ke kuch hisse mein ibadat se madad talab karo." Bukhari 39 Saiyyadna Anas (Razi Allahu anhu) bayan karte hain ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ) masjid mein tashreef laye to ek rassi ko do satoono ke darmiyan bandha hua paya. Aap ne poochha "Ye rassi kis maqsad ke liye hai?" Logon ne batlaya ke ye Saiyyada Zainab (Razi Allahu anha) ki rassi hai, jab wo (ibadat karte karte) thak jati hain to iske sath sahara le leti hain. Nabi Kareem (ﷺ) ne farmaya "aisa na karo, ise khol do, tum me se har shakhs ko chahiye ke wo uss waqt namaz padhe jab wo farhat o nishaat mehsoos kare, jab thak jaye to wo baith jaye." Bukhari 1150, Muslim 784 Saiyyadna hanzalah bin Rabi Aseedi (Razi Allahu anhu) se riwayat hai aur ye Nabi (ﷺ) ke katibo mein se the, bayan farmate hain ke mujhe Abu Bakar(Razi Allahu anhu) mile, unhone poochha, hanzalah! kaise ho? Maine kaha, hanzalah to munafiq ho gaya hai. Abu Bakar ne farmaya, Subhan Allah! Ye tum kya keh rahe ho? Maine kaha, (baat ye hai ke jab) hum Rasool Allah (ﷺ) ke paas hote hain to Aap hamare saamne jannat aur dozakh ka is tarah tazkirah karte hain goya hum unhe aankho se dekh rahe ho, lekin jab hum Rasool Allah (ﷺ) ki majlis se nikal aate hain aur biwi aur bachcho aur duniya ke karobar mein mashghool ho jate hain to hum bahut kuch bhool jate hain. Abu Bakar ne farmaya, Allah ki kasam! aisi hi kaifiyat se to hum bhi dochaar hain. Chunanche mai aur Abu Bakar (Razi Allahu anhu)(dono) chalte chalte Nabi Kareem(ﷺ) ki khidmat me pahuch gaye. Maine kaha, Aye Allah ke Rasool! hanzalah to munafiq ho gaya hai. Rasool Allah (ﷺ) ne farmaya "wo kaise?" Maine kaha, Ya Rasool Allah! Hum aapke paas hote hain aur aap hamare saamne jannat aur dozakh ka tazkirah farmaate hain to aise maalum hota hai ke hum apni aankho'n se ye sab dekh rahe hain, phir jab hum aapki majlis se nikal jate hain to biwi bachcho aur karobar mein mashghool ho jate hain to hum bahut kuch bhool jate hain. Rasool Allah (ﷺ) ne farmaya "iss zaat ki qasam, jiske hath me meri jaan hai! Agar tum hamesha isi haalat o kaifiyat me raho jis mein tum mere paas hote ho aur (har waqt) Allah ki yaad mein raho to farishte tumhare bistaro aur tumhare raasto mein tum se musafah kare, lekin aey hanzalah! Saiyyadna Moaviya (Razi Allahu anhu) bayan karte hain ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ) ne farmaya "Allah Taala jis ke sath bhalayi ka irada farmata hai to usey deen ki samajh ata farma deta hai." Bukhari 71, Muslim 1037 ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنُ عَلَى ٱلۡعَرۡشِ ٱسۡتَوَىٰ ٥ "Wo behad reham wala arsh par buland hua." Khaliq arz-o-samaa aur duniya-o-aakhirat mein reham karne wala wo Allah hai jo arsh par mustavi hai. Allah ki sifat "Astava" ke bare mein salf saleheen ka ye aqeedah hai ke Quran-o-Sunnat mein Allah Taala ki jo sifat sabit hain unhe isi tarah taweel-o-tahreef, tashbiya-o-tamseel aur baghair koi kaifiyat bayan kiye hue maan liya jaye. لَهُۥ مَا فِي ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَمَا بَيۡنَهُمَا وَمَا تَحۡتَ ٱلثَّرَىٰ ٦ "Usi ka hai jo kuch aasmano mein hai aur jo zameen mein hai aur jo un dono ke darmiyan hai aur geeli mitti ke neeche hai." Aasman aur zameen mein aur unke darmiyan jo kuch bhi hai, wo sab Allah ki milkiyat aur uske zer-e-saltanat hai, unme se koi bhi cheez Allah ki marzi ke baghair harkat nahi karti, na badalti hai aur na qarar pati hai. وَإِن تَجۡهَرۡ بِٱلۡقَوۡلِ فَإِنَّهُۥ يَعۡلَمُ ٱلسِّرَّ وَأَخۡفَى ٧ ٱللَّهُ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَۖ لَهُ ٱلۡأَسۡمَآءُ ٱلۡحُسۡنَىٰ ٨ "Aur agar tu oonchi aawaz se baat kare to wo posheeda aur uss se bhi posheeda baat ko janta hai. Allah wo hai jiske siwa koi ma'bood nahi, sabse achhe naam usi ke hain" Yani agar aap ba-aawaz buland Allah ko yaad karte hain aur dua-o-munaajaat karte hain, to jaan lijiye ke Allah isse beniyaaz hai, kyonki wo to chhupe hue raazo'n ko bhi jaanta hai, balke raaz haaye sar basta se bhi zyada makhfi baaton ko jaanta hai, jinhe ibn-e-aadam nahin jaanta, jinka ilm sirf allam-ul-ghayyub ko hota hai, jaisa ke irshad farmaya قُلۡ أَنزَلَهُ ٱلَّذِي يَعۡلَمُ ٱلسِّرَّ فِي ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ غَفُورٗا رَّحِيمٗا ٦ Al-Furqan 25 6 "To keh isey usne naazil kiya hai jo aasmano aur zameen mein sab poshidah baaton ko jaanta hai. Beshak wo hamesha se behadd bakhshane wala, nihayat reham wala hai." Aage farmaya ke mazkurah baala e tareeqey ibadat ka mustahiq wo Allah hai jiske siwa koi mabood haqeeqi nahi hai aur tamaam pakeeza naamo ka sirf wahi sazawaar hai. ٱللَّهُ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَۖ لَهُ ٱلۡأَسۡمَآءُ ٱلۡحُسۡنَىٰ Saiyyadna Abu Huraira'h (Razi Allahu anhu) bayan karte hain ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ) ne farmaya " Allah Taala ke ek kam saw 99 naam hain jo shakhs unko yaad karega wo jannat me dakhil hoga." Bukhari 7392 وَهَلۡ أَتَىٰكَ حَدِيثُ مُوسَىٰٓ ٩ إِذۡ رَءَا نَارٗا فَقَالَ لِأَهۡلِهِ ٱمۡكُثُوٓاْ إِنِّيٓ ءَانَسۡتُ نَارٗا لَّعَلِّيٓ ءَاتِيكُم مِّنۡهَا بِقَبَسٍ أَوۡ أَجِدُ عَلَى ٱلنَّارِ هُدٗى ١٠ فَلَمَّآ أَتَىٰهَا نُودِيَ يَٰمُوسَىٰٓ ١١ إِنِّيٓ أَنَا۠ رَبُّكَ فَٱخۡلَعۡ نَعۡلَيۡكَ إِنَّكَ بِٱلۡوَادِ ٱلۡمُقَدَّسِ طُوٗى ١٢ وَأَنَا ٱخۡتَرۡتُكَ فَٱسۡتَمِعۡ لِمَا يُوحَىٰٓ ١٣ إِنَّنِيٓ أَنَا ٱللَّهُ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّآ أَنَا۠ فَٱعۡبُدۡنِي وَأَقِمِ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ لِذِكۡرِيٓ ١٤ "Aur kya tere paas Moosa ki khabar pahuchi hai. Jab usne ek aag dekhi to apne gharwalo se kaha tum thehro, beshak maine ek aag dekhi hai, shayad main tumhare paas usse koi angara le aaun, ya us aag par koi rehnumayi haasil kar lu. To jab wo uske paas aaya to use aawaz di gayi Aye Moosa! Beshak main hi tera Rab hoon, so apni dono jootiyan utar de, beshak tu paak wadi Tuwa mein hai. Aur maine tujhe chun liya hai, pas ghaur se sun jo kuch wahi kiya jata hai. Beshak main hi Allah hoon, mere siwa koi ma'bood nahin, so meri ibadat kar aur meri yaad ke liye namaz qayam kar." In aayaat mein Moosa (AS)Alehis Salam par nuzool wahi ki ibteda aur Allah Taala se humkalaam hone ka waqia bayan kiya ja raha hai. Moosa (AS)Alehis Salam "Madyan" mein dus saal guzar kar apni biwi ke saath Misr ki taraf rawana hue, to maslehat-e-ilaahi ke mutabiq Toor-e-seena k qareeb raasta kho baithe, mausam-e-sarma ki sard aur andheri raat thi, unhe roshni aur aag dono ki zarurat thi, Toor ki taraf se unhe aag ki roshni nazar aayi to apni biwi se bataur khush khabri kaha ke tum yahin ruki raho, main tumhare liye aag lekar aata hoon, ya shayad wahan koi aadmi mil jaye jo humari rehnumayi kare. Moosa (AS)Alehis Salam jab aag ke qareeb pahuche to wahan maamla hi doosra tha. Wahan waadi ke dahine janib ek darakht tha jo baqaa-e-noor bana hua tha, wahan se aawaz aayi, Aye Moosa! Main aap ka Rab hoon aur aap se mukhatib hoon aur aap is waqt muqaddas wadi Tuwa mein khade hain. Apne Rab ke liye taazeem-o-tawazey aur adab ka izhar karte hue joota utar dijiye. Maine aapko iss zamane ke tamam logon ke darmiyan se chun liya hai aur apni paighambari ke liye muntakhib kar liya hai, isliye ab aap par jo wahi nazil hone ja rahi hai use ghaur se suniye aur uski zimmedari qubool karne ke liye tayyar ho jaiye. Main hi Allah hoon, mere siwa koi ibadat ke layaq nahi hai, isliye sirf meri ibadat kijiye aur mujhe yaad karne ke liye namaz qayam kijiye. وَأَقِمِ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ لِذِكۡرِيٓ Saiyyadna Abu Huraira'h (Razi Allahu anhu) bayan karte hain ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ) Khaibar se laut'te waqt raat ko safar karte rahe, jab aakhir shab hui to aapko oongh aane lagi, tab Aap ne padao kiya aur Bilal(Razi Allahu anhu) se kaha " Aaj ki raat tum hamara pehra do." Chunanche Saiyyadna Bilal (Razi Allahu anhu) namaz padhte rahe, jitni ke unki taqdeer mein thi aur Rasool Allah (ﷺ) so gaye aur aapke as-haab bhi so gaye. Phir jab subeh qareeb hui to Bilal (Razi Allahu anhu) mashriq ki taraf munh karke apni oontni se tekk laga kar baith gaye aur unki aankh lag gayi. Phir na to Rasool Allah (ﷺ) hi jaage aur na Bilal (Razi Allahu anhu) aur na aapke sahaba mein se kisiko jaag aayi, yahan tak ke jab un par dhoop padi, to sab se pehle Rasool Allah (ﷺ) jaage. Aap ghabra gaye aur pukara " Aye Bilal!" Bilal(Razi Allahu anhu) ne arz ki, Aye Allah ke Rasool ! Mere maa baap aap par qurban ! Mere nafs ko bhi usi ne pakad liya jis ne aapke nafs ko pakda. Aap ne sahaba se farmaya "oonto ko haanko!" Unhone thodi der oonto ko haanka to phir Rasool Allah (ﷺ) utre. Aap ne wazu kiya aur Saiyyadna Bilal (Razi Allahu anhu) ko iqamat kehne ka hukam diya, so Saiyyadna Bilal (Razi Allahu anhu) ne namaz ki iqamat kahi aur Rasool Allah (ﷺ) ne subeh ki namaz padhayi. Jab aap namaz padh chuke to farmaya "Jo shakhs namaz padhna bhool jaye to jab yaad aajaye tab padh le, isliye ke Allah Taala farmata hai وَأَقِمِ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ لِذِكۡرِيٓ Taha 20 14 "Aur meri yaad ke liye namaz qayam kar." Muslim 680 Saiyyadna Anas (Razi Allahu anhu) bayan karte hain ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ) ne farmaya " Jab koi namaz ke waqt soya reh jaye ya namaz padhna bhool jaye to usko chahiye ke jab yaad aajaye to namaz padhle, isliye ke Allah Taala farmata hai وَأَقِمِ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ لِذِكۡرِيٓ Taha 20 14 "Aur meri yaad ke liye namaz qayam kar." Muslim 683 316, Bukhari 597 Saiyyadna Anas (Razi Allahu anhu) bayan karte hain ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ) ne farmaya "Jo shakhs namaz bhool jaye ya so jaye to uska kaffara ye hai ke use usi waqt padh le jab use yaad aaye, bas uska yehi kaffara hai." Bukhari 597, Muslim 684 315, 314 إِنَّ ٱلسَّاعَةَ ءَاتِيَةٌ أَكَادُ أُخۡفِيهَا لِتُجۡزَىٰ كُلُّ نَفۡسِۢ بِمَا تَسۡعَىٰ ١٥ "Yaqeenan qayamat aane wali hai, mai qareeb hoon ke use chhupa kar rakhun, taake har shakhs ko uska badla diya jaye jo wo koshish karta hai." Yaani qayamat ka waqoo pazeer hona amar yaqeeni hai, isme koi shak-o-shuba'h nahi hai, lekin Allah ne uska waqt mehdood tamam ins-o-jin se itna poshidah rakha hai ke qareeb tha ke uska zikr hi na karta, use sigha-e-raaz me rakhta yahan tak ke achanak waqa'y ho jati. Lekin apne momin bando par reham karte hue, unhe amal saleh ki targheeb dilane ke liye aur taake ghair momino ke liye koi uzr baqi na rahe, uska ajmaali taur par zikr kar diya. Uss din Baari Taala tamam insano ko unke nek-o-bad aamaal ka badla chukayega jo unhone duniya mein apne ikhtiyaar aur marzi se kiye honge, irshad farmaya فَمَن يَعۡمَلۡ مِثۡقَالَ ذَرَّةٍ خَيۡرٗا يَرَهُۥ ٧ وَمَن يَعۡمَلۡ مِثۡقَالَ ذَرَّةٖ شَرّٗا يَرَهُۥ ٨ "To jo shakhs ek zarra barabar neki karega use dekh lega. Aur jo shakhs ek zarra barabar burayi karega use dekh lega." فَلَا يَصُدَّنَّكَ عَنۡهَا مَن لَّا يُؤۡمِنُ بِهَا وَٱتَّبَعَ هَوَىٰهُ فَتَرۡدَىٰ ١٦ "So tujhe usse wo shakhs kahi rok na de jo us par yaqeen nahi rakhta aur apni khwahish ke peechhe laga hua hai, pas wo halaak ho jayega." Is aayat me Allah Taala ne Moosa (AS)Alehis Salam ko nasihat ki ke kahi aisa na ho ke munkareen-e-aakhirat aur khwahishat ki itteba karne wale aapko aakhirat par imaan lane se rok de. Yaani aap aise logon ki pairawi na kijiye jo aakhirat ka inkaar karte hain aur jinki zindagi ka maqsad husool-e-lazzat duniya hai, isliye wo husool razaa-e-maula se bilkul ghafil hain. وَمَا تِلۡكَ بِيَمِينِكَ يَٰمُوسَىٰ ١٧ قَالَ هِيَ عَصَايَ أَتَوَكَّؤُاْ عَلَيۡهَا وَأَهُشُّ بِهَا عَلَىٰ غَنَمِي وَلِيَ فِيهَا مَ َٔارِبُ أُخۡرَىٰ ١٨ "Aur ye tere daye hath mein kya hai Aye Moosa!? Kaha ye meri laathi hai, main iss par tekk lagata hoon aur uske saath apni bakriyon par patte jhaadta hoon aur mere liye isme kayi aur zaroorate hain." Allah Taala ne Moosa (AS)Alehis Salam se poochha ke aapke daye hath mein kya hai? Unhone jawab diya, ye meri laathi hai, jis par main tekk lagata hoon aur iske zariye se main apni bakriyon ke khane ke liye darakhto'n se patte giraata hoon aur main ise deegar kaamo ke liye bhi istemal karta hoon, yaani main is par apna zaad-e-safar aur pani latka kar apne kandhe par dhota hoon. قَالَ أَلۡقِهَا يَٰمُوسَىٰ ١٩ فَأَلۡقَىٰهَا فَإِذَا هِيَ حَيَّةٞ تَسۡعَىٰ ٢٠ قَالَ خُذۡهَا وَلَا تَخَفۡۖ سَنُعِيدُهَا سِيرَتَهَا ٱلۡأُولَىٰ ٢١ "Farmaya use phenk de Aye Moosa! To usne use phenka to achanak wo ek saanp tha jo daudta tha. Farmaya use pakad aur darr nahi, anqareeb hum use uski pehli haalat me lauta denge." Allah Taala ne farmaya, Aye Moosa! Aap apni laathi zameen par daal dijiye. Unhone use zameen par daal diya, to Allah Taala ne uske ausaaf badal kar use ek lambe chaude maheeb saanp ki shakal de di, jo tezi se darawni harkate karne laga aur rassi ke saanpo'n ko nigalne laga. Moosa (AS)Alehis Salam ne apni laathi ka jab ye haal dekha to darr kar bhaagne lage. Allah Taala ne unse kaha ke aap use pakad lijiye aur darein nahi, hum use pehle ki tarah laathi bana denge. Chunanche unhone aisa hi kiya to wo laathi ban gayi jo unke haath mein pehle se thi. وَٱضۡمُمۡ يَدَكَ إِلَىٰ جَنَاحِكَ تَخۡرُجۡ بَيۡضَآءَ مِنۡ غَيۡرِ سُوٓءٍ ءَايَةً أُخۡرَىٰ ٢٢ لِنُرِيَكَ مِنۡ ءَايَٰتِنَا ٱلۡكُبۡرَى ٢٣ "Aur apna haath apne pehlu ki taraf mila, wo kisi aib ke baghair safed (chamakta hua) niklega, iss haal mein ke ek aur nishani hai. Taake hum tujhe apni chand badi nishaniyan dikhaye." Allah Taala ne Moosa (AS)Alehis Salam se farmaya ke aap apna haath apne gireban mein daal kar nikaaliye, wo baghair kisi beemari aur aib ke khoobsurat chamakta hua hoga. Ye aapki nabuwwat ki sadaqat par dalalat karne wala dusra maujaza hoga, jaisa ke irshad farmaya ٱسۡلُكۡ يَدَكَ فِي جَيۡبِكَ تَخۡرُجۡ بَيۡضَآءَ مِنۡ غَيۡرِ سُوٓءٖ وَٱضۡمُمۡ إِلَيۡكَ جَنَاحَكَ مِنَ ٱلرَّهۡبِۖ فَذَٰنِكَ بُرۡهَٰنَانِ مِن رَّبِّكَ إِلَىٰ فِرۡعَوۡنَ وَمَلَإِيْهِۦٓۚ إِنَّهُمۡ كَانُواْ قَوۡمٗا فَٰسِقِينَ ٣٢ Al-Qasas 28 32 "Apna haath apne gireban mein dakhil kar, wo kisi aib ke baghair safed (chamakdaar) niklega aur khauf se (bachne ke liye) apna baazu apni janib mila le, so ye dono tere Rab ki janib se Firaun aur uske sardaaro'n ki taraf do daleelein hain." ٱذۡهَبۡ إِلَىٰ فِرۡعَوۡنَ إِنَّهُۥ طَغَىٰ ٢٤ "Firaun ki taraf ja, beshak wo sarkash ho gaya hai." Moosa (AS)Alehis Salam ko maujzaat diye jane ka maqsad bayan kiya ja raha hai ke Aye Moosa! Maujzaat lekar hamare Rasool ki haisiyat se aap Firaun ke paas jaiye, jo apni hadd se tajawuz karke ma'bood hone ka dawa kar baitha hai, use uski haisiyat yaad dilaiye aur meri ibadat ka hukum dijiye. Dusre maqam par Allah Taala ne irshad farmaya ٱذۡهَبَآ إِلَىٰ فِرۡعَوۡنَ إِنَّهُۥ طَغَىٰ ٤٣ فَقُولَا لَهُۥ قَوۡلٗا لَّيِّنٗا لَّعَلَّهُۥ يَتَذَكَّرُ أَوۡ يَخۡشَىٰ ٤٤ Taha 20 43, 44 "Dono Firaun ke paas jao, beshak wo sarkash ho gaya hai. Pas usse baat karo, narm baat, iss ummeed par ke wo nasihat haasil kar le, ya darr jaye."Aur farmaya ٱذۡهَبۡ إِلَىٰ فِرۡعَوۡنَ إِنَّهُۥ طَغَىٰ ١٧ فَقُلۡ هَل لَّكَ إِلَىٰٓ أَن تَزَكَّىٰ ١٨ وَأَهۡدِيَكَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ فَتَخۡشَىٰ ١٩ فَأَرَىٰهُ ٱلۡأٓيَةَ ٱلۡكُبۡرَىٰ ٢٠ Al-Nazi'at 79 17 to 20 "Firaun ke paas ja, yaqeenan wo hadd se badh gaya hai. Pas keh kya tujhe iss baat ki koi raghbat hai ke tu paak ho jaye? Aur main tere Rab ki taraf teri rehnumayi karu, pas tu darr jaye. Chunanche usne use bahot badi nishani dikhayi." قَالَ رَبِّ ٱشۡرَحۡ لِي صَدۡرِي ٢٥ وَيَسِّرۡ لِيٓ أَمۡرِي ٢٦ وَٱحۡلُلۡ عُقۡدَةٗ مِّن لِّسَانِي ٢٧ يَفۡقَهُواْ قَوۡلِي ٢٨ "Usne kaha Aye mere Rab! Mere liye mera seena khol de. Aur mere liye mera kaam aasaan karde. Aur meri zubaan ki kuch gireh khol de. Ke wo meri baat samajh le." Jab unhe Firaun ke saamne dawat-o-tauheed dene ka hukum hua, to socha ke unke kandho par ek azeem zimmedari daal di gayi hai, ek taraf ba-haisiyate insaan unhe apni kam maayegi aur besar-o-saamani yaad aarahi thi, to dusri taraf Firaun jaise azeem shah Misr ki quwwat-o-jabroot aur uska jaah-o-jalal unki aankho'n ke saamne ghoom raha tha. Isiliye unhone Allah se dua ki ke Aye Allah! Mera seena khol de aur mujh par jo zimmedari daali hai, use aasan karde, isliye ke teri nusrat-o-aanat ke baghair itni badi zimmedari mere naatawa'n kandhe bardasht nahi kar sakenge aur meri zubaan ki gireh khol de, taake jab main firauniyo ke saamne teri dawat paish karu to meri baat ko samajh sakein. Irshad farmaya قَالَ رَبِّ إِنِّيٓ أَخَافُ أَن يُكَذِّبُونِ ١٢ وَيَضِيقُ صَدۡرِي وَلَا يَنطَلِقُ لِسَانِي فَأَرۡسِلۡ إِلَىٰ هَٰرُونَ ١٣ وَلَهُمۡ عَلَيَّ ذَنۢبٞ فَأَخَافُ أَن يَقۡتُلُونِ ١٤ Ash-Shu'ara 26 12 to 14 "Usne kaha Aye mere Rab! Beshak main darta hoon ke wo mujhe jhutla denge. Aur mera seena tang padta hai aur meri zuban nahi chalti, so tu Haroon ki taraf paigham bhej. Aur unka mere zimme ek gunah hai, pas main darta hoon ke wo mujhe qatal kar denge." وَٱجۡعَل لِّي وَزِيرٗا مِّنۡ أَهۡلِي ٢٩ هَٰرُونَ أَخِي ٣٠ ٱشۡدُدۡ بِهِۦٓ أَزۡرِي ٣١ وَأَشۡرِكۡهُ فِيٓ أَمۡرِي ٣٢ كَيۡ نُسَبِّحَكَ كَثِيرٗا ٣٣ وَنَذۡكُرَكَ كَثِيرًا ٣٤ إِنَّكَ كُنتَ بِنَا بَصِيرٗا ٣٥ قَالَ قَدۡ أُوتِيتَ سُؤۡلَكَ يَٰمُوسَىٰ ٣٦ "Aur mere ghar walo mein se ek bojh bataane wala bana de. Haroon ko, jo mera bhai hai. Uske sath meri pusht mazboot karde. Aur use mere kaam mein shareek karde. Taakey hum teri bahot tasbeeh kare. Aur tujhe bahot yaad kare. Beshak tu hamesha humare haal ko khoob dekhne wala raha hai. Farmaya beshak tujhe tera sawal ata kar diya gaya Aye Moosa!" Moosa (AS)Alehis Salam ne dua ki, Aye mere Rab ! Mere khandaan walo mein se mere bhai Haroon ko risalat ki zimmedari uthane mein mera shareek-o-madadgaar bana de, taakey hum teri khoob tasbeeh bayan kare aur tujhe khoob yaad kare. Tu humare halaat se baa khabar hai aur tu jaanta hai ke maine tujh se jo maanga hai wo humare liye mufeed hai. Allah Taala ne unki dua qubool farma li, unka seena khol diya, unki nusrat-o-aanat ka wada farmaya, unki zaban ki girah khol di aur unke bhai Haroon ko nabi bana kar Firaun ke saamne dawat paish karne ki zimmedari mein unka shareek-o-madadgaar bana diya. Irshad farmaya قَالَ رَبِّ إِنِّي قَتَلۡتُ مِنۡهُمۡ نَفۡسٗا فَأَخَافُ أَن يَقۡتُلُونِ ٣٣ وَأَخِي هَٰرُونُ هُوَ أَفۡصَحُ مِنِّي لِسَانٗا فَأَرۡسِلۡهُ مَعِيَ رِدۡءٗا يُصَدِّقُنِيٓۖ إِنِّيٓ أَخَافُ أَن يُكَذِّبُونِ ٣٤ Al-Qasas 28 33, 34 "Kahaa- Aye mere Rab! Beshak maine unme se ek shakhs ko qatal kiya hai, isliye darta hoon ke wo mujhe qatal kar denge. Aur mera bhai Haroon, wo zaban mein mujhse zyada faseeh hai, to use mere saath madadgaar bana kar bhej ke meri tasdeeq kare, beshak main darta hoon ke wo mujhe jhutla denge." Saiyyadna Saad Bin Abi Waqas (Razi Allahu anhu) bayan karte hain ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ) ne Saiyyadna Ali (Razi Allahu anhu) se farmaya "Kya tum iss par khush nahi ho ke tum mere liye aise ho jaise Moosa (AS)Alehis Salam ke liye Haroon (AS)Alehis Salam the?" Bukhari 3706 قَالَ قَدۡ أُوتِيتَ سُؤۡلَكَ يَٰمُوسَىٰ قَالَ سَنَشُدُّ عَضُدَكَ بِأَخِيكَ وَنَجۡعَلُ لَكُمَا سُلۡطَٰنٗا فَلَا يَصِلُونَ إِلَيۡكُمَا بِ َٔايَٰتِنَآۚ أَنتُمَا وَمَنِ ٱتَّبَعَكُمَا ٱلۡغَٰلِبُونَ ٣٥ Al-Qasas 28 35 "Kaha hum tere bhai ke sath tera baazu zaroor mazboot karenge aur tum dono ke liye ghalba rakhenge, so wo tum tak nahi pahuchenge, humari nishaniyo'n ke sath tum dono aur jinhone tumhari pairawi ki, ghalib aane wale ho." وَلَقَدۡ مَنَنَّا عَلَيۡكَ مَرَّةً أُخۡرَىٰٓ ٣٧ إِذۡ أَوۡحَيۡنَآ إِلَىٰٓ أُمِّكَ مَا يُوحَىٰٓ ٣٨ أَنِ ٱقۡذِفِيهِ فِي ٱلتَّابُوتِ فَٱقۡذِفِيهِ فِي ٱلۡيَمِّ فَلۡيُلۡقِهِ ٱلۡيَمُّ بِٱلسَّاحِلِ يَأۡخُذۡهُ عَدُوّٞ لِّي وَعَدُوّٞ لَّهُۥۚ وَأَلۡقَيۡتُ عَلَيۡكَ مَحَبَّةٗ مِّنِّي وَلِتُصۡنَعَ عَلَىٰ عَيۡنِيٓ ٣٩ "Aur bila shuba h yaqeenan hum ne tujh par ek aur baar bhi ehsaan kiya. Jab humne teri maa ko wahi ki, jo wahi ki jati thi. Ye ke tu use sandooq me daal, phir use dariya mein daal de, phir dariya usey kinare par daal de, use ek mera dushman aur uska dushman utha lega aur maine tujh par apni taraf se ek mohabbat daal di aur taakey teri parwarish meri aankhon ke saamne ki jaye." Allah Taala ne Moosa (AS)Alehis Salam ki maa ko bazariye ilham hukum diya ke wo apne bachche ko ek sandooq me rakh kar apne khaliq-o-maalik par bharosa karte hue dariya me daal de, taakey dariya Allah ke hukum se uss sandooq ko uss jagah pahucha de jahan Firaun nahaya karta tha. Chunanche aisa hi hua aur sandooq tairta hua us neher tak pahunch gaya jo dariya se nikal kar Firaun ke mahal tak pahunchti thi. Jab Allah aur uske Rasool Moosa (AS)Alehis Salam ke dushman ne wo sandooq dekha to use nikaalne ka hukum diya. Usme bachcha dekh kar Allah ki masiyat ke mutabiq Firaun bahot hi khush hua. Allah ne uske aur dusro ke dil me Moosa (AS)Alehis Salam ki mohabbat paiwast kardi, taakey Allah ke hifz-o-amaan me Firaun ke ghar hi mein parwarish-o-pardaakht ho. أَنِ ٱقۡذِفِيهِ فِي ٱلتَّابُوتِ فَٱقۡذِفِيهِ فِي ٱلۡيَمِّ فَلۡيُلۡقِهِ ٱلۡيَمُّ بِٱلسَّاحِلِ يَأۡخُذۡهُ عَدُوّٞ لِّي وَعَدُوّٞ لَّهُۥۚ فَٱلۡتَقَطَهُۥٓ ءَالُ فِرۡعَوۡنَ لِيَكُونَ لَهُمۡ عَدُوّٗا وَحَزَنًاۗ إِنَّ فِرۡعَوۡنَ وَهَٰمَٰنَ وَجُنُودَهُمَا كَانُواْ خَٰطِ ِٔينَ ٨ وَقَالَتِ ٱمۡرَأَتُ فِرۡعَوۡنَ قُرَّتُ عَيۡنٖ لِّي وَلَكَۖ لَا تَقۡتُلُوهُ عَسَىٰٓ أَن يَنفَعَنَآ أَوۡ نَتَّخِذَهُۥ وَلَدٗا وَهُمۡ لَا يَشۡعُرُونَ ٩ Al-Qasas 28 8,9 "To Firaun ke ghar walo ne use utha liya, taakey aakhir unke liye dushman ho aur gham ka ba-iss ho. Beshak Firaun aur Haamaan aur unke lashkar khatakaar the. Aur Firaun ki biwi ne kaha ye mere liye aur tere liye aankhon ki thandak hai, ise qatal na karo, ummeed hai ke wo hume fayda pahuchaye, ya hum use beta bana lein aur wo samajhte na the." إِذۡ تَمۡشِيٓ أُخۡتُكَ فَتَقُولُ هَلۡ أَدُلُّكُمۡ عَلَىٰ مَن يَكۡفُلُهُۥۖ فَرَجَعۡنَٰكَ إِلَىٰٓ أُمِّكَ كَيۡ تَقَرَّ عَيۡنُهَا وَلَا تَحۡزَنَۚ وَقَتَلۡتَ نَفۡسٗا فَنَجَّيۡنَٰكَ مِنَ ٱلۡغَمِّ وَفَتَنَّٰكَ فُتُونٗاۚ فَلَبِثۡتَ سِنِينَ فِيٓ أَهۡلِ مَدۡيَنَ ثُمَّ جِئۡتَ عَلَىٰ قَدَرٖ يَٰمُوسَىٰ ٤٠ وَٱصۡطَنَعۡتُكَ لِنَفۡسِي ٤١ "Jab teri behan chali jati thi, pas kehti thi kya main tumhe uska pata doon jo uski parwarish kare? Pas humne tujhe teri maa ki taraf lauta diya, taakey uski aankh thandi ho aur wo gham na kare. Aur tune ek shakhs ko qatal kar diya humne tujhe gham se nijaat di aur humne tujhe aazmaaya, khoob aazmaana, phir kayi saal tu madyan walo me thehra raha, phir tu ek muqarrar andaze par aaya Aye Moosa! Aur maine tujhe apne liye khaas taur par banaya hai." Moosa (AS)Alehis Salam jab Firaun ke ghar pahuch gaye to wo aur uski biwi unse khoob mohabbat karne lage, lekin masiyat e Ilaahi ke mutabiq wo kisi bhi doodh pilane wali daiya ka doodh peene se munh band kar lete the. Unki behan Maryam Bint-e-Imraan ne jo lamha ba-lamha unki khabar le rahi thi, jab suna ke Firaun aur uski biwi Aasiya kisi daiya ki talaash mein hain, to kaha kya main aap logon ko ek daiya ka pata doon, jo is bachche ko doodh pilayegi aur uski parwarish-o-pardakht karegi? Unhone poochha ke wo kaun hai? To kaha ke wo meri maa hai, jinki godd mein mera ek saal ka bhai Haroon hai. Chunanche jab unhe bulaya gaya to Moosa fauran unka doodh peene lage. Iss tarah Allah ne unhe unki maa tak pahuncha diya, taakey unki maa ki aankhein thandi ho aur bachche ko dariya mein daal dene ki wajah se unhe jo gham laahaq hua tha uska azaala ho. Allah Taala ne Moosa (AS)Alehis Salam par ek ehsaan ye bhi kiya ke unhone Firaun ke ghar mein bade hokar ek qabti ko ghalti se qatal kar diya to sabhi firauni unke qatal ke dar pe ho gaye. Moosa (AS)Alehis Salam wahan se jaan bacha kar bhaag nikle aur Allah Taala ne unki ye laghzish maaf kardi. Isi tarah nabi banne se pehle gonago'n aazmaisho'n se guzre aur har baar Allah Taala ne unki madad ki aur jab firauniyo ke darr se bhaag kar madyan pahunche to ek mard saleh ne sara majra sun kar kaha ke ab tumhe darne ki zarurat nahi, yahan aakar tum zaalimo se nijaat paa chuke ho. Chunanche wahan 20 ya 28 saal iss nek shakhs ki zer tarbiyat rahe aur phir hikmat-e-ilaahi ke taihat wahan se apni biwi ko lekar chale aur Toor-e-seena ke paas pahuche to Allah Taala ne unhe paighambari ata ki aur unse hum kalaam hua. Toor tak uss waqt unka pahuchna Allah taala ke ilm mein pehle se muqaddar tha jiski unhe koi khabar nahi thi. Agli aayat me Allah Taala ne Moosa (AS)Alehis Salam se farmaya ke maine aapko apni risalat ke liye chun liya hai aur mukhtalif maraahil se guzaar kar iski zimmedariyan poori karne ke qabil banaya hai, lihaza Firaun aur bani Israel ko mera paigham achhi tarah pahuncha dijiye aur unhe mujh par imaan laane aur amaal saleh karne ki dawat dijiye, taakey unhe duniya-o-aakhirat mein bhalayi haasil ho. وَقَتَلۡتَ نَفۡسٗا فَنَجَّيۡنَٰكَ مِنَ ٱلۡغَمِّ وَفَتَنَّٰكَ فُتُونٗاۚ Jawan hone ke baad Moosa (AS)Alehis Salam ne Firaun ki qaum ke ek shakhs ko ghalti se qatal kar diya aur jab unhe maloom hua ke hukumat unhe qasaas mein qatal karne wali hai to wo uss shehar ko chhorh kar chale gaye, irshad farmaya وَلَمَّا بَلَغَ أَشُدَّهُۥ وَٱسۡتَوَىٰٓ ءَاتَيۡنَٰهُ حُكۡمٗا وَعِلۡمٗاۚ وَكَذَٰلِكَ نَجۡزِي ٱلۡمُحۡسِنِينَ ١٤ وَدَخَلَ ٱلۡمَدِينَةَ عَلَىٰ حِينِ غَفۡلَةٖ مِّنۡ أَهۡلِهَا فَوَجَدَ فِيهَا رَجُلَيۡنِ يَقۡتَتِلَانِ هَٰذَا مِن شِيعَتِهِۦ وَهَٰذَا مِنۡ عَدُوِّهِۦۖ فَٱسۡتَغَٰثَهُ ٱلَّذِي مِن شِيعَتِهِۦ عَلَى ٱلَّذِي مِنۡ عَدُوِّهِۦ فَوَكَزَهُۥ مُوسَىٰ فَقَضَىٰ عَلَيۡهِۖ قَالَ هَٰذَا مِنۡ عَمَلِ ٱلشَّيۡطَٰنِۖ إِنَّهُۥ عَدُوّٞ مُّضِلّٞ مُّبِينٞ ١٥ Al-Qasas 28 14, 15 "Aur jab wo apni jawani ko pahucha aur poora taqatwar ho gaya to humne use quwwat faisla aur ilm ata kiya aur isi tarah neki karne walo ko hum badla dete hain. Aur wo shehar mein uske rehne walo ki kisi qadar ghaflat ke waqt dakhil hua to usme do aadmiyo ko paya ke ladd rahein hain, ye uski qaum se hai aur ye uske dushmano mein se hai. To jo uski qaum se tha uss ne usse uske khilaf madad maangi jo uske dushmano mein se tha, to Moosa ne use ghoonsa maara to uska kaam tamam kar diya. Kaha ye shaitaan ke kaam se hai, yaqeenan wo khullam khulla gumraah karne wala dushman hai." Irshad farmaya فَخَرَجَ مِنۡهَا خَآئِفٗا يَتَرَقَّبُۖ قَالَ رَبِّ نَجِّنِي مِنَ ٱلۡقَوۡمِ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ ٢١ وَلَمَّا تَوَجَّهَ تِلۡقَآءَ مَدۡيَنَ قَالَ عَسَىٰ رَبِّيٓ أَن يَهۡدِيَنِي سَوَآءَ ٱلسَّبِيلِ ٢٢ Al-Qasas 28 21, 22 "to wo darta hua usse nikal pada, intezar karta tha, kaha Aye mere Rab! Mujhe un zaalim logon se bacha le. Aur jab usne Madyan ki taraf rukh kiya to kaha mera Rab qareeb hai ke mujhe seedhe raste par le jaye." Fazeel bin Ayaaz (RahimaUllah) bayan karte hain ke maine Saalim bin Abdullah (Razi Allahu anhu) ko farmate hue suna, Aye Ahle Iraaq! Main tumse chhote gunah se mutalliq nahin poochhta, na uske mutalliq poochhta hoon jo kabeera gunah karta ho. Maine suna apne baap Saiyyadna Abdullah bin Umar(Razi Allahu anhu) se, wo kehte the, maine suna Rasool Allah (ﷺ) se, Aap (ﷺ) farmate the "Fitna idhar se aage aayega." Aur aapne apne haath se mashriq ki taraf ishara kiya aur farmaya "Jahan se shaitaan ke dono qarn niklenge aur tum ek dusre ki gardan maarte ho (haalake momin ka qatal kitna bada gunah hai)." Aur Moosa (AS)Alehis Salam ne jo Firaun ki qaum ka ek shakhs maara tha wo khata se maara tha (na ke qatal ki niyat se, kyunki ghoonse se aadmi nahi marta) is par Allah Taala ne farmaya وَقَتَلۡتَ نَفۡسٗا فَنَجَّيۡنَٰكَ مِنَ ٱلۡغَمِّ وَفَتَنَّٰكَ فُتُونٗاۚ "Aur tune ek shakhs ko qatal kar diya to humne tujhe gham se nijat di aur humne tujhe aazmaya, khoob aazmana." Muslim 7297 Yaani maine apni marzi-o-masiyat se apne apne rasool ke taur par tumhara intekhab kar liya hai, Imam Bukhari (RaimaUllah) ne is aayat-e-kareema ki tafseer bayan karte hue wo hadees bayan ki, jise Saiyyadna Abu Huraira'h (Razi Allahu anhu) bayan karte hain ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ) ne farmaya "Saiyyadna Adam (AS)Alehis Salam aur Saiyyadna Moosa (AS)Alehis Salam ki mulaqat hui, to Saiyyadna Moosa (AS)Alehis Salam ne kaha, Aapne logon ko mashqqat me daal diya aur unhe jannat se nikalwa diya? Saiyyadna Adam (AS)Alehis Salam ne farmay, Aap wahi hain jinhe Allah ne apni risalat se mumtaz farmaya aur apne liye pasand farmaya aur Tauraat ata farmayi? Saiyyadna Moosa (AS)Alehis Salam ne farmaya, Haan! Phir Saiyyadna Adam (AS)Alehis Salam ne farmaya, Kya aap ne usme ye nahi padha ke meri paidaish se pehle ye sab mere liye likh diya gaya tha? Kaha, Haan ! Algharz Saiyyadna Adam (AS)Alehis Salam Saiyyadna Moosa (AS)Alehis Salam par daleel mein ghalba pa gaye." Bukhari 4736, Muslim 2652 ٱذۡهَبۡ أَنتَ وَأَخُوكَ بِ َٔايَٰتِي وَلَا تَنِيَا فِي ذِكۡرِي ٤٢ ٱذۡهَبَآ إِلَىٰ فِرۡعَوۡنَ إِنَّهُۥ طَغَىٰ ٤٣ فَقُولَا لَهُۥ قَوۡلٗا لَّيِّنٗا لَّعَلَّهُۥ يَتَذَكَّرُ أَوۡ يَخۡشَىٰ ٤٤ "Tu aur tera bhai meri aayaat lekar jao aur meri yaad mein susti na karna. Dono Firaun ke paas jao, beshak wo sarkash ho gaya hai. Pas usse baat karo, narm baat, iss ummeed par ke wo nasihat haasil kar le, ya darr jaye." Aye Moosa ! Aap aur aapke bhai Haroon jinke liye aapne dua ki hai, mere dono maujzaat lekar, jinka zahoor meri qudrat se aapke saamne ho chuka hai, daawat ke liye aage badhiye aur aap dono par ab tak maine jo ehsanaat-o-inaamaat kiye hain unhe yaad rakhiye aur tableegh risalat mein tand hi se kaam lijiye. Aap dono mera paigham lekar Firaun ke paas jaiye jisne sarkashi ki raah ikhtiyaar karli hai aur apne aapko ek banda-e-aajiz maanne ke bajaye Rab aur Maabood hone ka dawa kar baitha hai aur dekhiye aap dono ka asloob-e- bayan narm hona chahiye. Isliye ke narm guftugu bade bade zaalimo'n aur sarkasho'n ko bhi baaz auqaat mom bana deti hai. Shayad ke aap dono ki baatein use ghaur-o-fikr par majboor kar de aur wo imaan-o-hidayat ki raah apna le, ya dare ke agar kufr-o-zulm par misr raha to Allah ka azaab usey apni giraft mein le lega. فَقُولَا لَهُۥ قَوۡلٗا لَّيِّنٗا لَّعَلَّهُۥ يَتَذَكَّرُ أَوۡ يَخۡشَىٰ Ye aayat-e-kareema azeem-o-shaan nasihat par mushtamil hai, dekhiye ! Firaun zulm-o-istabdaad aur sarkashi-o-baghawat mein hadd se badha hua tha, Moosa uss waqt saare insaano mein sabse pasandeedah aur Allah Taala ke muntakhib kardah the, iske bawajood Allah Taala ne unhe hukum diya ke Firaun se mukhatib hote waqt lab-o-lehja narm rakhein aur use malaimat-o-shaistagi se daawat de, jaisa ke irshad farmaya ٱدۡعُ إِلَىٰ سَبِيلِ رَبِّكَ بِٱلۡحِكۡمَةِ وَٱلۡمَوۡعِظَةِ ٱلۡحَسَنَةِۖ وَجَٰدِلۡهُم بِٱلَّتِي هِيَ أَحۡسَنُۚ An-Nahl 16 125 "Apne Rab ke raste ki taraf hikmat aur achhi nasihat ke sath bula aur unse iss tareeqey ke sath behas kar jo sabse achha hai." Saiyyadna Jareer (Razi Allahu anhu) bayan karte hain ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ) ne farmaya "Jo shakhs narmi se mehroom kar diya gaya wo bhalaayi se mehroom kar diya gaya". Muslim 2592 Saiyyada Ayesha (Razi Allahu anha) bayan karti hain ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ) ne farmaya "Aye Aayesha ! Beshak Allah narm hai, narmi ko pasand karta hai aur jo kuch wo narmi par ataa farmata hai sakhti par ataa nahin farmata aur na uske alawa kisi aur cheez par ataa farmata hai." Muslim 2593 قَالَا رَبَّنَآ إِنَّنَا نَخَافُ أَن يَفۡرُطَ عَلَيۡنَآ أَوۡ أَن يَطۡغَىٰ ٤٥ قَالَ لَا تَخَافَآۖ إِنَّنِي مَعَكُمَآ أَسۡمَعُ وَأَرَىٰ ٤٦ فَأۡتِيَاهُ فَقُولَآ إِنَّا رَسُولَا رَبِّكَ فَأَرۡسِلۡ مَعَنَا بَنِيٓ إِسۡرَٰٓءِيلَ وَلَا تُعَذِّبۡهُمۡۖ قَدۡ جِئۡنَٰكَ بِ َٔايَةٖ مِّن رَّبِّكَۖ وَٱلسَّلَٰمُ عَلَىٰ مَنِ ٱتَّبَعَ ٱلۡهُدَىٰٓ ٤٧ إِنَّا قَدۡ أُوحِيَ إِلَيۡنَآ أَنَّ ٱلۡعَذَابَ عَلَىٰ مَن كَذَّبَ وَتَوَلَّىٰ ٤٨ قَالَ فَمَن رَّبُّكُمَا يَٰمُوسَىٰ ٤٩ قَالَ رَبُّنَا ٱلَّذِيٓ أَعۡطَىٰ كُلَّ شَيۡءٍ خَلۡقَهُۥ ثُمَّ هَدَىٰ ٥٠ "Dono ne kaha Aye mere Rab! Yaqeenan hum darte hain ke wo hum par zyadti karega, ya ke hadd se badh jayega. Farmaya daro nahin, beshak main tum dono ke sath hoon, main sun raha hoon aur dekh raha hoon. To uske paas jao aur kaho beshak hum tere Rab ke bheje hue hain, pas tu bani Israel ko humare sath bhej de aur unhe azaab na de, yaqeenan hum tere paas tere Rab ki taraf se ek nishani lekar aaye hain aur salam uss par jo hidayat ke peechhe chale. Beshak hum, yaqeenan humari taraf wahi ki gayi hai ke beshak azaab uss par hai jisne jhutlaya aur munh phera. Usne kaha to tum dono ka Rab kaun hai Aye Moosa!? Kaha humara Rab wo jisne har cheez ko uski shakal-o-surat bakhshi, phir rasta dikhaya." Dono bhaiyo ne Allah ka hukum paane ke baad jab haalaat par ghaur kiya aur apni bekasi aur Firaun ke qahr-o-jabroot ka tasawwur kiya to insaani fitrat ke mutabiq dare aur uska apne Rab se izhaar karte hue kaha, Aye humare Rab ! Hum darte hain ke kahin ghazab-o-ghusse mein wo humein qatal na karde, ya koi sakht saza na de de, ya uski sarkashi aur badh jaye aur teri shaan-o-azmat ke khilaf koi baat na kar baithe, to Allah Taala ne unhe itminaan dilaya aur kaha ke darne ki aisi koi baat nahi, main tum dono ke sath hoon, aap dono aur uske darmiyan jo guftugu hogi aur jo kuch waqoo pazeer hoga, use main sununga aur dekhunga aur tum dono ki hifazat karta rahunga. Isliye aap dono uske paas jaiye aur usse kahiye ke hum dono tumhare Rab ke paighambar hain, tumhare paas isliye bheje gaye hain ke tum bani Israel ko qaid-o-band se aazad kardo, unhe azaab dena band karo aur humare sath unhe humare watan Philisteen jane do aur ye bhi kahiye ke humare paas tumhare Rab ki janib se humare Rasool hone ki daleel yaani maujze maujood hain. Hakeemana asloob ikhtiyaar karte hue usse kahiye ke jo shakhs Allah Taala ki nishaniyo'n ki tasdeeq nahi karega aur uske deen se rugardani karega, wo uske azaab ka mustahiq hoga. Firaun ne unki poori baat sunne ke baad kaha, Aye Moosa ! Tum dono ka Rab kaun hai? To Moosa (AS)Alehis Salam ne kaha ke humara Rab wo hai jisne saari makhlooq ko uski makhsoos shakal-o-surat mein paida kiya hai, phir sabhi ko talab-e-rizq ke gurr sikhaye aur unki naslo'n ki baqaa ke liye wasaail-o-asbaab muhaiya farma kar unhe istemal karne ka tareeqa bhi sikhaya hai. وَٱلسَّلَٰمُ عَلَىٰ مَنِ ٱتَّبَعَ ٱلۡهُدَىٰٓ Yaani agar tu hidayat ki baat ko maan le to tere liye bhi salaamati hogi. Rasool Allah (ﷺ) ne har qul ko khat likhte waqt bhi yahi andaaz ikhtiyaar kiya, jaisa ke Saiyyadna Abdullah bin Abbas (Razi Allahu anhuma) se riwayat hai ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ) ne jo khat Shah Rom Har Qul ko likha tha, usme "Bismillah Hirrehmaan Nirraheem" ke baad ye mazmoon likha tha "Ye khat Allah ke bande aur uske Rasool Muhammad (ﷺ) ki taraf se Shah Rom Har Qul ke naam hai. Jo hidayat ki pairawi kare uspar salam ho. Iske baad ye ke main tujhe islaam ki taraf bulata hoon, tum islaam qubool karlo to salamat rahoge aur Allah Taala tujhe dohra ajr inayat farmayega." Bukhari 7, Muslim 1773 إِنَّا قَدۡ أُوحِيَ إِلَيۡنَآ أَنَّ ٱلۡعَذَابَ عَلَىٰ مَن كَذَّبَ وَتَوَلَّىٰ Yaani Allah Taala ne wahi ke zariye se hamein ye bataya hai ke azaab sirf uss shakhs ke liye hai jo Allah Taala ki aayaat ko jhutlaye aur uski ataat se rugardani kare, jaisa ke irshad farmaya فَأَمَّا مَن طَغَىٰ ٣٧ وَءَاثَرَ ٱلۡحَيَوٰةَ ٱلدُّنۡيَا ٣٨ فَإِنَّ ٱلۡجَحِيمَ هِيَ ٱلۡمَأۡوَىٰ ٣٩ Al-Nazi'at 79 37 to 39 "Pas lekin jo hadd se badh gaya. Aur usne duniya ki zindagi ko tarjeeh di. To beshak jahannum hi (uska) thikana hai." aur farmaya فَأَنذَرۡتُكُمۡ نَارٗا تَلَظَّىٰ ١٤ لَا يَصۡلَىٰهَآ إِلَّا ٱلۡأَشۡقَى ١٥ ٱلَّذِي كَذَّبَ وَتَوَلَّىٰ ١٦ Al-Lail 92 14 to 16 "Pas maine tumhe ek aisi aag se daraa diya hai jo shola maarti hai. Jismein uss bade bade bad bakht ke siwa koi dakhil nahin hoga. Jisne jhutlaya aur munh phera." Aur farmaya فَلَا صَدَّقَ وَلَا صَلَّىٰ ٣١ وَلَٰكِن كَذَّبَ وَتَوَلَّىٰ ٣٢ Al-Qiyama 75 31, 32 "So naa usne sach mana aur naa namaz ada ki. Aur lekin usne jhutlaya aur munh phera." قَالَ فَمَا بَالُ ٱلۡقُرُونِ ٱلۡأُولَىٰ ٥١ قَالَ عِلۡمُهَا عِندَ رَبِّي فِي كِتَٰبٖۖ لَّا يَضِلُّ رَبِّي وَلَا يَنسَى ٥٢ ٱلَّذِي جَعَلَ لَكُمُ ٱلۡأَرۡضَ مَهۡدٗا وَسَلَكَ لَكُمۡ فِيهَا سُبُلٗا وَأَنزَلَ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءٗ فَأَخۡرَجۡنَا بِهِۦٓ أَزۡوَٰجٗا مِّن نَّبَاتٖ شَتَّىٰ ٥٣ كُلُواْ وَٱرۡعَوۡاْ أَنۡعَٰمَكُمۡۚ إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَأٓيَٰتٖ لِّأُوْلِي ٱلنُّهَىٰ ٥٤ "Usne kaha to pehle zamaane ke logon ka kya haal hai? Kaha unka ilm mere Rab ke paas ek kitaab mein hai, mera Rab na bhatakta hai aur na bhoolta hai. Wo jisne tumhare liye zameen ko bichhauna banaya aur tumhare liye usmein raaste jari kiye aur aasman se kuch paani utara, phir humne uske sath kayi qismein mukhtalif nabaataat se nikali'n. Khao aur apne chaupaayo'n ko charaao, beshak usmein aqlon walon ke liye yaqeenan bahut si nishaniyan hain." Jab Moosa (AS)Alehis Salam ne Firaun ko bataya ke unka Rab wo hai jisne sari makhlooqat ko paida kiya hai, unhe rozi di hai aur unhe zindagi guzaarne ka tareeqa sikhaya hai to wo laajawab ho gaya, aakhir shikast khurdah hokar kehne laga ke phir un aqwam guzishta ke baare mein tum kya kahoge jo buto'n ki pooja karti thi? Jaise Nooh, Hood, Loot aur Saleh (AS)Alehis Salam ki qaumein, jo ek Allah par imaan nahin laaye aur buto'n ki parastish karti hui duniya se rukhsat ho gayin. To Moosa (AS)Alehis Salam ne kaha ke unn tamam qaumo'n ke aamaal ka Allah ko poora poora ilm hai. Unka har qaul-o-amal unke naamaye aamaal mein mehfooz hai aur roz-e-qayamat unhe unka badla mil jayega. Mere Rab ke daaire ilm se koi adna cheez bhi kharij nahi hai aur naa uss par nasyaan taari hota hai, mera Rab in dono ayyub aur deegar tamam naqaais se yaksar paak hai. Mera Rab wo hai jisne zameen ko tumhare liye farsh bana diya, taakey tum uspar zindagi guzaar sako aur mera Rab wo hai jisne zameen par tumhare liye raaste humwaar kar diye, taakey tum ek jagah se dusri jagah ja sako aur mera Rab wo hai jo aasman se barish naazil karta hai jisse nehrein banti hain aur kuwein bharte hain. Moosa (AS)Alehis Salam ka jawab khatam ho jane ke baad Allah Taala ne ahle kitaab ko apni wehdaniyat par imaan lane ki nasihat ke taur par farmaya ke hum hi iss pani ke zariye se inwaa-o-iqsaam ke paudhe, phal aur darakht waghaira paida karte hain, jo rang, maza, buu aur deegar ausaaf-o-khasais mein ek dusre se mukhtalif hote hain. Isliye aqal taqaza karti hai ke tum hum par imaan le aao, inn paudhon aur phalon mein se jo tumhare khane ke liye hain unhe khud khao aur jo tumhare jaanwaro ke liye hain wo unhe khilao. Mazkoorah baala tamam aamal iss baat ki daleel hain ke Allah Rabbul Izzat har baat par qadir hai, uska ilm har shay ko muheet hai aur uski rehmat tamam makhlooqat ko shamil hai, isliye sirf wahi ibaadat ka mustahiq hai, lekin inn dalaael se sirf ahle aqal-o-danish hi mustafeed hote hain. ۞مِنۡهَا خَلَقۡنَٰكُمۡ وَفِيهَا نُعِيدُكُمۡ وَمِنۡهَا نُخۡرِجُكُمۡ تَارَةً أُخۡرَىٰ ٥٥ "Usi se humne tumhe paida aur usi mein tumhe lautayenge aur usi se tumhe ek aur baar nikalenge." Yaani tum sab ke baap Adam (AS)Alehis Salam ka putla mitti se banaya gaya aur tamam ghizayein bhi mitti se nikalti hain, marne ke baad khuwah koi insaam qabr mein dafan ho ya na ho, bilwaasta ya bila'waasta uske ajza bhi mitti hi mein mil jayenge. Qayamat ke roz unhi ajza ko dobara jama karke aur unmein rooh phoonk kar zinda kar diya jayega, jaisa ke irshad farmaya قَالَ فِيهَا تَحۡيَوۡنَ وَفِيهَا تَمُوتُونَ وَمِنۡهَا تُخۡرَجُونَ ٢٥ Al-A'raf 7 25 "Farmaya tum isi mein zinda rahoge aur isi mein maroge aur isi se nikaale jaoge." Baaz riwayaat mein dafnane ke baad teen mutthiyaan mitti daalte waqt iss aayat ka padhna Nabi (ﷺ) se manqool hai, lekin ye riwayat sanad zaeef hain, taaham aayat ke baghair teen mutthiyaan mitti daalne wali riwayat jo Ibn-e-Maaja, kitaab Al-janaaiz(1565) mein hai, wo sahi hai. وَلَقَدۡ أَرَيۡنَٰهُ ءَايَٰتِنَا كُلَّهَا فَكَذَّبَ وَأَبَىٰ ٥٦ قَالَ أَجِئۡتَنَا لِتُخۡرِجَنَا مِنۡ أَرۡضِنَا بِسِحۡرِكَ يَٰمُوسَىٰ ٥٧ فَلَنَأۡتِيَنَّكَ بِسِحۡرٖ مِّثۡلِهِۦ فَٱجۡعَلۡ بَيۡنَنَا وَبَيۡنَكَ مَوۡعِدٗا لَّا نُخۡلِفُهُۥ نَحۡنُ وَلَآ أَنتَ مَكَانٗا سُوٗى ٥٨ قَالَ مَوۡعِدُكُمۡ يَوۡمُ ٱلزِّينَةِ وَأَن يُحۡشَرَ ٱلنَّاسُ ضُحٗى ٥٩ فَتَوَلَّىٰ فِرۡعَوۡنُ فَجَمَعَ كَيۡدَهُۥ ثُمَّ أَتَىٰ ٦٠ "Aur bila shuba'h yaqeenan hum ne use apni nishaniyan sab ki sab dikhlayi, pas usne jhutlaya aur inkaar kar diya. Kaha kya tu humare paas isliye aaya hai ke hamein hamari sar zameen se apne jaadu ke zariye nikaal de Aye Moosa! To hum bhi har soorat tere paas iss jaisa jaadu layenge, pas tu humare darmiyan aur apne darmiyan waade ka ek waqt tay karde ke na hum uske khilaf kare aur na tu, aisi jagah mein jo masawi ho. Kaha tumhare waade ka waqt zeenat ka din hai aur ye ke log din chadhe jama kiye jaye. Pas Firaun wapas lauta, pas usne apne daon pech jama kiye, phir aagaya." Yahan aayaat se muraad wo nishaniyan hain jo Allah Taala ne Moosa (AS)Alehis Salam ko di thi, wo nishaniyan ye hain, laathi, yadbaiza, qahat saali, phalon ki kami, toofan, tiddi, juwein, maindak aur khoon. Moosa (AS)Alehis Salam lambe arse tak Firaun ko daawat tauheed dete rahe aur iss taweel muddat mein Allah Taala ne mazkoorah baala nishaniyan bhej kar use raah dikhayi, lekin wo kibr-o-ghuroor mein sab ko jhutlata raha aur imaan laane se inkaar karta raha, balke iske bar aqs Moosa (AS)Alehis Salam se kaha ke tum Misr walo ko apne jaadu ke zor se iss weham mein mubtala karna chahte ho ke Allah ne tumhe apna Nabi bana kar bheja hai, taakey humari sultanat aur mulk Misr par qabiz ho jao aur humein yahan se nikaal do, to sunlo ke hum tumhare jaadu ka todd isse qawi jaadu se karenge, taakey logon ko maaloom ho jaye ke tum Nabi nahi balke jaadugar ho. Isliye tum khud hi humare darmiyan muqable ka ek waqt muqarrar kardo, jiski hum mein se koi khilaf warzi na kare aur iske liye ek aisi jagah muqarrar kardo jahan khade hokar sabhi log muqabla dekh lein. Moosa (AS)Alehis Salam ne kaha ke humare darmiyan muqable ka waqt eid ka din raha aur log muqabla dekhne ke liye subah ke waqt jama ho jayenge, taakey din ki poori roshni mein use dekh sakein. Iss guftugu ke baad Firaun ne apni majlis barkhast kardi aur Moosa (AS)Alehis Salam ko maghloob karne ke liye apni saazish ke taane baane bunne laga aur mulk ke tamam bade bade jaadugaron ko jama karke muqabla jeetne ke liye apne tayein tamam intezam mukammal kar liye. قَالَ لَهُم مُّوسَىٰ وَيۡلَكُمۡ لَا تَفۡتَرُواْ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ كَذِبٗا فَيُسۡحِتَكُم بِعَذَابٖۖ وَقَدۡ خَابَ مَنِ ٱفۡتَرَىٰ ٦١ فَتَنَٰزَعُوٓاْ أَمۡرَهُم بَيۡنَهُمۡ وَأَسَرُّواْ ٱلنَّجۡوَىٰ ٦٢ قَالُوٓاْ إِنۡ هَٰذَٰنِ لَسَٰحِرَٰنِ يُرِيدَانِ أَن يُخۡرِجَاكُم مِّنۡ أَرۡضِكُم بِسِحۡرِهِمَا وَيَذۡهَبَا بِطَرِيقَتِكُمُ ٱلۡمُثۡلَىٰ ٦٣ فَأَجۡمِعُواْ كَيۡدَكُمۡ ثُمَّ ٱئۡتُواْ صَفّٗاۚ وَقَدۡ أَفۡلَحَ ٱلۡيَوۡمَ مَنِ ٱسۡتَعۡلَىٰ ٦٤ "Moosa ne unse kaha tumhari barbadi ho! Allah par koi jhoot na baandhna, warna wo tumhe azaab se halaak kar dega aur yaqeenan naa kaam hua jisne jhoot baandha. To wo apne maamle mein aapas mein jhagad pade aur unhone poshidah sargoshi ki. Kaha beshak ye dono yaqeenan jaadugar hain, chahte hain ke tumhe tumhari sar zameen se apne jaadu ke zariye nikaal de aur tumhara wo tareeqa le jaye jo sab se achha hai. So tum apni tadbeer pukhta karo, phir saff bandh kar aajao aur yaqeenan aaj wo kaamyaab hoga jisne ghalba haasil kar liya." Jab jaadugar waqt muqarrar'h par Moosa (AS)Alehis Salam ke saamne aaye, to unhone unse azraah hujjat kaha ke tum log Allah ke baare mein iftaraa pardaazi na karo aur apne jaadu ke zariye se mehaz khayali cheez paish karke logon ko dhoka na do, agar tum aisa karoge to ek dardnaak azaab ke zariye se Allah tumhe nest-o-nabood kar dega aur jaan lo ke iftaraa pardaaz hamesha ghaatey mein rehta hai. Moosa (AS)Alehis Salam ki baatein sun kar jaadugaron mein ikhtilaaf ho gaya aur aapas mein sargoshiyan karne lage ke ye koi jaadugar hai ya waqayi Allah ka Rasool hai. Bila aakhir unki yehi raay hui ke ye dono jaadugar hi hain, apne jaadu ke zariye se Firaun aur humein sar zameen Misr se nikaal kar khud saltanat par qaabiz ho jana chahte hain aur humari jagah apni qaum ko yahan basa kar humare achhe bhale deen aur akhlaaq ka khatma chahte hain. Isliye hum log ek baat par muttafiq ho jaye aur saff bana kar aage badhein, taakey dekhne walo par humara roab pade aur phir aapas mein ek dusre se kehne lage ke aaj jo ghalib hoga wo Firaun aur firauniyo ki janib se khoob daad-o-dahash payega. لَا تَفۡتَرُواْ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ كَذِبٗا فَيُسۡحِتَكُم بِعَذَابٖۖ وَقَدۡ خَابَ مَنِ ٱفۡتَرَىٰ Saiyyadna Abdullah bin Masood (AS)Alehis Salam bayan karte hain ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ) ne farmaya "(Jhoot se bacho, kyonki) jhoot fasq-o-fajoor ki taraf le jata hai aur fasq-o-fajoor jahannum ki taraf le jate hain aur aadmi jhoot bolta rehta hai, yahan tak ke Allah Taala ke nazdeek jhoota likh diya jata hai." Muslim 2607 قَالُواْ يَٰمُوسَىٰٓ إِمَّآ أَن تُلۡقِيَ وَإِمَّآ أَن نَّكُونَ أَوَّلَ مَنۡ أَلۡقَىٰ ٦٥ قَالَ بَلۡ أَلۡقُواْۖ فَإِذَا حِبَالُهُمۡ وَعِصِيُّهُمۡ يُخَيَّلُ إِلَيۡهِ مِن سِحۡرِهِمۡ أَنَّهَا تَسۡعَىٰ ٦٦ فَأَوۡجَسَ فِي نَفۡسِهِۦ خِيفَةٗ مُّوسَىٰ ٦٧ قُلۡنَا لَا تَخَفۡ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلۡأَعۡلَىٰ ٦٨ وَأَلۡقِ مَا فِي يَمِينِكَ تَلۡقَفۡ مَا صَنَعُوٓاْۖ إِنَّمَا صَنَعُواْ كَيۡدُ سَٰحِرٖۖ وَلَا يُفۡلِحُ ٱلسَّاحِرُ حَيۡثُ أَتَىٰ ٦٩ "Unhone kaha Aye Moosa! Ya to ye ke tu phenke ya ye ke hum pehle ho jo phenke. Kaha balke tum phenko, to achanak unki rassiyan aur unki laathiyan, uske khayal mein daala jata tha, unke jaadu ki wajah se ke waqayi wo daud rahi hain. To Moosa ne apne dil mein ek khauf mehsoos kiya. Humne kaha khauf na kar, yaqeenan tu hi ghalib hai. Aur phenk jo tere dayein hath mein hai, wo nigal jayega jo kuch unhone banaya hai, beshak unhone jo kuch banaya hai wo jaadugar ki chaal hai aur jaadugar kaamyaab nahi hota jahan bhi aaye." Jab jaadugaron ke darmiyan ittefaq ho gaya ke muqabla kaise kiya jaye to unhone Moosa (AS)Alehis Salam se poochha ke pehle tum ibteda karoge ya hum shuru kare? Moosa (AS)Alehis Salam ne kaha ke pehle tum hi daalo aur unhone aisa isliye kaha ke jab jaadugar apna kartab dikha chukenge aur unke khayali saanpo'n ko Moosa ki laathi nigal jayegi, to maujza-e-nabwi zyada waaze shakal mein dars ibrat ban kar logon ke saamne aayega. Jaadugaron ne jab apni rassiyan aur laathiyan zameen par phenki to Moosa (AS)Alehis Salam ne dekha ke wo jaadu ke asar se daud rahi hain. Moosa (AS)Alehis Salam ba-haisiyat insaan unn saanpo'n se darr gaye, ya iss baat se darr gaye ke kahin log jaadugaron ke kartab se mutassir to na ho jayenge. Isliye ke wo jo cheez pesh karne ja rahe the wo bhi unke jaadu se milti julti thi, unki laathiyan aur rassiyan bhi saanp nazar aarhi thin aur Moosa (AS)Alehis Salam ke asaa ko bhi saanp ki shakal ikhtiyaar karna thi, to Moosa (AS)Alehis Salam ghabraye ke pata nahi log jaadu aur maujze ke darmiyan farq kar payenge ke nahi. To Moosa (AS)Alehis Salam ki ghabrahat dekh kar Allah Taala ne farmaya ke aap pareshan na ho, tujhe unke muqable mein fateh naseeb hogi aur maujza-e-ilaahi ke saamne unki ek nahi chalegi. Aapke dayein hath mein jo laathi hai, use zameen par daal dijiye, unhone aisa hi kiya aur wo laathi ek muheeb-o-tez tarrar azdaha ban kar jaadugaron ki laathiyon aur rassiyon ko nigalne lagi aur tamam log aur jaadugar apni aankho se ye sab kuch dekhte rahe, yahan tak ke maidan mein ek saanp bhi baqi na raha, jaadu shikast kha gaya aur Allah Taala ka maujza ghalib aagaya. Isliye Allah Taala ne aage farmaya ke unhone jo kuch banaya tha wo jaadugaron ka kartab tha aur jaadugar koi bhi chaal chale kaamyaab nahi ho sakta. فَأُلۡقِيَ ٱلسَّحَرَةُ سُجَّدٗا قَالُوٓاْ ءَامَنَّا بِرَبِّ هَٰرُونَ وَمُوسَىٰ ٧٠ قَالَ ءَامَنتُمۡ لَهُۥ قَبۡلَ أَنۡ ءَاذَنَ لَكُمۡۖ إِنَّهُۥ لَكَبِيرُكُمُ ٱلَّذِي عَلَّمَكُمُ ٱلسِّحۡرَۖ فَلَأُقَطِّعَنَّ أَيۡدِيَكُمۡ وَأَرۡجُلَكُم مِّنۡ خِلَٰفٖ وَلَأُصَلِّبَنَّكُمۡ فِي جُذُوعِ ٱلنَّخۡلِ وَلَتَعۡلَمُنَّ أَيُّنَآ أَشَدُّ عَذَابٗا وَأَبۡقَىٰ ٧١ "To jadugar gira diye gaye, iss haal mein ke sajda karne wale the, unhone kaha hum Haroon aur Moosa ke Rabb par iman laaye. Kaha tum iss par isse pehle iman le aaye ke main tumhe ijazat doon, yaqeenan ye to tumhara badaa hai jisne tumhe jadu sikhaya hai, pass yaqeenan main har surat tumhare hath aur tumhare paaon mukhalif simt se buri tarah kaatunga aur zaroor har surat tumhe khajoor ke tano'n par buri tarah sooli dunga aur yaqeenan tum zaroor jaan loge ke hum mein se kaun azaab dene mein zyada sakht aur zyada baaqi rehne wala hai." Jab jaadugaro'n ne tamaam maajra apni aankhon se dekh liya to jadugari ke tamaam uloom o fanoon ki wajah se unhe yaqeen ho gaya ke moosa (AS) ke hathon abhi unhone jo kuch dekha hai wo koi jaadu nahi hai, woh to wo haq hai jiski haqaaniyat me koi shuba'h nahi hai aur ye sab kuch uss Allah ki qudrat se hua hai jo kehta hai ke "ho ja" to wo cheez ho jati hai.
