On a Tuesday evening in Seongsu-dong, a small wood-counter restaurant called Ilpum Sikdang is quietly turning over its third seating of the night. Inside the Korea solo economy 2026, this is what dinner looks like. The seats face the wall, not each other. Each diner has a single power outlet, a USB port, and a tiny shelf for a phone. Nobody asks for two portions of pork belly. No one waits for a friend. Solo diners do not even glance at the next stool over. The chef ladles out a bubbling earthen pot of kimchi stew. Then he slides over five small banchan and walks away. Scenes like this now repeat themselves across more than 10 million Korean households every night. For most foreign visitors, Seoul still reads as a city of K-pop crowds and group barbecue tables. However, beneath that older image, a quieter and far stranger consumer market has emerged. Specifically, single-person households now make up between 36 and 42 percent of all Korean households. Moreover, they have become the largest household type in the country. As a result, Korea s restaurants, supermarkets, appliance makers, and real estate developers are rebuilding everything around a customer of one. This is the story of the honjok economy the alone tribe that few outside Korea have heard of. It is also the story of the businesses that learned how to serve them. Meet the Honjok The Tribe Behind the Solo Household Economy The Korean word honjok (혼족) combines honja alone with the suffix -jok , meaning tribe. Specifically, it describes Koreans who live, eat, drink, travel, and identify as comfortably solo. Furthermore, the honjok vocabulary has branched into specific verbs that now dominate everyday speech Honbap (혼밥) eating alone Honsul (혼술) drinking alone Honnol (혼놀) playing or doing leisure alone A decade ago, these terms carried mild stigma. Older generations valued traditional dining customs. Meanwhile, younger Koreans began to embrace solo dining as self-care. Today, however, the words appear on restaurant signs, beer cans, hotel ads, and even government tourism campaigns. As a result, Visit Seoul s official site now publishes a 2026 honbap guide for foreigners. Above all, the cultural shift matters because Korean commerce has organized itself around it. Specifically, the Korea feelconomy reshaped how Koreans spend on emotion. In addition, the Korea pop-up industry 2026 showed how brands chase intimate, individual experiences. Meanwhile, the single-person household market sits beneath both trends as the underlying demographic engine. The Numbers Behind Korea Solo Economy 2026 The headline figure depends on which Korean government agency you read. The Ministry of Health and Welfare s social security factbook puts single-person households at 8.05 million by the end of 2024. That figure equals 36.1 percent of all Korean households. However, the Ministry of the Interior and Safety reports a higher number. Its data shows 10.12 million single-person households out of 24.12 million total. That works out to roughly 42 percent of all Korean homes. Either way, the trajectory is unambiguous. The figure has climbed steadily from 5.2 million in 2015 to 6.64 million in 2020. In 2020, it breached the 30 percent mark for the first time. Projections see it reaching 8.55 million by 2027 and 9.94 million by 2042. Meanwhile, in Seoul, single-person households totaled around 1.66 million, or 40 percent of the city s total. Two-person households followed at 26 percent. Four-person households made up just 12 percent. Two demographic forces drive the rise. First, young Koreans in their 20s and 30s now view moving out as a step toward independence. They no longer treat it as preparation for marriage. Second, more than 5.65 million households contain a member aged 65 or older. Around 2.13 million seniors among them now live alone. Notably, that figure marks a 37.8 percent jump from 2023. In other words, the solo household economy has two distinct customer segments. One is young urban professionals delaying or skipping marriage. The other is elderly Koreans living past their spouses or adult children. As a result, this barbell shape forces companies to serve both ends of the age curve. The connection between solo living and Korea s broader birth rate crisis is no coincidence. Specifically, the same shift away from marriage that drove fertility to 0.65 has produced the 10-million-strong customer base. One more number matters before we move on. According to Statistics Korea, single-person households earned an average annual income of 34.23 million won in 2024. That equals about 23,288. Furthermore, the figure is just 46.1 percent of the overall household average. Therefore, the Korea solo economy 2026 is not driven by raw wealth. Instead, it is driven by sheer volume and a willingness to spend on convenience. Honbap Built a Food Empire Inside the Korea Solo Economy 2026 Eating alone rebuilt the Korean food industry from the inside out. Twenty years ago, dining alone in a Korean restaurant could be socially uncomfortable. Some establishments openly refused single diners. Solo customers were seen as unprofitable. They would still receive a full spread of banchan side dishes for just one person. Today, the math has inverted. The honbap customer is the most reliable customer. The clearest commercial winner has been the home meal replacement, or HMR, category. According to IMARC Group, South Korea s convenience food market reached 9.7 billion in 2025. It is forecast to hit 16.2 billion by 2034, growing at a 5.23 percent CAGR. Moreover, the HMR segment alone surpassed 6 trillion won in annual sales. Projections point toward 6.8 trillion won. CJ CheilJedang has become the de facto champion of solo eating. In May 2025, ready-to-eat and convenience meals led the entire food manufacturing sector with 5.89 trillion won in production value. CJ CheilJedang held the top spot at 2.84 trillion won. Furthermore, its Bibigo brand has converted small-batch dumplings, kimchi stew pouches, and microwaveable bulgogi into export-quality products. These products now sell across the United States, Japan, and the European Union. Meanwhile, convenience stores have built their own honbap economy on top of the HMR wave. Specifically, Korea s convenience store empire CU, GS25, 7-Eleven, and Emart24 generates most of its lunch traffic from solo office workers. They typically buy a single triangle gimbap, a hot chicken cup, and a small bottle of tea. As a result, the lunch tray for one has become a multi-billion-dollar product category. Importantly, the honjok economy has also reshaped restaurants themselves. Counter seating, individual hot-pot burners, and single-serving grills now appear in traditional Korean BBQ chains. Many of those chains once required two-person minimums. In addition, ramen bars modeled on Tokyo s Ichiran have multiplied across Gangnam, Seongsu, and Hongdae. These bars feature partitioned booths where a solo diner can finish a meal without eye contact. Honsul Built a Whiskey Boom Across the Single-Person Household Market If honbap rebuilt food, honsul rebuilt alcohol. For decades, Korean drinking culture revolved around hoesik. These were group dinners with senior colleagues, soju shots poured by juniors, and a strict etiquette around who pours for whom. However, that culture collapsed faster than most analysts expected. As a result, hoesik attendance fell sharply after the pandemic. A generation of Korean office workers stopped attending altogether. What replaced it was honsul. The most visible business signal has been Korea s whiskey explosion. South Korea became the world s fastest-growing whiskey market in 2022. Specifically, consumption jumped 46 percent that year. Whiskey imports then hit a record high in 2023. Furthermore, the single-person household market drove the format shift. Convenience stores now sell whiskey in small bottle formats. As a result, millennials can enjoy drinking in their living rooms rather than at fancy bars. The highball whiskey plus soda water has become the honsul drink of choice. Meanwhile, craft soju, low-ABV makgeolli, and premium imported beer have all expanded shelf space in the convenience-store cold case. Liquor specialty shops have multiplied across Korea. Specifically, homesul (home drinking) and honsul trends merged into a continuous consumption channel. Notably, the honsul boom also created its own retail format. Bottle shops small storefronts with no seating now occupy spaces once held by traditional pubs. They sell 150 to 300 curated spirits each. In addition, e-commerce platforms have rolled out pickup-only whiskey services. Solo drinkers can order online and collect their bottle within walking distance of home. In short, the Korea solo economy 2026 has rewritten one of the world s most communal drinking cultures. It is now one of the most private. Living Alone Built MINIX and the Mini-Appliance Boom The third pillar is appliances. For a foreigner walking through a Korean department store, the most surprising shelf is no longer the giant kimchi fridge. It is the mini one. ATHOME s MINIX won a 2026 Red Dot Design Award for a mini kimchi refrigerator. The product was tailored to single- and two-person households. Furthermore, MINIX s Flender a compact food waste processor swept five international design awards in the same year. The broader category is booming. South Korea s small home appliance market reached 4.18 billion in 2025. It is projected to grow to 4.92 billion by 2030. Although the headline CAGR of 3.33 percent looks modest, the structural driver matters more than the rate. Specifically, growth is underpinned by rapid single-person household formation, premium adoption, and smart-home integration. Within the segment, three product categories have outperformed the rest Mini washing machines sized for studio apartments and officetels. Single-burner induction ranges that fit a one-meter kitchen counter. Slim air purifiers and dehumidifiers designed for 20-square-meter rooms. Domestic specialists like Cuckoo Electronics and Coway have aggressively repositioned around the solo household economy. Meanwhile, incumbents Samsung and LG have launched dedicated small-form lines such as Bespoke and Objet. These lines are tailored to compact urban interiors. The appliance boom intersects with another category covered elsewhere on Seoulz. Specifically, the Korea sleep economy 2026 is an 11 billion industry built around premium mattresses and recovery devices. It overlaps heavily with the single-person customer who prioritizes home-based wellbeing. Housing for One How Co-Living Is Reshaping the Honjok Economy If you live alone in Korea, you face a brutal housing math problem. The traditional Korean rental system jeonse requires a lump-sum deposit. That deposit runs 50 to 70 percent of the property s value. It is refunded at the end of a typical two-year lease. For a young solo renter in Seoul, the deposit can exceed 200 million won. That works out to roughly 145,000. Furthermore, the jeonse market has been rocked by widespread fraud since 2022. Into that vacuum, a new format has emerged co-living . The standout operator is Mangrove, run by Seoul-based startup MGRV. Mangrove Sinchon combines furnished private studios with intentionally designed shared spaces. These spaces include communal kitchens, libraries, study rooms, home theaters, and fitness centers. Specifically, the Sinchon branch is a 16-floor co-living building. It can house up to 277 residents across 165 households. Co-living solves three pain points for the Korea solo economy 2026 customer Lower upfront cost. Flexible deposits run 1 to 5 million won versus traditional 20 to 50 million won deposits. Shorter commitments. Lease terms start at 3 to 6 months versus the standard 2-year contract. Built-in social infrastructure. Loneliness is the most cited downside of solo urban living. Notably, around 25 percent of Mangrove residents are foreigners. They include international students, digital nomads, and remote workers. Furthermore, these foreigners find the format more accessible than the Korean jeonse system. Therefore, co-living is one of the few honjok-economy categories that directly serves an overseas customer. Beyond Mangrove, several other operators are scaling co-living. They include SK D D s Episode brand and the listed REIT-backed Tribe House. Their locations span Seoul, Bundang, and Songdo. Furthermore, the Living Company an Australian institutional real estate group opened its Korean office in April 2025. The office sits in Seoul s Magok district and serves the build-to-rent market. For broader context, this shift connects to the Korea wedding industry collapse story. Specifically, the same young Koreans who are not marrying are not buying multi-bedroom apartments either. As a result, single-occupancy housing has outgrown family-sized housing structurally. That has happened for the first time in modern Korean history. Shopping for One Inside the Solo Household Economy The fifth pillar is grocery. Founded in 2015 by ex-investment banker Sophie Kim, Market Kurly revolutionized fresh food delivery in South Korea. Specifically, its Saetbyeol Delivery offered next-day early-morning service. The format altered consumer expectations long before Coupang entered the space. Furthermore, the company s customer profile became inseparable from the single-person household market. Market Kurly became popular among health-conscious and solo households. The Kurly format solved a structural problem for solo consumers. Traditional Korean groceries packed in bulk a kilogram of pork belly, a dozen eggs, an entire napa cabbage were impossible to finish before spoilage. As a result, food waste in single-person households became a national topic. Kurly s answer was the small-batch SKU. Single-portion meat cuts. Pre-cut vegetables. Two-egg trays. Half-loaves of bread. Furthermore, Market Kurly s revenue grew at a 146 percent CAGR over five years to 2021. It reached 1.56 trillion won about 1.3 billion. Other Korean platforms have followed the same logic. Oasis Market which IPO d in 2023 targets the organic small-batch segment. Specifically, Jeongyukgak (정육각) sells single-serving portions of premium domestic pork. The platform delivers them on the same day they are cut. Meanwhile, Coupang s Rocket Fresh has built an equivalent service inside its broader e-commerce ecosystem. The retail format is now exporting. Online platforms in pet care are growing at a 17.3 percent CAGR in Korea. Notably, same-day delivery and subscriptions drive that growth. It mirrors what happened in human grocery a decade earlier. The Loneliness Premium in the Korea Solo Economy 2026 Solo living is not free. Emotionally or financially. The clearest commercial expression of the cost is pet adoption. Specifically, the Korea pet industry 2026 is on track to surpass 6 trillion won by 2027. Around 5.91 million pet-owning households now represent 27 percent of the total. Furthermore, the average pet owner spends 194,000 won roughly 142 per month per pet. Notably, that figure is rising faster than overall household income. Solo households are disproportionately represented in pet ownership. Specifically, single-person households exceeded 30 percent and are driving a fur-baby culture. As a result, pets now enjoy birthday parties, premium grooming, and even insurance policies. Beyond pets, a quieter category has emerged AI companions. Korean tech firms have started building emotional-support chatbots for the solo customer. Specifically, SK Telecom s A. and Kakao s Zeta are both leading the wave. Notably, Zeta a Korean Gen Z chatbot recently overtook ChatGPT in domestic downloads. Furthermore, Naver has invested heavily in companion-style language models tuned to Korean cultural context. The phenomenon overlaps with the Korea silver economy 2026 . Specifically, elderly solo seniors are a primary target for tablets and voice assistants. These devices are designed to reduce social isolation. Importantly, the loneliness premium also shows up in emotional spending data. According to a 2025 KB Financial Group study, solo households allocate a higher share of discretionary income to several categories Streaming subscriptions (Netflix, Coupang Play, Tving, Wavve). Hobby memberships (climbing gyms, golf simulators, ceramics studios). Solo-friendly travel packages (Jeju, Busan, regional 4-star hotels). Mental health apps and counseling sessions. In other words, the Korea solo economy 2026 is not just an economy of survival goods. Instead, it is increasingly an economy of self-curated experience. What Korea Solo Economy 2026 Tells Us About the Future Three structural patterns separate Korea s solo market from comparable trends elsewhere. First, the speed. Within a single generation, single-person households moved from a fringe statistic to the largest household category. Most OECD countries took 40 to 50 years to make the same transition. In contrast, Korea did it in roughly 15. Second, the technology layer. Korean solo households operate on top of one of the world s most advanced delivery, payments, and convenience infrastructures. As a result, the friction of living alone is lower in Seoul than almost anywhere on earth. Furthermore, that lowers the implicit cost of choosing solo life over marriage. Third, the demographic compression. Korea is aging faster than any major economy. At the same time, it is losing its child population. Therefore, the solo customer is both 25 years old and 75 years old. This forces companies to design products that work across two very different ends of the lifespan. Looking forward, the honjok economy is unlikely to plateau. Projections suggest the number of single-person households will continue to grow toward 9.94 million by 2042. Meanwhile, the cultural normalization of solo living has already passed the inflection point. Younger Koreans no longer treat marriage as the default life script. As a result, Korean industry is no longer pretending otherwise. For Foreign Founders and Investors Quiet Entry Points into the Honjok Economy For overseas operators evaluating Korea, the solo household economy offers several non-obvious entry points. Small-batch consumer goods. Korean consumers will pay premium prices for single-serving formats. These formats don t yet exist in mass-market portfolios from Nestlé, Unilever, or Procter Gamble. Compact appliances. Foreign manufacturers struggle to design products for a 1.2-meter kitchen. Specifically, partnerships with Korean OEMs around MINIX-style formats are an underexplored channel. Co-living real estate. The Living Company, Greystar, and several institutional REITs are entering Korea s build-to-rent market. Furthermore, the segment remains structurally underbuilt versus demand. Solo-friendly hospitality. Hotels and resorts that price aggressively for one without single-supplement penalties are still rare. They capture disproportionate share when launched. Subscription wellness. Mental health, fitness, and self-development subscriptions remain fragmented. As a result, no clear winner has yet emerged in the honjok wellness segment. For broader strategic context, foreign investors should also read related Seoulz coverage. Specifically, the Korea hagwon industry 2026 story reveals how Korean households spend even as they shrink. Furthermore, the Korea live commerce 2026 coverage shows the digital-first distribution layer the solo customer expects. The Quiet Economy That Is No Longer Quiet The Tuesday evening at Ilpum Sikdang ends without a single conversation among the diners. Each finishes a personal pot of stew, swipes a Toss QR code at the counter, and walks back into Seongsu s narrow alleys. By 9 p.m., the same seats will turn over twice more. This is the Korea solo economy 2026 in its most ordinary form. It is not a viral moment. Furthermore, it is not a trend piece. Instead, it is the daily commercial reality of 10 million households. Together, they are building the consumer market that will define Korea for the next two decades. For foreign investors, brand operators, and curious travelers, the honjok are not a niche. They are the new mainstream. As a result, the businesses that have learned how to serve a customer of one are the businesses worth watching. The Seoul Metropolitan Government is launching a full-scale push for "night economy revitalization," linking tourism, culture, commercial districts, and transportation, as a core growth strategy for its 9th popular election term. The plan aims to transform Seoul into a "24-hour global city" where vitality continues even after work hours, in line with growing tourism demand and changing consumption trends. The Seoul Metropolitan Government said it held its first regular executive meeting since the launch of the 9th popular election term on the 15th, chaired by Mayor Oh Se-hoon, and discussed the "night economy revitalization plan." It marks the first step in fleshing out the night economy vision Oh presented in his inaugural address into a strategy spanning the city administration. The night economy is a strategy to spread the spending of the growing number of foreign tourists into local alley commercial districts, and to inject vitality into the urban center, which empties out after work hours, to realize a "24-hour global city." The focus is on lifting economic vitality across the city by increasing dwell time and inducing consumption, beyond simply expanding night business operations. "The night economy is a new growth strategy that connects culture, tourism, commercial districts, and transportation into a single ecosystem, going beyond simple support for alley commercial districts," Oh said. "Break down the boundaries between offices and bureaus and pursue this with a sense of speed." To strengthen policy execution, the Seoul Metropolitan Government plans to activate a joint task force (TF) involving seven offices, headquarters, and bureaus, centered on a "night economy special advisor," and to establish a dedicated team within the Economic Affairs Office. In August, it will announce a "comprehensive night economy revitalization plan" and form a public-private governance body involving small business owners and experts to discuss region-specific measures and conflict-mediation plans. It will also develop an integrated brand tying together night content across Seoul through a citizen contest. Officials are reviewing a plan to designate major urban hubs as "night economy win-win special districts." The special districts will receive a package of support including night business incentives, deregulation such as extended outdoor business hours, and expanded late-night transportation. The enactment of a "Seoul Night Economy Revitalization Ordinance" to support this is also being pursued. Regional hub development will proceed in parallel. The Dongdaemun Design Plaza (DDP) will strengthen ties with nearby commercial districts, and the area around Seoul Arena, set to open next year, will be developed with accommodation and commercial facilities to enable stay-type consumption linked to performances. The Han River and waterfront areas will be fostered as 24-hour stay-type consumption hubs by easing restrictions on nighttime use. The Seoul Metropolitan Government will also expand "Seoul Moonlight Night Markets," which brought "night market" culture into the institutional framework. After running five as pilots this year, it plans to increase them to 25 by 2028, and to provide selected commercial districts with environmental improvement and branding support of up to 2 billion won along with additional incentives. To reduce noise and hygiene problems, it will introduce win-win agreements and consultative bodies between merchants and residents. Along with this, the city will expand nighttime openings of cultural facilities such as art galleries and museums, and develop convergence programs and unique stay-type content aimed at foreign tourists. It will also strengthen measures for nighttime mobility convenience and safety, including expanding late-night buses and introducing autonomous transportation. "We will establish the night economy as a signature policy that citizens feel in their daily lives," Oh said. "We will make it a core pillar that raises Seoul's competitiveness." Verify Download OTP enter karein aur Verify Download par click karein. Aapka e-Aadhaar PDF format mein download ho jayega. e-Aadhaar PDF Password Kya Hota Hai? Bahut se log Aadhaar download to kar lete hain lekin PDF khul nahi pati kyunki wo password-protected hoti hai. Iska password bahut simple hota hai. Password Formula First 4 Letters of Name (in CAPITAL) Year of Birth (YYYY) Example 1 Naam SURESH KUMAR Janam Saal 1990 Password SURE1990 Example 2 Naam RIA (Sirf 3 akshar hain) Janam Saal 2002 Password RIA2002 Difference e-Aadhaar vs Aadhaar PVC Card Feature e-Aadhaar (Digital) Aadhaar PVC Card Format PDF File (Phone PC mein) Hard Plastic Card Cost Bilkul Free 50 (Speed Post) Delivery Instant Download 5-15 Days (Home Delivery) Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs) Q Kya main bina registered mobile number ke Aadhaar download kar sakta hun? Ans Nahi, online download karne ke liye mobile number link hona zaroori hai kyunki OTP ussi par aata hai. Agar link nahi hai, to aapko nazdiki Aadhaar center jana hoga. Q Aadhaar PVC Card kitne din mein aata hai? Ans Order karne ke baad aamtaur par 5 se 15 working days ke andar India Post dwara aapke ghar pahunch jata hai. Lost Your Aadhaar? Retrieve it Instantly! Forgot your Aadhaar Number (UID) or Enrolment ID (EID)? Use your registered mobile number to get it back via SMS in seconds. Retrieve UID EID How to Retrieve Lost Aadhaar Number (UID) or Enrolment ID (EID) Have you lost your physical Aadhaar card and cannot remember your 12-digit Aadhaar number? Or perhaps you have applied for a new Aadhaar card but lost the acknowledgement slip containing the Enrolment ID (EID)? Do not worry. The Retrieve Aadhaar number EID SID service allows you to recover these details online instantly. This feature is a lifesaver for those who have misplaced their documents and need to download their e-Aadhaar urgent. By using this facility, your lost Aadhaar number or EID is sent directly to your registered mobile number. Important Prerequisite To use this online facility, your Mobile Number or Email ID MUST be registered and linked with your Aadhaar. If your mobile number is not linked, you cannot receive the OTP required for retrieval. Difference Between UID and EID Term Full Form Description UID Unique ID This is your final 12-digit Aadhaar Number . Select this if you already had a card. EID Enrolment ID This is the 28-digit number from your acknowledgement slip (for new applications). Step-by-Step Process to Retrieve Lost Aadhaar (UID) Visit the Official Portal Click on the Retrieve UID EID button above to open the official page. Select Retrieval Option Choose Aadhaar Number to find your main ID or Enrolment ID if you are tracking a new application. Enter Personal Details Enter your Full Name exactly as it is printed on your Aadhaar card. Enter Contact Info Captcha Enter your Registered Mobile Number or Email ID, fill the Captcha, and click Send OTP . Get SMS After OTP verification, your Aadhaar Number (UID) or EID will be sent to your mobile via SMS. Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs) Q Can I retrieve my Aadhaar if I don t have my mobile number? Ans No, the online facility works strictly via OTP. If your mobile is not linked, you must visit an Aadhaar Enrollment Center with your identity proof. Q Is there any fee for this service? Ans No, the Retrieve Aadhaar EID service is completely free of cost on the myAadhaar portal. Verify Mobile Email Not sure which mobile number is linked to your Aadhaar? Verify it instantly to ensure you receive OTPs for all government services. Verify Now How to Verify Mobile Number Email Linked with Aadhaar In today s digital India, your Registered Mobile Number is the key to accessing almost all Aadhaar services. Whether you want to download your e-Aadhaar, update your address online, or verify your ITR, the OTP (One Time Password) is sent to this linked number. However, people often change their SIM cards or forget which mobile number they gave at the time of enrollment years ago. The Verify Email Mobile service on the myAadhaar portal solves this confusion. It allows you to check if the mobile number or email ID you currently possess is the one linked to your Aadhaar database. ℹ Important Clarification This service does NOT show you the mobile number linked to your Aadhaar (for privacy reasons). Instead, YOU have to enter a mobile number, and the system will tell you if it matches the records or not. It is a verification tool, not a search tool. Step-by-Step Process to Verify Mobile Number Follow this simple procedure to confirm your linked contact details Access the Service Click on the green Verify Now button above. Select Verification Type You will see two options Verify Mobile Number and Verify Email Address . Select the one you want to check. Enter Details First, enter your 12-digit Aadhaar Number . Then, enter the Mobile Number (or Email) that you think is linked. Security Check Enter the Captcha code exactly as shown in the image box. Send OTP Click on the Send OTP button. Check the Result The system will display a success or error message based on your input (explained below). Understanding the Result Messages After submitting, you will see one of these two messages. Here is what they mean Scenario 1 Match Found (Success) The mobile number you have entered is already verified with our records. Meaning Congratulations! The mobile number you typed IS the one linked to your Aadhaar. You can receive OTPs on this number. Scenario 2 No Match (Failure) The mobile number you have entered does not match with our records. Meaning The number you typed is NOT linked. Either you linked a different family member s number, or an old number that you have lost. Why is this Verification Important? 1. Fraud Prevention Ensuring that no unknown mobile number or email is linked to your ID protects your biometric and demographic data. 2. Banking Services To link Aadhaar with a bank account or PAN card, the OTP validation is mandatory. Verifying ensures you are using the correct SIM. 3. Updates You cannot update your address or download Aadhaar online if you don t know which number receives the OTP. Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs) Q The system says Record not found . What should I do? Ans This means the mobile number you are entering is incorrect. Try entering mobile numbers of your family members. If none match, you must visit an Aadhaar Seva Kendra to check or update your number. Q Can I update my mobile number using this service? Ans No. This service is only for verification . To update or change your mobile number, biometric authentication is required, which can only be done offline at a center. Report Death Deactivate Aadhaar Secure the identity of your deceased family member. Officially report the death to UIDAI to prevent misuse of documents. Report Now How to Report Death of a Family Member for Aadhaar Deactivation The Aadhaar card is a unique identity proof that remains valid for a lifetime. However, in the unfortunate event of a family member s demise, it is the responsibility of the legal heir or guardian to inform the Unique Identification Authority of India (UIDAI). The Report death of a family member service allows you to officially flag an Aadhaar number for deactivation. This is a crucial step to ensure that the deceased person s identity documents are not misused for financial fraud, illegal SIM card issuance, or identity theft. Why is Deactivating Aadhaar Important? Many people often overlook this step, but keeping a deceased person s Aadhaar active can lead to several complications Prevent Misuse Scammers often look for dormant identities to open fake bank accounts or take loans. Subsidies Benefits To prevent the continued transfer of government benefits (like pensions) to a deceased person, which can later lead to legal recovery issues. Closure of Records It helps in closing other linked official documents like PAN Card and Voter ID systematically. Important Requirement To use this service, you MUST have a valid Death Certificate issued by the Registrar of Births and Deaths. The details on the Death Certificate must match the Aadhaar details of the deceased. Procedure to Report Death Online UIDAI has simplified the process by allowing family members to initiate this request via the myAadhaar portal. Follow these steps Login to Portal The reporting family member (Applicant) must login to the myAadhaar portal using their Own Aadhaar Number and OTP. You cannot login using the deceased person s Aadhaar. Select the Service On the dashboard, locate and click on the Report death of a family member card. Enter Details of Deceased Enter the 12-digit Aadhaar Number of the deceased family member. You may also need to provide their Name and Date of Birth as per records. Upload Document Upload a clear scanned copy (PDF JPG) of the Death Certificate . Ensure the file size is within the permissible limit (usually 2MB). Review Submit Verify all the details entered. Once submitted, you will receive a Service Request Number (SRN) to track the status. What Happens Next? (Verification) Reporting the death online does not instantly deactivate the Aadhaar. The request goes through a verification process 1. Registrar Verification The details are cross-verified with the birth and death registration records. 2. Deactivation Once verified, the UIDAI will permanently deactivate the Aadhaar number of the deceased. 3. Confirmation You can check the status using the Check deceased Aadhaar deactivation status service on the same portal. Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs) Q Can anyone report the death? Ans Usually, only immediate family members (spouse, children, parents) whose mobile numbers are linked or who can prove the relationship can initiate this request. Q Is it mandatory to deactivate Aadhaar after death? Ans While there is no strict penalty currently, it is highly recommended for safety and to close the financial and legal footprint of the deceased. Q Can I reactivate the Aadhaar later if reported by mistake? Ans No. Once an Aadhaar is marked as Deceased and deactivated after proper verification, it cannot be reactivated. Please use this service carefully. LIMITED TIME OFFER Free Document Update Is your Aadhaar 10 years old? Upload Proof of Identity Address documents online for FREE till 14 06 2026. Update Now Document Update Upload PoI and PoA Online Has it been more than 10 years since you got your Aadhaar card made? Have you updated your documents recently? If not, the Unique Identification Authority of India (UIDAI) strongly recommends that you update your Proof of Identity (PoI) and Proof of Address (PoA) documents. Keeping your documents updated ensures that your demographic information (Name, Address, DOB) in the Aadhaar database is accurate and up-to-date. This helps in seamless verification for banking, passport services, and government subsidies. Special Offer Free Service! This online document update service is FREE OF COST till 14 06 2026 . (Note If you visit an offline Aadhaar Center, you will have to pay 50.) Which Documents do you need to upload? You need to upload one document for Identity and one for Address. Common valid documents include 1. Proof of Identity (PoI) To verify your Name and Photo. PAN Card e-PAN Driving License Passport Voter ID Ration Card (with Photo) Mark Sheet School Certificate 2. Proof of Address (PoA) To verify your Current Address. Electricity Bill ( 3 months) Water Bill ( 3 months) Gas Connection Bill Bank Passbook Statement Passport (Address page) Voter ID Step-by-Step Process to Update Documents Online Take advantage of the free window and update your documents from home using these steps Login to myAadhaar Click the Update Now button above and login using your Aadhaar Number OTP. Select Document Update Click on the Document Update card. Review your current details (Name, Address, DOB). Upload Files Scan your PoI and PoA documents. Supported formats are JPEG, PNG, or PDF (Size 2MB). Submit Since the service is free, skip the payment. Click submit. You will get a Service Request Number (SRN) . Online vs Offline Update Comparison Feature Online (myAadhaar Portal) Offline (Aadhaar Center) Cost FREE (till 14 06 2026) 50 (Service Charge) Convenience From Home (24 7) Visit Wait in Queue Documents Self Scan Upload Originals Verified by Operator Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs) Q My address has changed. Can I use this service? Ans No. This service is ONLY to upload documents for existing details. To change your address, use the Address Update service. Q What happens if I don t update? Ans Your Aadhaar might get suspended or face difficulties in KYC authentication for banks or ration services. Generate Virtual ID (VID) Protect your privacy! Create a temporary 16-digit Virtual ID to use instead of your Aadhaar Number for authentication. Generate VID VID Generator Create Virtual ID to Hide Aadhaar Number Are you worried about sharing your 12-digit Aadhaar number everywhere? Do you want to protect your privacy while performing e-KYC? The Virtual ID (VID) is the solution. The VID Generator service allows you to create a temporary, revocable 16-digit random number mapped to your Aadhaar number. It can be used in lieu of your Aadhaar number for authentication services. This ensures your actual Aadhaar number remains hidden from the service provider. Privacy Feature When you use a VID, the agency (like a telecom operator or bank) cannot store your Aadhaar number. They only get a UID Token , which makes your data much more secure against leaks. Difference Aadhaar Number vs Virtual ID (VID) Feature Aadhaar Number (UID) Virtual ID (VID) Length 12 Digits (Permanent) 16 Digits (Temporary) Validity Lifetime valid Valid until you generate a new one Security Directly linked to biometric data Masks the actual Aadhaar number How to Generate or Retrieve VID Online You can generate a new VID or retrieve an existing one using the myAadhaar portal. Follow these steps Login to Portal Visit the myAadhaar dashboard by clicking the Generate VID button above. Select VID Generator Click on the VID Generator icon from the services menu. Choose Option You will see two options 1. Generate New VID If you want to create a fresh 16-digit number. 2. Retrieve Existing VID If you already generated one but forgot it. Confirm Receive Select your choice. Your 16-digit Virtual ID will be sent immediately to your Registered Mobile Number via SMS. Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs) Q Is VID accepted everywhere? Ans Yes, as per government regulations, all agencies (Banks, Telecom, Govt) must accept VID for authentication. Q What happens if I generate a new VID? Ans The moment you generate a new VID, your old VID gets automatically cancelled. You can only have one active VID at a time. Q Does VID expire? Ans No, a VID does not expire by itself. It remains valid until you choose to generate a new one. Lock Unlock Aadhaar Worried about identity theft? Temporarily Lock your Biometrics or Aadhaar Number instantly for maximum security. Secure Now Lock Unlock Aadhaar Secure Your Biometrics Instantly Security is a major concern for Aadhaar holders. What if someone gets hold of your Aadhaar number and tries to misuse it? To prevent unauthorized authentication, UIDAI provides a powerful feature Lock Unlock Aadhaar . This service allows you to temporarily Lock your UID (Aadhaar Number). Once locked, no one (not even you) can perform authentication using the Aadhaar number. It acts as a digital shield against identity theft. You can Unlock it whenever you need to use it. MUST READ BEFORE LOCKING Do not lock your Aadhaar without generating a Virtual ID (VID). Once your Aadhaar is locked, you CANNOT use your Aadhaar number to unlock it (because the number itself is locked). You will compulsorily need a 16-digit Virtual ID (VID) to perform the Unlock process. Difference Aadhaar Lock vs Biometric Lock Many people confuse these two services. Here is the difference Feature UID Lock (Aadhaar Lock) Biometric Lock What it blocks? Blocks ALL authentication (Demographic, Biometric, OTP). Blocks ONLY Fingerprint and Iris scan. OTP still works. How to use when locked? You must use Virtual ID (VID) . You must temporarily Unlock biometrics to use fingerprint iris. Security Level Highest (Total Lock) Medium (Protects Biometrics only) Step-by-Step Guide to LOCK Aadhaar Generate VID First As mentioned, ensure you have a valid VID. If not, use the VID Generator service first. Open Lock Service Click the Secure Now button above and select the Lock UID option. Enter Details Enter your 12-digit Aadhaar Number, Full Name, and Pin Code. Verify OTP Enter the security captcha and click Send OTP . Enter the OTP received on your mobile. Confirmation Your Aadhaar Number is now LOCKED. You will not be able to perform authentication using the UID anymore. Step-by-Step Guide to UNLOCK Aadhaar Select Unlock UID Go to the same service page and select the Unlock UID tab. Enter VID (Not Aadhaar Number) Here, you CANNOT enter your Aadhaar number. You must enter your 16-digit Virtual ID (VID) . Verify Unlock Enter the Captcha and OTP. Once verified, your Aadhaar number will be active again. Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs) Q Can I download e-Aadhaar if my UID is locked? Ans Yes, but you will have to use your Virtual ID (VID) to download it, as the Aadhaar number will not be accepted by the system. Q I forgot my VID and my Aadhaar is locked. What do I do? Ans You can use the Retrieve VID service via SMS. Send an SMS RVID Last 4 digits of Aadhaar to 1947 from your registered mobile number. Bank Seeding Status Are you receiving government subsidies? Check if your Aadhaar is successfully linked and mapped with your bank account for Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT). Check Status Bank Seeding Status Check Aadhaar-Bank Linking for DBT Many government schemes in India transfer money directly to beneficiaries bank accounts using the Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) system. This money is sent using the Aadhaar Payment Bridge (APB). For this to work, simply having a bank account is not enough. Your Aadhaar number must be seeded or mapped with that specific bank account in the NPCI (National Payments Corporation of India) database. The Bank Seeding Status service helps you check which of your bank accounts is currently linked to receive government funds. Why is Bank Seeding Essential? If your Bank Seeding Status is Inactive , you will NOT receive funds for PM Kisan Samman Nidhi LPG Gas Subsidy (PAHAL) Scholarships Pension Schemes (Old Age Widow) MNREGA Wages How to Check Bank Linking Status Online You can verify your current NPCI mapping status instantly through the myAadhaar portal. Follow these steps Login to Portal Click the Check Status button above and login using your Aadhaar Number OTP. Select Bank Seeding Status Locate and click on the Bank Seeding Status icon on the dashboard. View Result The system will display the Bank Name, Seeding Status (Active Inactive), and the Date of Linking. Understanding Your Status Result Status ACTIVE Your Aadhaar is successfully mapped. You are eligible to receive DBT funds in the mentioned bank account. Status INACTIVE Your mapping has been disabled or expired. You will NOT receive subsidies until you re-link it. My Status is Inactive Not Linked. How to Link? Note You CANNOT link your bank account to Aadhaar online via the UIDAI website. This must be done through your bank. Method 1 Visit Bank Branch (Recommended) Go to your bank branch, fill out the Aadhaar Seeding Form (DBT Mandate form), and attach a copy of your e-Aadhaar. Ask the official to Enable DBT specifically. Method 2 Net Banking Mobile App Some banks (like SBI, HDFC, ICICI, PNB) offer an option in their Net Banking App under Service Request Link Aadhaar Enable DBT . Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs) Q I have accounts in 3 banks. Which one will receive the money? Ans Government benefits are sent to the Last Seeded Bank Account . If you recently linked a new bank account, the money will start coming to that new account automatically. Q My bank says Aadhaar is linked (KYC done), but status shows Inactive. Why? Ans Linking for KYC and Linking for DBT are different. You must specifically ask the bank to Map Aadhaar to NPCI for DBT . Q How long does it take to update the status? Ans Once the bank processes your request, it usually takes 2-3 working days for the status to reflect on the myAadhaar portal. Track Your PVC Card Ordered your Aadhaar PVC Card? Track its printing and delivery status in real-time. Know exactly when it will reach your doorstep. Track Order Check Aadhaar PVC Card Order Status Track Delivery Have you recently ordered the new, durable Aadhaar PVC Card online by paying 50? If yes, you might be wondering when it will reach your home. The Check Aadhaar PVC card order status service allows you to track the progress of your printing request and its dispatch status. The entire process, from ordering to delivery, typically takes 5 to 15 working days . This tool helps you know exactly where your card is whether it is still printing or has been handed over to the post office. You Need Your SRN (Service Request Number) To check the status, you must have the 28-digit SRN . This number was generated when you successfully placed the order and paid the fees. It is available on the acknowledgement slip you downloaded. How to Check PVC Order Status Online Follow these simple steps to track your application Open the Tool Click on the Track Order button above. Enter SRN Enter the 28-digit Service Request Number (SRN) carefully. Security Check Type the Captcha code shown on the screen. Submit Click on Submit . The system will verify your request and display the current status. Understanding the Status Meanings Payment Successful Your order has been received by UIDAI. In Process Your data has been sent for printing. Dispatched Your card has been printed and handed over to India Post. (This is the most important status). How to Track via India Post (Speed Post) Once the status shows Dispatched , the portal will display an Airway Bill Number (AWB) . This is your tracking ID. Copy the Airway Bill Number (AWB). Visit the India Post Tracking website (indiapost.gov.in). Enter the AWB number in the Consignment Number field. You will see the exact location of your card and the expected delivery date. Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs) Q I lost my SRN. How can I check the status? Ans If you lost the SRN, check your SMS history for messages from UIDAI. Or check the Payment History section if you were logged in. Q The status says Dispatched but I haven t received it yet. Ans Delivery speed depends on India Post services. Use the Airway Bill Number to track it on the India Post website for real-time updates. Check Aadhaar Status Applied for a new Aadhaar or updated details? Track your application status in real-time using your Enrolment ID (EID) or URN. Check Status Check Aadhaar Enrolment Update Status Online Have you recently applied for a new Aadhaar card? Or have you updated your Name, Address, or Date of Birth at an Aadhaar Center? If yes, you don t need to visit the center again to know if your request is processed. The Check Enrolment Update Status service allows you to track your application in real-time. Whether you did the update online (via myAadhaar portal) or offline (at a Seva Kendra), you can track it here. Which Number Do You Need for Tracking? Depending on how you applied, you will have one of the following numbers 1. Enrolment ID (EID) Found on the top of the Acknowledgement Slip given at the Aadhaar Center. It contains 14-digit Enrolment No. 14-digit Date Time. 2. Service Request Number (SRN) Generated when you initiate an Online Update (like Address or Document Update) on the myAadhaar portal. It starts with S . 3. Update Request Number (URN) Generated via SMS if you updated details using the Self Service Update Portal (SSUP) in the past. How to Enter EID Correctly (Very Important) Most users fail to check status because they enter the EID incorrectly. The 28-digit EID is a combination of the Enrolment Number and Timestamp. Format Enrolment Number Year Month Day Time Example If slip says Date 15 08 2024, Time 14 30 55, Enrolment 1234 56789 01234 Enter like this 12345678901234 20240815 143055 (Notice the Date is reversed YYYY-MM-DD). Step-by-Step Tracking Process Follow these steps to know your current status Open the Tool Click on the Check Status button above. Enter ID Type your EID (28 digits), SRN, or URN in the box provided. Ensure there are no spaces or slashes. Security Check Enter the Captcha code exactly as shown. Submit Click Submit . The status will appear on the screen. What Does Your Status Mean? In Process Your application is still being verified by the backend team. This usually takes 5-30 days. Completed Congratulations! Your update is successful. You can now Download Aadhaar to see the changes. Rejected Your request was declined. This usually happens due to wrong documents or data mismatch. You will have to apply again. Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs) Q I lost my Acknowledgement Slip. How can I get my EID? Ans You can use the Retrieve EID UID service to get your Enrolment ID on your registered mobile number. Q How many days does it take to update Aadhaar? Ans As per UIDAI guidelines, up to 90 of updates are processed within 30 days. However, in some cases, it can take up to 90 days. Q Status shows Completed but I didn t get the card by post. Ans Completed means the data is updated online. The physical letter delivery takes extra time. You can download the e-Aadhaar immediately. Check Deceased Aadhaar Deactivation Status Once you have formally reported the death of a family member to UIDAI for Aadhaar deactivation, it is important to verify if the request has been processed. The Check Deceased Aadhaar Deactivation Status service allows legal heirs or guardians to track the progress of their application. Deactivating the Aadhaar of a deceased person is a critical step to prevent identity fraud and ensure that government records are updated accurately. Requirement You will need the Service Request Number (SRN) that was generated when you submitted the Report Death request. How to Track Deactivation Request Access the Tool Click on the Check Deceased Aadhaar Deactivation Status card on the myAadhaar dashboard. Enter SRN Input the 28-digit Service Request Number provided during the reporting process. Captcha Enter the security code displayed on the screen. View Status The system will show whether the request is Pending Verification , Approved (Deactivated), or Rejected (due to document mismatch). One Login, Many Services Access all Aadhaar services with a single secure login. Use your SSO ID or try our new Face Authentication feature for instant access without a password. Secure 256-bit Encryption Biometric Face Auth Supported Access Document Update Status Manage Family Profiles SSO Portal Login SSO ID User ID Password Use your camera to scan your face or upload a photo for verification. Click to Scan Face Upload Photo Supports JPG PNG (Max 5MB) Forgot Password? Create New Account What is SSO ID? (Single Sign-On Login) SSO (Single Sign-On) ek aisa digital authentication system hai jo users ko sirf ek ID aur Password ke zariye kai saari sarkari aur private websites par login karne ki suvidha deta hai. Chahe wo Aadhaar Card Download ho, Ration Card ki jankari ho, ya Jan Aadhaar portal SSO Login se sab kuch ek jagah manage hota hai. Bharat mein digital services badhne ke saath, SSO ID Login ab har nagarik ke liye zaroori ho gaya hai. Is portal par aap apne Aadhaar number ya Face Auth ka upyog karke securely login kar sakte hain. New Update Ab aap bina password yaad rakhe, seedhe apne Chehre (Face Auth) ya Biometric se SSO Login kar sakte hain. SSO ID Registration Account Kaise Banayein? Agar aapke paas abhi tak SSO ID nahi hai, to aap niche diye gaye steps follow karke apna naya account register kar sakte hain Upar diye gaye SSO Login box mein Create New Account par click karein. Apna 12-digit Aadhaar Number enter karein. Aapke registered mobile par ek OTP aayega, use verify karein. Apna manpasand SSO User ID aur Password set karein. Registration complete hone par aap turant login kar sakte hain. Benefits of SSO Portal (SSO Ke Fayde) All-in-One Access Ek hi login se 100 services ka labh uthayein. Recover Forgotten Password Agar password bhool gaye, to Aadhaar OTP se reset karein. High Security Two-factor authentication (2FA) aur Identity verification. SSO Login FAQs Q Main apna SSO ID Password bhool gaya hun, kya karun? Ans Aap Forgot Password link par click karke apne registered mobile number ya Aadhaar OTP ke zariye apna password reset kar sakte hain. Q Kya SSO Login ke liye Aadhaar zaroori hai? Ans Haan, security verification ke liye Aadhaar card number ya Jan Aadhaar ID ka hona anivarya hai. Q SSO ID se main kaunsi services use kar sakta hun? Ans Aap Aadhaar PVC order, Address Update, Scholarship forms, Job applications, aur Electricity bill payment jaisi suvidhayein use kar sakte hain.

Subsidy automatically bank mein aati hai Fake booking numbers WhatsApp pe circulate hote hain - sirf upar wale official numbers use karo "e-KYC online Rs 200 mein" - FRAUD. e-KYC distributor ke paas FREE hai "New connection Rs 1,000 mein" - FRAUD. Ujjwala mein FREE hai eligible logo ke liye Fake delivery boy - delivery pe ID card zaroor check karo Sirf official apps aur numbers se booking karo. Scam Database dekho. FAQs Q Kaunsa tarika sabse fast hai cylinder book karne ka? A WhatsApp ya Missed Call sabse fast hai - 2 minute mein booking confirm. App bhi achha hai agar tracking chahiye. Q Registered mobile number change karna hai, kaise? A Nearest distributor ke paas jaao Aadhaar card ke saath. Woh number update kar denge. Online nahi hota ye. Q Cylinder price kab change hoti hai? A Har mahine ki 1 tareekh ko oil companies price revise karti hain. Increase ya decrease dono ho sakta hai. Q Subsidy kaise milti hai? A Agar eligible ho toh subsidy directly bank account mein aati hai (DBT - Direct Benefit Transfer). Aadhaar bank se link hona chahiye. Q Double cylinder connection le sakte hain? A Haan! Ek hi company se ya alag companies se 2 cylinders le sakte ho. Distributor se baat karo. Q Cylinder delivery mein kitna time lagta hai? A Normal mein 1-3 din . Festival season ya shortage mein 5-7 din bhi lag sakte hain. Booking ke baad tracking check karo. Q Commercial cylinder ghar pe use kar sakte hain? A Nahi! Commercial cylinder domestic use ke liye illegal hai. Pakde gaye toh fine lagega. Domestic cylinder hi use karo. Report Death Deactivate Aadhaar Secure the identity of your deceased family member. Officially report the death to UIDAI to prevent misuse of documents. Report Now How to Report Death of a Family Member for Aadhaar Deactivation The Aadhaar card is a unique identity proof that remains valid for a lifetime. However, in the unfortunate event of a family member s demise, it is the responsibility of the legal heir or guardian to inform the Unique Identification Authority of India (UIDAI). The Report death of a family member service allows you to officially flag an Aadhaar number for deactivation. This is a crucial step to ensure that the deceased person s identity documents are not misused for financial fraud, illegal SIM card issuance, or identity theft. Why is Deactivating Aadhaar Important? Many people often overlook this step, but keeping a deceased person s Aadhaar active can lead to several complications Prevent Misuse Scammers often look for dormant identities to open fake bank accounts or take loans. Subsidies Benefits To prevent the continued transfer of government benefits (like pensions) to a deceased person, which can later lead to legal recovery issues. Closure of Records It helps in closing other linked official documents like PAN Card and Voter ID systematically. Important Requirement To use this service, you MUST have a valid Death Certificate issued by the Registrar of Births and Deaths. The details on the Death Certificate must match the Aadhaar details of the deceased. Procedure to Report Death Online UIDAI has simplified the process by allowing family members to initiate this request via the myAadhaar portal. Follow these steps Login to Portal The reporting family member (Applicant) must login to the myAadhaar portal using their Own Aadhaar Number and OTP. You cannot login using the deceased person s Aadhaar. Select the Service On the dashboard, locate and click on the Report death of a family member card. Enter Details of Deceased Enter the 12-digit Aadhaar Number of the deceased family member. You may also need to provide their Name and Date of Birth as per records. Upload Document Upload a clear scanned copy (PDF JPG) of the Death Certificate . Ensure the file size is within the permissible limit (usually 2MB). Review Submit Verify all the details entered. Once submitted, you will receive a Service Request Number (SRN) to track the status. What Happens Next? (Verification) Reporting the death online does not instantly deactivate the Aadhaar. The request goes through a verification process 1. Registrar Verification The details are cross-verified with the birth and death registration records. 2. Deactivation Once verified, the UIDAI will permanently deactivate the Aadhaar number of the deceased. 3. Confirmation You can check the status using the Check deceased Aadhaar deactivation status service on the same portal. Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs) Q Can anyone report the death? Ans Usually, only immediate family members (spouse, children, parents) whose mobile numbers are linked or who can prove the relationship can initiate this request. Q Is it mandatory to deactivate Aadhaar after death? Ans While there is no strict penalty currently, it is highly recommended for safety and to close the financial and legal footprint of the deceased. Q Can I reactivate the Aadhaar later if reported by mistake? Ans No. Once an Aadhaar is marked as Deceased and deactivated after proper verification, it cannot be reactivated. Secure Now Lock Unlock Aadhaar Secure Your Biometrics Instantly Security is a major concern for Aadhaar holders. What if someone gets hold of your Aadhaar number and tries to misuse it? To prevent unauthorized authentication, UIDAI provides a powerful feature Lock Unlock Aadhaar . This service allows you to temporarily Lock your UID (Aadhaar Number). How to use when locked? You must use Virtual ID (VID) . You must temporarily Unlock biometrics to use fingerprint iris. Security Level Highest (Total Lock) Medium (Protects Biometrics only) Step-by-Step Guide to LOCK Aadhaar Generate VID First As mentioned, ensure you have a valid VID. documents: Her Students Put Muzz on Her Phone as a Prank. Then This Happened A Muzz Couple Story Atlanta Chicago Everybody s got a take on the apps. They don t work. Nobody s serious. I d never. Amira Thomas had that take too. For five years.Here s the thing though she didn t even download Muzz herself. Her students stole her phone and put it on there as a prank. (Never underestimate a MIST team.)A singer-songwriter and producer from Atlanta, Amira wasn t exactly lacking. She coached her high school s MIST team, led sister halaqahs, and came from a tight, creative, deeply involved family in the Atlanta Muslim community. Her life was full mashallah full. Why d She Keep Deleting the App? For five years, Amira downloaded Muzz, deleted it, and downloaded it again. The other times, it was more just confirming my bias, she admits. Brothers weren t putting effort into their profiles. The ones who did couldn t hold a conversation past salams. She d get frustrated, then land back at peace she had friendship, family, community and faith that the rest was in Allah s timing.But two things shifted. A real conversation with her mom about self-esteem, about not actually putting herself out there. And her career she didn t want to be on the road as a singer and still not have found her person. I ve got everything I want, and no one to share it with. So she made a list. Emotionally available. Serious but goofy. Passionate. Wealthy didn t make the list.Then one night, watching Mad About You, she thought I want to be in love. And downloaded Muzz one more time. Meanwhile, in Chicago Suleiman Thomas s road to that same moment was longer and rougher.Born and raised in Chicago in a first-generation Muslim family, Suleiman was a D1 soccer player headed pro. Recruited to a boarding school at fourteen. Lived away from home through high school and college. Trained across the country and in Europe. You never think you re not going to make it. You ve always been in the small percentages. Then he broke his foot right before the flight to join a professional team.The years after forced a reckoning. Who was he without soccer? He d spent his whole life in the grind, no time for internships, no plan B. A marriage ended in the same stretch. Both the divorce and the end of my career happened over a short period of time. I really had to do some soul searching. His dad gave him exactly one month to mope. His boys tried to cheer him up not helpful at all. But one friend did something that actually was he put Suleiman on Muzz.Because here s the reality for a lot of first-gen Muslim families there s no auntie network. No long list of rishtas waiting. Muzz is critical for people who don t have traditional Muslim communities in their families, Suleiman says. How else would we have connected? He gave it six months. Then went quiet app still installed, just untouched. One Email. That s All It Took. A month into his hiatus Amira liked your profile.He could see her face and her city, and that was it. He reactivated, set his filters to Atlanta, and instead of paying to unlock the match swiped for a full hour until he found her again. (Respect the hustle.)Then he sent the first message Salams I ve been off the app for a while and saw your notification via email and had to reach out. Amira was on the treadmill when it came through. She lowered her incline to reply, then moved to the weight room so she could keep typing. Why had she swiped on him in the first place? His profile had an intro video and his smile, plus a slightly awkward laugh, caught her. His was the last profile she saw before getting off the app for good. I knew immediately it was him. Plot twist her age filter should ve hidden him completely. Qadr is not playing about the details.Their first phone call lasted five hours. They haven t stopped talking since. After the Talking Stage Then What? The similarities got almost eerie. Birthdays one day apart. Same favorite donut flavors. Same approach to disagreements. Both had voice-noted friends breaking down Love Is Blind.Two weeks in, they were talking marriage. At one month, Amira said I love you first technically. On the morning of her mom s birthday, mid-Mean Girls discussion, she slid in make fetch happen for sure ily. He caught it immediately. He d been circling it too I have a HUGE crush on you texts and paragraph-long messages that said everything except the actual words.But talking is one thing. Doing it right is another.Amira s dad is the gatekeeper, and she was terrified to tell him. Her mom spent a month strategizing then one day, when he happened to start talking about the value of family, she seized it NOW. NOW. His questions came fast Where did he come from? How long has this been going on? but under all of it was one thing making sure Amira ended up with someone who valued her as much as he did.From there, both families did it properly, adapted for distance. Her mom spoke with his mom. Her dad with his dad. And since Atlanta and Chicago are 700 miles apart, their chaperoned dates happened online parents in the room. They wanted to give us our space. They just wanted to be around. The families clicked instantly. Even coming from different traditions he s from a Sufi background, she s Sunni there was zero conflict. The hardest part came after Amira leaving Atlanta. Everyone was sad. My dad was heartbroken. She s been back five times already and Suleiman, deeply emotionally intuitive, has helped carry the weight of that transition. So What Does It Look Like Now? Mornings in Chicago Suleiman heads out early to drive a school bus for special-needs kids. Amira makes breakfast. They watch something light and hyper-analyze it together she calls him her anchor. Fridays are for the mosque weekends he plays soccer while she works on her music. Sometimes he makes up songs about her and just starts dancing. There s a lot of play, a standing arm-wrestling rivalry, and a genuine competition over who can out-nice the other. We both have a lot going on, Suleiman says. So we re intentional about making space for each other. Watch our instagram feature here Still Searching? Read This Twice. Amira There are billions of people you only need one. Allah is still preparing them for you. Maybe your person is going through a transition period right now. Say Alhamdulillah, and know your person is out there. Suleiman There s no fast-forward to marriage. The only lose condition is marrying the wrong person and everything we ve been prescribed as Muslims is designed to avoid that. Do what you can in your control, and leave the rest to Allah. Amira and Suleiman met on Muzz. Your person might be one notification away.

Can China turn off India's tap, hit land formation? The life-sustaining Brahmaputra runs from China's Tibet as the Yarlung Tsangpo. Can China block or divert the flow of Tsangpo and hit India's water supply and soil formation? Pakistan was into scare-mongering after India suspended the Indus Waters Treaty. This is what experts and data say about China and the Brahmaputra. Live TV Share Advertisement The Brahmaputra, which begins in Tibet as the Yarlung Tsangpo, flows wide and steady under the Saraighat Bridge in Guwahati, Assam's largest city. (Image PTI) Yudhajit Shankar Das New Delhi , UPDATED Jun 8, 2025 22 57 IST It's impossible that anyone who has taken a train to Guwahati and crossed the Saraighat Bridge hasn't been left amazed by the width of the Brahmaputra. It looks like a sea. Just to imagine that the mighty Brahmaputra gushes as a stream, called Yarlung Tsangpo, in Tibet is unimaginable for millions of Indians. But that's the fact and the visual answer to the question -- can China turn the Brahmaputra tap off for India? advertisement The idea that China, being the upper riparian country, might be capable of controlling the flow of the Tsangpo-Brahmaputra river system was brought up by Pakistan after India suspended the Indus Waters Treaty (IWT). That scare-mongering was promptly addressed by Assam Chief Minister Himanta Biswa Sarma. But what do research data and experts suggest? Can China block or divert the flow of Yarlung Tsangpo and hit India's water supply? Diverting the flow of a high-sediment river like the Brahmaputra won't be just about the water, it would also hit soil formation downstream. "If India does something like this that they stop the flow of rivers to Pakistan, then China can also do the same thing," Rana Ihsaan Afzal, a senior aide to Pakistani Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif, told Geo News on May 23. His remarks caused some consternation given the fact that China is constructing the 60,000-MW Medong Dam on the Yarlung Tsangpo at the Great Bend, near the India-China border. Experts rule out any possibility of China blocking or diverting water, and say a bigger worry should be that the massive dam -- one of the biggest in the world -- is coming up in a calamity-prone area in China-controlled Tibet. Economist Nilanjan Ghosh, who has studied the Tsangpo-Brahmaputra River System for close to two decades, says that it has never been China's position to block the flow of the Brahmaputra, albeit it aims to build run-of-the-river dams. "Any attempt to divert the flow would be counterproductive as it would result in upstream floods because of sediment accumulation," Ghosh, Vice President, Development Studies at the Observer Research Foundation (ORF), tells India Today Digital. The expert says China won't be able to "turn off the tap" as the Brahmaputra is primarily a rain- and tributary-fed river, and the Yarlung Tsangpo contributes just 10-15 of the entire volume of the Brahmaputra's water. "The Brahmaputra gets fatter and fatter as it moves downstream," says Ghosh. China contributes only a small portion of the Brahmaputra's total water. As the river flows through India, its volume increases more than six times due to several tributaries joining in. (Image Arun Uniyal India Today) In January this year, Ghosh and fellow researcher, Sayanangshu Modak, published a research paper in the peer-reviewed International Journal of Water Resources Development where they used hydrological data to junk the rhetoric around China being capable of turning the Brahmaputra tap off. Data collated over the years show that the discharge of the Yarlung Tsangpo, measured at Nuxia in Tibet, to be at 31.2 billion cubic meters (BCM) annually, which then swells to an estimated 78.1 BCM as it passes through the Great Bend and exits China. At the measuring station at Pandu in Guwahati, the Brahmaputra's annual discharge is 526 BCM, showing a six-fold volume increase. At Bahadurabad, in Bangladesh, which is just across the border with India, the annual discharge is 606 BCM. This shows that since the river's entry into India, the Brahmaputra has been fed by its tributaries to grow massively. The Brahmaputra has shaped Assam for centuries by carving out banks and creating shape-shifting islands. It has caused flooding woes, but has also left behind life-sustaining fertile soil. advertisement The Majuli island on the Brahmaputra is the world's biggest riverine island, and has been at the heart of neo-Vaishnavism, spearheaded by Srimanta Sankaradeva. The Vaishnavite satras (monastries) in Majuli have been centres of cultural and art for centuries. Like the one-horned rhino, the twin-leaf tea buds and the xorai and gamusa, the Brahmaputra has become a marker for Assam's civilisational identity. "Mahabahu Brahmaputra" is how legendary Assamese singer Bhupen Hazarika refers to the mighty river in one of his ever-popular songs, which tells the story of the land it feeds. WHAT BRAHMAPUTRA FLOODS SUGGEST Originating in the Angsi Glacier in western Tibet, the Yarlung Tsangpo travels 1,625 km in the China-controlled territory of Tibet and enters India after the Great Bend near the Namcha Barwa peak. Then, as the Brahmaputra, it flows for 918 km within India and another 337 km in Bangladesh, where it is called Jamuna, and empties into the Bay of Bengal. The length of the Tsangpo-Brahmaputra system in Tibet gives the perception that it is a major river with a huge water volume in China. advertisement Ghosh agrees with Himanta Biswa Sarma's analysis of the Brahmaputra but calculates the Tsangpo's water contribution to the Brahmaputra at much lower than the 30-35 pegged by the Assam chief minister. The expert says though the river system completes 56 of its run in China, it contributes just 15 of the water in its boundary. "That is why some literature suggests the Yarlung Tsangpo to be a tributary of the Brahmaputra," Ghosh tells India Today Digital. It is believed that the Brahmaputra actually forms at Sadiya in eastern Assam after the merger of three rivers the Dihang (Siang), Lohit and Dibang. "So, I don't think that, given these hydrological facts, there will be any substantial impact on India, even if China blocks the flow of Tsangpo," says Ghosh. The Brahmaputra in Assam gains significant volume of water as it flows parallel to the Himalayan foothills and is fed by many snowmelt tributaries such as the Subansiri, Kameng, and Kameng rivers.(Image Arun Uniyal India Today) Derek J Grossman, a national security and Indo-Pacific analyst with Rand Corporation, says Pakistan cannot count on China to turn off the tap as monsoons feed the Brahmaputra. advertisement "China has little control over the water flow of the Brahmaputra River, according to Indian government officials. One reason is that monsoons are the primary source of water. Another is that Beijing can only halt roughly 30 percent of the flow. Pakistan can't count on China," says Grossman. Tibet, one should remember, is a cold desert with very little precipitation. It is the glaciers that give birth to the rivers there. In India, the Brahmaputra has been linked with devastating annual floods, which are a result of the water drained into it by over two dozen tributaries in the monsoon months. Sadiya the town where experts argue that the Brahmaputra is formed is the town where Bhupen Hazarika was born, and a good part of it was engulfed by the Brahmaputra as it changed course after the earthquake in 1950. Hazarika rebukes the Brahmaputra, referring to it as Burha Luit, in one of his songs, for flowing silently, deaf to the wails of the numerous people on its banks. "...Burha Luit tumi boa kiyo (Why do you flow)," he asks. CHINA'S BLOCKING OF BRAHMAPUTRA FLOW WON'T HIT SOIL FORMATION Experts have suggested that the Brahmaputra is an antecedent river that is older than the Himalayas. While the Brahmaputra, in its age-old wisdom, flows silently, taking away land, like in Sadiya, the sediment it carries is crucial to soil formation. Even from the perspective of soil formation and fertility, China's blocking of the Yarlung-Tsangpo wouldn't impact India. According to the 2016 book -- River morphodynamics and stream ecology of the Qinghai-Tibet Plateau -- by Chinese experts, the annual suspended sediment load of the Yarlung-Tsangpo near Nuxia in Tibet is around 30 million metric tonnes (mmt), much lower than the 735 mmt of sediment load at Bahadurabad in Bangladesh. The stream-like Yarlung Tsangpo in Tibet cannot carry the sediment load, and it is the powerful Brahmaputra that does the heavy-lifting of the sediment load not just in India but to form the fertile Jamuna floodplain in Bangladesh. The average width of the Brahmaputra is 5.46 km, according to the Assam Water Resources website. In areas where it forms a braided system due to sediment deposition, the width extends to up to 18 km. Satellite images show the Yarlung Tsangpo (top) in Tibet as a narrow, fast-flowing river cutting through the plateau, while in the Assam plains the Brahmaputra (bottom) spreads out and swells into braided channels, often accommodating islands as large as Majuli and the one with the Dibru-Saikhowa National Park. Note The scale of the two images is not uniform, and they are presented only for visual comparison, not to exact proportions. (Image Google Maps) INDUS WATERS TREATY SUSPENSION AND CHINA'S DAMS The Indus Waters Treaty (IWT) that India kept in abeyance after the April 22 Pahalgam terror attack is very different from the treaty that India has with China on the Tsangpo-Brahmaputra system. While the IWT is a water-sharing treaty under which India gave the rights to water use of the western rivers of the Indus Rivers System to India, the pact with China on Yarlung-Brahmaputra is just for sharing of information, and not water. What China could do worst is stop sharing hydrological data with India, but even that won't matter much, according to Ghosh. "India has an MoU with China for hydrological data from three stations in China . Even if China stops sharing data, it won't matter because the information isn't helping much anyway due to the wrong choice of stations agreed on by the Indian government at the beginning of the millennia," he tells India Today Digital. Ghosh says no one should draw parallels between the Indus Water System and the Tsangpo-Brahmaputra River System because of the difference in the nature of the two. "The Indus System is largely fed by glacial and ice melt. It has around 45 to 55 normalised melting index (NMI). While the contribution of glacial and ice melt of the Brahmaputra is barely 10-12 ," says Ghosh. What this means is that the bulk of the water in the Indus River System is added upstream, which isn't true in the case of the Yarlung-Brahmaputra. While India has the advantage of being the upper riparian state in the case of the Indus system, China doesn't enjoy that in the case of the Brahmaputra. While Pakistan, an agrarian economy, is completely dependent on the Indus River System for its agriculture and power generation, India, according to Ghosh, barely taps 25 of the renewable water flow of the Brahmaputra. Therefore, while Pakistan might love to believe that its "all-weather friend" China might be able to turn the tap off on India and hurt it, this isn't true going by the hydrological and meteorological data. The Brahmaputra has historically been associated with Assam's resilience. The Saraighat rail bridge that one uses to travel to Guwahati is a reminder of that. It was the crucial Battle of Saraighat, led by legendary Ahom general Lachit Borphukan , on the Brahmaputra that led to the defeat of the Mughal forces and the end of the siege of Guwahati. Mahabahu Brahmaputra nurtures Assam. It is formed in Sadiya and China cannot weaponise its waters against India. - Ends Published By Sushim Mukul Published On Jun 8, 2025 09 43 IST
