Update Now Document Update Upload PoI and PoA Online Has it been more than 10 years since you got your Aadhaar card made? Have you updated your documents recently? If not, the Unique Identification Authority of India (UIDAI) strongly recommends that you update your Proof of Identity (PoI) and Proof of Address (PoA) documents. Keeping your documents updated ensures that your demographic information (Name, Address, DOB) in the Aadhaar database is accurate and up-to-date. This helps in seamless verification for banking, passport services, and government subsidies. Special Offer Free Service! This online document update service is FREE OF COST till 14 06 2026 . (Note If you visit an offline Aadhaar Center, you will have to pay 50.) Which Documents do you need to upload? You need to upload one document for Identity and one for Address. Common valid documents include 1. Proof of Identity (PoI) To verify your Name and Photo. PAN Card e-PAN Driving License Passport Voter ID Ration Card (with Photo) Mark Sheet School Certificate 2. Proof of Address (PoA) To verify your Current Address. Electricity Bill ( 3 months) Water Bill ( 3 months) Gas Connection Bill Bank Passbook Statement Passport (Address page) Voter ID Step-by-Step Process to Update Documents Online Take advantage of the free window and update your documents from home using these steps Login to myAadhaar Click the Update Now button above and login using your Aadhaar Number OTP. Select Document Update Click on the Document Update card. Review your current details (Name, Address, DOB). Upload Files Scan your PoI and PoA documents. Supported formats are JPEG, PNG, or PDF (Size 2MB). Submit Since the service is free, skip the payment. Click submit. You will get a Service Request Number (SRN) . Online vs Offline Update Comparison Feature Online (myAadhaar Portal) Offline (Aadhaar Center) Cost FREE (till 14 06 2026) 50 (Service Charge) Convenience From Home (24 7) Visit Wait in Queue Documents Self Scan Upload Originals Verified by Operator Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs) Q My address has changed. Can I use this service? Ans No. This service is ONLY to upload documents for existing details. To change your address, use the Address Update service. Q What happens if I don t update? Ans Your Aadhaar might get suspended or face difficulties in KYC authentication for banks or ration services. Generate Virtual ID (VID) Protect your privacy! Create a temporary 16-digit Virtual ID to use instead of your Aadhaar Number for authentication. Generate VID VID Generator Create Virtual ID to Hide Aadhaar Number Are you worried about sharing your 12-digit Aadhaar number everywhere? Do you want to protect your privacy while performing e-KYC? The Virtual ID (VID) is the solution. The VID Generator service allows you to create a temporary, revocable 16-digit random number mapped to your Aadhaar number. It can be used in lieu of your Aadhaar number for authentication services. This ensures your actual Aadhaar number remains hidden from the service provider. Privacy Feature When you use a VID, the agency (like a telecom operator or bank) cannot store your Aadhaar number. They only get a UID Token , which makes your data much more secure against leaks. Difference Aadhaar Number vs Virtual ID (VID) Feature Aadhaar Number (UID) Virtual ID (VID) Length 12 Digits (Permanent) 16 Digits (Temporary) Validity Lifetime valid Valid until you generate a new one Security Directly linked to biometric data Masks the actual Aadhaar number How to Generate or Retrieve VID Online You can generate a new VID or retrieve an existing one using the myAadhaar portal. Follow these steps Login to Portal Visit the myAadhaar dashboard by clicking the Generate VID button above. Select VID Generator Click on the VID Generator icon from the services menu. Choose Option You will see two options 1. Generate New VID If you want to create a fresh 16-digit number. 2. Retrieve Existing VID If you already generated one but forgot it. Confirm Receive Select your choice. Your 16-digit Virtual ID will be sent immediately to your Registered Mobile Number via SMS. Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs) Q Is VID accepted everywhere? Ans Yes, as per government regulations, all agencies (Banks, Telecom, Govt) must accept VID for authentication. Q What happens if I generate a new VID? Ans The moment you generate a new VID, your old VID gets automatically cancelled. You can only have one active VID at a time. Q Does VID expire? Ans No, a VID does not expire by itself. It remains valid until you choose to generate a new one. Lock Unlock Aadhaar Worried about identity theft? Temporarily Lock your Biometrics or Aadhaar Number instantly for maximum security. Secure Now Lock Unlock Aadhaar Secure Your Biometrics Instantly Security is a major concern for Aadhaar holders. What if someone gets hold of your Aadhaar number and tries to misuse it? To prevent unauthorized authentication, UIDAI provides a powerful feature Lock Unlock Aadhaar . This service allows you to temporarily Lock your UID (Aadhaar Number). Once locked, no one (not even you) can perform authentication using the Aadhaar number. It acts as a digital shield against identity theft. You can Unlock it whenever you need to use it. MUST READ BEFORE LOCKING Do not lock your Aadhaar without generating a Virtual ID (VID). Once your Aadhaar is locked, you CANNOT use your Aadhaar number to unlock it (because the number itself is locked). You will compulsorily need a 16-digit Virtual ID (VID) to perform the Unlock process. Difference Aadhaar Lock vs Biometric Lock Many people confuse these two services. Here is the difference Feature UID Lock (Aadhaar Lock) Biometric Lock What it blocks? Blocks ALL authentication (Demographic, Biometric, OTP). Blocks ONLY Fingerprint and Iris scan. OTP still works. How to use when locked? You must use Virtual ID (VID) . You must temporarily Unlock biometrics to use fingerprint iris. Security Level Highest (Total Lock) Medium (Protects Biometrics only) Step-by-Step Guide to LOCK Aadhaar Generate VID First As mentioned, ensure you have a valid VID. If not, use the VID Generator service first. Open Lock Service Click the Secure Now button above and select the Lock UID option. Enter Details Enter your 12-digit Aadhaar Number, Full Name, and Pin Code. Verify OTP Enter the security captcha and click Send OTP . Enter the OTP received on your mobile. Confirmation Your Aadhaar Number is now LOCKED. You will not be able to perform authentication using the UID anymore. Step-by-Step Guide to UNLOCK Aadhaar Select Unlock UID Go to the same service page and select the Unlock UID tab. Enter VID (Not Aadhaar Number) Here, you CANNOT enter your Aadhaar number. You must enter your 16-digit Virtual ID (VID) . Verify Unlock Enter the Captcha and OTP. Once verified, your Aadhaar number will be active again. Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs) Q Can I download e-Aadhaar if my UID is locked? Ans Yes, but you will have to use your Virtual ID (VID) to download it, as the Aadhaar number will not be accepted by the system. Q I forgot my VID and my Aadhaar is locked. What do I do? Ans You can use the Retrieve VID service via SMS. Send an SMS RVID Last 4 digits of Aadhaar to 1947 from your registered mobile number. Bank Seeding Status Are you receiving government subsidies? Check if your Aadhaar is successfully linked and mapped with your bank account for Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT). Check Status Bank Seeding Status Check Aadhaar-Bank Linking for DBT Many government schemes in India transfer money directly to beneficiaries bank accounts using the Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) system. This money is sent using the Aadhaar Payment Bridge (APB). For this to work, simply having a bank account is not enough. Your Aadhaar number must be seeded or mapped with that specific bank account in the NPCI (National Payments Corporation of India) database. The Bank Seeding Status service helps you check which of your bank accounts is currently linked to receive government funds. Why is Bank Seeding Essential? If your Bank Seeding Status is Inactive , you will NOT receive funds for PM Kisan Samman Nidhi LPG Gas Subsidy (PAHAL) Scholarships Pension Schemes (Old Age Widow) MNREGA Wages How to Check Bank Linking Status Online You can verify your current NPCI mapping status instantly through the myAadhaar portal. Follow these steps Login to Portal Click the Check Status button above and login using your Aadhaar Number OTP. Select Bank Seeding Status Locate and click on the Bank Seeding Status icon on the dashboard. View Result The system will display the Bank Name, Seeding Status (Active Inactive), and the Date of Linking. Understanding Your Status Result Status ACTIVE Your Aadhaar is successfully mapped. You are eligible to receive DBT funds in the mentioned bank account. Status INACTIVE Your mapping has been disabled or expired. You will NOT receive subsidies until you re-link it. My Status is Inactive Not Linked. How to Link? Note You CANNOT link your bank account to Aadhaar online via the UIDAI website. This must be done through your bank. Method 1 Visit Bank Branch (Recommended) Go to your bank branch, fill out the Aadhaar Seeding Form (DBT Mandate form), and attach a copy of your e-Aadhaar. Ask the official to Enable DBT specifically. Method 2 Net Banking Mobile App Some banks (like SBI, HDFC, ICICI, PNB) offer an option in their Net Banking App under Service Request Link Aadhaar Enable DBT . Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs) Q I have accounts in 3 banks. Which one will receive the money? Ans Government benefits are sent to the Last Seeded Bank Account . If you recently linked a new bank account, the money will start coming to that new account automatically. Q My bank says Aadhaar is linked (KYC done), but status shows Inactive. Why? Ans Linking for KYC and Linking for DBT are different. You must specifically ask the bank to Map Aadhaar to NPCI for DBT . Q How long does it take to update the status? Ans Once the bank processes your request, it usually takes 2-3 working days for the status to reflect on the myAadhaar portal. Track Your PVC Card Ordered your Aadhaar PVC Card? Track its printing and delivery status in real-time. Know exactly when it will reach your doorstep. Track Order Check Aadhaar PVC Card Order Status Track Delivery Have you recently ordered the new, durable Aadhaar PVC Card online by paying 50? If yes, you might be wondering when it will reach your home. The Check Aadhaar PVC card order status service allows you to track the progress of your printing request and its dispatch status. The entire process, from ordering to delivery, typically takes 5 to 15 working days . This tool helps you know exactly where your card is whether it is still printing or has been handed over to the post office. You Need Your SRN (Service Request Number) To check the status, you must have the 28-digit SRN . This number was generated when you successfully placed the order and paid the fees. It is available on the acknowledgement slip you downloaded. How to Check PVC Order Status Online Follow these simple steps to track your application Open the Tool Click on the Track Order button above. Enter SRN Enter the 28-digit Service Request Number (SRN) carefully. Security Check Type the Captcha code shown on the screen. Submit Click on Submit . The system will verify your request and display the current status. Understanding the Status Meanings Payment Successful Your order has been received by UIDAI. In Process Your data has been sent for printing. Dispatched Your card has been printed and handed over to India Post. (This is the most important status). How to Track via India Post (Speed Post) Once the status shows Dispatched , the portal will display an Airway Bill Number (AWB) . This is your tracking ID. Copy the Airway Bill Number (AWB). Visit the India Post Tracking website (indiapost.gov.in). Enter the AWB number in the Consignment Number field. You will see the exact location of your card and the expected delivery date. Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs) Q I lost my SRN. How can I check the status? Ans If you lost the SRN, check your SMS history for messages from UIDAI. Or check the Payment History section if you were logged in. Q The status says Dispatched but I haven t received it yet. Ans Delivery speed depends on India Post services. Use the Airway Bill Number to track it on the India Post website for real-time updates. Check Aadhaar Status Applied for a new Aadhaar or updated details? Track your application status in real-time using your Enrolment ID (EID) or URN. Check Status Check Aadhaar Enrolment Update Status Online Have you recently applied for a new Aadhaar card? Or have you updated your Name, Address, or Date of Birth at an Aadhaar Center? If yes, you don t need to visit the center again to know if your request is processed. The Check Enrolment Update Status service allows you to track your application in real-time. Whether you did the update online (via myAadhaar portal) or offline (at a Seva Kendra), you can track it here. Which Number Do You Need for Tracking? Depending on how you applied, you will have one of the following numbers 1. Enrolment ID (EID) Found on the top of the Acknowledgement Slip given at the Aadhaar Center. It contains 14-digit Enrolment No. 14-digit Date Time. 2. Service Request Number (SRN) Generated when you initiate an Online Update (like Address or Document Update) on the myAadhaar portal. It starts with S . 3. Update Request Number (URN) Generated via SMS if you updated details using the Self Service Update Portal (SSUP) in the past. How to Enter EID Correctly (Very Important) Most users fail to check status because they enter the EID incorrectly. The 28-digit EID is a combination of the Enrolment Number and Timestamp. Format Enrolment Number Year Month Day Time Example If slip says Date 15 08 2024, Time 14 30 55, Enrolment 1234 56789 01234 Enter like this 12345678901234 20240815 143055 (Notice the Date is reversed YYYY-MM-DD). Step-by-Step Tracking Process Follow these steps to know your current status Open the Tool Click on the Check Status button above. Enter ID Type your EID (28 digits), SRN, or URN in the box provided. Ensure there are no spaces or slashes. Security Check Enter the Captcha code exactly as shown. Submit Click Submit . The status will appear on the screen. What Does Your Status Mean? In Process Your application is still being verified by the backend team. This usually takes 5-30 days. Completed Congratulations! Your update is successful. You can now Download Aadhaar to see the changes. Rejected Your request was declined. This usually happens due to wrong documents or data mismatch. You will have to apply again. Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs) Q I lost my Acknowledgement Slip. How can I get my EID? Ans You can use the Retrieve EID UID service to get your Enrolment ID on your registered mobile number. Q How many days does it take to update Aadhaar? Ans As per UIDAI guidelines, up to 90 of updates are processed within 30 days. However, in some cases, it can take up to 90 days. Q Status shows Completed but I didn t get the card by post. Ans Completed means the data is updated online. The physical letter delivery takes extra time. You can download the e-Aadhaar immediately. Check Deceased Aadhaar Deactivation Status Once you have formally reported the death of a family member to UIDAI for Aadhaar deactivation, it is important to verify if the request has been processed. The Check Deceased Aadhaar Deactivation Status service allows legal heirs or guardians to track the progress of their application. Deactivating the Aadhaar of a deceased person is a critical step to prevent identity fraud and ensure that government records are updated accurately. Requirement You will need the Service Request Number (SRN) that was generated when you submitted the Report Death request. How to Track Deactivation Request Access the Tool Click on the Check Deceased Aadhaar Deactivation Status card on the myAadhaar dashboard. Enter SRN Input the 28-digit Service Request Number provided during the reporting process. Captcha Enter the security code displayed on the screen. View Status The system will show whether the request is Pending Verification , Approved (Deactivated), or Rejected (due to document mismatch). One Login, Many Services Access all Aadhaar services with a single secure login. Use your SSO ID or try our new Face Authentication feature for instant access without a password. Secure 256-bit Encryption Biometric Face Auth Supported Access Document Update Status Manage Family Profiles SSO Portal Login SSO ID User ID Password Use your camera to scan your face or upload a photo for verification. Click to Scan Face Upload Photo Supports JPG PNG (Max 5MB) Forgot Password? Create New Account What is SSO ID? (Single Sign-On Login) SSO (Single Sign-On) ek aisa digital authentication system hai jo users ko sirf ek ID aur Password ke zariye kai saari sarkari aur private websites par login karne ki suvidha deta hai. Chahe wo Aadhaar Card Download ho, Ration Card ki jankari ho, ya Jan Aadhaar portal SSO Login se sab kuch ek jagah manage hota hai. Bharat mein digital services badhne ke saath, SSO ID Login ab har nagarik ke liye zaroori ho gaya hai. Is portal par aap apne Aadhaar number ya Face Auth ka upyog karke securely login kar sakte hain. New Update Ab aap bina password yaad rakhe, seedhe apne Chehre (Face Auth) ya Biometric se SSO Login kar sakte hain. SSO ID Registration Account Kaise Banayein? Agar aapke paas abhi tak SSO ID nahi hai, to aap niche diye gaye steps follow karke apna naya account register kar sakte hain Upar diye gaye SSO Login box mein Create New Account par click karein. Apna 12-digit Aadhaar Number enter karein. Aapke registered mobile par ek OTP aayega, use verify karein. Apna manpasand SSO User ID aur Password set karein. Registration complete hone par aap turant login kar sakte hain. Benefits of SSO Portal (SSO Ke Fayde) All-in-One Access Ek hi login se 100 services ka labh uthayein. Recover Forgotten Password Agar password bhool gaye, to Aadhaar OTP se reset karein. High Security Two-factor authentication (2FA) aur Identity verification. SSO Login FAQs Q Main apna SSO ID Password bhool gaya hun, kya karun? Ans Aap Forgot Password link par click karke apne registered mobile number ya Aadhaar OTP ke zariye apna password reset kar sakte hain. Q Kya SSO Login ke liye Aadhaar zaroori hai? Ans Haan, security verification ke liye Aadhaar card number ya Jan Aadhaar ID ka hona anivarya hai. Q SSO ID se main kaunsi services use kar sakta hun? Ans Aap Aadhaar PVC order, Address Update, Scholarship forms, Job applications, aur Electricity bill payment jaisi suvidhayein use kar sakte hain.

documents: Home Next Compromised Rahul Gandhi's favourite word for PM Modi hits Punjab Congress ranks Channi camp's Sukhjinder Singh Randhawa said party needs not a compromising leader , Raja Warring hit back with some loaded agreement. Updated on Jul 12, 2026, 16 50 56 IST By Aarish Chhabra Prefer HT on Google Share via Copy link For months now, compromised has been the Congress's word of choice for Prime Minister Narendra Modi. On Saturday, it turned up inside the party's own house, in a spat over who should lead the Congress in Punjab. Channi, Baghel, Randhawa and others at a meeting in Chandigarh where Raja Warring was not invited both Channi and Raja have in their own ways had Rahul Gandhi's backing in the past. (ANI, File Photos) After a meeting between Congress national unit's Punjab in-charge Bhupesh Baghel and leaders close to former CM Charanjit Singh Channi, senior party leader Sukhjinder Singh Randhawa from Channi's camp said the party needed a leader who speaks forcefully and not a compromising leader . Channi, 63, a leader from the Dalit community whom Rahul Gandhi reportedly chose as CM in the last big Congress rift before the 2022 polls when Capt Amarinder Singh was removed, was standing next to Randhawa, nodding along. The Congress and Channi, as CM face, lost that election to the AAP in a landslide, but Channi later became MP from Jalandhar in 2024. State unit president and Ludhiana MP Amarinder Singh Raja Warring the 48-year-old former national president of the Youth Congress, also seen as close to Rahul hit back within hours when asked about the jibe that comes barely six months ahead of the 2027 assembly polls. He said he agreed with Randhawa who happens to be from the dominant Jat Sikh community like Warring even though they are in opposite camps for now. Who is compromised? Has he taken any names? If not, why are you people pointing it at me?... We do not need any sleeper cell or compromised leader in our party, he told PTI, before adding that he and Randhawa would sort out their differences soon. He also jibed at leaders who he said had met people from the BJP, those from UP, and from AAP . Baghel did not distance himself from the word compromised . Yes, I agree that any leader who is compromised will not work. If any leader will be compromised by BJP, it will not work. It is my responsibility that I won't let it happen, the former CM of Chhattisgarh said in response to a question later. Neither Randhawa nor Warring invoked Modi or drew any national parallel in their remarks. But the word they reached for is not a neutral one in Congress's current vocabulary it is the same word the party's central leadership, Rahul Gandhi effectively at its helm and Mallikarjun Kharge the formal president, has spent months hammering PM Modi and his BJP-led NDA regime with. A word with a history Counting since May alone, it started with Rahul Gandhi's X posts calling Modi compromised and alleging a connection between the trade deal in the works with the US and PM Modi's alleged crony capitalist friends. By June, party materials were describing Modi outright as compromised and alleging the administration functions as a private marketing agency for oligarchs. Congress state-level communications were also running ads and social media trends around a compromised PM, selling India's interests . Modi has not responded, but the BJP has combated these allegations as anti-national remarks . Punjab rift The word arrived at a fraught moment for the Punjab Congress unit , though. The rift traces back to July 1 in the immediate, when the high command retained Warring as Punjab Congress president and named Channi chairperson of the campaign committee a decision that led to Channi skipping a week of meetings Baghel held with party leaders after arriving in Punjab on July 6. Baghel repeatedly ruled out any rethink through the week, telling reporters on July 9 that the leadership question was not gudda-guddi ka khel child's play and that high command decisions, once taken, do not change . Saturday's 80-minute sit-down with the Channi camp at Rana Gurjit Singh's Chandigarh residence attended by Channi, Randhawa, Bharat Bhushan Ashu, Tript Rajinder Singh Bajwa and Leader of Opposition Partap Singh Bajwa, but not Warring was billed by Baghel as an informal conversation rather than a negotiation. This is not a meeting... When you stay like family, there are many talks that happen, which is not disclosed publicly, he said. If any leader will be compromised by BJP, it will not work. It is my responsibility that I won't let it happen. Bhupesh Baghel at the HT Mohali office earlier this week for an interview. Seen along with him is Punjab Congress president Amarinder Singh Raja Warring. (Ravi Kumar HT) He also sought to shut down speculation that Channi was being lined up as the party's chief ministerial face for 2027. Partap Singh Bajwa, playing the calm patriarch at 69, called the meeting a culmination of long-standing worker sentiment and said Baghel had promised to carry every concern word for word to the high command. Punjab goes to the assembly polls in early 2027, and the party's central leadership has staked its position on Warring's continuity, citing the 2024 Lok Sabha result in which Congress won seven of the state's 13 seats under him. But Saturday's compromised exchange showed Baghel's all is well claim may not be a done deal as of now. ABOUT THE AUTHOR Aarish Chhabra Aarish Chhabra is an Associate Editor with the Hindustan Times online team, writing news reports and explanatory articles, besides overseeing coverage for the website. His career spans nearly two decades across India's most respected newsrooms in print, digital, and broadcast. He has reported, written, and edited across formats from breaking news and live election coverage, to analytical long-reads and cultural commentary building a body of work that reflects both editorial rigour and a deep curiosity about the society he writes for. Aarish studied English literature, sociology and history, besides journalism, at Panjab University, Chandigarh, and started his career in that city, eventually moving to Delhi. He is also the author of The Big Small Town How Life Looks from Chandigarh , a collection of critical essays originally serialised as a weekly column in the Hindustan Times, examining the culture and politics of a city that is far more than its famous architecture and, in doing so, holding up a mirror to modern India. In stints at the BBC, The Indian Express, NDTV, and Jagran New Media, he worked across formats and languages mainly English, also Hindi and Punjabi. He was part of the crack team for the BBC Explainer project replicated across the world by the broadcaster. At Jagran, he developed editorial guides and trained journalists on integrity and content quality. He has also worked at the intersection of journalism and education. At the Indian School of Business (ISB), Hyderabad, he developed a website that simplified academic research in management. At Bennett University's Times School of Media in Noida, he taught students the craft of digital journalism from newsgathering and writing, to social media strategy and video storytelling. Having moved from a small town to a bigger town to a mega city for education and work, his intellectual passions lie at the intersection of society, politics, and popular culture a perspective that informs both his writing and his view of the world. When not working, he is constantly reading long-form journalism or watching brainrot content, sometimes both at the same time. News India Abuses hurled at PM Modi during Congress rally in Bihar organised to welcome Rahul Gandhi Abuses hurled at PM Modi during Congress rally in Bihar organised to welcome Rahul Gandhi Reported By Nitish Chandra Edited By Ashish Verma Published Aug 28, 2025, 12 46 PM IST ,Updated Aug 28, 2025, 12 49 PM IST Rahul Gandhi s 'Voter Adhikar Yatra' in Bihar sparked controversy after a video from Darbhanga showed a Youth Congress leader using abusive language against Prime Minister Narendra Modi from the stage. The event was organised by Mohammad Naushad, a youth Congress leader. The event was organised by a Congress leader to mark Rahul Gandhi's 'Voter Adhikar Yatra' in Bihar's Darbhanga Image Source Reporter Darbhanga Controversy has erupted after derogatory remarks and abuses were hurled at Prime Minister Narendra Modi during a political rally organised by a Congress leader in Bihar's Darbhanga on Wednesday. The event was held as part of Congress MP Rahul Gandhi's ongoing 'Voter Adhikar Yatra' in the state. A video has surfaced from the Darbhanga rally showing Rahul Gandhi s supporters using abusive language against the Prime Minister. According to reports, the gathering was held in the Atarbel area of the district. From the stage, derogatory remarks and offensive language were directed at PM Modi. The event was organised by Mohammad Naushad, a youth Congress leader. BJP hits back, demands apology The Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) strongly condemned the incident, accusing Rahul Gandhi of allowing such behaviour from his platform. BJP leaders said the use of abusive language against the Prime Minister is unacceptable and intolerable. Rahul Gandhi ji, the kind of language and the vulgar abuses for the honourable Prime Minister Narendra Modi ji from your stage cannot be tolerated. You should apologise to the country. The people of Bihar will never forgive you for this. The entire country and the world respect Modi ji. A poor man s son, an OBC, has become Prime Minister, and you cannot digest it. You will burn with this frustration, BJP spokesperson Neeraj Kumar said. Congress leader apologises Following widespread outcry and condemnation, Nausha issued an apology, stating that he was not present at the event when the remarks were made against PM Modi. Naushad is a Youth Congress leader from Jale assembly constituency in Darbhanga and is considered a ticket aspirant for the upcoming elections. Recently, he was also accused of assaulting another ticket aspirant, Maskoor Usmani, leaving Usmani with a head injury. The sitting MLA from Jale is BJP s Jivesh Mishra, who serves as Urban Development Minister in Bihar. Yatra to conclude with roadshow in Patna Rahul Gandhi s Voter Rights Yatra, initially planned to conclude on September 1 with a rally at Gandhi Maidan, will now end with a roadshow in Patna due to the unavailability of the venue. The roadshow will start from the Gandhi statue at Gandhi Maidan and proceed to the Ambedkar statue near Patna High Court. Rahul Gandhi and RJD leader Tejashwi Yadav will walk together during the closing leg of the campaign. Currently on its 12th day, the Yatra is passing through Mithilanchal. Rahul began Thursday s events with prayers at the Janaki Temple in Sitamarhi, accompanied by Tejashwi Yadav. The visit was initially scheduled for the previous day but was delayed due to security concerns. The Yatra will continue to Motihari on Thursday. documents: Hà Nội Ra gần giếng làng để chơi, hai anh em ruột bị đuối nước tử vong Văn Yên (Dân trí) - Trong lúc ra khu vực giếng làng ở xã An Khánh (Hà Nội) để chơi, hai bé trai là anh em ruột không may bị rơi xuống nước tử vong. Chiều 31 7, trao đổi với phóng viên Dân trí , lãnh đạo UBND xã An Khánh (Hà Nội) cho biết, trên địa bàn vừa xảy ra sự việc 2 bé trai bị đuối nước thương tâm. Theo vị lãnh đạo, sự việc xảy ra vào khoảng 17h57 ngày 30 7, tại xã Đông La cũ, nay thuộc xã An Khánh. Vào thời điểm trên, hai bé trai là anh em ruột (một cháu 9 tuổi và một cháu 6 tuổi) ra sân chơi gần khu nhà trọ. Trong lúc vui chơi, cả 2 cháu không may rơi xuống giếng làng gần đó. Sau khi phát hiện sự việc, người dân cùng gia đình nhanh chóng đưa các cháu lên khỏi mặt nước và chuyển đến bệnh viện cấp cứu. Dù được các y bác sĩ nỗ lực cứu chữa, nhưng khoảng 2 giờ sau, cả hai cháu nhỏ đều không qua khỏi. "Đây là một vụ đuối nước rất thương tâm, gia đình các cháu mới chuyển đến đây thuê trọ. Sau khi xảy ra sự việc, chính quyền địa phương đã đến thăm hỏi, chia buồn và động viên gia đình nạn nhân", vị lãnh đạo UBND xã An Khánh cho biết.

FAQs Q Kaunsa tarika sabse fast hai cylinder book karne ka? A WhatsApp ya Missed Call sabse fast hai - 2 minute mein booking confirm. App bhi achha hai agar tracking chahiye. Q Registered mobile number change karna hai, kaise? A Nearest distributor ke paas jaao Aadhaar card ke saath. Woh number update kar denge. Online nahi hota ye. Q Cylinder price kab change hoti hai? A Har mahine ki 1 tareekh ko oil companies price revise karti hain. Increase ya decrease dono ho sakta hai. Q Subsidy kaise milti hai? A Agar eligible ho toh subsidy directly bank account mein aati hai (DBT - Direct Benefit Transfer). Aadhaar bank se link hona chahiye. Q Double cylinder connection le sakte hain? A Haan! Ek hi company se ya alag companies se 2 cylinders le sakte ho. Distributor se baat karo. Q Cylinder delivery mein kitna time lagta hai? A Normal mein 1-3 din . Festival season ya shortage mein 5-7 din bhi lag sakte hain. Booking ke baad tracking check karo. Q Commercial cylinder ghar pe use kar sakte hain? A Nahi! Commercial cylinder domestic use ke liye illegal hai. Pakde gaye toh fine lagega. Domestic cylinder hi use karo. Coronavirus health and science Surprising COVID-19 hot spots Why coronavirus still threatens rural areas It's common for viruses to trickle into rural areas after hitting cities first. By Dr. Vinayak Kumar April 4, 2020, 6 42 PM These past several weeks, national attention regarding the COVID-19 pandemic has been focused on known urban hotspots such as New York City, Chicago and Los Angeles. However, a troubling new trend is emerging outbreaks in rural communities. Dr. Marynia Kolak is the assistant director for Health Informatics at the Center for Spatial Data Science at the University of Chicago, which recently released a U.S. COVID-19 Atlas, providing county-level data on COVID-19 cases to help locate emerging hotspots for the disease. The results are surprising. Unfortunately, it's not just an increase in the number of cases. "We also see elevated adjusted death rates in places like Northern Mississippi, a lot of Louisiana, and smaller counties in Alabama and South Carolina," she said. Tune into ABC at 1 p.m. ET and ABC News Live at 4 p.m. ET every weekday for special coverage of the novel coronavirus with the full ABC News team, including the latest news, context and analysis. The focus has been on COVID-19 cases in Los Angeles and New York, but outbreaks in rural communities have become a concerning trend. Center for Spatial Data Science at the University of Chicago The rise of COVID-19 in rural communities might at first seem counterintuitive. With people spread far apart, sometimes with acres of land between houses, rural communities on the surface appear to be practicing social distancing by default. But Dr. John Brownstein, an epidemiologist at Boston Children's Hospital, said it's common for viruses to trickle into rural communities after hitting big cities first. "We see this kind of trend in the flu as well," he said. "It tends to start in urban areas where there is a lot of mixing, and then it moves out to suburban and rural communities. Additionally, in this case, when people are asked to quarantine or shelter-in-place, people tend to move out of cities to suburban and rural locations bunker down." On top of that, Kolak said some states have been slow to adopt formal social distancing policies, which may drive an uptick in infections among their rural populations. "We also see a sense of community in rural environments where family and friends come together, which is great at most times, but not ideal for this crisis," Kolak added. This helps explain how the disease spread to rural locations. But why are people in rural communities more likely to die of COVID-19 infection, as the data also seems to indicate? A man is brought into Elmhurst Hospital in the Queens neighborhood, which has one of the highest infection rates of coronavirus in the nation, on April 03, 2020, in New York. Spencer Platt Getty Images Experts say the elevated death rate can be attributed to the fact that people living in rural communities, on average, tend to have higher rates of chronic medical conditions and less access to medical resources. The Centers for Disease Control and Prevention notes that rural Americans "tend to have higher rates of cigarette smoking, high blood pressure, and obesity. They also have higher rates of poverty, less access to health care, and are less likely to have health insurance." "These are vulnerable populations with poor access to insurance who may have to travel far to get to a hospital," Kolak said. "It's a bit of a perfect storm with worse access to health care, less health insurance overall, and slow policies to take COVID-19 seriously." Guide Overview Category Government Services Portal Bihar Bhumi Estimated Time 5 min Fee Free Complete Guide Bhaiyon, apni zameen ka khatiyan (Record of Rights purana land record) online nikalna hai? Bihar me ye bilkul free aur ghar baithe ho jaata hai - biharbhumi.bihar.gov.in pe "Apna Khata Dekhein" service se. Pehle ek confusion clear khatiyan purana survey-record jo ownership possession dikhata hai (frozen) jamabandi abhi ka updated record (har dakhil-kharij ke baad badalta hai) rasid lagan tax receipt. Download Your e-Aadhaar Instantly Get your digitally signed, password-protected Aadhaar PDF on your phone or computer in just 2 minutes. Secure and valid everywhere. Download Now Complete Guide to e-Aadhaar Download Process Aaj ke digital yug mein, Aadhaar Card har Bhartiya nagarik ke liye sabse zaroori pehchaan patra (Identity Proof) ban gaya hai. Chahe bank account khulwana ho, SIM card lena ho, ya kisi sarkari yojana ka labh uthana ho Aadhaar har jagah anivarya hai. Lekin kya aap jante hain ki aapko hamesha physical card sath rakhne ki zarurat nahi hai? Aap e-Aadhaar ka istemal kar sakte hain. What is e-Aadhaar? (e-Aadhaar Kya Hai?) Ye aapke physical Aadhaar card ki ek password-protected electronic copy hai, jise UIDAI ke competent authority dwara digitally sign kiya jata hai. Aadhaar Act ke mutabiq, e-Aadhaar physical copy ke barabar hi valid mana jata hai. Aadhaar Card Download Kaise Karein? (Online Process) Agar aapka Aadhaar card kho gaya hai ya aapke paas physical copy nahi hai, to ghabrayein nahi. Aap niche diye gaye aasaan steps ko follow karke 2 minute mein apna e-Aadhaar PDF download kar sakte hain. Official Website Upar diye gaye orange color ke Download Now button par click karein. Enter Details Yahan aapke paas 3 option honge Aadhaar Number, Enrolment ID (EID), ya Virtual ID (VID). Apna 12-digit Aadhaar number dalein. Captcha Verification Screen par dikh raha security code (Captcha) dhyan se bharein. OTP Verification Send OTP button dabayein. Aapke registered mobile number par ek 6-digit ka OTP aayega. Verify Download OTP enter karein aur Verify Download par click karein. Aapka e-Aadhaar PDF format mein download ho jayega. e-Aadhaar PDF Password Kya Hota Hai? Bahut se log Aadhaar download to kar lete hain lekin PDF khul nahi pati kyunki wo password-protected hoti hai. Iska password bahut simple hota hai. Password Formula First 4 Letters of Name (in CAPITAL) Year of Birth (YYYY) Example 1 Naam SURESH KUMAR Janam Saal 1990 Password SURE1990 Example 2 Naam RIA (Sirf 3 akshar hain) Janam Saal 2002 Password RIA2002 Difference e-Aadhaar vs Aadhaar PVC Card Feature e-Aadhaar (Digital) Aadhaar PVC Card Format PDF File (Phone PC mein) Hard Plastic Card Cost Bilkul Free 50 (Speed Post) Delivery Instant Download 5-15 Days (Home Delivery) Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs) Q Kya main bina registered mobile number ke Aadhaar download kar sakta hun? Ans Nahi, online download karne ke liye mobile number link hona zaroori hai kyunki OTP ussi par aata hai. Agar link nahi hai, to aapko nazdiki Aadhaar center jana hoga. Q Aadhaar PVC Card kitne din mein aata hai? Ans Order karne ke baad aamtaur par 5 se 15 working days ke andar India Post dwara aapke ghar pahunch jata hai. Lost Your Aadhaar? Retrieve it Instantly! Forgot your Aadhaar Number (UID) or Enrolment ID (EID)? Use your registered mobile number to get it back via SMS in seconds. Retrieve UID EID How to Retrieve Lost Aadhaar Number (UID) or Enrolment ID (EID) Have you lost your physical Aadhaar card and cannot remember your 12-digit Aadhaar number? Or perhaps you have applied for a new Aadhaar card but lost the acknowledgement slip containing the Enrolment ID (EID)? Do not worry. The Retrieve Aadhaar number EID SID service allows you to recover these details online instantly. This feature is a lifesaver for those who have misplaced their documents and need to download their e-Aadhaar urgent. By using this facility, your lost Aadhaar number or EID is sent directly to your registered mobile number. Important Prerequisite To use this online facility, your Mobile Number or Email ID MUST be registered and linked with your Aadhaar. If your mobile number is not linked, you cannot receive the OTP required for retrieval. Difference Between UID and EID Term Full Form Description UID Unique ID This is your final 12-digit Aadhaar Number . Select this if you already had a card. EID Enrolment ID This is the 28-digit number from your acknowledgement slip (for new applications). Step-by-Step Process to Retrieve Lost Aadhaar (UID) Visit the Official Portal Click on the Retrieve UID EID button above to open the official page. Select Retrieval Option Choose Aadhaar Number to find your main ID or Enrolment ID if you are tracking a new application. Enter Personal Details Enter your Full Name exactly as it is printed on your Aadhaar card. Enter Contact Info Captcha Enter your Registered Mobile Number or Email ID, fill the Captcha, and click Send OTP . Get SMS After OTP verification, your Aadhaar Number (UID) or EID will be sent to your mobile via SMS. Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs) Q Can I retrieve my Aadhaar if I don t have my mobile number? Ans No, the online facility works strictly via OTP. If your mobile is not linked, you must visit an Aadhaar Enrollment Center with your identity proof. Q Is there any fee for this service? Ans No, the Retrieve Aadhaar EID service is completely free of cost on the myAadhaar portal. Verify Mobile Email Not sure which mobile number is linked to your Aadhaar? Verify it instantly to ensure you receive OTPs for all government services. Verify Now How to Verify Mobile Number Email Linked with Aadhaar In today s digital India, your Registered Mobile Number is the key to accessing almost all Aadhaar services. Whether you want to download your e-Aadhaar, update your address online, or verify your ITR, the OTP (One Time Password) is sent to this linked number. However, people often change their SIM cards or forget which mobile number they gave at the time of enrollment years ago. The Verify Email Mobile service on the myAadhaar portal solves this confusion. It allows you to check if the mobile number or email ID you currently possess is the one linked to your Aadhaar database. ℹ Important Clarification This service does NOT show you the mobile number linked to your Aadhaar (for privacy reasons). Instead, YOU have to enter a mobile number, and the system will tell you if it matches the records or not. It is a verification tool, not a search tool. Step-by-Step Process to Verify Mobile Number Follow this simple procedure to confirm your linked contact details Access the Service Click on the green Verify Now button above. Select Verification Type You will see two options Verify Mobile Number and Verify Email Address . Select the one you want to check. Enter Details First, enter your 12-digit Aadhaar Number . Then, enter the Mobile Number (or Email) that you think is linked. Security Check Enter the Captcha code exactly as shown in the image box. Send OTP Click on the Send OTP button. Check the Result The system will display a success or error message based on your input (explained below). Understanding the Result Messages After submitting, you will see one of these two messages. Here is what they mean Scenario 1 Match Found (Success) The mobile number you have entered is already verified with our records. Meaning Congratulations! The mobile number you typed IS the one linked to your Aadhaar. You can receive OTPs on this number. Scenario 2 No Match (Failure) The mobile number you have entered does not match with our records. Meaning The number you typed is NOT linked. Either you linked a different family member s number, or an old number that you have lost. Why is this Verification Important? 1. Fraud Prevention Ensuring that no unknown mobile number or email is linked to your ID protects your biometric and demographic data. 2. Banking Services To link Aadhaar with a bank account or PAN card, the OTP validation is mandatory. Verifying ensures you are using the correct SIM. 3. Updates You cannot update your address or download Aadhaar online if you don t know which number receives the OTP. Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs) Q The system says Record not found . What should I do? Ans This means the mobile number you are entering is incorrect. Try entering mobile numbers of your family members. If none match, you must visit an Aadhaar Seva Kendra to check or update your number. Q Can I update my mobile number using this service? Ans No. This service is only for verification . To update or change your mobile number, biometric authentication is required, which can only be done offline at a center. Report Death Deactivate Aadhaar Secure the identity of your deceased family member. Officially report the death to UIDAI to prevent misuse of documents. Report Now How to Report Death of a Family Member for Aadhaar Deactivation The Aadhaar card is a unique identity proof that remains valid for a lifetime. However, in the unfortunate event of a family member s demise, it is the responsibility of the legal heir or guardian to inform the Unique Identification Authority of India (UIDAI). The Report death of a family member service allows you to officially flag an Aadhaar number for deactivation. This is a crucial step to ensure that the deceased person s identity documents are not misused for financial fraud, illegal SIM card issuance, or identity theft. Why is Deactivating Aadhaar Important? Many people often overlook this step, but keeping a deceased person s Aadhaar active can lead to several complications Prevent Misuse Scammers often look for dormant identities to open fake bank accounts or take loans. Subsidies Benefits To prevent the continued transfer of government benefits (like pensions) to a deceased person, which can later lead to legal recovery issues. Closure of Records It helps in closing other linked official documents like PAN Card and Voter ID systematically. Important Requirement To use this service, you MUST have a valid Death Certificate issued by the Registrar of Births and Deaths. The details on the Death Certificate must match the Aadhaar details of the deceased. Procedure to Report Death Online UIDAI has simplified the process by allowing family members to initiate this request via the myAadhaar portal. Follow these steps Login to Portal The reporting family member (Applicant) must login to the myAadhaar portal using their Own Aadhaar Number and OTP. You cannot login using the deceased person s Aadhaar. Select the Service On the dashboard, locate and click on the Report death of a family member card. Enter Details of Deceased Enter the 12-digit Aadhaar Number of the deceased family member. You may also need to provide their Name and Date of Birth as per records. Upload Document Upload a clear scanned copy (PDF JPG) of the Death Certificate . Ensure the file size is within the permissible limit (usually 2MB). Review Submit Verify all the details entered. Once submitted, you will receive a Service Request Number (SRN) to track the status. What Happens Next? (Verification) Reporting the death online does not instantly deactivate the Aadhaar. The request goes through a verification process 1. Registrar Verification The details are cross-verified with the birth and death registration records. 2. Deactivation Once verified, the UIDAI will permanently deactivate the Aadhaar number of the deceased. 3. Confirmation You can check the status using the Check deceased Aadhaar deactivation status service on the same portal. Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs) Q Can anyone report the death? Ans Usually, only immediate family members (spouse, children, parents) whose mobile numbers are linked or who can prove the relationship can initiate this request. Q Is it mandatory to deactivate Aadhaar after death? Ans While there is no strict penalty currently, it is highly recommended for safety and to close the financial and legal footprint of the deceased. Q Can I reactivate the Aadhaar later if reported by mistake? Ans No. Once an Aadhaar is marked as Deceased and deactivated after proper verification, it cannot be reactivated. Update Now Document Update Upload PoI and PoA Online Has it been more than 10 years since you got your Aadhaar card made? Have you updated your documents recently? If not, the Unique Identification Authority of India (UIDAI) strongly recommends that you update your Proof of Identity (PoI) and Proof of Address (PoA) documents. Keeping your documents updated ensures that your demographic information (Name, Address, DOB) in the Aadhaar database is accurate and up-to-date. This helps in seamless verification for banking, passport services, and government subsidies. Special Offer Free Service! This online document update service is FREE OF COST till 14 06 2026 . Electricity Bill ( 3 months) Water Bill ( 3 months) Gas Connection Bill Bank Passbook Statement Passport (Address page) Voter ID Step-by-Step Process to Update Documents Online Take advantage of the free window and update your documents from home using these steps Login to myAadhaar Click the Update Now button above and login using your Aadhaar Number OTP. Select Document Update Click on the Document Update card. Review your current details (Name, Address, DOB). Upload Files Scan your PoI and PoA documents. Online vs Offline Update Comparison Feature Online (myAadhaar Portal) Offline (Aadhaar Center) Cost FREE (till 14 06 2026) 50 (Service Charge) Convenience From Home (24 7) Visit Wait in Queue Documents Self Scan Upload Originals Verified by Operator Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs) Q My address has changed. Can I use this service? Ans No. This service is ONLY to upload documents for existing details. To change your address, use the Address Update service. Q What happens if I don t update? Ans Your Aadhaar might get suspended or face difficulties in KYC authentication for banks or ration services. Generate Virtual ID (VID) Protect your privacy! Create a temporary 16-digit Virtual ID to use instead of your Aadhaar Number for authentication. Generate VID VID Generator Create Virtual ID to Hide Aadhaar Number Are you worried about sharing your 12-digit Aadhaar number everywhere? Do you want to protect your privacy while performing e-KYC? The Virtual ID (VID) is the solution. The VID Generator service allows you to create a temporary, revocable 16-digit random number mapped to your Aadhaar number. It can be used in lieu of your Aadhaar number for authentication services. This ensures your actual Aadhaar number remains hidden from the service provider. Privacy Feature When you use a VID, the agency (like a telecom operator or bank) cannot store your Aadhaar number. They only get a UID Token , which makes your data much more secure against leaks. Difference Aadhaar Number vs Virtual ID (VID) Feature Aadhaar Number (UID) Virtual ID (VID) Length 12 Digits (Permanent) 16 Digits (Temporary) Validity Lifetime valid Valid until you generate a new one Security Directly linked to biometric data Masks the actual Aadhaar number How to Generate or Retrieve VID Online You can generate a new VID or retrieve an existing one using the myAadhaar portal. Follow these steps Login to Portal Visit the myAadhaar dashboard by clicking the Generate VID button above. Select VID Generator Click on the VID Generator icon from the services menu. Choose Option You will see two options 1. Generate New VID If you want to create a fresh 16-digit number. 2. Retrieve Existing VID If you already generated one but forgot it. Confirm Receive Select your choice. Your 16-digit Virtual ID will be sent immediately to your Registered Mobile Number via SMS. Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs) Q Is VID accepted everywhere? Ans Yes, as per government regulations, all agencies (Banks, Telecom, Govt) must accept VID for authentication. Q What happens if I generate a new VID? Ans The moment you generate a new VID, your old VID gets automatically cancelled. You can only have one active VID at a time. Q Does VID expire? Ans No, a VID does not expire by itself. It remains valid until you choose to generate a new one. Lock Unlock Aadhaar Worried about identity theft? Temporarily Lock your Biometrics or Aadhaar Number instantly for maximum security. Secure Now Lock Unlock Aadhaar Secure Your Biometrics Instantly Security is a major concern for Aadhaar holders. What if someone gets hold of your Aadhaar number and tries to misuse it? To prevent unauthorized authentication, UIDAI provides a powerful feature Lock Unlock Aadhaar . This service allows you to temporarily Lock your UID (Aadhaar Number). Once locked, no one (not even you) can perform authentication using the Aadhaar number. It acts as a digital shield against identity theft. You can Unlock it whenever you need to use it. MUST READ BEFORE LOCKING Do not lock your Aadhaar without generating a Virtual ID (VID). Once your Aadhaar is locked, you CANNOT use your Aadhaar number to unlock it (because the number itself is locked). You will compulsorily need a 16-digit Virtual ID (VID) to perform the Unlock process. Difference Aadhaar Lock vs Biometric Lock Many people confuse these two services. Here is the difference Feature UID Lock (Aadhaar Lock) Biometric Lock What it blocks? Blocks ALL authentication (Demographic, Biometric, OTP). Blocks ONLY Fingerprint and Iris scan. OTP still works. How to use when locked? You must use Virtual ID (VID) . You must temporarily Unlock biometrics to use fingerprint iris. Security Level Highest (Total Lock) Medium (Protects Biometrics only) Step-by-Step Guide to LOCK Aadhaar Generate VID First As mentioned, ensure you have a valid VID. If not, use the VID Generator service first. Open Lock Service Click the Secure Now button above and select the Lock UID option. Enter Details Enter your 12-digit Aadhaar Number, Full Name, and Pin Code. Verify OTP Enter the security captcha and click Send OTP . Enter the OTP received on your mobile. Confirmation Your Aadhaar Number is now LOCKED. You will not be able to perform authentication using the UID anymore. Step-by-Step Guide to UNLOCK Aadhaar Select Unlock UID Go to the same service page and select the Unlock UID tab. Enter VID (Not Aadhaar Number) Here, you CANNOT enter your Aadhaar number. You must enter your 16-digit Virtual ID (VID) . Verify Unlock Enter the Captcha and OTP. Once verified, your Aadhaar number will be active again. Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs) Q Can I download e-Aadhaar if my UID is locked? Ans Yes, but you will have to use your Virtual ID (VID) to download it, as the Aadhaar number will not be accepted by the system. Q I forgot my VID and my Aadhaar is locked. What do I do? Ans You can use the Retrieve VID service via SMS. Send an SMS RVID Last 4 digits of Aadhaar to 1947 from your registered mobile number. Bank Seeding Status Are you receiving government subsidies? Check if your Aadhaar is successfully linked and mapped with your bank account for Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT). Check Status Bank Seeding Status Check Aadhaar-Bank Linking for DBT Many government schemes in India transfer money directly to beneficiaries bank accounts using the Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) system. This money is sent using the Aadhaar Payment Bridge (APB). For this to work, simply having a bank account is not enough. Your Aadhaar number must be seeded or mapped with that specific bank account in the NPCI (National Payments Corporation of India) database. The Bank Seeding Status service helps you check which of your bank accounts is currently linked to receive government funds. Why is Bank Seeding Essential? If your Bank Seeding Status is Inactive , you will NOT receive funds for PM Kisan Samman Nidhi LPG Gas Subsidy (PAHAL) Scholarships Pension Schemes (Old Age Widow) MNREGA Wages How to Check Bank Linking Status Online You can verify your current NPCI mapping status instantly through the myAadhaar portal. Follow these steps Login to Portal Click the Check Status button above and login using your Aadhaar Number OTP. Select Bank Seeding Status Locate and click on the Bank Seeding Status icon on the dashboard. View Result The system will display the Bank Name, Seeding Status (Active Inactive), and the Date of Linking. Understanding Your Status Result Status ACTIVE Your Aadhaar is successfully mapped. You are eligible to receive DBT funds in the mentioned bank account. Status INACTIVE Your mapping has been disabled or expired. You will NOT receive subsidies until you re-link it. My Status is Inactive Not Linked. How to Link? Note You CANNOT link your bank account to Aadhaar online via the UIDAI website. This must be done through your bank. Method 1 Visit Bank Branch (Recommended) Go to your bank branch, fill out the Aadhaar Seeding Form (DBT Mandate form), and attach a copy of your e-Aadhaar. Ask the official to Enable DBT specifically. Method 2 Net Banking Mobile App Some banks (like SBI, HDFC, ICICI, PNB) offer an option in their Net Banking App under Service Request Link Aadhaar Enable DBT . Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs) Q I have accounts in 3 banks. Which one will receive the money? Ans Government benefits are sent to the Last Seeded Bank Account . If you recently linked a new bank account, the money will start coming to that new account automatically. Q My bank says Aadhaar is linked (KYC done), but status shows Inactive. Why? Ans Linking for KYC and Linking for DBT are different. You must specifically ask the bank to Map Aadhaar to NPCI for DBT . Q How long does it take to update the status? Ans Once the bank processes your request, it usually takes 2-3 working days for the status to reflect on the myAadhaar portal. Track Your PVC Card Ordered your Aadhaar PVC Card? Track its printing and delivery status in real-time. Know exactly when it will reach your doorstep. Track Order Check Aadhaar PVC Card Order Status Track Delivery Have you recently ordered the new, durable Aadhaar PVC Card online by paying 50? If yes, you might be wondering when it will reach your home. The Check Aadhaar PVC card order status service allows you to track the progress of your printing request and its dispatch status. The entire process, from ordering to delivery, typically takes 5 to 15 working days . This tool helps you know exactly where your card is whether it is still printing or has been handed over to the post office. You Need Your SRN (Service Request Number) To check the status, you must have the 28-digit SRN . This number was generated when you successfully placed the order and paid the fees. It is available on the acknowledgement slip you downloaded. How to Check PVC Order Status Online Follow these simple steps to track your application Open the Tool Click on the Track Order button above. Enter SRN Enter the 28-digit Service Request Number (SRN) carefully. Security Check Type the Captcha code shown on the screen. Submit Click on Submit . The system will verify your request and display the current status. Understanding the Status Meanings Payment Successful Your order has been received by UIDAI. In Process Your data has been sent for printing. Dispatched Your card has been printed and handed over to India Post. (This is the most important status). How to Track via India Post (Speed Post) Once the status shows Dispatched , the portal will display an Airway Bill Number (AWB) . This is your tracking ID. Copy the Airway Bill Number (AWB). Visit the India Post Tracking website (indiapost.gov.in). Enter the AWB number in the Consignment Number field. You will see the exact location of your card and the expected delivery date. Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs) Q I lost my SRN. How can I check the status? Ans If you lost the SRN, check your SMS history for messages from UIDAI. Or check the Payment History section if you were logged in. Q The status says Dispatched but I haven t received it yet. Ans Delivery speed depends on India Post services. Use the Airway Bill Number to track it on the India Post website for real-time updates. Check Aadhaar Status Applied for a new Aadhaar or updated details? Track your application status in real-time using your Enrolment ID (EID) or URN. Check Status Check Aadhaar Enrolment Update Status Online Have you recently applied for a new Aadhaar card? Or have you updated your Name, Address, or Date of Birth at an Aadhaar Center? If yes, you don t need to visit the center again to know if your request is processed. The Check Enrolment Update Status service allows you to track your application in real-time. Whether you did the update online (via myAadhaar portal) or offline (at a Seva Kendra), you can track it here. Which Number Do You Need for Tracking? Depending on how you applied, you will have one of the following numbers 1. Enrolment ID (EID) Found on the top of the Acknowledgement Slip given at the Aadhaar Center. It contains 14-digit Enrolment No. 14-digit Date Time. 2. Service Request Number (SRN) Generated when you initiate an Online Update (like Address or Document Update) on the myAadhaar portal. It starts with S . 3. Update Request Number (URN) Generated via SMS if you updated details using the Self Service Update Portal (SSUP) in the past. How to Enter EID Correctly (Very Important) Most users fail to check status because they enter the EID incorrectly. The 28-digit EID is a combination of the Enrolment Number and Timestamp. Format Enrolment Number Year Month Day Time Example If slip says Date 15 08 2024, Time 14 30 55, Enrolment 1234 56789 01234 Enter like this 12345678901234 20240815 143055 (Notice the Date is reversed YYYY-MM-DD). Step-by-Step Tracking Process Follow these steps to know your current status Open the Tool Click on the Check Status button above. Enter ID Type your EID (28 digits), SRN, or URN in the box provided. Ensure there are no spaces or slashes. Security Check Enter the Captcha code exactly as shown. Submit Click Submit . The status will appear on the screen. What Does Your Status Mean? In Process Your application is still being verified by the backend team. This usually takes 5-30 days. Completed Congratulations! Your update is successful. You can now Download Aadhaar to see the changes. Rejected Your request was declined. This usually happens due to wrong documents or data mismatch. You will have to apply again. Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs) Q I lost my Acknowledgement Slip. How can I get my EID? Ans You can use the Retrieve EID UID service to get your Enrolment ID on your registered mobile number. Q How many days does it take to update Aadhaar? Ans As per UIDAI guidelines, up to 90 of updates are processed within 30 days. However, in some cases, it can take up to 90 days. Q Status shows Completed but I didn t get the card by post. Ans Completed means the data is updated online. The physical letter delivery takes extra time. You can download the e-Aadhaar immediately. Check Deceased Aadhaar Deactivation Status Once you have formally reported the death of a family member to UIDAI for Aadhaar deactivation, it is important to verify if the request has been processed. The Check Deceased Aadhaar Deactivation Status service allows legal heirs or guardians to track the progress of their application. Deactivating the Aadhaar of a deceased person is a critical step to prevent identity fraud and ensure that government records are updated accurately. Requirement You will need the Service Request Number (SRN) that was generated when you submitted the Report Death request. How to Track Deactivation Request Access the Tool Click on the Check Deceased Aadhaar Deactivation Status card on the myAadhaar dashboard. Enter SRN Input the 28-digit Service Request Number provided during the reporting process. Captcha Enter the security code displayed on the screen. View Status The system will show whether the request is Pending Verification , Approved (Deactivated), or Rejected (due to document mismatch). One Login, Many Services Access all Aadhaar services with a single secure login. Use your SSO ID or try our new Face Authentication feature for instant access without a password. Secure 256-bit Encryption Biometric Face Auth Supported Access Document Update Status Manage Family Profiles SSO Portal Login SSO ID User ID Password Use your camera to scan your face or upload a photo for verification. Click to Scan Face Upload Photo Supports JPG PNG (Max 5MB) Forgot Password? Create New Account What is SSO ID? (Single Sign-On Login) SSO (Single Sign-On) ek aisa digital authentication system hai jo users ko sirf ek ID aur Password ke zariye kai saari sarkari aur private websites par login karne ki suvidha deta hai. Chahe wo Aadhaar Card Download ho, Ration Card ki jankari ho, ya Jan Aadhaar portal SSO Login se sab kuch ek jagah manage hota hai. Bharat mein digital services badhne ke saath, SSO ID Login ab har nagarik ke liye zaroori ho gaya hai. Is portal par aap apne Aadhaar number ya Face Auth ka upyog karke securely login kar sakte hain. New Update Ab aap bina password yaad rakhe, seedhe apne Chehre (Face Auth) ya Biometric se SSO Login kar sakte hain. SSO ID Registration Account Kaise Banayein? Agar aapke paas abhi tak SSO ID nahi hai, to aap niche diye gaye steps follow karke apna naya account register kar sakte hain Upar diye gaye SSO Login box mein Create New Account par click karein. Apna 12-digit Aadhaar Number enter karein. Aapke registered mobile par ek OTP aayega, use verify karein. Apna manpasand SSO User ID aur Password set karein. Registration complete hone par aap turant login kar sakte hain. Benefits of SSO Portal (SSO Ke Fayde) All-in-One Access Ek hi login se 100 services ka labh uthayein. Recover Forgotten Password Agar password bhool gaye, to Aadhaar OTP se reset karein. High Security Two-factor authentication (2FA) aur Identity verification. Ans Aap Forgot Password link par click karke apne registered mobile number ya Aadhaar OTP ke zariye apna password reset kar sakte hain. Q Kya SSO Login ke liye Aadhaar zaroori hai? Ans Haan, security verification ke liye Aadhaar card number ya Jan Aadhaar ID ka hona anivarya hai. Q SSO ID se main kaunsi services use kar sakta hun? Ans Aap Aadhaar PVC order, Address Update, Scholarship forms, Job applications, aur Electricity bill payment jaisi suvidhayein use kar sakte hain.
