Download Now Complete Guide to e-Aadhaar Download Process Aaj ke digital yug mein, Aadhaar Card har Bhartiya nagarik ke liye sabse zaroori pehchaan patra (Identity Proof) ban gaya hai. Chahe bank account khulwana ho, SIM card lena ho, ya kisi sarkari yojana ka labh uthana ho Aadhaar har jagah anivarya hai. Lekin kya aap jante hain ki aapko hamesha physical card sath rakhne ki zarurat nahi hai? Aap e-Aadhaar ka istemal kar sakte hain. What is e-Aadhaar? (e-Aadhaar Kya Hai?) Ye aapke physical Aadhaar card ki ek password-protected electronic copy hai, jise UIDAI ke competent authority dwara digitally sign kiya jata hai. Aadhaar Act ke mutabiq, e-Aadhaar physical copy ke barabar hi valid mana jata hai. Aadhaar Card Download Kaise Karein? (Online Process) Agar aapka Aadhaar card kho gaya hai ya aapke paas physical copy nahi hai, to ghabrayein nahi. Aap niche diye gaye aasaan steps ko follow karke 2 minute mein apna e-Aadhaar PDF download kar sakte hain. Official Website Upar diye gaye orange color ke Download Now button par click karein. Enter Details Yahan aapke paas 3 option honge Aadhaar Number, Enrolment ID (EID), ya Virtual ID (VID). Apna 12-digit Aadhaar number dalein. Captcha Verification Screen par dikh raha security code (Captcha) dhyan se bharein. OTP Verification Send OTP button dabayein. Aapke registered mobile number par ek 6-digit ka OTP aayega. Verify Download OTP enter karein aur Verify Download par click karein. Aapka e-Aadhaar PDF format mein download ho jayega. e-Aadhaar PDF Password Kya Hota Hai? Bahut se log Aadhaar download to kar lete hain lekin PDF khul nahi pati kyunki wo password-protected hoti hai. Iska password bahut simple hota hai. Password Formula First 4 Letters of Name (in CAPITAL) Year of Birth (YYYY) Example 1 Naam SURESH KUMAR Janam Saal 1990 Password SURE1990 Example 2 Naam RIA (Sirf 3 akshar hain) Janam Saal 2002 Password RIA2002 Difference e-Aadhaar vs Aadhaar PVC Card Feature e-Aadhaar (Digital) Aadhaar PVC Card Format PDF File (Phone PC mein) Hard Plastic Card Cost Bilkul Free 50 (Speed Post) Delivery Instant Download 5-15 Days (Home Delivery) Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs) Q Kya main bina registered mobile number ke Aadhaar download kar sakta hun? Ans Nahi, online download karne ke liye mobile number link hona zaroori hai kyunki OTP ussi par aata hai. Agar link nahi hai, to aapko nazdiki Aadhaar center jana hoga. Q Aadhaar PVC Card kitne din mein aata hai? Ans Order karne ke baad aamtaur par 5 se 15 working days ke andar India Post dwara aapke ghar pahunch jata hai. Lost Your Aadhaar? Retrieve it Instantly! Forgot your Aadhaar Number (UID) or Enrolment ID (EID)? Use your registered mobile number to get it back via SMS in seconds. Retrieve UID EID How to Retrieve Lost Aadhaar Number (UID) or Enrolment ID (EID) Have you lost your physical Aadhaar card and cannot remember your 12-digit Aadhaar number? Or perhaps you have applied for a new Aadhaar card but lost the acknowledgement slip containing the Enrolment ID (EID)? Do not worry. The Retrieve Aadhaar number EID SID service allows you to recover these details online instantly. This feature is a lifesaver for those who have misplaced their documents and need to download their e-Aadhaar urgent. By using this facility, your lost Aadhaar number or EID is sent directly to your registered mobile number. Important Prerequisite To use this online facility, your Mobile Number or Email ID MUST be registered and linked with your Aadhaar. If your mobile number is not linked, you cannot receive the OTP required for retrieval. Difference Between UID and EID Term Full Form Description UID Unique ID This is your final 12-digit Aadhaar Number . Select this if you already had a card. EID Enrolment ID This is the 28-digit number from your acknowledgement slip (for new applications). Step-by-Step Process to Retrieve Lost Aadhaar (UID) Visit the Official Portal Click on the Retrieve UID EID button above to open the official page. Select Retrieval Option Choose Aadhaar Number to find your main ID or Enrolment ID if you are tracking a new application. Enter Personal Details Enter your Full Name exactly as it is printed on your Aadhaar card. Enter Contact Info Captcha Enter your Registered Mobile Number or Email ID, fill the Captcha, and click Send OTP . Get SMS After OTP verification, your Aadhaar Number (UID) or EID will be sent to your mobile via SMS. Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs) Q Can I retrieve my Aadhaar if I don t have my mobile number? Ans No, the online facility works strictly via OTP. If your mobile is not linked, you must visit an Aadhaar Enrollment Center with your identity proof. Q Is there any fee for this service? Ans No, the Retrieve Aadhaar EID service is completely free of cost on the myAadhaar portal. Verify Mobile Email Not sure which mobile number is linked to your Aadhaar? Verify it instantly to ensure you receive OTPs for all government services. Verify Now How to Verify Mobile Number Email Linked with Aadhaar In today s digital India, your Registered Mobile Number is the key to accessing almost all Aadhaar services. Whether you want to download your e-Aadhaar, update your address online, or verify your ITR, the OTP (One Time Password) is sent to this linked number. However, people often change their SIM cards or forget which mobile number they gave at the time of enrollment years ago. The Verify Email Mobile service on the myAadhaar portal solves this confusion. It allows you to check if the mobile number or email ID you currently possess is the one linked to your Aadhaar database. ℹ Important Clarification This service does NOT show you the mobile number linked to your Aadhaar (for privacy reasons). Instead, YOU have to enter a mobile number, and the system will tell you if it matches the records or not. It is a verification tool, not a search tool. Step-by-Step Process to Verify Mobile Number Follow this simple procedure to confirm your linked contact details Access the Service Click on the green Verify Now button above. Select Verification Type You will see two options Verify Mobile Number and Verify Email Address . Select the one you want to check. Enter Details First, enter your 12-digit Aadhaar Number . Then, enter the Mobile Number (or Email) that you think is linked. Security Check Enter the Captcha code exactly as shown in the image box. Send OTP Click on the Send OTP button. Check the Result The system will display a success or error message based on your input (explained below). Understanding the Result Messages After submitting, you will see one of these two messages. Here is what they mean Scenario 1 Match Found (Success) The mobile number you have entered is already verified with our records. Meaning Congratulations! The mobile number you typed IS the one linked to your Aadhaar. You can receive OTPs on this number. Scenario 2 No Match (Failure) The mobile number you have entered does not match with our records. Meaning The number you typed is NOT linked. Either you linked a different family member s number, or an old number that you have lost. Why is this Verification Important? 1. Fraud Prevention Ensuring that no unknown mobile number or email is linked to your ID protects your biometric and demographic data. 2. Banking Services To link Aadhaar with a bank account or PAN card, the OTP validation is mandatory. Verifying ensures you are using the correct SIM. 3. Updates You cannot update your address or download Aadhaar online if you don t know which number receives the OTP. Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs) Q The system says Record not found . What should I do? Ans This means the mobile number you are entering is incorrect. Try entering mobile numbers of your family members. If none match, you must visit an Aadhaar Seva Kendra to check or update your number. Q Can I update my mobile number using this service? Ans No. This service is only for verification . To update or change your mobile number, biometric authentication is required, which can only be done offline at a center. Report Death Deactivate Aadhaar Secure the identity of your deceased family member. Officially report the death to UIDAI to prevent misuse of documents. Report Now How to Report Death of a Family Member for Aadhaar Deactivation The Aadhaar card is a unique identity proof that remains valid for a lifetime. However, in the unfortunate event of a family member s demise, it is the responsibility of the legal heir or guardian to inform the Unique Identification Authority of India (UIDAI). The Report death of a family member service allows you to officially flag an Aadhaar number for deactivation. This is a crucial step to ensure that the deceased person s identity documents are not misused for financial fraud, illegal SIM card issuance, or identity theft. Why is Deactivating Aadhaar Important? Many people often overlook this step, but keeping a deceased person s Aadhaar active can lead to several complications Prevent Misuse Scammers often look for dormant identities to open fake bank accounts or take loans. Subsidies Benefits To prevent the continued transfer of government benefits (like pensions) to a deceased person, which can later lead to legal recovery issues. Closure of Records It helps in closing other linked official documents like PAN Card and Voter ID systematically. Important Requirement To use this service, you MUST have a valid Death Certificate issued by the Registrar of Births and Deaths. The details on the Death Certificate must match the Aadhaar details of the deceased. Procedure to Report Death Online UIDAI has simplified the process by allowing family members to initiate this request via the myAadhaar portal. Follow these steps Login to Portal The reporting family member (Applicant) must login to the myAadhaar portal using their Own Aadhaar Number and OTP. You cannot login using the deceased person s Aadhaar. Select the Service On the dashboard, locate and click on the Report death of a family member card. Enter Details of Deceased Enter the 12-digit Aadhaar Number of the deceased family member. You may also need to provide their Name and Date of Birth as per records. Upload Document Upload a clear scanned copy (PDF JPG) of the Death Certificate . Ensure the file size is within the permissible limit (usually 2MB). Review Submit Verify all the details entered. Once submitted, you will receive a Service Request Number (SRN) to track the status. What Happens Next? (Verification) Reporting the death online does not instantly deactivate the Aadhaar. The request goes through a verification process 1. Registrar Verification The details are cross-verified with the birth and death registration records. 2. Deactivation Once verified, the UIDAI will permanently deactivate the Aadhaar number of the deceased. 3. Confirmation You can check the status using the Check deceased Aadhaar deactivation status service on the same portal. Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs) Q Can anyone report the death? Ans Usually, only immediate family members (spouse, children, parents) whose mobile numbers are linked or who can prove the relationship can initiate this request. Q Is it mandatory to deactivate Aadhaar after death? Ans While there is no strict penalty currently, it is highly recommended for safety and to close the financial and legal footprint of the deceased. Q Can I reactivate the Aadhaar later if reported by mistake? Ans No. Once an Aadhaar is marked as Deceased and deactivated after proper verification, it cannot be reactivated. Please use this service carefully. LIMITED TIME OFFER Free Document Update Is your Aadhaar 10 years old? Upload Proof of Identity Address documents online for FREE till 14 06 2026. Update Now Document Update Upload PoI and PoA Online Has it been more than 10 years since you got your Aadhaar card made? Have you updated your documents recently? If not, the Unique Identification Authority of India (UIDAI) strongly recommends that you update your Proof of Identity (PoI) and Proof of Address (PoA) documents. Keeping your documents updated ensures that your demographic information (Name, Address, DOB) in the Aadhaar database is accurate and up-to-date. This helps in seamless verification for banking, passport services, and government subsidies. Special Offer Free Service! This online document update service is FREE OF COST till 14 06 2026 . (Note If you visit an offline Aadhaar Center, you will have to pay 50.) Which Documents do you need to upload? You need to upload one document for Identity and one for Address. Common valid documents include 1. Proof of Identity (PoI) To verify your Name and Photo. PAN Card e-PAN Driving License Passport Voter ID Ration Card (with Photo) Mark Sheet School Certificate 2. Proof of Address (PoA) To verify your Current Address. Electricity Bill ( 3 months) Water Bill ( 3 months) Gas Connection Bill Bank Passbook Statement Passport (Address page) Voter ID Step-by-Step Process to Update Documents Online Take advantage of the free window and update your documents from home using these steps Login to myAadhaar Click the Update Now button above and login using your Aadhaar Number OTP. Select Document Update Click on the Document Update card. Review your current details (Name, Address, DOB). Upload Files Scan your PoI and PoA documents. Supported formats are JPEG, PNG, or PDF (Size 2MB). Submit Since the service is free, skip the payment. Click submit. You will get a Service Request Number (SRN) . Online vs Offline Update Comparison Feature Online (myAadhaar Portal) Offline (Aadhaar Center) Cost FREE (till 14 06 2026) 50 (Service Charge) Convenience From Home (24 7) Visit Wait in Queue Documents Self Scan Upload Originals Verified by Operator Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs) Q My address has changed. Can I use this service? Ans No. This service is ONLY to upload documents for existing details. To change your address, use the Address Update service. Q What happens if I don t update? Ans Your Aadhaar might get suspended or face difficulties in KYC authentication for banks or ration services. Generate Virtual ID (VID) Protect your privacy! Create a temporary 16-digit Virtual ID to use instead of your Aadhaar Number for authentication. Generate VID VID Generator Create Virtual ID to Hide Aadhaar Number Are you worried about sharing your 12-digit Aadhaar number everywhere? Do you want to protect your privacy while performing e-KYC? The Virtual ID (VID) is the solution. The VID Generator service allows you to create a temporary, revocable 16-digit random number mapped to your Aadhaar number. It can be used in lieu of your Aadhaar number for authentication services. This ensures your actual Aadhaar number remains hidden from the service provider. Privacy Feature When you use a VID, the agency (like a telecom operator or bank) cannot store your Aadhaar number. They only get a UID Token , which makes your data much more secure against leaks. Difference Aadhaar Number vs Virtual ID (VID) Feature Aadhaar Number (UID) Virtual ID (VID) Length 12 Digits (Permanent) 16 Digits (Temporary) Validity Lifetime valid Valid until you generate a new one Security Directly linked to biometric data Masks the actual Aadhaar number How to Generate or Retrieve VID Online You can generate a new VID or retrieve an existing one using the myAadhaar portal. Follow these steps Login to Portal Visit the myAadhaar dashboard by clicking the Generate VID button above. Select VID Generator Click on the VID Generator icon from the services menu. Choose Option You will see two options 1. Generate New VID If you want to create a fresh 16-digit number. 2. Retrieve Existing VID If you already generated one but forgot it. Confirm Receive Select your choice. Your 16-digit Virtual ID will be sent immediately to your Registered Mobile Number via SMS. Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs) Q Is VID accepted everywhere? Ans Yes, as per government regulations, all agencies (Banks, Telecom, Govt) must accept VID for authentication. Q What happens if I generate a new VID? Ans The moment you generate a new VID, your old VID gets automatically cancelled. You can only have one active VID at a time. Q Does VID expire? Ans No, a VID does not expire by itself. It remains valid until you choose to generate a new one. Lock Unlock Aadhaar Worried about identity theft? Temporarily Lock your Biometrics or Aadhaar Number instantly for maximum security. Secure Now Lock Unlock Aadhaar Secure Your Biometrics Instantly Security is a major concern for Aadhaar holders. What if someone gets hold of your Aadhaar number and tries to misuse it? To prevent unauthorized authentication, UIDAI provides a powerful feature Lock Unlock Aadhaar . This service allows you to temporarily Lock your UID (Aadhaar Number). Once locked, no one (not even you) can perform authentication using the Aadhaar number. It acts as a digital shield against identity theft. You can Unlock it whenever you need to use it. MUST READ BEFORE LOCKING Do not lock your Aadhaar without generating a Virtual ID (VID). Once your Aadhaar is locked, you CANNOT use your Aadhaar number to unlock it (because the number itself is locked). You will compulsorily need a 16-digit Virtual ID (VID) to perform the Unlock process. Difference Aadhaar Lock vs Biometric Lock Many people confuse these two services. Here is the difference Feature UID Lock (Aadhaar Lock) Biometric Lock What it blocks? Blocks ALL authentication (Demographic, Biometric, OTP). Blocks ONLY Fingerprint and Iris scan. OTP still works. How to use when locked? You must use Virtual ID (VID) . You must temporarily Unlock biometrics to use fingerprint iris. Security Level Highest (Total Lock) Medium (Protects Biometrics only) Step-by-Step Guide to LOCK Aadhaar Generate VID First As mentioned, ensure you have a valid VID. If not, use the VID Generator service first. Open Lock Service Click the Secure Now button above and select the Lock UID option. Enter Details Enter your 12-digit Aadhaar Number, Full Name, and Pin Code. Verify OTP Enter the security captcha and click Send OTP . Enter the OTP received on your mobile. Confirmation Your Aadhaar Number is now LOCKED. You will not be able to perform authentication using the UID anymore. Step-by-Step Guide to UNLOCK Aadhaar Select Unlock UID Go to the same service page and select the Unlock UID tab. Enter VID (Not Aadhaar Number) Here, you CANNOT enter your Aadhaar number. You must enter your 16-digit Virtual ID (VID) . Verify Unlock Enter the Captcha and OTP. Once verified, your Aadhaar number will be active again. Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs) Q Can I download e-Aadhaar if my UID is locked? Ans Yes, but you will have to use your Virtual ID (VID) to download it, as the Aadhaar number will not be accepted by the system. Q I forgot my VID and my Aadhaar is locked. What do I do? Ans You can use the Retrieve VID service via SMS. Send an SMS RVID Last 4 digits of Aadhaar to 1947 from your registered mobile number. Bank Seeding Status Are you receiving government subsidies? Check if your Aadhaar is successfully linked and mapped with your bank account for Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT). Check Status Bank Seeding Status Check Aadhaar-Bank Linking for DBT Many government schemes in India transfer money directly to beneficiaries bank accounts using the Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) system. This money is sent using the Aadhaar Payment Bridge (APB). For this to work, simply having a bank account is not enough. Your Aadhaar number must be seeded or mapped with that specific bank account in the NPCI (National Payments Corporation of India) database. The Bank Seeding Status service helps you check which of your bank accounts is currently linked to receive government funds. Why is Bank Seeding Essential? If your Bank Seeding Status is Inactive , you will NOT receive funds for PM Kisan Samman Nidhi LPG Gas Subsidy (PAHAL) Scholarships Pension Schemes (Old Age Widow) MNREGA Wages How to Check Bank Linking Status Online You can verify your current NPCI mapping status instantly through the myAadhaar portal. Follow these steps Login to Portal Click the Check Status button above and login using your Aadhaar Number OTP. Select Bank Seeding Status Locate and click on the Bank Seeding Status icon on the dashboard. View Result The system will display the Bank Name, Seeding Status (Active Inactive), and the Date of Linking. Understanding Your Status Result Status ACTIVE Your Aadhaar is successfully mapped. You are eligible to receive DBT funds in the mentioned bank account. Status INACTIVE Your mapping has been disabled or expired. You will NOT receive subsidies until you re-link it. My Status is Inactive Not Linked. How to Link? Note You CANNOT link your bank account to Aadhaar online via the UIDAI website. This must be done through your bank. Method 1 Visit Bank Branch (Recommended) Go to your bank branch, fill out the Aadhaar Seeding Form (DBT Mandate form), and attach a copy of your e-Aadhaar. Ask the official to Enable DBT specifically. Method 2 Net Banking Mobile App Some banks (like SBI, HDFC, ICICI, PNB) offer an option in their Net Banking App under Service Request Link Aadhaar Enable DBT . Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs) Q I have accounts in 3 banks. Which one will receive the money? Ans Government benefits are sent to the Last Seeded Bank Account . If you recently linked a new bank account, the money will start coming to that new account automatically. Q My bank says Aadhaar is linked (KYC done), but status shows Inactive. Why? Ans Linking for KYC and Linking for DBT are different. You must specifically ask the bank to Map Aadhaar to NPCI for DBT . Q How long does it take to update the status? Ans Once the bank processes your request, it usually takes 2-3 working days for the status to reflect on the myAadhaar portal. Track Your PVC Card Ordered your Aadhaar PVC Card? Track its printing and delivery status in real-time. Know exactly when it will reach your doorstep. Track Order Check Aadhaar PVC Card Order Status Track Delivery Have you recently ordered the new, durable Aadhaar PVC Card online by paying 50? If yes, you might be wondering when it will reach your home. The Check Aadhaar PVC card order status service allows you to track the progress of your printing request and its dispatch status. The entire process, from ordering to delivery, typically takes 5 to 15 working days . This tool helps you know exactly where your card is whether it is still printing or has been handed over to the post office. You Need Your SRN (Service Request Number) To check the status, you must have the 28-digit SRN . This number was generated when you successfully placed the order and paid the fees. It is available on the acknowledgement slip you downloaded. How to Check PVC Order Status Online Follow these simple steps to track your application Open the Tool Click on the Track Order button above. Enter SRN Enter the 28-digit Service Request Number (SRN) carefully. Security Check Type the Captcha code shown on the screen. Submit Click on Submit . The system will verify your request and display the current status. Understanding the Status Meanings Payment Successful Your order has been received by UIDAI. In Process Your data has been sent for printing. Dispatched Your card has been printed and handed over to India Post. (This is the most important status). How to Track via India Post (Speed Post) Once the status shows Dispatched , the portal will display an Airway Bill Number (AWB) . This is your tracking ID. Copy the Airway Bill Number (AWB). Visit the India Post Tracking website (indiapost.gov.in). Enter the AWB number in the Consignment Number field. You will see the exact location of your card and the expected delivery date. Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs) Q I lost my SRN. How can I check the status? Ans If you lost the SRN, check your SMS history for messages from UIDAI. Or check the Payment History section if you were logged in. Q The status says Dispatched but I haven t received it yet. Ans Delivery speed depends on India Post services. Use the Airway Bill Number to track it on the India Post website for real-time updates. Check Aadhaar Status Applied for a new Aadhaar or updated details? Track your application status in real-time using your Enrolment ID (EID) or URN. Check Status Check Aadhaar Enrolment Update Status Online Have you recently applied for a new Aadhaar card? Or have you updated your Name, Address, or Date of Birth at an Aadhaar Center? If yes, you don t need to visit the center again to know if your request is processed. The Check Enrolment Update Status service allows you to track your application in real-time. Whether you did the update online (via myAadhaar portal) or offline (at a Seva Kendra), you can track it here. Which Number Do You Need for Tracking? Depending on how you applied, you will have one of the following numbers 1. Enrolment ID (EID) Found on the top of the Acknowledgement Slip given at the Aadhaar Center. It contains 14-digit Enrolment No. 14-digit Date Time. 2. Service Request Number (SRN) Generated when you initiate an Online Update (like Address or Document Update) on the myAadhaar portal. It starts with S . 3. Update Request Number (URN) Generated via SMS if you updated details using the Self Service Update Portal (SSUP) in the past. How to Enter EID Correctly (Very Important) Most users fail to check status because they enter the EID incorrectly. The 28-digit EID is a combination of the Enrolment Number and Timestamp. Format Enrolment Number Year Month Day Time Example If slip says Date 15 08 2024, Time 14 30 55, Enrolment 1234 56789 01234 Enter like this 12345678901234 20240815 143055 (Notice the Date is reversed YYYY-MM-DD). Step-by-Step Tracking Process Follow these steps to know your current status Open the Tool Click on the Check Status button above. Enter ID Type your EID (28 digits), SRN, or URN in the box provided. Ensure there are no spaces or slashes. Security Check Enter the Captcha code exactly as shown. Submit Click Submit . The status will appear on the screen. What Does Your Status Mean? In Process Your application is still being verified by the backend team. This usually takes 5-30 days. Completed Congratulations! Your update is successful. You can now Download Aadhaar to see the changes. Rejected Your request was declined. This usually happens due to wrong documents or data mismatch. You will have to apply again. Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs) Q I lost my Acknowledgement Slip. How can I get my EID? Ans You can use the Retrieve EID UID service to get your Enrolment ID on your registered mobile number. Q How many days does it take to update Aadhaar? Ans As per UIDAI guidelines, up to 90 of updates are processed within 30 days. However, in some cases, it can take up to 90 days. Q Status shows Completed but I didn t get the card by post. Ans Completed means the data is updated online. The physical letter delivery takes extra time. You can download the e-Aadhaar immediately. Check Deceased Aadhaar Deactivation Status Once you have formally reported the death of a family member to UIDAI for Aadhaar deactivation, it is important to verify if the request has been processed. The Check Deceased Aadhaar Deactivation Status service allows legal heirs or guardians to track the progress of their application. Deactivating the Aadhaar of a deceased person is a critical step to prevent identity fraud and ensure that government records are updated accurately. Requirement You will need the Service Request Number (SRN) that was generated when you submitted the Report Death request. How to Track Deactivation Request Access the Tool Click on the Check Deceased Aadhaar Deactivation Status card on the myAadhaar dashboard. View Status The system will show whether the request is Pending Verification , Approved (Deactivated), or Rejected (due to document mismatch). (Single Sign-On Login) SSO (Single Sign-On) ek aisa digital authentication system hai jo users ko sirf ek ID aur Password ke zariye kai saari sarkari aur private websites par login karne ki suvidha deta hai. Chahe wo Aadhaar Card Download ho, Ration Card ki jankari ho, ya Jan Aadhaar portal SSO Login se sab kuch ek jagah manage hota hai. Bharat mein digital services badhne ke saath, SSO ID Login ab har nagarik ke liye zaroori ho gaya hai. Is portal par aap apne Aadhaar number ya Face Auth ka upyog karke securely login kar sakte hain. New Update Ab aap bina password yaad rakhe, seedhe apne Chehre (Face Auth) ya Biometric se SSO Login kar sakte hain. SSO ID Registration Account Kaise Banayein? Agar aapke paas abhi tak SSO ID nahi hai, to aap niche diye gaye steps follow karke apna naya account register kar sakte hain Upar diye gaye SSO Login box mein Create New Account par click karein. Apna 12-digit Aadhaar Number enter karein. Aapke registered mobile par ek OTP aayega, use verify karein. Apna manpasand SSO User ID aur Password set karein. Registration complete hone par aap turant login kar sakte hain. Benefits of SSO Portal (SSO Ke Fayde) All-in-One Access Ek hi login se 100 services ka labh uthayein. Recover Forgotten Password Agar password bhool gaye, to Aadhaar OTP se reset karein. High Security Two-factor authentication (2FA) aur Identity verification. SSO Login FAQs Q Main apna SSO ID Password bhool gaya hun, kya karun? Ans Aap Forgot Password link par click karke apne registered mobile number ya Aadhaar OTP ke zariye apna password reset kar sakte hain. Q Kya SSO Login ke liye Aadhaar zaroori hai? Ans Haan, security verification ke liye Aadhaar card number ya Jan Aadhaar ID ka hona anivarya hai. Q SSO ID se main kaunsi services use kar sakta hun? Ans Aap Aadhaar PVC order, Address Update, Scholarship forms, Job applications, aur Electricity bill payment jaisi suvidhayein use kar sakte hain.

Supreme court ne aaj apne judgement mein Iccha mrityu ki anumati de di hai. Court ne apne is judgment mein ye bhi kaha ki samman (honor) se marna vyakti ka adhikar. Iske sath Five judge's bench nein Living Will ki bhi anumati de di hai. Ab koi bhi vyakti jinda rahte apni mrityu ke bare mein tay kar sakta hai. Aruna Ramchandra shanbag V s Central Government of India Is case mien Aruna Ramchandra ki iccha mrityu ke liye petition dayar ki gyi thi, jisme Aruna Ramchandra jo ki ek rape victim thi, jiske sath Hospital ke ek ward boy ne rape kar usko marne ki kosis ki thi par vah bach gyi aur coma mein chali gyi. Wah 42 years tak coma mein rahi. IS case ke antargat Supreme Court ne kaha tha ki sanvidhan kr Article 21 mein jine ka adhikar ke bare mein pravdhan kiya gya hai, na ki kisi vyakti ke mrne ka pravdhan kiya gya hai. lekin baad mien Supreme Court ne is case mien kaha ki court ki kadi nigrani mein asadharan condition mien Passive euthanasia diya ja sakta hai. Chief justice Deepak Mishra ki adhyakshata wali sanvidhan peeth ne is bare mein detail mien guideline bhi taiyar ki hai. Court ne apna yah nirnay Common Cause ki Writ par diya hai. Guideline's 1 .Iccha mrityu par akhiri nirnay Medical Borad karega, Board yah tay karega ki mareej ka ilaaj sambhav hai ya nahi hai. Yadi medical borad mareej ki report dekhne ke bad yah nirnay leta hai ki us marej ka ilaaj hona asambahav hai to, aise medical board ke adesh ke anusar us mareej ka life Supporting System hta diya jayega. 2. Healthy person ab apna Living Will District Magistrate ki nigrani mein likh sakta hai. 3. Living Will Yadi koi vyakti nahi likh pata hai aur wah aisi bimari se grashit hai jiska ilaj ho pana asambhav hai to aise mein marej ke ristedar ya parivar wale High Court ja sakte hai. 4. High Court jo apna nirnay degi wah nirnay Medical Board ki report ke aadhaar par hi degi. Living Will ka matlab yah hai ki ab koi bhi vyakti apni jevan ka nirnay le sakta hai. ab koi bhi vyakti yah likh-kar rakh sakta hai, ki yadi ussay koi aisi bimari ho jaati hai jiske kaaran se vah aisi awastha (condition) mein aa jata hai, jaha uska thik (cure) hona asambhav hai , to aise mein us vyakti ka life supporting machine jo ki ilaj ke time lagi hoti hai, wah machine hatane ke liye kah sakta hai. Kendra ne kaha agr koi Living Will karta bhi hai, to aise mein Medical Board ki rai ke aadhaar par hi Life supporting Machine hataya ja sakta hai ya hataya jayega. Euthanasia kya hai ? NGO common cause ne 2005 mein is mamle par writ (Petition) court mein dakhil ki thi. Is Common cause ke advocate Prashant bhusan ne dhakil ki apni petition ke paksh (favor) mein kaha ki kisi ghambir bimari se joojh rahe logo ko "Living Will" banane ka adhikar diya jana chahiye. Living Will ek aisa document hoga jisme har ek vyakti yah likh sakega ki, jaha wah aisi condition mien pahuch jaye, jaha uske thik hone ki sambhavna bahut kam ho, to aise mien usay jabran Life Supporting System mien na rakha jaye. Iccha mrityu kya hai ? ( What is Passive euthanasia?) Iccha mrityu ka matlab yah hota hai, koi vyakti apni marji se mrna chahta hai. Yadi koi vyakti kisi aisi gambhir bimari se grashit hai, to aise mein us vyakti ko dard se aram dilane ke liye doctor ki help se uski life ka ant karna hai.Yah 2 tarah ki hoti hai. 1. Passive euthanasia. Yadi koi vyakti kaafi lambe time se coma mien hai, to aise mien yadi uski family ki permission se us vyakti ki Life Support System ko hataya jata hai to wah Passive euthanasia kha jayega. Isko supreme court ne manjuri de di hai. 2.Active euthanasia. Yadi koi vyakti aisi bimari se grashit hai jiska sahi hona asambhav hai. Yadi aise mien marej ko poision ya pain killer ke injection ki overdose dekar usay mara jata hai, to aisi mrityu ko Active euthanasia kha jayega. Par India aur kai Countries mein isay illegal aur crime mana jata hai. Supreme Court ne isya manjuri nahi di hai. Supreme Court ke nirnay ( Iccha Mrityu) ke kuch ahem bindu.( Some main Point of Supreme Court verdict on Iccha Mrityu) 1. Living Will ko kuch sharto (condition's) ke sath hi manjuri di jayegi. 2. Iccha Mrityu par kanoon banne tak Supreme Court ki hi guide-line ko hi mana jayega. 3. Supreme Court ne yah bhi kaha ki vyakti ko garima ke sath mrne ka adhikar hai. 4. Supreme Court ne yah bhi kaha ki yadi mareej ko aisi koi bimari hogi jiska ilaj hona sambhav nahi hai, to likh-kar dena hoga. 5. Yadi vyakti ko aisa koi rog hai jiska ilaj hona asambhav hai aur us vyakti ko life Supporting System ke sahare se jivit rakha ja rha hai aur yadi us vyakti ko jivit na rakhne ke sambandh mein likhit vasiyat di hai, to yah legal hoga. Constitution Bench ke paas ye mamla kaise pahucha ? 2014 mein supreme Court ki 3 judge's ki bench nein Passive euthanasia par Aruna Shanbhag ke mamle mein 2011 mein diye gaye nirnay ko asangat bataya tha aur yah mamla 5 judge's ki bench ko transfer kar diya tha. Tab se yah case pending par tha. Aruna Shanbag ka kya mamala hai ? Aruna shanbag ke sath 27 November 1973 mein Mumbai ke KEM Hospital mein kaam kar rahe ek ward boy nein allegedly rape kiya tha. lekin us ward boy par ya arop sabit (proof) nahi ho paya tha. Us ward boy nein aruna ke gale mien janjer kas-kar usay marne ki kosis ki, lekin aruna ki mrityu na ho kar wah coma mein chali gyi. Coma mein Aruna 42 saal rahi. Akhir -kar apne is dard ko jhelti 18 may 2015 ko aruna ne apna yah sharir tyag diya aur unki mrityu ho gyi. Pahli petition kisne dayar ki thi ? Issay pahle Journalist Pinki Virani nein Aruna Shanbag ki halat dekhtye huye 2011 mein unke liye iccha mrityu dene ki mang ki thi aur supreme court mein petition dayar ki thi. Supreme Court ne Pinki Virani ki petition kyo kharij kar diya thi ? Supreme Court mein Pinki Virani ke dwara dayar ki gyi petition jo Aruna Shanbag ki iccha mrityu se sambandhit thi us par supreme court ne 7 march 2011 ko Passive euthanasia ko anumati de di thi. Lekin Aruna Shanbag ke liye supreme court se mangi gyi iccha mrityu ki petition ko kahrij kar di gyi thi. Supreme Court ne apne nirnay mein yah kaha tha ki kuch khas condition mein sambandhit high court ke guide-line ke anusar hi passive euthanasia ki anumati di ja sakti hai. lekin iske liye 3 doctor aur mareej ke parivar walo ki anumati jaruri thi, aise mien Pinki Virani Aruna Shanbag ki parivar wali nahi thi, isliye supreme Court nein Pinki Virani ke dwara dayar ki Yachika ko kharij kar diya tha. Jis Petition par nirnay aya wah kisne dayar ki thi aur Yachika-karta ka kya tha kahna? Supreme Court mein chal rahi sunvai ke waqt Advocate Prashant bhusan ne kaha ki yadi kisi bhi vyakti ki life mien aisi condition aa jati hai ki vyakti Life Supporting System se jivit nahi rah sakta hai to, aise mien ya nirnay kiya jana chahiye ki kya bina Life Supporting System ke us vyakti ko bachaya ja sakta hai ya nahi ? Sirf us vyakti ki marji honi chahiye ki wak kya Life supporting System ke sahare jivit rahna chahta hai ya nahi. Prashant Bhusan ne apni dalil mein yah bhi kaha ki kisi vyakti ko aap uski marji ke bina jine ke liye majbor (force) nahi kar sakte hai. Supreme court mein sunvai ke waqt yah bhi kaha gya ki yadi koi vyakti jo aise rog se grashit hai jiska ilaj asambhav hai aur vah vyakti jina nahi chahta hai, to uske liye doctor ki puri team lagana kaha tak sahi hai. Supreme Court ne Arun Shanbag ke mamle mein kya nirnay diya tha? Supreme Court mein 8 march 2011 ko Pinki Virani ke dwara dayar ki gyi petition ko kharij kar diya tha lekin court ne yah bhi kaha tha ki Family ki anumati par kisi ko iccha mrityu di ja sakti hai.

साधा निशाना, बोले- युवाओं के नाम पर की जा रही राजनीति दुर्भाग्यपूर्ण सोनम वांगचुक से मिलने मेदांता पहुंचे भीमसेना प्रमुख को रोका सतपाल तंवर बोले-देश में अघोषित इमरजेंसी 27 जुलाई को भारत बंद का ऐलान सोनम वांगचुक से मिलने मेदांता पहुंचे भीमसेना प्रमुख को रोका सतपाल तंवर बोले-देश में अघोषित इमरजेंसी 27 जुलाई को भारत बंद का ऐलान जंतर-मंतर आंदोलन पर CM सैनी का विपक्ष पर निशाना गुरुग्राम में बोले- छात्रों को मोहरा बनाकर राजनीतिक कर रहे, कांग्रेस-इंडी गठबंधन नेता भड़का रहे जंतर-मंतर आंदोलन पर CM सैनी का विपक्ष पर निशाना गुरुग्राम में बोले- छात्रों को मोहरा बनाकर राजनीतिक कर रहे, कांग्रेस-इंडी गठबंधन नेता भड़का रहे गुरुग्राम के श्रमिक कैंप में घुसा 5 फीट लंबा कोबरा वाइल्ड लाइफ विशेषज्ञ ने पकड़ा 3 दिन पहले हुई थी बच्ची की मौत गुरुग्राम में अहीर रेजिमेंट मोर्चा ने लाठीचार्ज का विरोध किया अधिकारियों को सौंपा ज्ञापन बोले- छात्रों को न्याय नहीं मिला तो, देशव्यापी आंदोलन करेंगे गुरुग्राम में तीन साल से बंद पड़ी स्ट्रीट लाइटें देखरेख के अभाव में खंभे टूटकर गिरे, RWA फेडरेशन ने की जल्द शुरू कराने की मांग गुरुग्राम में पुरानी रंजिश में हमला और अपहरण देसी पिस्टल समेत दो और आरोपी गिरफ्तार कार से मारी थी टक्कर गुरुग्राम के सरकारी प्रतिष्ठानों में अप्रेंटिसशिप को बढ़ावा नोडल अधिकारी नियुक्त करने के निर्देश, एडीसी बोले-आईटीआई विभाग के साथ समन्वय स्थापित किया जाए फर्रुखनगर अनाज मंडी को मिलेगी नई पहचान चेयरमैन वेदपाल ने किए ऐलान टीनशेड और अटल कैंटीन समेत नया गेट बनेगा शादी का झांसा देकर रेप-ठगी का आरोपी गिरफ्तार गुरुग्राम पुलिस ने जयपुर से पकड़ा मैट्रिमोनियल साइट पर हुई थी दोस्ती खुले में कूड़ा फेंकने वालों की संपत्ति होगी सील मानेसर निगम आयुक्त ने दिए निर्देश, लापरवाही पर सफाई एजेंसियों पर भी होगी कार्रवाई गुरुग्राम-मेदांता के डॉक्टरों के मुताबिक सोनम की हालत स्टेबल मेडिकल बुलेटिन में कहा-होश में हैं चिट्ठी के बावजूद सरकार से कोई बातचीत नहीं हुई सोहना में दो सगे भाईयों को लाठी-डंडों से पीटा लहूलुहान होकर सड़क पर गिरे, सब्जी की दुकान पर बैठे थे दोनों गुरुग्राम में बेरिकेडिंग तोड़ DC ऑफिस में घुसे कांग्रेसी पुलिस के रोकने पर फूटा गुस्सा मोदी सरकार को बर्खास्त करने की मांग गुरुग्राम कस्टोडियल टॉर्चर केस में मानवाधिकार आयोग सख्त आरोपी का दावा- फ्लाईओवर से नहीं गिरा, पुलिस ने टांग तोड़ी DGP से मांगी रिपोर्ट फर्रुखनगर में कैच द रेन अभियान नगरपालिका सचिव बोले- बारिश के पानी को संरक्षित करें, रेन वाटर हार्वेस्टिंग सिस्टम स्थापित करने पर जोर गुरुग्राम में पहली इलेक्ट्रिक बस का ट्रायल शुरू GMCBL बेड़े में 25 सीटों वाली AC ई-बस शामिल, 3 दिन तक होगा परीक्षण गुरुग्राम में कार-बाइक सवार में चले लात-घूंसे, VIDEO रोड रेज के बाद हाई-वोल्टेज हंगामा, हेलमेट से ताबड़तोड़ वार जाम लगा गुरुग्राम-वांगचुक से मिलने पहुंचे 15 सांसदों को पुलिस ने रोका मेडिकल टीम से हेल्थ अपडेट लेकर लौटे सोनम ने VIDEO जारी कर अनशन तोड़ने की शर्त बताई फर्रुखनगर में 172 कनाल जमीन का फर्जीवाड़ा खरीद से 477 वर्ग गज ज्यादा बेची, रास्तों की जमीन पर काटी अवैध कॉलोनी गुरुग्राम नगर निगम ने सील किए 9 निर्माणाधीन भवन आयुध डिपो के प्रतिबंधित क्षेत्र में बनाए जा रहे, नहीं ली गई थी कोई अनुमति गुरुग्राम में युवक मारपीट करने का आरोपी अरेस्ट जबरन कार में बैठाकर ले गया, हवाई फायरिंग की, पुरानी रंजिश में दिया वारदात को अंजाम गुरुग्राम में बाइक को ट्रक ने मारी टक्कर यूपी की युवती समेत दो घायल, नोएडा से आ रही थी लड़की, ड्राइवर हुआ फरार सोहना में 14 गाड़ियों के शीशे तोड़े जीएलएस सोसाइटी पार्किंग विवाद बढ़ा पुलिस हस्तक्षेप के बाद 23 जुलाई तक राहत गुरुग्राम में अंतरिक्ष हाइट्स सोसायटी मैनेजमेंट पर FIR बास्केटबॉल पोल गिरने का मामला युवक की रीढ़ में 3 फ्रैक्चर किसानों का दिल्ली कूच स्थगित दो मांगों पर सहमति बनी, हरियाणा में बॉर्डर सील कुंडली-सिंघु बॉर्डर पर 4 किमी लंबा जाम गुरुग्राम में अवैध स्विमिंग पूल MCG ने किया सील आयुध डिपो क्षेत्र में चल रहा था संचालक को नगर निगम की चेतावनी फर्रुखनगर में झाड़ियों में मिला चौकीदार का शव ग्रामीणों ने लगाया जाम, हाथ से खून निकलता मिला, पेट पर खरोंच के निशान मिले गुरुग्राम में सफाई व्यवस्था पर नगर निगम की सख्ती एजेंसी पर 5.30 लाख का जुर्माना, कर्मचारी और ट्रैक्टर-ट्रॉलियां कमी पर कार्रवाई गुरुग्राम सड़क हादसे में 2 दोस्तों की मौत, युवती गंभीर ट्रक में घुसी तेज रफ्तार कार क्लब में फुटबॉल फाइनल मैच देखकर दिल्ली लौट रहे थे मानेसर में जलभराव से निपटने की तैयारी तेज आयुक्त ने लिया संभावित क्षेत्रों का जायजा, 24 घंटे पंप तैनात रखने, नालों की सफाई के निर्देश गुरुग्राम में सीवर गड्ढे में धंसने से ट्रैक्टर-ट्रॉली पलटी बाल-बाल बचा ड्राइवर लोग बोले- प्रशासन ने चेतावनी बोर्ड या बैरिकेडिंग नहीं लगाई गुरुग्राम में झमाझम बारिश से राहत, निचले इलाकों में जलभराव एक्सप्रेसवे से राजीव चौक तक रेंगता रहा ट्रैफिक जाम ने बढ़ाई मुसीबत Copyright 2024-25 DB Corp ltd., In an embarrassment to Pakistan Prime Minister Imran Khan , the country s embassy in Serbia on Friday shared a public message on its social media handle asking people Aap Ne Ghabrana Nahi . The Twitter handle shared a video in which it raised questions over Khan s so-called Naya Pakistan pitch and asked how long does the government expect its officials to remain silent when they have not been paid for the last three months. Video shared by the Pakistan embassy shows that how the people of the country are making do under severe poverty. It also depicted the miserable condition of the government employees under Imran Khan s regime, stating that they have been working unpaid for the last three months and their children are being forced out of schools due to non-payment of their fees. With inflation breaking all previous records, how long do you expect ImranKhanPTI that we government official will remain silent keep working for you without been paid for past 3 months our children been forced out of school due to non-payment of fees Is this NayaPakistan?, the embassy in Serbia tweeted. The tweet comes with a music video mocking Imran Khan s dialogue Aapne ghabrana nahi . If soap becomes costlier, don t use. If wheat becomes dearer, please don t eat, the lyrics of the song said with Imran Khan s aapne ghabrana nahi video inserted in between. In another Tweet, Pakistan Embassy in Serbia said I am sorry ImranKhanPTI, am not left with another option. Reports said that the inflation in Pakistan has risen to 11.5 per cent from 9.2 per cent earlier this week, the highest spike in the last 20 months. In November the inflation rate in the country was over 9 per cent with per capita income decreasing to USD 1,260 in 2021. According to The New International, the country s economy which was increased by 36 per cent during 2013-2018 has now nosedived by 16 per cent from 2018-2020. Therefore the per capita income that stood at USD 1,482 in 2018 tumbled to USD 1,194 in 2020 which has been estimated by IMF at USD 1,260 in 2021 still showing the fact that the purchasing power parity has eroded a lot, reported The News International. The bad governance and wrong decisions at the highest level of first exporting sugar then importing it and the same with wheat and flour coupled with discouraging cultivation of pulses and cotton also played a vital role in increasing the food inflation and importing over USD 1 billion cotton further resulted in the devaluation of the rupee. Amid rising prices, Pakistani artist gives musical twist to Imran Khan s Aap ne ghabrana nahi hai From talking about rising prices of flour to medicines, the singer pokes fun at the PM and asks citizens simply to ignore those items, reminding all of Khan's line -- don't panic. As prices of basic commodities continues to soar in Pakistan, a spoof video created by a music composer has tickled many online. Giving a musical twist to Pakistani Prime Minister Imran Khan s viral Aap ne ghabrana nahi hai line, the artist takes a jibe at the debilitating inflation in the country, and netizens seem to hooked. Written and performed by popular music artist and YouTuber, Saad Alavi, the song is titled Aap ne ghabrana nahi , which translates into don t panic. Drawing inspiration from Khan s line that has inspired many memes in the past, Alavi s song starts with, Sabun mehnga hojaey to aap ne lagana nahin(If soap becomes expensive, don t use it). From talking about rising prices of flour to medicines, the singer pokes fun at the PM and asks citizens simply to ignore those items, reminding all of Khan s line don t panic. Aap paise jama kar kar ke bas tax tum bhaaro phir pet ko patti baandho aur bas bhook se maro (You just save up and pay the tax then tie your stomach and die of hunger), the artist is heard singing in the song. The prime minister went viral for his line, which quickly became a catchphrase to troll him as he urged citizens not to worry in an address to the nation duringcoronaviruspandemic. Aap ne ghabrana nahi hai You should not panic . It is our belief that life and death are in the hands of Allah, he had said in March 2020. Contrary to government projections and market expectations, the cost of goods and services for the public during February rose by 8.7pc, one of the fastest increases in a given month owing mainly to the resurgence of food and electricity prices, the dailyDawnsaid in a report. According to the Sensitive Price Indicator (SPI), inflation for the week ending on March 4, 2021, has shown an increase of over 0.6 percent as compared to the last week of February. This is despite the continued claims of the government that inflation is under control,The News,Pakistan reported.

Download Now Complete Guide to e-Aadhaar Download Process Aaj ke digital yug mein, Aadhaar Card har Bhartiya nagarik ke liye sabse zaroori pehchaan patra (Identity Proof) ban gaya hai. Chahe bank account khulwana ho, SIM card lena ho, ya kisi sarkari yojana ka labh uthana ho Aadhaar har jagah anivarya hai. Lekin kya aap jante hain ki aapko hamesha physical card sath rakhne ki zarurat nahi hai? Aap e-Aadhaar ka istemal kar sakte hain. What is e-Aadhaar? (e-Aadhaar Kya Hai?) Ye aapke physical Aadhaar card ki ek password-protected electronic copy hai, jise UIDAI ke competent authority dwara digitally sign kiya jata hai. Aadhaar Act ke mutabiq, e-Aadhaar physical copy ke barabar hi valid mana jata hai. Aadhaar Card Download Kaise Karein? (Online Process) Agar aapka Aadhaar card kho gaya hai ya aapke paas physical copy nahi hai, to ghabrayein nahi. Aap niche diye gaye aasaan steps ko follow karke 2 minute mein apna e-Aadhaar PDF download kar sakte hain. Official Website Upar diye gaye orange color ke Download Now button par click karein. Enter Details Yahan aapke paas 3 option honge Aadhaar Number, Enrolment ID (EID), ya Virtual ID (VID). Apna 12-digit Aadhaar number dalein. Captcha Verification Screen par dikh raha security code (Captcha) dhyan se bharein. OTP Verification Send OTP button dabayein. Aapke registered mobile number par ek 6-digit ka OTP aayega. Verify Download OTP enter karein aur Verify Download par click karein. Aapka e-Aadhaar PDF format mein download ho jayega. e-Aadhaar PDF Password Kya Hota Hai? Bahut se log Aadhaar download to kar lete hain lekin PDF khul nahi pati kyunki wo password-protected hoti hai. Iska password bahut simple hota hai. Forgot your Aadhaar Number (UID) or Enrolment ID (EID)? Use your registered mobile number to get it back via SMS in seconds. Retrieve UID EID How to Retrieve Lost Aadhaar Number (UID) or Enrolment ID (EID) Have you lost your physical Aadhaar card and cannot remember your 12-digit Aadhaar number? Or perhaps you have applied for a new Aadhaar card but lost the acknowledgement slip containing the Enrolment ID (EID)? Do not worry. The Retrieve Aadhaar number EID SID service allows you to recover these details online instantly. This feature is a lifesaver for those who have misplaced their documents and need to download their e-Aadhaar urgent. By using this facility, your lost Aadhaar number or EID is sent directly to your registered mobile number. Important Prerequisite To use this online facility, your Mobile Number or Email ID MUST be registered and linked with your Aadhaar. If your mobile number is not linked, you cannot receive the OTP required for retrieval. Difference Between UID and EID Term Full Form Description UID Unique ID This is your final 12-digit Aadhaar Number . Select this if you already had a card. EID Enrolment ID This is the 28-digit number from your acknowledgement slip (for new applications). Step-by-Step Process to Retrieve Lost Aadhaar (UID) Visit the Official Portal Click on the Retrieve UID EID button above to open the official page. Select Retrieval Option Choose Aadhaar Number to find your main ID or Enrolment ID if you are tracking a new application. Enter Personal Details Enter your Full Name exactly as it is printed on your Aadhaar card. Enter Contact Info Captcha Enter your Registered Mobile Number or Email ID, fill the Captcha, and click Send OTP . Get SMS After OTP verification, your Aadhaar Number (UID) or EID will be sent to your mobile via SMS. Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs) Q Can I retrieve my Aadhaar if I don t have my mobile number? Ans No, the online facility works strictly via OTP. If your mobile is not linked, you must visit an Aadhaar Enrollment Center with your identity proof. Q Is there any fee for this service? Ans No, the Retrieve Aadhaar EID service is completely free of cost on the myAadhaar portal. Verify Mobile Email Not sure which mobile number is linked to your Aadhaar? Verify it instantly to ensure you receive OTPs for all government services. Verify Now How to Verify Mobile Number Email Linked with Aadhaar In today s digital India, your Registered Mobile Number is the key to accessing almost all Aadhaar services. Whether you want to download your e-Aadhaar, update your address online, or verify your ITR, the OTP (One Time Password) is sent to this linked number. However, people often change their SIM cards or forget which mobile number they gave at the time of enrollment years ago. The Verify Email Mobile service on the myAadhaar portal solves this confusion. It allows you to check if the mobile number or email ID you currently possess is the one linked to your Aadhaar database. ℹ Important Clarification This service does NOT show you the mobile number linked to your Aadhaar (for privacy reasons). Instead, YOU have to enter a mobile number, and the system will tell you if it matches the records or not. It is a verification tool, not a search tool. Step-by-Step Process to Verify Mobile Number Follow this simple procedure to confirm your linked contact details Access the Service Click on the green Verify Now button above. Select Verification Type You will see two options Verify Mobile Number and Verify Email Address . Select the one you want to check. Enter Details First, enter your 12-digit Aadhaar Number . Then, enter the Mobile Number (or Email) that you think is linked. Security Check Enter the Captcha code exactly as shown in the image box. Send OTP Click on the Send OTP button. Check the Result The system will display a success or error message based on your input (explained below). Understanding the Result Messages After submitting, you will see one of these two messages. Here is what they mean Scenario 1 Match Found (Success) The mobile number you have entered is already verified with our records. Meaning Congratulations! The mobile number you typed IS the one linked to your Aadhaar. You can receive OTPs on this number. Scenario 2 No Match (Failure) The mobile number you have entered does not match with our records. Meaning The number you typed is NOT linked. Either you linked a different family member s number, or an old number that you have lost. Why is this Verification Important? 1. Fraud Prevention Ensuring that no unknown mobile number or email is linked to your ID protects your biometric and demographic data. 2. Banking Services To link Aadhaar with a bank account or PAN card, the OTP validation is mandatory. Verifying ensures you are using the correct SIM. 3. Updates You cannot update your address or download Aadhaar online if you don t know which number receives the OTP. Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs) Q The system says Record not found . What should I do? Ans This means the mobile number you are entering is incorrect. Try entering mobile numbers of your family members. If none match, you must visit an Aadhaar Seva Kendra to check or update your number. Q Can I update my mobile number using this service? Ans No. This service is only for verification . To update or change your mobile number, biometric authentication is required, which can only be done offline at a center. Report Death Deactivate Aadhaar Secure the identity of your deceased family member. Officially report the death to UIDAI to prevent misuse of documents. Report Now How to Report Death of a Family Member for Aadhaar Deactivation The Aadhaar card is a unique identity proof that remains valid for a lifetime. However, in the unfortunate event of a family member s demise, it is the responsibility of the legal heir or guardian to inform the Unique Identification Authority of India (UIDAI). The Report death of a family member service allows you to officially flag an Aadhaar number for deactivation. This is a crucial step to ensure that the deceased person s identity documents are not misused for financial fraud, illegal SIM card issuance, or identity theft. Why is Deactivating Aadhaar Important? Many people often overlook this step, but keeping a deceased person s Aadhaar active can lead to several complications Prevent Misuse Scammers often look for dormant identities to open fake bank accounts or take loans. Subsidies Benefits To prevent the continued transfer of government benefits (like pensions) to a deceased person, which can later lead to legal recovery issues. Closure of Records It helps in closing other linked official documents like PAN Card and Voter ID systematically. Important Requirement To use this service, you MUST have a valid Death Certificate issued by the Registrar of Births and Deaths. The details on the Death Certificate must match the Aadhaar details of the deceased. Procedure to Report Death Online UIDAI has simplified the process by allowing family members to initiate this request via the myAadhaar portal. Follow these steps Login to Portal The reporting family member (Applicant) must login to the myAadhaar portal using their Own Aadhaar Number and OTP. You cannot login using the deceased person s Aadhaar. Select the Service On the dashboard, locate and click on the Report death of a family member card. Enter Details of Deceased Enter the 12-digit Aadhaar Number of the deceased family member. You may also need to provide their Name and Date of Birth as per records. Upload Document Upload a clear scanned copy (PDF JPG) of the Death Certificate . Ensure the file size is within the permissible limit (usually 2MB). Review Submit Verify all the details entered. Once submitted, you will receive a Service Request Number (SRN) to track the status. What Happens Next? (Verification) Reporting the death online does not instantly deactivate the Aadhaar. The request goes through a verification process 1. Registrar Verification The details are cross-verified with the birth and death registration records. 2. Deactivation Once verified, the UIDAI will permanently deactivate the Aadhaar number of the deceased. 3. Confirmation You can check the status using the Check deceased Aadhaar deactivation status service on the same portal. Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs) Q Can anyone report the death? Ans Usually, only immediate family members (spouse, children, parents) whose mobile numbers are linked or who can prove the relationship can initiate this request. Q Is it mandatory to deactivate Aadhaar after death? Ans While there is no strict penalty currently, it is highly recommended for safety and to close the financial and legal footprint of the deceased. Q Can I reactivate the Aadhaar later if reported by mistake? Ans No. Once an Aadhaar is marked as Deceased and deactivated after proper verification, it cannot be reactivated. Create a temporary 16-digit Virtual ID to use instead of your Aadhaar Number for authentication. Generate VID VID Generator Create Virtual ID to Hide Aadhaar Number Are you worried about sharing your 12-digit Aadhaar number everywhere? Do you want to protect your privacy while performing e-KYC? The Virtual ID (VID) is the solution. The VID Generator service allows you to create a temporary, revocable 16-digit random number mapped to your Aadhaar number. It can be used in lieu of your Aadhaar number for authentication services. This ensures your actual Aadhaar number remains hidden from the service provider. Privacy Feature When you use a VID, the agency (like a telecom operator or bank) cannot store your Aadhaar number. They only get a UID Token , which makes your data much more secure against leaks. Difference Aadhaar Number vs Virtual ID (VID) Feature Aadhaar Number (UID) Virtual ID (VID) Length 12 Digits (Permanent) 16 Digits (Temporary) Validity Lifetime valid Valid until you generate a new one Security Directly linked to biometric data Masks the actual Aadhaar number How to Generate or Retrieve VID Online You can generate a new VID or retrieve an existing one using the myAadhaar portal. Follow these steps Login to Portal Visit the myAadhaar dashboard by clicking the Generate VID button above. Select VID Generator Click on the VID Generator icon from the services menu. Choose Option You will see two options 1. Generate New VID If you want to create a fresh 16-digit number. 2. Retrieve Existing VID If you already generated one but forgot it. Confirm Receive Select your choice. Your 16-digit Virtual ID will be sent immediately to your Registered Mobile Number via SMS. Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs) Q Is VID accepted everywhere? Ans Yes, as per government regulations, all agencies (Banks, Telecom, Govt) must accept VID for authentication. Q What happens if I generate a new VID? Ans The moment you generate a new VID, your old VID gets automatically cancelled. You can only have one active VID at a time. Q Does VID expire? Ans No, a VID does not expire by itself. It remains valid until you choose to generate a new one. Lock Unlock Aadhaar Worried about identity theft? Temporarily Lock your Biometrics or Aadhaar Number instantly for maximum security. Secure Now Lock Unlock Aadhaar Secure Your Biometrics Instantly Security is a major concern for Aadhaar holders. What if someone gets hold of your Aadhaar number and tries to misuse it? To prevent unauthorized authentication, UIDAI provides a powerful feature Lock Unlock Aadhaar . This service allows you to temporarily Lock your UID (Aadhaar Number). Once locked, no one (not even you) can perform authentication using the Aadhaar number. It acts as a digital shield against identity theft. You can Unlock it whenever you need to use it. MUST READ BEFORE LOCKING Do not lock your Aadhaar without generating a Virtual ID (VID). Once your Aadhaar is locked, you CANNOT use your Aadhaar number to unlock it (because the number itself is locked). You will compulsorily need a 16-digit Virtual ID (VID) to perform the Unlock process. Difference Aadhaar Lock vs Biometric Lock Many people confuse these two services. Here is the difference Feature UID Lock (Aadhaar Lock) Biometric Lock What it blocks? Blocks ALL authentication (Demographic, Biometric, OTP). Blocks ONLY Fingerprint and Iris scan. OTP still works. How to use when locked? You must use Virtual ID (VID) . You must temporarily Unlock biometrics to use fingerprint iris. Security Level Highest (Total Lock) Medium (Protects Biometrics only) Step-by-Step Guide to LOCK Aadhaar Generate VID First As mentioned, ensure you have a valid VID. If not, use the VID Generator service first. Open Lock Service Click the Secure Now button above and select the Lock UID option. Enter Details Enter your 12-digit Aadhaar Number, Full Name, and Pin Code. Verify OTP Enter the security captcha and click Send OTP . Enter the OTP received on your mobile. Confirmation Your Aadhaar Number is now LOCKED. You will not be able to perform authentication using the UID anymore. Step-by-Step Guide to UNLOCK Aadhaar Select Unlock UID Go to the same service page and select the Unlock UID tab. Enter VID (Not Aadhaar Number) Here, you CANNOT enter your Aadhaar number. You must enter your 16-digit Virtual ID (VID) . Verify Unlock Enter the Captcha and OTP. Once verified, your Aadhaar number will be active again. Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs) Q Can I download e-Aadhaar if my UID is locked? Ans Yes, but you will have to use your Virtual ID (VID) to download it, as the Aadhaar number will not be accepted by the system. Q I forgot my VID and my Aadhaar is locked. What do I do? Check if your Aadhaar is successfully linked and mapped with your bank account for Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT). Check Status Bank Seeding Status Check Aadhaar-Bank Linking for DBT Many government schemes in India transfer money directly to beneficiaries bank accounts using the Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) system. This money is sent using the Aadhaar Payment Bridge (APB). For this to work, simply having a bank account is not enough. Your Aadhaar number must be seeded or mapped with that specific bank account in the NPCI (National Payments Corporation of India) database. The Bank Seeding Status service helps you check which of your bank accounts is currently linked to receive government funds. Why is Bank Seeding Essential? If your Bank Seeding Status is Inactive , you will NOT receive funds for PM Kisan Samman Nidhi LPG Gas Subsidy (PAHAL) Scholarships Pension Schemes (Old Age Widow) MNREGA Wages How to Check Bank Linking Status Online You can verify your current NPCI mapping status instantly through the myAadhaar portal. Follow these steps Login to Portal Click the Check Status button above and login using your Aadhaar Number OTP. Select Bank Seeding Status Locate and click on the Bank Seeding Status icon on the dashboard. View Result The system will display the Bank Name, Seeding Status (Active Inactive), and the Date of Linking. Understanding Your Status Result Status ACTIVE Your Aadhaar is successfully mapped. You are eligible to receive DBT funds in the mentioned bank account. Status INACTIVE Your mapping has been disabled or expired. You will NOT receive subsidies until you re-link it. My Status is Inactive Not Linked. How to Link? Note You CANNOT link your bank account to Aadhaar online via the UIDAI website. This must be done through your bank. Method 1 Visit Bank Branch (Recommended) Go to your bank branch, fill out the Aadhaar Seeding Form (DBT Mandate form), and attach a copy of your e-Aadhaar. Ask the official to Enable DBT specifically. Method 2 Net Banking Mobile App Some banks (like SBI, HDFC, ICICI, PNB) offer an option in their Net Banking App under Service Request Link Aadhaar Enable DBT . Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs) Q I have accounts in 3 banks. Which one will receive the money? Ans Government benefits are sent to the Last Seeded Bank Account . If you recently linked a new bank account, the money will start coming to that new account automatically. Q My bank says Aadhaar is linked (KYC done), but status shows Inactive. Why? Ans Linking for KYC and Linking for DBT are different. You must specifically ask the bank to Map Aadhaar to NPCI for DBT . Q How long does it take to update the status? Ans Once the bank processes your request, it usually takes 2-3 working days for the status to reflect on the myAadhaar portal. Track Your PVC Card Ordered your Aadhaar PVC Card? Track its printing and delivery status in real-time. Know exactly when it will reach your doorstep. Track Order Check Aadhaar PVC Card Order Status Track Delivery Have you recently ordered the new, durable Aadhaar PVC Card online by paying 50? If yes, you might be wondering when it will reach your home. The Check Aadhaar PVC card order status service allows you to track the progress of your printing request and its dispatch status. The entire process, from ordering to delivery, typically takes 5 to 15 working days . This tool helps you know exactly where your card is whether it is still printing or has been handed over to the post office. You Need Your SRN (Service Request Number) To check the status, you must have the 28-digit SRN . This number was generated when you successfully placed the order and paid the fees. It is available on the acknowledgement slip you downloaded. How to Check PVC Order Status Online Follow these simple steps to track your application Open the Tool Click on the Track Order button above. Enter SRN Enter the 28-digit Service Request Number (SRN) carefully. Security Check Type the Captcha code shown on the screen. Submit Click on Submit . The system will verify your request and display the current status. Understanding the Status Meanings Payment Successful Your order has been received by UIDAI. In Process Your data has been sent for printing. Dispatched Your card has been printed and handed over to India Post. (This is the most important status). How to Track via India Post (Speed Post) Once the status shows Dispatched , the portal will display an Airway Bill Number (AWB) . This is your tracking ID. Copy the Airway Bill Number (AWB). Visit the India Post Tracking website (indiapost.gov.in). Enter the AWB number in the Consignment Number field. You will see the exact location of your card and the expected delivery date. Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs) Q I lost my SRN. How can I check the status? Ans If you lost the SRN, check your SMS history for messages from UIDAI. Or check the Payment History section if you were logged in. Q The status says Dispatched but I haven t received it yet. Ans Delivery speed depends on India Post services. Use the Airway Bill Number to track it on the India Post website for real-time updates. Check Aadhaar Status Applied for a new Aadhaar or updated details? Track your application status in real-time using your Enrolment ID (EID) or URN. Check Status Check Aadhaar Enrolment Update Status Online Have you recently applied for a new Aadhaar card? Or have you updated your Name, Address, or Date of Birth at an Aadhaar Center? If yes, you don t need to visit the center again to know if your request is processed. The Check Enrolment Update Status service allows you to track your application in real-time. Whether you did the update online (via myAadhaar portal) or offline (at a Seva Kendra), you can track it here. Which Number Do You Need for Tracking? Depending on how you applied, you will have one of the following numbers 1. Enrolment ID (EID) Found on the top of the Acknowledgement Slip given at the Aadhaar Center. It contains 14-digit Enrolment No. 14-digit Date Time. 2. Service Request Number (SRN) Generated when you initiate an Online Update (like Address or Document Update) on the myAadhaar portal. It starts with S . 3. Update Request Number (URN) Generated via SMS if you updated details using the Self Service Update Portal (SSUP) in the past. How to Enter EID Correctly (Very Important) Most users fail to check status because they enter the EID incorrectly. The 28-digit EID is a combination of the Enrolment Number and Timestamp. Format Enrolment Number Year Month Day Time Example If slip says Date 15 08 2024, Time 14 30 55, Enrolment 1234 56789 01234 Enter like this 12345678901234 20240815 143055 (Notice the Date is reversed YYYY-MM-DD). Step-by-Step Tracking Process Follow these steps to know your current status Open the Tool Click on the Check Status button above. Enter ID Type your EID (28 digits), SRN, or URN in the box provided. Ensure there are no spaces or slashes. Security Check Enter the Captcha code exactly as shown. Submit Click Submit . The status will appear on the screen. What Does Your Status Mean? In Process Your application is still being verified by the backend team. This usually takes 5-30 days. Completed Congratulations! Your update is successful. You can now Download Aadhaar to see the changes. Rejected Your request was declined. This usually happens due to wrong documents or data mismatch. You will have to apply again. Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs) Q I lost my Acknowledgement Slip. How can I get my EID? Ans You can use the Retrieve EID UID service to get your Enrolment ID on your registered mobile number. Q How many days does it take to update Aadhaar? Ans As per UIDAI guidelines, up to 90 of updates are processed within 30 days. However, in some cases, it can take up to 90 days. Q Status shows Completed but I didn t get the card by post. Ans Completed means the data is updated online. The physical letter delivery takes extra time. You can download the e-Aadhaar immediately. Check Deceased Aadhaar Deactivation Status Once you have formally reported the death of a family member to UIDAI for Aadhaar deactivation, it is important to verify if the request has been processed. The Check Deceased Aadhaar Deactivation Status service allows legal heirs or guardians to track the progress of their application. Deactivating the Aadhaar of a deceased person is a critical step to prevent identity fraud and ensure that government records are updated accurately. Requirement You will need the Service Request Number (SRN) that was generated when you submitted the Report Death request. How to Track Deactivation Request Access the Tool Click on the Check Deceased Aadhaar Deactivation Status card on the myAadhaar dashboard. Enter SRN Input the 28-digit Service Request Number provided during the reporting process. Captcha Enter the security code displayed on the screen. View Status The system will show whether the request is Pending Verification , Approved (Deactivated), or Rejected (due to document mismatch). One Login, Many Services Access all Aadhaar services with a single secure login. Use your SSO ID or try our new Face Authentication feature for instant access without a password. Secure 256-bit Encryption Biometric Face Auth Supported Access Document Update Status Manage Family Profiles SSO Portal Login SSO ID User ID Password Use your camera to scan your face or upload a photo for verification. Click to Scan Face Upload Photo Supports JPG PNG (Max 5MB) Forgot Password? Create New Account What is SSO ID? (Single Sign-On Login) SSO (Single Sign-On) ek aisa digital authentication system hai jo users ko sirf ek ID aur Password ke zariye kai saari sarkari aur private websites par login karne ki suvidha deta hai. Chahe wo Aadhaar Card Download ho, Ration Card ki jankari ho, ya Jan Aadhaar portal SSO Login se sab kuch ek jagah manage hota hai. Bharat mein digital services badhne ke saath, SSO ID Login ab har nagarik ke liye zaroori ho gaya hai. Is portal par aap apne Aadhaar number ya Face Auth ka upyog karke securely login kar sakte hain. New Update Ab aap bina password yaad rakhe, seedhe apne Chehre (Face Auth) ya Biometric se SSO Login kar sakte hain. SSO ID Registration Account Kaise Banayein? Agar aapke paas abhi tak SSO ID nahi hai, to aap niche diye gaye steps follow karke apna naya account register kar sakte hain Upar diye gaye SSO Login box mein Create New Account par click karein. Apna 12-digit Aadhaar Number enter karein. Aapke registered mobile par ek OTP aayega, use verify karein. Apna manpasand SSO User ID aur Password set karein. Registration complete hone par aap turant login kar sakte hain. Benefits of SSO Portal (SSO Ke Fayde) All-in-One Access Ek hi login se 100 services ka labh uthayein. Recover Forgotten Password Agar password bhool gaye, to Aadhaar OTP se reset karein. High Security Two-factor authentication (2FA) aur Identity verification. SSO Login FAQs Q Main apna SSO ID Password bhool gaya hun, kya karun? Ans Aap Forgot Password link par click karke apne registered mobile number ya Aadhaar OTP ke zariye apna password reset kar sakte hain. Q Kya SSO Login ke liye Aadhaar zaroori hai? Ans Haan, security verification ke liye Aadhaar card number ya Jan Aadhaar ID ka hona anivarya hai. Q SSO ID se main kaunsi services use kar sakta hun? Ans Aap Aadhaar PVC order, Address Update, Scholarship forms, Job applications, aur Electricity bill payment jaisi suvidhayein use kar sakte hain.

Government Services Verified 21 Jul 2026 Share Bihar Khatiyan Kaise Nikale 2026 - Apna Khata Khesra Online Dekho biharbhumi (Free, 5 Min) A By Abhishek Govt Services Documentation Guide 3 min read Updated 21 July 2026 Free Bihar Bhumi 5 min Summary Documents Full Guide Links 30-SECOND SUMMARY Bihar khatiyan (purana land record RoR) kaise nikale 2026 - biharbhumi.bihar.gov.in pe 'Apna Khata Dekhein' se district anchal mauza chuno, fir khata number, khesra number, ya naam se search karo, khatiyan PDF download print karo. Bilkul free. Khatiyan vs jamabandi vs rasid ka farak bhi clear. Guide Overview Category Government Services Portal Bihar Bhumi Estimated Time 5 min Fee Free Complete Guide Bhaiyon, apni zameen ka khatiyan (Record of Rights purana land record) online nikalna hai? Bihar me ye bilkul free aur ghar baithe ho jaata hai - biharbhumi.bihar.gov.in pe "Apna Khata Dekhein" service se. Pehle ek confusion clear khatiyan purana survey-record jo ownership possession dikhata hai (frozen) jamabandi abhi ka updated record (har dakhil-kharij ke baad badalta hai) rasid lagan tax receipt. Teeno alag hain. Khatiyan nikalne ka poora step-by-step neeche. Khatiyan Kaise Nikale (Step-by-Step) biharbhumi.bihar.gov.in kholo "अपना खाता देखें Apna Khata Dekhein" pe click karo Bihar ke naqsche pe apna District (जिला) chuno Anchal Circle (अंचल CO) chuno Mauza (मौजा gaon) dropdown ya alphabet se chuno In me se kisi ek se search karo Khata number (खाता संख्या) Khesra number (खेसरा plot) Khatadhari ka naam (मालिक ka naam) ya poore mauza ki list dekho "खाता देखें Dekhein" record khulega "देखें print" se khatiyan PDF download print karo (free) Khatiyan vs Jamabandi vs Rasid (Confusion Clear) Cheez Kya Hai Khatiyan One-time survey Record of Rights (CS RS) - frozen, update nahi hota possession rights dikhata hai Jamabandi (Register-II) Current RoR - har mutation (dakhil-kharij) ke baad update "Jamabandi Panji Dekhein" service Khesra Ek single plot ka ID Khata Ek malik ke plots ka account grouping Rasid Lagan tax receipt - "Bhu-Lagan" service se ( guide ) Dhyan Khatiyan ownership ka proof-support hai par akela title deed nahi . Registry dispute me current jamabandi registered deed bhi lagte hain. FAQs Q Bihar khatiyan online kaise nikale? A biharbhumi.bihar.gov.in pe "Apna Khata Dekhein" district anchal mauza chuno khata khesra naam se search PDF download. Free. Q Khatiyan nikalne ki fee kitni hai? A Bilkul free - biharbhumi portal pe khata khatiyan dekhna aur print karna nishulk hai. Q Khata number nahi pata to? A Khatadhari (malik) ke naam se ya poore mauza ki list se dhundh sakte ho - naam wale option se search karo. Q Khatiyan aur jamabandi me kya farak hai? A Khatiyan purana survey RoR (frozen) Jamabandi current record jo har mutation pe update hota hai. Dono biharbhumi pe alag services hain. Q Khatiyan aur rasid ek hi cheez hai? A Nahi - khatiyan ownership record rasid lagan tax receipt (Bhu-Lagan service). Alag intents. Q Khatiyan se zameen ki registry ho jayegi? A Khatiyan ownership-support hai par akela kaafi nahi - registry me current jamabandi registered deed documents list chahiye. Q Online khatiyan legal maany hai? A Reference verification ke liye theek hai - legal use ke liye anchal office se certified copy lena behtar hota hai. Q Mobile se khatiyan nikal sakte hain? A Haan - biharbhumi.bihar.gov.in mobile browser pe bhi khulta hai wahi steps. Ye Bhi Zaroor Padhein LPC Full Form Apply - Land Possession Certificate - loan registry me lagta hai Bihar Jamin Rashid Online Nikale - lagan receipt Jamin Registry Documents List - registry ke papers Dakhil Kharij (Mutation) Online - naam transfer Bihar Bhumi Survey Documents Form - survey ke kaagaz Bhulekh Bhu-Naksha Guide - naksha records Source Bihar Bhumi portal (biharbhumi.bihar.gov.in) - "Apna Khata Dekhein" se khatiyan free khatiyan (survey RoR) vs jamabandi (current) vs rasid (lagan) distinct. Legal use ke liye anchal se certified copy. Bhaiyon, apni zameen ke kaagaz khud dekhna seekho - dalaal ko paisa dene ki zaroorat nahi, 5 minute me ghar baithe khatiyan nikal jaata hai!
