documents: HOME NEWS NEET-UG 2026 Re-Test Mein 11.21 Lakh Candidates Qualify Mahilayen Shamil Hain Sabse Zyada - 2026 NEET-UG 2026 re-examination ke results declare ho gaye. 11.21 lakh candidates qualify hue hain. Mahila candidates ne 58 qualify kiye hain aur men se zyada performance di hai. E Editorial Team Published on 17 Jul 2026 Follow Advertisement html Rahe-Rahe Hindustaan mein ek badi khabar sun ne ke liye aagaye hain! National Testing Agency (NTA) ne NEET-UG 2026 re-test ke natijon ka ilan kar diya hai aur is baar 11.21 lakh candidates qualify ho gaye hain. Sabse dilchasp baat yeh hai ki is baar mahilayen hi sabse zyada number mein pass hui hain aur ladkiyon ka performance ladkon se kaafi behtar raha. 17 July 2026 ko NTA ne yeh results release kiye hain aur ab sari duniya ke liye golden opportunity ban gayi hai medical colleges mein admission lene ki. Iss lakh se zyada successful candidates ab agle mukhtalif rounds mein bhaag lenge aur iska matlab hai ki india mein medical education ka ek naya doorish yatra shuru hone wala hai. Poori Khabar Kya Hai? NEET-UG 2026 re-test mein 11.21 lakh candidates successful hon kar nikle hain aur yeh ek record-breaking achievement rahi hai. Jab NEET exam hold kiya gaya tha to kai controversies aur issues ke wajah se re-test karna pad gaya tha. Ab jo results aagaye hain, unmein women candidates ka performance ekdum shuddh aur impressive raha hai. Mahilayen na sirf pass hi nahi hui hain balki unme se kai toh top ranks tak bhi pahunch gayi hain. Yeh baat kaafi important hai kyunki education mein gender equality ko lekar hamara desh hamisha aware rehta hai aur yeh results uska proof hain ki ladkiyon mein talant aur capability kitni zyada hai. National Testing Agency ne poore exam process ko bhot carefully organize kiya tha. Re-test se pehle kai sareefi steps the jismein centers ko ready kiya gaya, invigilators ko training di gayi aur security measures ko strict banaya gaya. Exam ke dauran technology ka bhot zyada istimal kiya gaya taaki cheating ka koi scene na bane aur fair evaluation ho sake. NTA ke senior officials ne separately check kiya ki har center par proper guidelines follow ho rahi hain ya nahi. Jab results come kar nikle to lakho students ke gharon mein khushiyan aa gayin aur unke parents ko apne beton-beton ki mehnat ka fal mil gaya. NEET exam essentially national level ka sabse bada medical entrance test hai aur isse har saal lakho students participate karte hain. 2026 mein jo re-test tha vo kai reasons se hua tha lekin ab final results aa gaye hain to students ko ek confidence milti hai ki unka hard work sweekar hua hai. 11.21 lakh candidates qualify karna matlab hai ki bahut bade scale par selection process ho raha hai. Inme se har ek candidate kisi na kisi medical college mein seat paana chahta hai aur government plus private donon hi medical institutions mein competition bhot zyada hai. Isliye rank list kuch zyada important ho jaati hai kyunki better rank matlab better college, aur better college matlab better future. Mahilayen jo sabse zyada qualify hui hain, yeh trend kaafi positive hai Indian medical education ke liye. Agar hum past years ko dekhen to women participation mein continuous increase dekha gaya hai NEET exams mein. Ab jo 2026 mein yeh pattern strongly dikhai de raha hai to samajh aata hai ki girls apni padhai ko lekar kitni serious hain aur unka dedication bhot impressive hai. Medical field mein women doctors ki zarorat bhi bahut hai kyunki kai situations mein female patients ko female doctor se check-up karana comfortable milta hai. Isliye yeh results sirf statistics nahi hain, balki society ke liye positive change laane wale hain. Key Highlights Total Qualified Candidates 11.21 lakh students ne NEET-UG 2026 re-test mein successfully qualify kiya hai Women Candidates Outshining Mahilayen sabse zyada number mein pass hui hain aur unka overall performance males se better raha Result Release Date National Testing Agency ne 17 July 2026 ko official results announce kiye Rank-Wise Distribution Qualified candidates ke rank list base par unhe medical colleges allocate kiye jayenge Fair Evaluation Process Re-test mein strict security measures aur proper examination protocols follow kiye gaye Multiple Round Admissions Qualified students ab agle rounds mein bhaag lenge jismein seat allocation hogi NEET Significance Yeh exam India mein medical aur dental course ke liye sabse important gate-keeper exam hai Counselling Process Upcoming Results ke baad counselling schedule announce hoga jismein students apna college choose karenge Advertisement Kisko Milega Fayda? NEET-UG 2026 re-test ke results se sabse pehla fayda obviously qualified 11.21 lakh candidates ko milega. Har ek qualified student ab agle rounds of counselling mein participate kar sakte hain aur unhe medical colleges mein seat milne ka mauka hain. Jo ladkiyan specially qualified hui hain, unhe reserved seats plus general seats both se opportunity hain. Plus unka performance itna behtar hai ki wo merit-based admissions bhi easily le sakte hain. Students jo PwD (Person with Disability) category mein hain unhe separate provisions aur separate quota hain which is extremely beneficial. Chhote chote towns aur rural areas se jo students qualify hue hain unhe government colleges mein seats milna practically possible bana diya gaya hai National Eligibility Examination ke through. Mahilayen ko ye results se special fayda milega kyunki unka performance clearly better nikla hai. Medical field mein women ki presence badane se society ko positive impact padne wala hai. Jo girls coming generations mein hain wo ab dekh sakti hain ki women doctors kaise successful hain aur inspire ho sakte hain. Government ne jo women-friendly policies aur scholarships provide ki hain, qualified female candidates unhe access le sakte hain. Reserved seats mein unhe priority milegi aur seats allocation process mein unka preference bhi consider hoga. Private medical colleges bhi top female candidates ko scholarship offer kar sakte hain kyunki competition among colleges bhi hota hai best students ke liye. Medical colleges ko bhi fayda milega kyunki qualified candidates ka large pool available hai selection ke liye. Colleges ab better quality ke students select kar sakte hain aur apne institutions ko strong bana sakte hain. Government ke through ye vision achieve hona possible tha kyunki NTA ne fair examination conduct kiya aur proper evaluation process follow kiya. States ke through jo norms hain counselling ke liye, wo bhi implement ho rahe hain smoothly. Parents aur families ko bhi khushi milti hai jab unke children qualify karte hain kyunki medical education mein investment bahut hota hai aur result positive aane se sab ke efforts pay off hote hain. Society ko bhi fayda hoga kyunki more doctors ka matlab better healthcare infrastructure aur accessible medical services. Zaroori Dates aur Timeline Event Date Timeline Details NEET-UG 2026 Re-Test Conducted Earlier in 2026 Re-examination held across multiple centers nationwide Official Results Announcement 17 July 2026 NTA officially released results with 11.21 lakh qualified candidates Result Verification Period Post 17 July 2026 Students can verify their scores and raise objections if any Counselling Schedule To be announced by NTA States Detailed counselling dates and process information coming soon Seat Allocation Round 1 As per state notification First round of merit-based seat allocation across colleges Choice Filling and Locking Scheduled by states Students select colleges and courses as per preference Final Seat Allocation Later rounds (dates TBD) Multiple rounds of allocation till most seats filled College Reporting and Registration After final allocation Students report to allotted colleges and complete registration Sarkar Vibhag ka Aadhikarik Bayaan National Testing Agency (NTA) ne apne official statement mein kaha ki NEET-UG 2026 re-test process poori transparency aur fairness se conduct kiya gaya tha. Re-examination conduct karte waqt sabhi safety protocols aur examination guidelines strictly follow kiye gaye. NTA ke director ne press meet mein bataya ki qualified candidates mein se mahilayen ka performance exceptional raha hai aur yeh National Education Policy 2020 ke vision ke according hai. Sabhi state governments ko instruction de diye gaye hain ki counselling process jaldi se jaldi start karo aur students ko transparent information provide karo. Government Medical Colleges aur Dental Colleges mein recruitment ke liye jo process hai, wo properly implemented hona chahiye. NTA ne confirm kiya ki rank list public hone ke baad students unhe neeche likhi websites par dekh sakte hain aur kisi bhi discrepancy ke liye objection raise kar sakte hain. Advertisement Important Details at a Glance Parameter Information Total Qualified Candidates 11.21 lakh (11,21,000) Exam Name NEET-UG 2026 Re-Test Conducting Authority National Testing Agency (NTA) Results Release Date 17 July 2026 Top Performers Women candidates outshined male candidates Admission Target MBBS and BDS courses across India Counselling Mode State-wise and national level (details awaited) Seat Allocation Merit-based with special categories and reservations Official Website nta.ac.in (for NTA information) Aage Kya Hoga? NEET results ke baad jab counselling start hogi to har qualified student ko carefully decide karna hoga ki unhe kaun sa college aur kaun sa course choose karna hai. Pehla step hoga counselling ke liye registration karna jo har state mein alag-alag dates ho sakte hain. Registration ke baad students ko apne preferences fill karni hongi colleges aur courses ke according. Preferences fill karte waqt bahut soch-samajh se decision lena chahiye kyunki early rounds mein jab seat allocate hogi to jo college top choice mein likha hai woh prefer hoga. Second round, third round aur sometimes fourth round tak allocation continue rehti hai. Har round mein jo seats vacant rahe hote hain unhe fill kiya jata hai aur new candidates ko allocate kiya jata hai. Final round ke baad which college aur course mil gaya, utne mein student ko settle karna padta hai. Counselling complete hone ke baad jo students ko seats mil jayengi unhe immediately college report karna hoga aur registration process complete karna hoga. College mein reporting ke dauran various documents verify kiye jayenge jaise 10th aur 12th certificates, caste certificate (agar applicable ho), PwD certificate aur aisa hi aur documents. Phir fees payment karna padti hai aur course mein admission final ho jata hai. First year medical course ka syllabus bhot extensive aur tough hota hai isliye joining ke baad padhna par full concentration dena padta hai. College life mein competitive environment hota hai aur har student apne aap ko prove karne ki koshish karti hai. Jo students this time qualify nahi ho paye hain unke liye alternative path bhi hote hain. Private medical colleges mein management quota through seats available hote hain lekin fees bhot zyada hota hai. Do-three saal baad phir NEET exam hold hoga aur wo dobara attempt kar sakte hain. Abroad se padai karna bhi option hai kaafi students ke liye lekin visa aur fees ke liye resources zaroori hote hain. NEET ke marks ke base par allopathy ke siwa Ayurveda, Homeopathy, Unani jaise courses mein bhi admission possible hai kai colleges mein. Nursing courses mein seats available hote hain aur woh bhi medical field mein career bana sakte hain. Counselling notifications aur official updates regular check karna zaroori hai kyunki sometimes seat allocation mein changes hote hain aur students ko update rehni chahiye. Aksar Pooche Jaane Wale Sawaal Q NEET-UG 2026 mein total kitne candidates qualify hue hain? A National Testing Agency ne announce kiya hai ki NEET-UG 2026 re-test mein 11.21 lakh (11,21,000) candidates successfully qualify kiye hain. Yeh ek bahut badi sankhya hai aur iska matlab hai ki medical colleges ko admission ke liye kaafi qualified students available hain. Q Mahilayen ne NEET 2026 mein acha performance kyun kiya? A Results dikha rahe hain ki mahilayen ne male candidates se better performance kiya hai. Ladkiyon ke level of commitment aur padhai mein dedication zyada impressive dekha gaya. Plus counseling aur academic support programs ne bhi ladkiyon ko boost diya. Society mein bhi women education ko lekar jo awareness aayi hai, woh positive effect dikha raha hai. Q Results ke baad kya next steps hain students ke liye? A Results aane ke baad students ko counselling registration karna hoga. Phir preference fill karna hoga, then seat allocation hogi multiple rounds mein. Final allocation ke baad college mein reporting karna hoga aur registration process complete karna hoga. Saari details official NTA aur state counselling websites par available rahti hain. Q Agar kisi ko seat nahi mila pehle round mein to kya hoga? A Counselling mein multiple rounds hote hain aur har round mein new seats available aate hain. Agar pehle round mein seat nahi mila to student dusre round ke liye eligible rehta hai. Plus spot counselling bhi hoti hai jo last-minute seats fill karne ke liye. Agar sara process mein seat nahi mile to private colleges ya agle saal ka attempt option hota hai. Q Women candidates ke liye kya special provisions hain NEET counselling mein? A Har state mein women candidates ke liye special seats hote hain aur reserved categories mein seats hote hain. Plus scholarship schemes available hote hain. Counselling process mein preference selection mein flexibility hoti hai aur women-centric policies apply hote hain. Hostel facilities bhi ensure kiye jate hain. Advertisement Closing Thoughts NEET-UG 2026 ke results se lakho students ke dreams ko ek naya direction mil gaya hai aur medical field mein unka entry confirm ho gaya. Mahilayon ka exceptional performance yeh dikha deta hai ki talent kisi bhi gender ke paas ho sakta hai aur dedication se sab kuch possible hai. Ab qualified students ko apne college selection ke liye soch-samajh se decision lena chahiye aur counselling process ko seriously lena chahiye kyunki medical degree sirf ek paper nahi hai, balki samaj ke liye responsibility le kar aate ho. Sabhi students ko advice hai ki official NTA website (nta.ac.in) par regular check karte rahein taaki latest announcements miss na ho jayein. Counselling ke process ko detail se samajhein aur sahi decisions lein. Medical education tough hota hai lekin rewarding bhi bhot hota hai. Doctors bankar society ko serve karna ek noble profession hai aur har qualified candidate ko is responsibility ko samajh kar age badna chahiye. Bhir kam nahi hui Parliament Street ke paas jab CJP ka jamavda kam nahi hua, to Rapid Action Force (RAF) ne bhir ko tittar-bittar karne ke liye tear gas ka istemal kiya. Ye tear gas visuals dekhte hi dekhte social media par tehalka macha diya, aur ghanton tak trending rahe. Dhuen bhare visuals ne machaya tehalka Video footage mein saaf dikha ki dhuen ke bade-bade gubbaar Parliament Street ke aas-paas fail gaye the. Protesters, jinme students aur senior citizens dono shamil the, apni aankhein malte hue bhi wahin date rahe. In tear gas visuals ne dikhaya ki andolan ka josh itni aasani se toota nahi. Multi-tiered security lockdown Tear gas ke bawajood bhir Parliament ke iron gates tak pahunchne ki koshish karti rahi. Security personnel ne physically gates ko secure kiya hua tha, aur ek multi-tiered lockdown system laागू kiya gaya tha taaki koi bhi group आगे na badh sake. Isके bawajood barricades kai jagah toड़e gaye. Ground par log kya keh rahe the Meerut se aaye ek 21 saal ke student, Adi Nathan, ne media ko bataya ki wo isliye protest kar rahe hain kyunki wo nahi chahte ki question papers baar-baar leak hon. Aise hi hazaron youth is tear gas ke bawajood dat kar khade rahe, jo dikhata hai ki unka gussa kitna deep-rooted hai. Police aur sarkar ka pakshh Delhi Police ka kehna hai ki protest ko professionally handle kiya ja raha tha, jabki television footage mein cane charges bhi dikhe. Tear gas ka istemal is pure ghatnakram ka sabse charchit hissa raha, jise videos aur photos ke through poore desh ne dekha. Ek baar phir bahas chhida Is ghatna ne ek baar phir Delhi mein protest aur police karyawahi ko lekar bahas chhed di hai. Kya tear gas jaisa force zaroori tha, ya ise avoid kiya ja sakta tha ye sawal media aur Rajya Sabha dono jagah goonja. Table of Contents Toggle

Retrieve UID EID How to Retrieve Lost Aadhaar Number (UID) or Enrolment ID (EID) Have you lost your physical Aadhaar card and cannot remember your 12-digit Aadhaar number? Or perhaps you have applied for a new Aadhaar card but lost the acknowledgement slip containing the Enrolment ID (EID)? Do not worry. The Retrieve Aadhaar number EID SID service allows you to recover these details online instantly. This feature is a lifesaver for those who have misplaced their documents and need to download their e-Aadhaar urgent. By using this facility, your lost Aadhaar number or EID is sent directly to your registered mobile number. Important Prerequisite To use this online facility, your Mobile Number or Email ID MUST be registered and linked with your Aadhaar. If your mobile number is not linked, you cannot receive the OTP required for retrieval. Difference Between UID and EID Term Full Form Description UID Unique ID This is your final 12-digit Aadhaar Number . Select this if you already had a card. EID Enrolment ID This is the 28-digit number from your acknowledgement slip (for new applications). Step-by-Step Process to Retrieve Lost Aadhaar (UID) Visit the Official Portal Click on the Retrieve UID EID button above to open the official page. Select Retrieval Option Choose Aadhaar Number to find your main ID or Enrolment ID if you are tracking a new application. Enter Personal Details Enter your Full Name exactly as it is printed on your Aadhaar card. Enter Contact Info Captcha Enter your Registered Mobile Number or Email ID, fill the Captcha, and click Send OTP . Get SMS After OTP verification, your Aadhaar Number (UID) or EID will be sent to your mobile via SMS. Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs) Q Can I retrieve my Aadhaar if I don t have my mobile number? Ans No, the online facility works strictly via OTP. If your mobile is not linked, you must visit an Aadhaar Enrollment Center with your identity proof. Q Is there any fee for this service? Ans No, the Retrieve Aadhaar EID service is completely free of cost on the myAadhaar portal. Verify Mobile Email Not sure which mobile number is linked to your Aadhaar? Verify it instantly to ensure you receive OTPs for all government services. Verify Now How to Verify Mobile Number Email Linked with Aadhaar In today s digital India, your Registered Mobile Number is the key to accessing almost all Aadhaar services. Whether you want to download your e-Aadhaar, update your address online, or verify your ITR, the OTP (One Time Password) is sent to this linked number. However, people often change their SIM cards or forget which mobile number they gave at the time of enrollment years ago. The Verify Email Mobile service on the myAadhaar portal solves this confusion. It allows you to check if the mobile number or email ID you currently possess is the one linked to your Aadhaar database. ℹ Important Clarification This service does NOT show you the mobile number linked to your Aadhaar (for privacy reasons). Instead, YOU have to enter a mobile number, and the system will tell you if it matches the records or not. It is a verification tool, not a search tool. Step-by-Step Process to Verify Mobile Number Follow this simple procedure to confirm your linked contact details Access the Service Click on the green Verify Now button above. Select Verification Type You will see two options Verify Mobile Number and Verify Email Address . Select the one you want to check. Enter Details First, enter your 12-digit Aadhaar Number . Then, enter the Mobile Number (or Email) that you think is linked. Security Check Enter the Captcha code exactly as shown in the image box. Send OTP Click on the Send OTP button. Check the Result The system will display a success or error message based on your input (explained below). Understanding the Result Messages After submitting, you will see one of these two messages. Here is what they mean Scenario 1 Match Found (Success) The mobile number you have entered is already verified with our records. Meaning Congratulations! The mobile number you typed IS the one linked to your Aadhaar. You can receive OTPs on this number. Scenario 2 No Match (Failure) The mobile number you have entered does not match with our records. Meaning The number you typed is NOT linked. Either you linked a different family member s number, or an old number that you have lost. Why is this Verification Important? 1. Fraud Prevention Ensuring that no unknown mobile number or email is linked to your ID protects your biometric and demographic data. 2. Banking Services To link Aadhaar with a bank account or PAN card, the OTP validation is mandatory. Verifying ensures you are using the correct SIM. 3. Updates You cannot update your address or download Aadhaar online if you don t know which number receives the OTP. Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs) Q The system says Record not found . What should I do? Ans This means the mobile number you are entering is incorrect. Try entering mobile numbers of your family members. If none match, you must visit an Aadhaar Seva Kendra to check or update your number. Q Can I update my mobile number using this service? Ans No. This service is only for verification . To update or change your mobile number, biometric authentication is required, which can only be done offline at a center. Report Death Deactivate Aadhaar Secure the identity of your deceased family member. Officially report the death to UIDAI to prevent misuse of documents. Report Now How to Report Death of a Family Member for Aadhaar Deactivation The Aadhaar card is a unique identity proof that remains valid for a lifetime. However, in the unfortunate event of a family member s demise, it is the responsibility of the legal heir or guardian to inform the Unique Identification Authority of India (UIDAI). The Report death of a family member service allows you to officially flag an Aadhaar number for deactivation. This is a crucial step to ensure that the deceased person s identity documents are not misused for financial fraud, illegal SIM card issuance, or identity theft. Why is Deactivating Aadhaar Important? Many people often overlook this step, but keeping a deceased person s Aadhaar active can lead to several complications Prevent Misuse Scammers often look for dormant identities to open fake bank accounts or take loans. Subsidies Benefits To prevent the continued transfer of government benefits (like pensions) to a deceased person, which can later lead to legal recovery issues. Closure of Records It helps in closing other linked official documents like PAN Card and Voter ID systematically. Important Requirement To use this service, you MUST have a valid Death Certificate issued by the Registrar of Births and Deaths. The details on the Death Certificate must match the Aadhaar details of the deceased. Procedure to Report Death Online UIDAI has simplified the process by allowing family members to initiate this request via the myAadhaar portal. Follow these steps Login to Portal The reporting family member (Applicant) must login to the myAadhaar portal using their Own Aadhaar Number and OTP. You cannot login using the deceased person s Aadhaar. Select the Service On the dashboard, locate and click on the Report death of a family member card. Enter Details of Deceased Enter the 12-digit Aadhaar Number of the deceased family member. You may also need to provide their Name and Date of Birth as per records. Upload Document Upload a clear scanned copy (PDF JPG) of the Death Certificate . Ensure the file size is within the permissible limit (usually 2MB). Review Submit Verify all the details entered. Once submitted, you will receive a Service Request Number (SRN) to track the status. What Happens Next? (Verification) Reporting the death online does not instantly deactivate the Aadhaar. The request goes through a verification process 1. Registrar Verification The details are cross-verified with the birth and death registration records. 2. Deactivation Once verified, the UIDAI will permanently deactivate the Aadhaar number of the deceased. 3. Confirmation You can check the status using the Check deceased Aadhaar deactivation status service on the same portal. Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs) Q Can anyone report the death? Ans Usually, only immediate family members (spouse, children, parents) whose mobile numbers are linked or who can prove the relationship can initiate this request. Q Is it mandatory to deactivate Aadhaar after death? Ans While there is no strict penalty currently, it is highly recommended for safety and to close the financial and legal footprint of the deceased. Q Can I reactivate the Aadhaar later if reported by mistake? Ans No. Once an Aadhaar is marked as Deceased and deactivated after proper verification, it cannot be reactivated. Generate VID VID Generator Create Virtual ID to Hide Aadhaar Number Are you worried about sharing your 12-digit Aadhaar number everywhere? Do you want to protect your privacy while performing e-KYC? The Virtual ID (VID) is the solution. The VID Generator service allows you to create a temporary, revocable 16-digit random number mapped to your Aadhaar number. It can be used in lieu of your Aadhaar number for authentication services. This ensures your actual Aadhaar number remains hidden from the service provider. Privacy Feature When you use a VID, the agency (like a telecom operator or bank) cannot store your Aadhaar number. They only get a UID Token , which makes your data much more secure against leaks. Difference Aadhaar Number vs Virtual ID (VID) Feature Aadhaar Number (UID) Virtual ID (VID) Length 12 Digits (Permanent) 16 Digits (Temporary) Validity Lifetime valid Valid until you generate a new one Security Directly linked to biometric data Masks the actual Aadhaar number How to Generate or Retrieve VID Online You can generate a new VID or retrieve an existing one using the myAadhaar portal. Follow these steps Login to Portal Visit the myAadhaar dashboard by clicking the Generate VID button above. Select VID Generator Click on the VID Generator icon from the services menu. Choose Option You will see two options 1. Generate New VID If you want to create a fresh 16-digit number. 2. Retrieve Existing VID If you already generated one but forgot it. Confirm Receive Select your choice. Your 16-digit Virtual ID will be sent immediately to your Registered Mobile Number via SMS. Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs) Q Is VID accepted everywhere? Ans Yes, as per government regulations, all agencies (Banks, Telecom, Govt) must accept VID for authentication. Q What happens if I generate a new VID? Ans The moment you generate a new VID, your old VID gets automatically cancelled. You can only have one active VID at a time. Q Does VID expire? Ans No, a VID does not expire by itself. It remains valid until you choose to generate a new one. Lock Unlock Aadhaar Worried about identity theft? Temporarily Lock your Biometrics or Aadhaar Number instantly for maximum security. Secure Now Lock Unlock Aadhaar Secure Your Biometrics Instantly Security is a major concern for Aadhaar holders. What if someone gets hold of your Aadhaar number and tries to misuse it? To prevent unauthorized authentication, UIDAI provides a powerful feature Lock Unlock Aadhaar . This service allows you to temporarily Lock your UID (Aadhaar Number). Once locked, no one (not even you) can perform authentication using the Aadhaar number. It acts as a digital shield against identity theft. You can Unlock it whenever you need to use it. MUST READ BEFORE LOCKING Do not lock your Aadhaar without generating a Virtual ID (VID). Once your Aadhaar is locked, you CANNOT use your Aadhaar number to unlock it (because the number itself is locked). You will compulsorily need a 16-digit Virtual ID (VID) to perform the Unlock process. Difference Aadhaar Lock vs Biometric Lock Many people confuse these two services. Here is the difference Feature UID Lock (Aadhaar Lock) Biometric Lock What it blocks? Blocks ALL authentication (Demographic, Biometric, OTP). Blocks ONLY Fingerprint and Iris scan. OTP still works. How to use when locked? You must use Virtual ID (VID) . You must temporarily Unlock biometrics to use fingerprint iris. Security Level Highest (Total Lock) Medium (Protects Biometrics only) Step-by-Step Guide to LOCK Aadhaar Generate VID First As mentioned, ensure you have a valid VID. If not, use the VID Generator service first. Open Lock Service Click the Secure Now button above and select the Lock UID option. Enter Details Enter your 12-digit Aadhaar Number, Full Name, and Pin Code. Verify OTP Enter the security captcha and click Send OTP . Enter the OTP received on your mobile. Confirmation Your Aadhaar Number is now LOCKED. You will not be able to perform authentication using the UID anymore. Step-by-Step Guide to UNLOCK Aadhaar Select Unlock UID Go to the same service page and select the Unlock UID tab. Enter VID (Not Aadhaar Number) Here, you CANNOT enter your Aadhaar number. You must enter your 16-digit Virtual ID (VID) . Verify Unlock Enter the Captcha and OTP. Once verified, your Aadhaar number will be active again. Ans Yes, but you will have to use your Virtual ID (VID) to download it, as the Aadhaar number will not be accepted by the system. Q I forgot my VID and my Aadhaar is locked. What do I do? Check Status Bank Seeding Status Check Aadhaar-Bank Linking for DBT Many government schemes in India transfer money directly to beneficiaries bank accounts using the Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) system. This money is sent using the Aadhaar Payment Bridge (APB). For this to work, simply having a bank account is not enough. Your Aadhaar number must be seeded or mapped with that specific bank account in the NPCI (National Payments Corporation of India) database. The Bank Seeding Status service helps you check which of your bank accounts is currently linked to receive government funds. Why is Bank Seeding Essential? If your Bank Seeding Status is Inactive , you will NOT receive funds for PM Kisan Samman Nidhi LPG Gas Subsidy (PAHAL) Scholarships Pension Schemes (Old Age Widow) MNREGA Wages How to Check Bank Linking Status Online You can verify your current NPCI mapping status instantly through the myAadhaar portal. Follow these steps Login to Portal Click the Check Status button above and login using your Aadhaar Number OTP. Select Bank Seeding Status Locate and click on the Bank Seeding Status icon on the dashboard. View Result The system will display the Bank Name, Seeding Status (Active Inactive), and the Date of Linking. Understanding Your Status Result Status ACTIVE Your Aadhaar is successfully mapped. You are eligible to receive DBT funds in the mentioned bank account. Status INACTIVE Your mapping has been disabled or expired. You will NOT receive subsidies until you re-link it. My Status is Inactive Not Linked. How to Link? Note You CANNOT link your bank account to Aadhaar online via the UIDAI website. This must be done through your bank. Method 1 Visit Bank Branch (Recommended) Go to your bank branch, fill out the Aadhaar Seeding Form (DBT Mandate form), and attach a copy of your e-Aadhaar. Ask the official to Enable DBT specifically. Method 2 Net Banking Mobile App Some banks (like SBI, HDFC, ICICI, PNB) offer an option in their Net Banking App under Service Request Link Aadhaar Enable DBT . Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs) Q I have accounts in 3 banks. Which one will receive the money? Ans Government benefits are sent to the Last Seeded Bank Account . If you recently linked a new bank account, the money will start coming to that new account automatically. Q My bank says Aadhaar is linked (KYC done), but status shows Inactive. Why? Ans Linking for KYC and Linking for DBT are different. You must specifically ask the bank to Map Aadhaar to NPCI for DBT . Q How long does it take to update the status? Ans Once the bank processes your request, it usually takes 2-3 working days for the status to reflect on the myAadhaar portal. Track Your PVC Card Ordered your Aadhaar PVC Card? Track Order Check Aadhaar PVC Card Order Status Track Delivery Have you recently ordered the new, durable Aadhaar PVC Card online by paying 50? You Need Your SRN (Service Request Number) To check the status, you must have the 28-digit SRN . This number was generated when you successfully placed the order and paid the fees. How to Check PVC Order Status Online Follow these simple steps to track your application Open the Tool Click on the Track Order button above. Enter SRN Enter the 28-digit Service Request Number (SRN) carefully. Security Check Type the Captcha code shown on the screen. Submit Click on Submit . The system will verify your request and display the current status. Understanding the Status Meanings Payment Successful Your order has been received by UIDAI. How to Track via India Post (Speed Post) Once the status shows Dispatched , the portal will display an Airway Bill Number (AWB) . This is your tracking ID. Copy the Airway Bill Number (AWB). Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs) Q I lost my SRN. How can I check the status? Ans If you lost the SRN, check your SMS history for messages from UIDAI. Or check the Payment History section if you were logged in. Q The status says Dispatched but I haven t received it yet. Ans Delivery speed depends on India Post services. Use the Airway Bill Number to track it on the India Post website for real-time updates. Check Aadhaar Status Applied for a new Aadhaar or updated details? Track your application status in real-time using your Enrolment ID (EID) or URN. Check Status Check Aadhaar Enrolment Update Status Online Have you recently applied for a new Aadhaar card? Or have you updated your Name, Address, or Date of Birth at an Aadhaar Center? If yes, you don t need to visit the center again to know if your request is processed. The Check Enrolment Update Status service allows you to track your application in real-time. Whether you did the update online (via myAadhaar portal) or offline (at a Seva Kendra), you can track it here. Which Number Do You Need for Tracking? Depending on how you applied, you will have one of the following numbers 1. Enrolment ID (EID) Found on the top of the Acknowledgement Slip given at the Aadhaar Center. It contains 14-digit Enrolment No. 14-digit Date Time. 2. Service Request Number (SRN) Generated when you initiate an Online Update (like Address or Document Update) on the myAadhaar portal. It starts with S . 3. Update Request Number (URN) Generated via SMS if you updated details using the Self Service Update Portal (SSUP) in the past. How to Enter EID Correctly (Very Important) Most users fail to check status because they enter the EID incorrectly. The 28-digit EID is a combination of the Enrolment Number and Timestamp. Format Enrolment Number Year Month Day Time Example If slip says Date 15 08 2024, Time 14 30 55, Enrolment 1234 56789 01234 Enter like this 12345678901234 20240815 143055 (Notice the Date is reversed YYYY-MM-DD). Step-by-Step Tracking Process Follow these steps to know your current status Open the Tool Click on the Check Status button above. Enter ID Type your EID (28 digits), SRN, or URN in the box provided. Ensure there are no spaces or slashes. Security Check Enter the Captcha code exactly as shown. Submit Click Submit . The status will appear on the screen. What Does Your Status Mean? In Process Your application is still being verified by the backend team. This usually takes 5-30 days. Completed Congratulations! Your update is successful. You can now Download Aadhaar to see the changes. Rejected Your request was declined. This usually happens due to wrong documents or data mismatch. You will have to apply again. Updated on Jul 21, 2026, 17 09 40 IST By Bhavya Sukheja Prefer HT on Google Share via Copy link Mamaearth co-founder Ghazal Alagh has voiced support for the ongoing Cockroach Janta Party (CJP) protest at Delhi's Jantar Mantar over alleged irregularities in the NEET examination, urging authorities to engage in dialogue instead of remaining silent. Mamaearth co-founder Ghazal Alagh has voiced support for the ongoing CJP protest. (Instagram ghazalalagh) In a video shared on Instagram, Alagh said she was disappointed that the concerns raised by protesters had not been acknowledged. "Aaj dil thoda sa bhaari hai. Aise lag raha hai kuch toh theek nahi hai (Today, my heart feels a little heavy. It feels like something isn't right.)," she said in the video. Without naming any individual or authority, Alagh stressed that listening to someone's concerns does not necessarily mean agreeing with them. "Kisi ki baat sunna, kisi ki baat ko acknowledge karna, unki baat maan ne ke barabar nahi hota. Aapka different point of view ho sakta hai, aapka nazariya kuch alag ho sakta hai. But aap doosre bande ki baat toh sunenge. Koi kuch kehna chah raha hai, aap unko ignore toh mat kijiye, please (Listening to someone or acknowledging what they have to say doesn't mean you agree with them. You may have a different point of view or perspective, but at least hear the other person out. If someone wants to say something, please don't ignore them.)," she said. Alagh added that she had expected some acknowledgement of the protesters' concerns but felt the situation was worsening. She said, "Ek paksh hai jo apni baat rakhna chahta hai, apni baat sunwana chahta hai. Doosre paksh ko baat sunni toh chahiye (One side wants to put forward its point of view and be heard. The other side should at least listen.)." Drawing parallels with conversations at home and the workplace, Alagh said that difficult situations require more communication, not less. "Hum apne ghar mein apne bachchon ki baat sunte hain. Hum office mein apne colleagues ko yahi bolte hain ki, 'Yeah, conversations can solve the most difficult things as well, right?' Baat kijiye. Jab cheezen mushkil hoti hain, over-communicate kijiye. Wahin se solution nikalta hai. But ignore karna, acknowledge hi nahi karna, yeh kisi cheez ka solution nahi ho sakta (We listen to our children at home. At work, we tell our colleagues that conversations can solve even the most difficult problems. Talk to each other. When things get difficult, communicate even more - that's where solutions come from. Ignoring people or refusing to acknowledge them cannot be a solution.)," she said. View this post on Instagram A post shared by Ghazal Alagh ( ghazalalagh) (Also Read Maine burger kiun khaya? CJP spokesperson Vijeta Dahiya slams trolls for accusing him of eating during protest ) About the CJP protest? The CJP protest has been underway at Delhi's Jantar Mantar, where students and supporters have been demonstrating over alleged irregularities in the NEET examination. Protesters have been demanding accountability and the resignation of Education Minister Dharmendra Pradhan. The demonstration has gained traction online, with several creators, entrepreneurs and public figures expressing support. (Also Read Ramit Verma, aka Peeing Human, reveals face after 11 years following head injury at CJP protest ) How did social media react to Gazal Alagh's remarks? Alagh's post drew mixed reactions on social media. "She's brave enough to take a stand despite knowing the risks. She's simply using her platform to speak her mind, and I respect that," one user wrote. "Thanks for speaking up," another commented. "Thanks for speaking up ghazalalagh. Even posting this short message needs a lot of guts," said another. However, some users criticised her remarks. "Mam pls try to do the Reasearch before talking on this platform because u r the mentor for many Indians and mentor can't have a biased opinion about the government of India," one user wrote. "When did CJP became experts in conducting exams? Govt has faltered - and it did take necessary steps to correct it. It promised it will never happen again. Further what do you want? Just ego of a group who started this movement and want this to balloon so that they get a high?" said another. Download Now Complete Guide to e-Aadhaar Download Process Aaj ke digital yug mein, Aadhaar Card har Bhartiya nagarik ke liye sabse zaroori pehchaan patra (Identity Proof) ban gaya hai. Chahe bank account khulwana ho, SIM card lena ho, ya kisi sarkari yojana ka labh uthana ho Aadhaar har jagah anivarya hai. Lekin kya aap jante hain ki aapko hamesha physical card sath rakhne ki zarurat nahi hai? Aap e-Aadhaar ka istemal kar sakte hain. What is e-Aadhaar? (e-Aadhaar Kya Hai?) Ye aapke physical Aadhaar card ki ek password-protected electronic copy hai, jise UIDAI ke competent authority dwara digitally sign kiya jata hai. Aadhaar Act ke mutabiq, e-Aadhaar physical copy ke barabar hi valid mana jata hai. Aadhaar Card Download Kaise Karein? (Online Process) Agar aapka Aadhaar card kho gaya hai ya aapke paas physical copy nahi hai, to ghabrayein nahi. Aap niche diye gaye aasaan steps ko follow karke 2 minute mein apna e-Aadhaar PDF download kar sakte hain. Official Website Upar diye gaye orange color ke Download Now button par click karein. Enter Details Yahan aapke paas 3 option honge Aadhaar Number, Enrolment ID (EID), ya Virtual ID (VID). Apna 12-digit Aadhaar number dalein. Captcha Verification Screen par dikh raha security code (Captcha) dhyan se bharein. OTP Verification Send OTP button dabayein. Aapke registered mobile number par ek 6-digit ka OTP aayega. Verify Download OTP enter karein aur Verify Download par click karein. Aapka e-Aadhaar PDF format mein download ho jayega. e-Aadhaar PDF Password Kya Hota Hai? Bahut se log Aadhaar download to kar lete hain lekin PDF khul nahi pati kyunki wo password-protected hoti hai. Iska password bahut simple hota hai. Q Aadhaar PVC Card kitne din mein aata hai? Ans Order karne ke baad aamtaur par 5 se 15 working days ke andar India Post dwara aapke ghar pahunch jata hai. Lost Your Aadhaar? Retrieve it Instantly! Forgot your Aadhaar Number (UID) or Enrolment ID (EID)? Use your registered mobile number to get it back via SMS in seconds. Retrieve UID EID How to Retrieve Lost Aadhaar Number (UID) or Enrolment ID (EID) Have you lost your physical Aadhaar card and cannot remember your 12-digit Aadhaar number? Or perhaps you have applied for a new Aadhaar card but lost the acknowledgement slip containing the Enrolment ID (EID)? Do not worry. The Retrieve Aadhaar number EID SID service allows you to recover these details online instantly. This feature is a lifesaver for those who have misplaced their documents and need to download their e-Aadhaar urgent. By using this facility, your lost Aadhaar number or EID is sent directly to your registered mobile number. Important Prerequisite To use this online facility, your Mobile Number or Email ID MUST be registered and linked with your Aadhaar. If your mobile number is not linked, you cannot receive the OTP required for retrieval. Difference Between UID and EID Term Full Form Description UID Unique ID This is your final 12-digit Aadhaar Number . Select this if you already had a card. EID Enrolment ID This is the 28-digit number from your acknowledgement slip (for new applications). Step-by-Step Process to Retrieve Lost Aadhaar (UID) Visit the Official Portal Click on the Retrieve UID EID button above to open the official page. Select Retrieval Option Choose Aadhaar Number to find your main ID or Enrolment ID if you are tracking a new application. Enter Personal Details Enter your Full Name exactly as it is printed on your Aadhaar card. Enter Contact Info Captcha Enter your Registered Mobile Number or Email ID, fill the Captcha, and click Send OTP . Get SMS After OTP verification, your Aadhaar Number (UID) or EID will be sent to your mobile via SMS. Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs) Q Can I retrieve my Aadhaar if I don t have my mobile number? Ans No, the online facility works strictly via OTP. If your mobile is not linked, you must visit an Aadhaar Enrollment Center with your identity proof. Q Is there any fee for this service? Ans No, the Retrieve Aadhaar EID service is completely free of cost on the myAadhaar portal. Verify Mobile Email Not sure which mobile number is linked to your Aadhaar? Verify it instantly to ensure you receive OTPs for all government services. Verify Now How to Verify Mobile Number Email Linked with Aadhaar In today s digital India, your Registered Mobile Number is the key to accessing almost all Aadhaar services. Whether you want to download your e-Aadhaar, update your address online, or verify your ITR, the OTP (One Time Password) is sent to this linked number. However, people often change their SIM cards or forget which mobile number they gave at the time of enrollment years ago. The Verify Email Mobile service on the myAadhaar portal solves this confusion. It allows you to check if the mobile number or email ID you currently possess is the one linked to your Aadhaar database. ℹ Important Clarification This service does NOT show you the mobile number linked to your Aadhaar (for privacy reasons). Instead, YOU have to enter a mobile number, and the system will tell you if it matches the records or not. It is a verification tool, not a search tool. Step-by-Step Process to Verify Mobile Number Follow this simple procedure to confirm your linked contact details Access the Service Click on the green Verify Now button above. Select Verification Type You will see two options Verify Mobile Number and Verify Email Address . Select the one you want to check. Enter Details First, enter your 12-digit Aadhaar Number . Then, enter the Mobile Number (or Email) that you think is linked. Security Check Enter the Captcha code exactly as shown in the image box. Send OTP Click on the Send OTP button. Check the Result The system will display a success or error message based on your input (explained below). Understanding the Result Messages After submitting, you will see one of these two messages. Here is what they mean Scenario 1 Match Found (Success) The mobile number you have entered is already verified with our records. Meaning Congratulations! The mobile number you typed IS the one linked to your Aadhaar. You can receive OTPs on this number. Scenario 2 No Match (Failure) The mobile number you have entered does not match with our records. Meaning The number you typed is NOT linked. Either you linked a different family member s number, or an old number that you have lost. Why is this Verification Important? 1. Fraud Prevention Ensuring that no unknown mobile number or email is linked to your ID protects your biometric and demographic data. 2. Banking Services To link Aadhaar with a bank account or PAN card, the OTP validation is mandatory. Verifying ensures you are using the correct SIM. 3. Updates You cannot update your address or download Aadhaar online if you don t know which number receives the OTP. Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs) Q The system says Record not found . What should I do? Ans This means the mobile number you are entering is incorrect. Try entering mobile numbers of your family members. If none match, you must visit an Aadhaar Seva Kendra to check or update your number. Q Can I update my mobile number using this service? Ans No. This service is only for verification . To update or change your mobile number, biometric authentication is required, which can only be done offline at a center. Report Death Deactivate Aadhaar Secure the identity of your deceased family member. Officially report the death to UIDAI to prevent misuse of documents. Report Now How to Report Death of a Family Member for Aadhaar Deactivation The Aadhaar card is a unique identity proof that remains valid for a lifetime. However, in the unfortunate event of a family member s demise, it is the responsibility of the legal heir or guardian to inform the Unique Identification Authority of India (UIDAI). The Report death of a family member service allows you to officially flag an Aadhaar number for deactivation. This is a crucial step to ensure that the deceased person s identity documents are not misused for financial fraud, illegal SIM card issuance, or identity theft. Why is Deactivating Aadhaar Important? Many people often overlook this step, but keeping a deceased person s Aadhaar active can lead to several complications Prevent Misuse Scammers often look for dormant identities to open fake bank accounts or take loans. Subsidies Benefits To prevent the continued transfer of government benefits (like pensions) to a deceased person, which can later lead to legal recovery issues. Closure of Records It helps in closing other linked official documents like PAN Card and Voter ID systematically. Important Requirement To use this service, you MUST have a valid Death Certificate issued by the Registrar of Births and Deaths. The details on the Death Certificate must match the Aadhaar details of the deceased. Procedure to Report Death Online UIDAI has simplified the process by allowing family members to initiate this request via the myAadhaar portal. Follow these steps Login to Portal The reporting family member (Applicant) must login to the myAadhaar portal using their Own Aadhaar Number and OTP. You cannot login using the deceased person s Aadhaar. Select the Service On the dashboard, locate and click on the Report death of a family member card. Enter Details of Deceased Enter the 12-digit Aadhaar Number of the deceased family member. You may also need to provide their Name and Date of Birth as per records. Upload Document Upload a clear scanned copy (PDF JPG) of the Death Certificate . Ensure the file size is within the permissible limit (usually 2MB). Review Submit Verify all the details entered. Once submitted, you will receive a Service Request Number (SRN) to track the status. What Happens Next? (Verification) Reporting the death online does not instantly deactivate the Aadhaar. The request goes through a verification process 1. Registrar Verification The details are cross-verified with the birth and death registration records. 2. Deactivation Once verified, the UIDAI will permanently deactivate the Aadhaar number of the deceased. 3. Confirmation You can check the status using the Check deceased Aadhaar deactivation status service on the same portal. Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs) Q Can anyone report the death? Ans Usually, only immediate family members (spouse, children, parents) whose mobile numbers are linked or who can prove the relationship can initiate this request. Q Is it mandatory to deactivate Aadhaar after death? Ans While there is no strict penalty currently, it is highly recommended for safety and to close the financial and legal footprint of the deceased. Q Can I reactivate the Aadhaar later if reported by mistake? Ans No. Once an Aadhaar is marked as Deceased and deactivated after proper verification, it cannot be reactivated. Create a temporary 16-digit Virtual ID to use instead of your Aadhaar Number for authentication. Generate VID VID Generator Create Virtual ID to Hide Aadhaar Number Are you worried about sharing your 12-digit Aadhaar number everywhere? Do you want to protect your privacy while performing e-KYC? The Virtual ID (VID) is the solution. The VID Generator service allows you to create a temporary, revocable 16-digit random number mapped to your Aadhaar number. It can be used in lieu of your Aadhaar number for authentication services. This ensures your actual Aadhaar number remains hidden from the service provider. Privacy Feature When you use a VID, the agency (like a telecom operator or bank) cannot store your Aadhaar number. They only get a UID Token , which makes your data much more secure against leaks. Difference Aadhaar Number vs Virtual ID (VID) Feature Aadhaar Number (UID) Virtual ID (VID) Length 12 Digits (Permanent) 16 Digits (Temporary) Validity Lifetime valid Valid until you generate a new one Security Directly linked to biometric data Masks the actual Aadhaar number How to Generate or Retrieve VID Online You can generate a new VID or retrieve an existing one using the myAadhaar portal. Follow these steps Login to Portal Visit the myAadhaar dashboard by clicking the Generate VID button above. Select VID Generator Click on the VID Generator icon from the services menu. Choose Option You will see two options 1. Generate New VID If you want to create a fresh 16-digit number. 2. Retrieve Existing VID If you already generated one but forgot it. Confirm Receive Select your choice. Your 16-digit Virtual ID will be sent immediately to your Registered Mobile Number via SMS. Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs) Q Is VID accepted everywhere? Ans Yes, as per government regulations, all agencies (Banks, Telecom, Govt) must accept VID for authentication. Q What happens if I generate a new VID? Ans The moment you generate a new VID, your old VID gets automatically cancelled. You can only have one active VID at a time. Q Does VID expire? Ans No, a VID does not expire by itself. It remains valid until you choose to generate a new one. Lock Unlock Aadhaar Worried about identity theft? Temporarily Lock your Biometrics or Aadhaar Number instantly for maximum security. Secure Now Lock Unlock Aadhaar Secure Your Biometrics Instantly Security is a major concern for Aadhaar holders. What if someone gets hold of your Aadhaar number and tries to misuse it? To prevent unauthorized authentication, UIDAI provides a powerful feature Lock Unlock Aadhaar . This service allows you to temporarily Lock your UID (Aadhaar Number). Once locked, no one (not even you) can perform authentication using the Aadhaar number. It acts as a digital shield against identity theft. You can Unlock it whenever you need to use it. MUST READ BEFORE LOCKING Do not lock your Aadhaar without generating a Virtual ID (VID). Once your Aadhaar is locked, you CANNOT use your Aadhaar number to unlock it (because the number itself is locked). You will compulsorily need a 16-digit Virtual ID (VID) to perform the Unlock process. Difference Aadhaar Lock vs Biometric Lock Many people confuse these two services. Here is the difference Feature UID Lock (Aadhaar Lock) Biometric Lock What it blocks? Blocks ALL authentication (Demographic, Biometric, OTP). Blocks ONLY Fingerprint and Iris scan. OTP still works. How to use when locked? You must use Virtual ID (VID) . You must temporarily Unlock biometrics to use fingerprint iris. Security Level Highest (Total Lock) Medium (Protects Biometrics only) Step-by-Step Guide to LOCK Aadhaar Generate VID First As mentioned, ensure you have a valid VID. If not, use the VID Generator service first. Open Lock Service Click the Secure Now button above and select the Lock UID option. Enter Details Enter your 12-digit Aadhaar Number, Full Name, and Pin Code. Verify OTP Enter the security captcha and click Send OTP . Enter the OTP received on your mobile. Confirmation Your Aadhaar Number is now LOCKED. You will not be able to perform authentication using the UID anymore. Step-by-Step Guide to UNLOCK Aadhaar Select Unlock UID Go to the same service page and select the Unlock UID tab. Enter VID (Not Aadhaar Number) Here, you CANNOT enter your Aadhaar number. You must enter your 16-digit Virtual ID (VID) . Verify Unlock Enter the Captcha and OTP. Once verified, your Aadhaar number will be active again. Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs) Q Can I download e-Aadhaar if my UID is locked? Ans Yes, but you will have to use your Virtual ID (VID) to download it, as the Aadhaar number will not be accepted by the system. Q I forgot my VID and my Aadhaar is locked. What do I do? Ans You can use the Retrieve VID service via SMS. Send an SMS RVID Last 4 digits of Aadhaar to 1947 from your registered mobile number. Bank Seeding Status Are you receiving government subsidies? Check if your Aadhaar is successfully linked and mapped with your bank account for Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT). Check Status Bank Seeding Status Check Aadhaar-Bank Linking for DBT Many government schemes in India transfer money directly to beneficiaries bank accounts using the Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) system. This money is sent using the Aadhaar Payment Bridge (APB). For this to work, simply having a bank account is not enough. Your Aadhaar number must be seeded or mapped with that specific bank account in the NPCI (National Payments Corporation of India) database. The Bank Seeding Status service helps you check which of your bank accounts is currently linked to receive government funds. Why is Bank Seeding Essential? If your Bank Seeding Status is Inactive , you will NOT receive funds for PM Kisan Samman Nidhi LPG Gas Subsidy (PAHAL) Scholarships Pension Schemes (Old Age Widow) MNREGA Wages How to Check Bank Linking Status Online You can verify your current NPCI mapping status instantly through the myAadhaar portal. Follow these steps Login to Portal Click the Check Status button above and login using your Aadhaar Number OTP. Select Bank Seeding Status Locate and click on the Bank Seeding Status icon on the dashboard. View Result The system will display the Bank Name, Seeding Status (Active Inactive), and the Date of Linking. Understanding Your Status Result Status ACTIVE Your Aadhaar is successfully mapped. You are eligible to receive DBT funds in the mentioned bank account. Status INACTIVE Your mapping has been disabled or expired. You will NOT receive subsidies until you re-link it. My Status is Inactive Not Linked. How to Link? Note You CANNOT link your bank account to Aadhaar online via the UIDAI website. This must be done through your bank. Method 1 Visit Bank Branch (Recommended) Go to your bank branch, fill out the Aadhaar Seeding Form (DBT Mandate form), and attach a copy of your e-Aadhaar. Ask the official to Enable DBT specifically. Method 2 Net Banking Mobile App Some banks (like SBI, HDFC, ICICI, PNB) offer an option in their Net Banking App under Service Request Link Aadhaar Enable DBT . Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs) Q I have accounts in 3 banks. Which one will receive the money? Ans Government benefits are sent to the Last Seeded Bank Account . If you recently linked a new bank account, the money will start coming to that new account automatically. Q My bank says Aadhaar is linked (KYC done), but status shows Inactive. Why? Ans Linking for KYC and Linking for DBT are different. You must specifically ask the bank to Map Aadhaar to NPCI for DBT . Q How long does it take to update the status? Ans Once the bank processes your request, it usually takes 2-3 working days for the status to reflect on the myAadhaar portal. Track Your PVC Card Ordered your Aadhaar PVC Card? Track its printing and delivery status in real-time. Know exactly when it will reach your doorstep. Track Order Check Aadhaar PVC Card Order Status Track Delivery Have you recently ordered the new, durable Aadhaar PVC Card online by paying 50? If yes, you might be wondering when it will reach your home. The Check Aadhaar PVC card order status service allows you to track the progress of your printing request and its dispatch status. The entire process, from ordering to delivery, typically takes 5 to 15 working days . This tool helps you know exactly where your card is whether it is still printing or has been handed over to the post office. You Need Your SRN (Service Request Number) To check the status, you must have the 28-digit SRN . This number was generated when you successfully placed the order and paid the fees. It is available on the acknowledgement slip you downloaded. How to Check PVC Order Status Online Follow these simple steps to track your application Open the Tool Click on the Track Order button above. Enter SRN Enter the 28-digit Service Request Number (SRN) carefully. Security Check Type the Captcha code shown on the screen. Submit Click on Submit . The system will verify your request and display the current status. Understanding the Status Meanings Payment Successful Your order has been received by UIDAI. In Process Your data has been sent for printing. Dispatched Your card has been printed and handed over to India Post. (This is the most important status). How to Track via India Post (Speed Post) Once the status shows Dispatched , the portal will display an Airway Bill Number (AWB) . This is your tracking ID. Copy the Airway Bill Number (AWB). Visit the India Post Tracking website (indiapost.gov.in). Enter the AWB number in the Consignment Number field. You will see the exact location of your card and the expected delivery date. Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs) Q I lost my SRN. How can I check the status? Ans If you lost the SRN, check your SMS history for messages from UIDAI. Or check the Payment History section if you were logged in. Q The status says Dispatched but I haven t received it yet. Ans Delivery speed depends on India Post services. Use the Airway Bill Number to track it on the India Post website for real-time updates. Check Aadhaar Status Applied for a new Aadhaar or updated details? Track your application status in real-time using your Enrolment ID (EID) or URN. Check Status Check Aadhaar Enrolment Update Status Online Have you recently applied for a new Aadhaar card? Or have you updated your Name, Address, or Date of Birth at an Aadhaar Center? If yes, you don t need to visit the center again to know if your request is processed. The Check Enrolment Update Status service allows you to track your application in real-time. Whether you did the update online (via myAadhaar portal) or offline (at a Seva Kendra), you can track it here. Which Number Do You Need for Tracking? Depending on how you applied, you will have one of the following numbers 1. Enrolment ID (EID) Found on the top of the Acknowledgement Slip given at the Aadhaar Center. It contains 14-digit Enrolment No. 14-digit Date Time. 2. Service Request Number (SRN) Generated when you initiate an Online Update (like Address or Document Update) on the myAadhaar portal. It starts with S . 3. Update Request Number (URN) Generated via SMS if you updated details using the Self Service Update Portal (SSUP) in the past. How to Enter EID Correctly (Very Important) Most users fail to check status because they enter the EID incorrectly. The 28-digit EID is a combination of the Enrolment Number and Timestamp. Format Enrolment Number Year Month Day Time Example If slip says Date 15 08 2024, Time 14 30 55, Enrolment 1234 56789 01234 Enter like this 12345678901234 20240815 143055 (Notice the Date is reversed YYYY-MM-DD). Step-by-Step Tracking Process Follow these steps to know your current status Open the Tool Click on the Check Status button above. Enter ID Type your EID (28 digits), SRN, or URN in the box provided. Ensure there are no spaces or slashes. Security Check Enter the Captcha code exactly as shown. Submit Click Submit . The status will appear on the screen. What Does Your Status Mean? In Process Your application is still being verified by the backend team. This usually takes 5-30 days. Completed Congratulations! Your update is successful. You can now Download Aadhaar to see the changes. Rejected Your request was declined. This usually happens due to wrong documents or data mismatch. You will have to apply again. Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs) Q I lost my Acknowledgement Slip. How can I get my EID? Ans You can use the Retrieve EID UID service to get your Enrolment ID on your registered mobile number. Q How many days does it take to update Aadhaar? Ans As per UIDAI guidelines, up to 90 of updates are processed within 30 days. However, in some cases, it can take up to 90 days. Q Status shows Completed but I didn t get the card by post. Ans Completed means the data is updated online. The physical letter delivery takes extra time. You can download the e-Aadhaar immediately. Check Deceased Aadhaar Deactivation Status Once you have formally reported the death of a family member to UIDAI for Aadhaar deactivation, it is important to verify if the request has been processed. The Check Deceased Aadhaar Deactivation Status service allows legal heirs or guardians to track the progress of their application. Deactivating the Aadhaar of a deceased person is a critical step to prevent identity fraud and ensure that government records are updated accurately. Requirement You will need the Service Request Number (SRN) that was generated when you submitted the Report Death request. How to Track Deactivation Request Access the Tool Click on the Check Deceased Aadhaar Deactivation Status card on the myAadhaar dashboard. Enter SRN Input the 28-digit Service Request Number provided during the reporting process. Captcha Enter the security code displayed on the screen. View Status The system will show whether the request is Pending Verification , Approved (Deactivated), or Rejected (due to document mismatch). One Login, Many Services Access all Aadhaar services with a single secure login. Use your SSO ID or try our new Face Authentication feature for instant access without a password. Secure 256-bit Encryption Biometric Face Auth Supported Access Document Update Status Manage Family Profiles SSO Portal Login SSO ID User ID Password Use your camera to scan your face or upload a photo for verification. Click to Scan Face Upload Photo Supports JPG PNG (Max 5MB) Forgot Password? Create New Account What is SSO ID? (Single Sign-On Login) SSO (Single Sign-On) ek aisa digital authentication system hai jo users ko sirf ek ID aur Password ke zariye kai saari sarkari aur private websites par login karne ki suvidha deta hai. Chahe wo Aadhaar Card Download ho, Ration Card ki jankari ho, ya Jan Aadhaar portal SSO Login se sab kuch ek jagah manage hota hai. Bharat mein digital services badhne ke saath, SSO ID Login ab har nagarik ke liye zaroori ho gaya hai. Is portal par aap apne Aadhaar number ya Face Auth ka upyog karke securely login kar sakte hain. New Update Ab aap bina password yaad rakhe, seedhe apne Chehre (Face Auth) ya Biometric se SSO Login kar sakte hain. SSO ID Registration Account Kaise Banayein? Agar aapke paas abhi tak SSO ID nahi hai, to aap niche diye gaye steps follow karke apna naya account register kar sakte hain Upar diye gaye SSO Login box mein Create New Account par click karein. Apna 12-digit Aadhaar Number enter karein. Aapke registered mobile par ek OTP aayega, use verify karein. Apna manpasand SSO User ID aur Password set karein. Registration complete hone par aap turant login kar sakte hain. Benefits of SSO Portal (SSO Ke Fayde) All-in-One Access Ek hi login se 100 services ka labh uthayein. Recover Forgotten Password Agar password bhool gaye, to Aadhaar OTP se reset karein. High Security Two-factor authentication (2FA) aur Identity verification. SSO Login FAQs Q Main apna SSO ID Password bhool gaya hun, kya karun? Ans Aap Forgot Password link par click karke apne registered mobile number ya Aadhaar OTP ke zariye apna password reset kar sakte hain. Q Kya SSO Login ke liye Aadhaar zaroori hai? Ans Haan, security verification ke liye Aadhaar card number ya Jan Aadhaar ID ka hona anivarya hai. Q SSO ID se main kaunsi services use kar sakta hun? Ans Aap Aadhaar PVC order, Address Update, Scholarship forms, Job applications, aur Electricity bill payment jaisi suvidhayein use kar sakte hain.

Guide Overview Category Government Services Portal Bihar Bhumi Estimated Time 5 min Fee Free Complete Guide Bhaiyon, apni zameen ka khatiyan (Record of Rights purana land record) online nikalna hai? Bihar me ye bilkul free aur ghar baithe ho jaata hai - biharbhumi.bihar.gov.in pe "Apna Khata Dekhein" service se. Pehle ek confusion clear khatiyan purana survey-record jo ownership possession dikhata hai (frozen) jamabandi abhi ka updated record (har dakhil-kharij ke baad badalta hai) rasid lagan tax receipt. Teeno alag hain. Khatiyan nikalne ka poora step-by-step neeche. Khatiyan Kaise Nikale (Step-by-Step) biharbhumi.bihar.gov.in kholo "अपना खाता देखें Apna Khata Dekhein" pe click karo Bihar ke naqsche pe apna District (जिला) chuno Anchal Circle (अंचल CO) chuno Mauza (मौजा gaon) dropdown ya alphabet se chuno In me se kisi ek se search karo Khata number (खाता संख्या) Khesra number (खेसरा plot) Khatadhari ka naam (मालिक ka naam) ya poore mauza ki list dekho "खाता देखें Dekhein" record khulega "देखें print" se khatiyan PDF download print karo (free) Khatiyan vs Jamabandi vs Rasid (Confusion Clear) Cheez Kya Hai Khatiyan One-time survey Record of Rights (CS RS) - frozen, update nahi hota possession rights dikhata hai Jamabandi (Register-II) Current RoR - har mutation (dakhil-kharij) ke baad update "Jamabandi Panji Dekhein" service Khesra Ek single plot ka ID Khata Ek malik ke plots ka account grouping Rasid Lagan tax receipt - "Bhu-Lagan" service se ( guide ) Dhyan Khatiyan ownership ka proof-support hai par akela title deed nahi . Registry dispute me current jamabandi registered deed bhi lagte hain. FAQs Q Bihar khatiyan online kaise nikale? A biharbhumi.bihar.gov.in pe "Apna Khata Dekhein" district anchal mauza chuno khata khesra naam se search PDF download. Free. Q Khatiyan nikalne ki fee kitni hai? A Bilkul free - biharbhumi portal pe khata khatiyan dekhna aur print karna nishulk hai. Q Khata number nahi pata to? A Khatadhari (malik) ke naam se ya poore mauza ki list se dhundh sakte ho - naam wale option se search karo. Q Khatiyan aur jamabandi me kya farak hai? A Khatiyan purana survey RoR (frozen) Jamabandi current record jo har mutation pe update hota hai. Dono biharbhumi pe alag services hain. Q Khatiyan aur rasid ek hi cheez hai? A Nahi - khatiyan ownership record rasid lagan tax receipt (Bhu-Lagan service). Alag intents. Q Khatiyan se zameen ki registry ho jayegi? A Khatiyan ownership-support hai par akela kaafi nahi - registry me current jamabandi registered deed documents list chahiye. Q Online khatiyan legal maany hai? A Reference verification ke liye theek hai - legal use ke liye anchal office se certified copy lena behtar hota hai. Q Mobile se khatiyan nikal sakte hain? A Haan - biharbhumi.bihar.gov.in mobile browser pe bhi khulta hai wahi steps. Ye Bhi Zaroor Padhein LPC Full Form Apply - Land Possession Certificate - loan registry me lagta hai Bihar Jamin Rashid Online Nikale - lagan receipt Jamin Registry Documents List - registry ke papers Dakhil Kharij (Mutation) Online - naam transfer Bihar Bhumi Survey Documents Form - survey ke kaagaz Bhulekh Bhu-Naksha Guide - naksha records Source Bihar Bhumi portal (biharbhumi.bihar.gov.in) - "Apna Khata Dekhein" se khatiyan free khatiyan (survey RoR) vs jamabandi (current) vs rasid (lagan) distinct. Legal use ke liye anchal se certified copy. Bhaiyon, apni zameen ke kaagaz khud dekhna seekho - dalaal ko paisa dene ki zaroorat nahi, 5 minute me ghar baithe khatiyan nikal jaata hai! Haar manne se pehle khud se yeh sawal puchhen Maine sab kuch kiya kya? जीवन में सफलता के लिए आपको अपने आप पर विश्वास होना चाहिए Jeevan mein safalta ke liye aapko apne aap par vishwas hona chahiye. हर बड़ी उपलब्धि एक छोटे से कदम से शुरू होती है बस उसे उठाने का साहस होना चाहिए Har badi uplabdhi ek chote se kadam se shuru hoti hai bas use uthane ka Sahas hona chahiye. दूसरों से तुलना करने के बजाय खुद की तुलना अपने बीते हुए कल से करें Doosron se tulna karne ke bajay Khud ki tulna apne beete hue kal se karen. मोटिवेशनल शायरी के प्रकार प्रेरणादायक शायरी यह शायरी हमें जीवन की कठिनाइयों का सामना करने के लिए प्रेरित करती है। यह हमें बताती है कि हर अंधेरी रात के बाद एक नई सुबह आती है। जीवन की सच्चाइयों पर आधारित शायरी यह शायरी हमें जीवन की सच्चाइयों से रूबरू कराती है। यह हमें सिखाती है कि जीवन में हर चीज का अपना महत्व है और हर कठिनाई का एक समाधान है। संघर्ष और सफलता की शायरी संघर्ष और सफलता की शायरी हमें यह बताती है कि सफलता पाने के लिए संघर्ष करना जरूरी है। यह हमें प्रोत्साहित करती है कि हम हार न मानें और अपने लक्ष्य की ओर बढ़ते रहें। मोटिवेशनल शायरी के लाभ आत्मविश्वास में वृद्धि मोटिवेशनल शायरी सुनकर या पढ़कर हमारे आत्मविश्वास में वृद्धि होती है। यह हमें अपनी क्षमताओं पर विश्वास करने के लिए प्रेरित करती है। मनोबल बढ़ाना यह शायरी हमारे मनोबल को बढ़ाती है। यह हमें बताती है कि कोई भी मुश्किल इतनी बड़ी नहीं होती कि हम उसे पार न कर सकें। नकारात्मकता से मुक्ति मोटिवेशनल शायरी हमें नकारात्मक विचारों से दूर रखने में मदद करती है। यह हमें सकारात्मक सोच की ओर प्रेरित करती है। निष्कर्ष Motivational Shayari न केवल हमारे मानसिक और भावनात्मक स्वास्थ्य को बेहतर बनाती है, बल्कि हमारे जीवन के विभिन्न क्षेत्रों में भी सकारात्मक प्रभाव डालती है। यह हमें प्रेरित करती है, हमें हमारे लक्ष्यों की याद दिलाती है, और हमें संघर्षों से निपटने की ताकत देती है। Motivational Shayari FAQ s क्या शायरी से मनोबल बढ़ सकता है? हाँ, मोटिवेशनल शायरी से मनोबल बढ़ सकता है। यह हमें जीवन में आगे बढ़ने और कठिनाइयों का सामना करने के लिए प्रेरित करती है। मोटिवेशनल शायरी क्या है? मोटिवेशनल शायरी वह काव्य (poem) है जो व्यक्ति को प्रेरित करती है और उसे संघर्ष और कठिनाइयों से निपटने की ताकत देती है। MD Masud Rana

documents: August 17, 2020 August 19, 2020 aal-e-qutub Ameer ul Momineen Farooq e Aazam Hazrat Syyedna Umar Bin Khattab (Razi Allahu Tala Anhu) Ka Yaume Shahadat 26 Zilhijja Yani Kal Hain, Lihaza Aap Hazraat Sirf Shia Rafziyo Ki Zidd Ki Wajah Se Ya Kuch Kharji Naasbi Zehan Molviyo Ki Wajah Se Jinka Maqsad 1 Muharram Ko Yaume Shahadat e Farooq e Aazam Bata Kar Zikr e Imaam Hussain (Alaihis Salam) Ko Rokna Ya Kam Karna Hain, Jis Tarha Abhi Unhone Ameer ul Momineen Zunnurain Hazrat Syedna Usman Ghani (Razi Allahu Tala Anhu) Ki Shahadat Ki Asal Tareekh 12 Zilhijja Ko Chor Sirf Shia Hazraat Ki Zidd Aur Eid e Ghadeer Ke Moqa Par Zikr e Mola e Kaynat Mola Imaam Ali (Alaihis Salam) Ko Rokne Ki Ye Chal Apnayi Ke Hazrat Usman Ghani Ka Yaume Shahadat 18 Zilhijja Bata Diya Lihaja Unki Bato Me Na Aakar Asal Tareekh Ko Na Chode 26 Zilhijja Ko Hi Huzoor Farooq e Aazam Ka Yaume Shahadat Manaye 26 Zilhaj Dusre Khalifa-e-Rashid Sayyeduna Umar-e-Farooq RadiAllahu Anhu ki Shahadat ka Din hai. Aaqa SallAllahu Alaihi wa Aalihi wa Sallam ne farmaya Zameen aur aasman me Mere 2-2 wazeer hain. Aasman me Jibril aur Mikail (Alaihi Mussalam), zameen me Abu Bakr aur Umar (RadiAllahu Anhuma) Sayyeduna Umar RadiAllahu Anhu ki Khilafat me he Persian aur Roman empires pe Islam ko fatah hasil hui jiski peshangoyi Quran ne 10 saal pehle ki thi. Aur Sayyeduna Umar RadiAllahu Anhu ke lashkar ko Sayyeduna Maula Ali Alaihissalam ne Jundahu kaha yaani Allah ka Lashkar karar diya!! Sayyeduna Farooq-e-Aazam RadiAllahu Anhu ki Khilafat me he Palestine fatah hua tha! Aapki Zaati Fazael bhi itne hain ke ek post me bayan nahi kiye jasakte. Aapki Azmat ka andaza lagane keliye sirf ek he baat kaafi hai jiska koi inkar he nahi karsakta! Wo ye ke Aapka Roza Mubarak Aaqa SallAllahu Alaihi wa Aalihi wa Sallam ke Roza-e-Adqas ke Pehlu me hai! Aur Mehshar ke Din me bhi jab Aaqa SallAllahu Alaihi wa Aalihi wa Sallam ki Kabr-e-Aqdas khulegi to Aaqa ek taraf Sayyeduna Isa Alaihissalam aur dusre taraf Hazrat Abu Bakr aur Hazrat Umar honge RadiAllahu Anhuma! Al Fatiha Allahumma Salle Ala Sayyedina wa Maulana Muhammadiw wa Ala Aalihi wa Sahbihi wa Barik wa Sallim. Ummul Momineen Hazrat Aaishah Siddiqa (سلام الله علیها) Se Rivayat Hai RasoolAllah (صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم) Ne Dua Farmayi, Aye ALLAH Islam Ko Umar Ibn Khattab Ke Zariye Se Quwwat De Reference Sunan Ibn Majah Volume 01, Page 65 ,Kitab al Mukaddam, Hadees No 110 Hazrat Abdullah Ibn Abbas (عليهم السلام) Se Rivayat Hai RasoolAllah (صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم) Ne Dua Farmayi , Aye ALLAH Islam Ko Faukiyat De Abu Jahl bin Hisham Ya Umar ibn Al Khattab Ke Zariye Se. Pass Agle Roz Ye Huwa Ke Hazrat Umar Ibn Khattab RasoolAllah (صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم) Ke Pass Aaye Aur Islam Qubuul Kar Liya Reference Jamai Tirmizi Volume 03, Page 363, Kitab ul Manakib, Baab RasoolAllah (صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم) Ki Dua Se Umar RadiAllahu Ta ala Anhu Ka Islaam Laana, Hadees No 4047, English No 3683 Jamai Tirmizi Volume 03, Page 362, Kitabul Manakib, Baab RasoolAllah (صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم) Ki Dua Se Umar RadiAllahu Ta ala Anhu Ka Islaam Laana, Hadees No 4045, English No 3681 Hazrat Abdullah Bin Abbas (عليهم السلام) Se Rivayat Hai Jiss Waqt Hazrat Umar (رضي الله عنه) Musharraf Ba Islam Huwe, Hazrat Jibareel e Amin (علیہ السلام) Haazir e Khidmat Huwe Aur Arz Kiya Ya RasoolAllah (صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم) Yaqeenan Umar (رضي الله عنه) Ke Islam Qubuul Karne Par Ahle Aasmaan Ne Khushiyaan Manayi. References Sunan Ibne Majah, Volume 01, Page 41, Kitabus Sunnah, Baab Fazail Umar (رضي الله عنه) Hadees No 108 Subhan Allah Hazrat Umar Wo Jinhe RasoolAllah (صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم) Ne Allah (تبارک وتعالی) Se Maanga Murad e Rasool Dua e Rasool 26 Dhul Hijjah Yaum e Shahadat Hazrat Umar Al Farooq (RadiAllahu Ta ala Anhu) 26 Zilhijja Yaume Shahadat Ameer ul Momineen Khalifa tul Muslimeen Sayed ul Aadileen Gha iz ul Munafiqeen Farooq e Aazam Hazrat Syedna Umar Bin Khattab (Razi Allahu Tala Anhu) Aapki Wiladat 586 Esvi Me Makka Mukarrama Me Hui, Aapki Shahadat 26 Zilhijja 23 Hijri Me Hui, Aap Dusre Khalifa e Rashid Hain, Shehansha e Qull Aalam Huzoor Ahmad e Mujtuba Muhammad Mustufa (Sallallāhu Ta ala Alaihi wa Aala Aalehi Wa sallam) Ne Aapke Liye Farmaya - Mere Bad Agar Koi Nabi Hota To Umar Hota, Huzoor (Alaihis Salam) Ne Irshad Farmaya - Allah Ne Umar Ki Zuban Aur Qalb Par Haq Ko Jari Farmaya Hain, Huzoor (Alaihis Salam) Ne Irshad Farmaya - Umar Wo Hain Jiske Saye Se Bhi Shaitan Door Bhagta Hain, Huzoor (Alaihis Salam) Ne Irshad Farmaya - Zameen Aur Aasman Me Mere 2-2 Wazeer Hain, Aasman Me Mere Wazeer Jibrail Aur Mikail (Alaihi Mussalam) Aur Zameen Par Mere Wazeer Abu Bakar Aur Umar (Razi Allahu Tala Anhuma) Hain, 17 Maqamaat Par Quran Sharif Aapki Raye Ke Mutabik Nazil Hua, Aapki Ek Sahabzadi Umm ul Momineen Hazrat Hafsa (Salam un Aleha) Huzoor (Alaihis Salam) Ke Nikah Me Aai, Aapka Daur e Khilafat 10 Saal 6 Mahine Raha, Aapki Hukumat 22 Lakh 55 Hazaar Murabba Meel Tak Pheli Hui Thi, Aapka Mazar Mubarak Madina Pak Me Roza e Rasool Ke Andar Hazrat Abu Bakar Siddique (Razi Allahu Tala Anhu) Ke Bagal Me Hain Share this Share on X (Opens in new window) X Share on Facebook (Opens in new window) Facebook Print (Opens in new window) Print Share on Pinterest (Opens in new window) Pinterest Share on WhatsApp (Opens in new window) WhatsApp Like Loading...
