Ameerool Moamenin, Haamiye Deen-E-Mateen, Muhibbul Muslemin, Gaizul Munafiqin, Imaamul Aadileen, Mutammimul Arba in, Hazrat Sayyiduna Umar Farook-E-Aazam RadiyAllahu Ta ala Anhu Ne Hazrate Sayyiduna Saariya RadiyAllahu Ta ala Anhu Ko Ek Lashkar Ka Sipaaah Saalaar Bana Kar Sar Zameene Nahaavand Me Zihaad Ke Liye Rawaana Farmaaya. Sipaah Saalaare Lashkare Islamiyah Hazrate Sayyiduna Saariya RadiyAllahu Ta ala Anhu Kuffaare Na Hanjaar Se Bar Sare Paikaar The Ke Wazeere Rasool-E-Anwar Hazrate Sayyiduna Umar RadiyAllahu Ta ala Anhu Ne Masjid-E-Nabviyyah Shareef Ke Mimbar-E-At har Par Khutba Padhte Hue Achaanak Irshaad Farmaaya Aye Saariya ! Pahaad Ki Taraf Peeth Kar Lo. Haazireene Masjid Hairaan Reh Gaye Ke Lashkar-E-Islam Ke Sipaah Saalaar Hazrate Saariya RadiyAllahu Ta ala Anhu To Madinae Munawwarah Se Saikadon Mil Dur Sar Zameene NAHAAVAND Me Masroofe Jihaad Hain, Aaj Ameerool Moamenin RadiyAllahu Ta ala Anhu Ne Unhein Kyun Kar Aur Kaise Pukaara ? Is Ulzan Ki Tashaffee Tab Huee Jab Vahaa Se Faatehe Nahaawand Hazrate Sayyiduna Saariya RadiyAllahu Ta ala Anhu Ka Kaasid Aaya Aur Us Ne Khabar Dee Ke Maidaane Jung Me Kuffaare Jafaakaar Se Mukaabale Ke Dauraan Jab Hamein Shikast Ke Aasaar Najar Aane Lage, Itne Me Aawaaj Aaee Aye Saariya ! Pahaad Ki Taraf Peeth Kar Lo. Hazrate Sayyiduna Saariya RadiyAllahu Ta ala Anhu Ne Farmaaya Yeh To Ameerool Moamenin, Khalifatul Muslemin Hazrate Sayyiduna Umar Farook-E-Aazam RadiyAllahu Ta ala Anhu Ki Aawaaj Hai Aur Feer Fauran Hee Apane Lashkar Ko Pahaad Ki Taraf Pusht Kar Ke Saf Bandi Ka Hukm De Diya, Is Ke Baad Hum Ne Kuffaare Bad Atvaar Par Jordaar Yalgaar Kar Dee To Ek Dum Jung Ka Paansa Hee Palat Gaya Aur Thodi Hee Der Me Islami Lashkar Ne Kuffaare Naa Hanjaar Ki Foujon Ko Raund Daala Aur Asaakire Islamiya Ke Kaahiraana Hamlon Ki Taab Na Laa Kar Lashkare Asharaar Maidaane Kaarzaar Se Firaar Ikhtiyaar kar Gaya Aur Afwaaje Islam Ne Fat he Mubin Ka Parcham Lahra Diya. Mishkatul Masaabeeh, Jild-04 , Safa-401, Hadith-5954 Dalaail Nubuwwah Lil Baihaqi, Jild-06 , Safa-370, Darool Kutubul Elmiyya Bairoot, Taarikhe Damishk Li Ibne Asaakir, Jild-44, Safa-336, Daarool Fikr Bairoot, Taarikhul Khulafa, Safa-99, Darool Kutubil Elmiya Bairoot, Hujjatullaahi Alal Aalamin, Safa-612, Markaze Ahle Sunnat Barkate Raza Al Hind. Azeezane Millate Islamiya! Ameerool Moameni Faatehe Aazam Hazrat Sayyiduna Farook-E-Aazam RadiyAllahu Ta ala Anhu Ki Is Aalishan Karaamat Se Elmo Hikmate Dekhne Ko Milti Hai Ameerool Moamenin Hazrat Sayyiduna Farook-E-Aazam RadiyAllahu Ta ala Anhu Ne Madina Tayyibah Se Saikaron Mil Ki Duri Par Nahaavand Ke Maidaane Jung Aur Us Ke Ahwaal Wa Kaifiyat Ko Dekh Liya Aur Feer Asaakire Islam Ki Mushkilaat Ka Hal Bhi Fauran Lashkar Ke Sipaah Saalaar Ko Bata Diya. Is Se Ma aloom Huwa Ke Auliya-E-Kiram Rahmatullahi Ta ala Alaihim Ajmaeen KicKuwwate Sama at Wa Basaarat (Yaa ni Sun Ne Aur Dekh Ne Ki Taakat) Ko Aam Logon Ki Kuwwate Sama at Wa Basaarat Par Hargiz Hargiz Kiyaas Nahin Karna Chaahie Balke Yeh A tikaad Rakhna Chaahie Ke Allahu Rabbul Izzat Azzavajalla Ne Apane Mahboob Bandon Ke Kaano Aur Aankhon Me Aam Insano Se Bahut Hee Zyaadah Taakat Rakkhi Hain Aur In Ki Aankhon, Kaano Aur Dusre Aa za Ki Taakat Is Kadar Be Misl Wa Be Misaal Hai Aur Un Se Aise Aise Kaarhaae Numaaya Anzaam Paate Hain Ki Jin Ko Dekh Kar KARAAMAT Se Siwa Kuchh Bhi Nahin Kaha Ja Sakta. Wazeere Shahanshaahe Nubuwwat, Rookne Kasre Millat Hazrate Sayyiduna Farook-E-Aazam RadiyAllahu Ta ala Anhu Aawaaj Saikaron Mil Dur Nahaavand Ke Makaam Par Pahonchi Aur Vahaan Sab Ahle Lashkar Ne Is Ko Suna. Jaa nasheene Rasoole Makbool, Gulshane Sahaabiyyat Ke Mahakte Fool Ameerool Moamenin Hazrat Sayyiduna Umar Bin Khattab RadiyAllahu Ta ala Anhu Ki Barkat Se Allahu Rabbul Izzat Azzavajalla Ne Is Jung Me Musalmano Ko Fat h Ata Farmaai Karamate Sahaba, Safa-74 Ta 76, Mirkaatul Mafaateeh, Jild-10, Safa-296, Tah tal Hadith-5954 Mulakkhasan, Dalarool Fikr Bairoot Aur Sab Se Badi Baat To Ye Huee Ki Jab Ameerool Moamenin Hazrat Sayyiduna Farook-E-Aazam RadiyAllahu Ta ala Anhu Ne Kaha Aye Saariya ! Pahaad Ki Taraf Peeth Kar Lo. To Is Ko Sirf Do Logo Ne Hee Suna Ek Jo Haazireene Masjid The Yaani Jo Aap Hazrat Sayyiduna Umar Bin Khattab RadiyAllaho Ta ala Anho Ke Qadamo Me The, Aur Dusre Voh Jo Sar Zameene Nahaavand Me Hazrate Sayyiduna Saariya RadiyAllahu Ta ala Anhu Ke Saath The. In Dono Ke Alaawa Jo Beech Waale The Yaa ni Ku Kuffaar Mushrikin Vagerah Ko Nahin Sunaai Diya Aur Nahin Sunaai Deta Kyun In Sab Ke Lie Aise Kaan Aur Aankhe Chaahie Jo In Beech Waalon Ke Paas Nahin Hain. (Sahih Bukhari Kitabul Bad ul Khalk) NABI E AKRAM SALLALLAHU ALAIHI WA SALLAM NE JANNAT MEIN HAZRAT UMAR RAZI ALLAHU ANHU KA THIKAANA DEKHA HAI Hazrat Abu Hurairah Razi Allahu Anhu kehte hai hum Nabi E Akram Sallallahu Alaihi Wa Sallam ki khidmat mein hazir they Aap Sallallahu Alaihi Wa Sallam ne irshad farmaya "Mein soo raha tha k mene apne Aapko jannat mein paaya mene ek mehal k andar kooney mein ek aurat ko wuzu karte dekha to pucha ye mehal kiska hai?" unhoney kaha "Umar bin Khattab Razi Allahu Anhu ka, mujhe Umar Razi Allahu Anhu ki gairat ka khayaal aaya to mein peeth pher kar chala aaya" Hazrat Umar Razi Allahu Anhu (ye sun kar) money lagey arz kiya "Ya Rasool Allah Sallallahu Alaihi Wa Sallam kya mein aap par gairat karunga?". (Surah Nahal Surah no. 16 Ayat no. 30-31) JANNAT KA TEESRA NAAM "DAARUL QARAAR" (QARAAR Kl JAGAH) HAI "Ae meri qaum k loogo! ye dunya ki zindagi to bas chand roozah hai qaraar ki jagah to aakhirat hi hai". (Surah Momin Surah no. 40 Ayat no. 39) JANNAT KA CHOOTHA NAAM "MUQAAM E AMAAN" (AMAN KI JAGAH) HAI "Beshak muttaqi loog aman ki jagarh mein hongey baago aur chashmo mein rahengey". (Surah Dukhan Surah no. 44 Ayat no. 51-52) JANNAT KO "DAARUL AAKHIRAH" (AAKHIRAT KA GHAR) BHI KAHA JATA HAI "Aakhirat ka ghar hi behtar hai un loogo k liye jinhone taqwa ikhtiyaar kiya, kya turn loog aqal se kaam nahi lete". (Surah Yousuf Surah no. 12 Ayat no. 109) JANNAT KO "JANNAATUN NA'EEM" (NAIMAT BHARI JANNATEY) BHI KAHA GAYA HAI "Aur aagey wale to aagey wale hi hai wahi to muqarrab loog hai naimat bhari jannato mein rahenge". (Surah Waqiyah Surah no. 56 Ayat no. 10-12) JANNAT KO "JANNAATUN ADN" (SADA-BAHAAR JANNATEY) BHI KAHA GAYA HAI "Ahle Emaan k liye sada-bahaar jannatey hai jinke nichey nehrey beh rahi hogi waha sooney k kangan pehnaaye jayenge aur sabz rang k bareek raisham aur atlas wa daiba k kapdey pehnayenge aur unchi musnado par takiye laga kar baithengey behtareen ajr aur aala darja ki qayaam ki jagah hogi". (Surah Kahaf Surah no. 18 Ayat no. 31) JANNAT QURAN MAJEED KI ROSHNI MEIN EMAAN LAANEY K BAAD NAIK AMAL KARNE WALE LOOG JANNAT MEIN JAYENGEY JANNAT K PHAL NAAM WA SHAKAL MEIN DUNYA K PHALO SE MILTE JULTE HONGEY JANNAT KI AURATEY ZAHIRI AALAISHO (MASALAN HAIZ WA NIFAAS WAGAIRAH) AUR BAATINI AALAISHO (MASALAN GUSSA, GEEBAT AUR HASAD WAGAIRAH) SE PAAK HOG I JANNAT KI ZINDAGI LA-ZAWAL HOGI "(Ae Muhammad Sallallahu Alaihi Wa Sallam!) khushkhabri de do un loogo ko jo emaan laye aur naik amal kiye k unke liye aese baag hai jiske nichey nehrey behti hongi un baago k phal dunya k phalo se milte julte honge jab koi phal uney khaaney k liye diya jayega to wo kahengey k aese hi phal is se pehle humey (dunya mein) diye gaye they unke liye waha pakeezah beewiya hongi aur wo usmey hamesha rahengey". (Surah Baqarah Surah no. 2 Ayat no. 25) AHLE JANNAT QAYAMAT K ROOZ HAR TARAH KI ZILLAT AUR RUSWAAYI SE MEHFOOZ RAHENGEY AHLE JANNAT KO JANNAT MEIN ALLAH TA'ALA KA DEEDAAR NASEEB HOGA "Jin loogo ne (emaan laane k baad dunya mein) naik kaam kiye unke liye (aakhirat mein) accha sila (yaani jannat) hoga aur us se zayada (inaam wa ikraam) bhi (yaani deedaar e ilahi) unke chehrey par zillat aur ruswaayi na hogi (balkey khushi aur chamak hogi) ye hai jannati loog jo usmey hamesha hamesha rahengey". (Surah Younus Surah no. 10 Ayat no. 26) AHLE EMAAN MEIN SE JINKE DILO MEIN DUNYA MEIN EK DOOSRE K KHILAAF KOI NAFRAT YA HASAD HOGA JANNAT MEIN JAANE K BAAD ALLAH TA'ALA KHATAM FARMA DENGEY "Aur jo kuch unke dilo mein keena tha unko hum khatam karengey unke (mehlo k) nichey behti hogi aur wo kahengey k Allah ka ehsaan hai jisne humko yaha ka raasta dikhaya aur agar humko Allah ye raasta na dikhata to hum kabhi ye raasta na paatey, beshak hamarey Allah k Rasool haq baat le kar aaye they aur (us rooz) munaadi kardi jayegi k turn un aamaal k siley mein jo (dunya mein) karte they jannat k maalik bana diye gaye ho". (Surah Aaraaf Surah no. 7 Ayat no. 43) JANNAT MEIN AHLE JANNAT KABHI BHOOK YA PIYAAS MEHSOOS NAHI KARENGEY JANNAT MEIN NA SARDI Kl SHIDDAT HOGI NA GARMI Kl BALKEY SADABAHAAR MOSAM HOGA "(Ae Aadam Alaihis Salaam!) tu jannat mein bhooka rahega na nanga, waha tere liye piyaas hogi na dhoop mein jalna hoga". (Surah Taha Surah no. 20 Ayat no. 118-119) NAIK KHATOON, JINME AABAA WA AJDAAD, BEEWIYA AUR UNKI AULAADEY SHAMIL HOGI, JANNAT MEIN EK HI JAGAH IKATTHEY KAR DIYE JAYENGEY "Abdi jannato mein jannati loog khud bhi dakhil hongey aur unke aaba wa ajdaad (pariwaar), unki beewiya aur aulaado mein se jo naik hongey wo bhi unke saath jannat mein jayengey jannat k har darwaazey se farishtey ahle jannat k paas aayengey aur kahengey "salamati ho turn par ye jannat tumhare sabar ka badla hai (jo dunya mein tumne kiya) aakhirat ka ghar tumhey mubarak ho". (Surah Raad Surah no. 13 Ayat no. 23-24) AHLE JANNAT KO JANNAT MEIN KISI QISM Kl MEHNAT YA MASHAKKAT NAHI KARNI PADEGI "Ahle jannat ko jannat mein kisi qism ki thakaan na hogi na hi wo us se nikaaley jayengey". (Surah Hijr Surah no. 15 Ayat no. 48) JANNAT MEIN JAN N ATI LOOGO K SAATH BADI IZZAT AUR EHTARAAM KA SULOOK KIYA JAYEGA JANNAT K KHUDDAM JANNATI LOOGO Kl KHIDMAT MEIN SAFAID RANG Kl LAZEEZ SHARAAB K JAAM PAISH KARENGEY JANNAT Kl SHARAAB HOSH O HAWAAS MEIN BIGAAD PAIDA NAHI KAREGI ANDEY K CHILKEY K NICHEY CHIPI HUI JHILLI SE ZAYADA NARAM WA NAZUK AUR KHOOBSURAT MOOTI AANKHO WALI HOOREY, JANNATIYO KO INAAM K TAURPAR Dl JAYENGI "Jannati loogo k liye (jannat mein) khana pehan'na rizq hoga, maivey hongey aur naimat bhari jannatey jinme wo izzat k saath rakkhey jayengey, aamney saamney takhto par takiya lagaaye baithey hongey, sharaab k chashmo se jaam bhar bhar kar jannatiyo ki khidmat mein paish kiye jayengey, sharaab hogi safaid rang ki lazeez, jis se na zarar pahunchega na aqal kharaab hogi aur unkey paas haya-daar, khoobsurat mooti aankho wali hoorey hogi aesi naram wa nazuk jese andey k nichey chipi hui jhilli". (Surah Saffat Surah no. 37 Ayat no. 41-49) JANNATIYO K LIYE ADN (JANNAT K EK MEHAL KA NAAM) K AESE BAAGAAT HONGEY JISKE DARWAAZEY UNKE LIYE HAMESHA KHULE RAKKHEY JAYENGEY JANNATI LOOG PAL-BHAR MEIN DHAIRO PHAL AUR MASHROBAAT KHA-PEE JAYENGEY JO FAURAN HAZAM HO JAYENGEY JANNAT Kl HOOREY KHOOBSURAT, SHARMEELI, MOOTI AANKHO WALI AUR APNE SHOHARO Kl HAM-UMAR HOGI JANNAT Kl NAIMATEY KAM HOGI NA KHATAM HOGI "Aur muttaqi loogo k liye behtareen thikana hai bagaat adn k darwaazey unke liye (hamesha) khule rakkhey jayengey usi mein wo takiya lagaaye baithey honge phal aur mashroob bakasrat talab karengey unke paas sharmeeli aur ham-umar beewiya hongi ye wo cheezey hai jinhey hisaab k din ata karne ka tumse wada kiya ja raha hai hamari ye ata kabhi khatam na hogi". (Surah Saad Surah no. 38 Ayat no. 49-54) AHLE JANNAT APNI NAIK BEEWIYO K SAATH JANNAT MEIN KHUSH WA KHURRAM ZINDAGI BASAR KARENGEY JANNATI JOODO (MIYA BEEWI) K SAAMNE, SOONEY K THAAL JINME MUKHTALIF QISM K PHAL AUR KHAANEY HONGEY AUR SOONEY K SAGIR JINME MUKHTALIF QISM K MASHROBAAT HONGEY, PAISH KIYE JAYENGEY JANNAT MEIN QALB WA NAZAR KO LAZZAT PAHUCHANEY WALI HAR CHEEZ MOJOOD HOGI JANNATI LOOGO Kl IZZAT AFZAAYI AUR HOSALA AFZAAYI Kl KHATIR UNHEY BATAYA JAYENGA K YE JANNAT AUR USKI NAIMATEY TUMHARE AAMAAL K BADLEY MEIN ALLAH NE TUMHEY ATA FARMAYI HAI "Dakhil ho jao jannat mein turn aur tumhari beewiya (aaj) tumhey khush kar diya jayega unke aagey sooney k thaal aur sooney k sagir garoosh karaaye jayengey aankho ko lazzat dene wali aur jannatiyo ki har matlooba cheez waha mojood hogi (unse kaha jayega) turn us jannat mein hamesha hamesha rahogey, turn us jannat k waris un aamaal ki wajah se banaaye gaye ho jo turn dunya mein karte rahey ho". (Surah Zukhruf Surah no. 43 Ayat no. 70-73) JANNAT MEIN KOI RANJ, DUKH, MUSEEBAT YA PARESHAANI NAHI HOGI BALKEY HAR WAQT AUR HAR TARAF MUSARRAT, RAAHAT AUR AM AN WA SALAMATI HOGI JANNATI LOOGO KA LIBAAS BAREEK AUR MOOTEY RAISHAM SE BANAYA GAYA HOGA MOOTI AUR KHOOBSURAT AANKHO WALI GOORI AURATO SE UNKA NIKAH KIYA JAYEGA JANNAT MEIN MAUT NAHI AAYEGI BALKEY ABDI ZINDAGI HOGI IBTADA'AN JANNAT MEIN DAKHIL HONE WALE LOOG JAHANNAM K AZAAB SE MUKAMMALTAUR PAR MEHFOOZ RAHENGEY ALLAH TA'ALA K FAZAL WA KARAM K BAGAIR JANNAT MEIN JANA MUMKIN NAHI JANNAT MEIN DAKHIL HONA HI ASAL FALAH AUR KAAMYAABI HAI "Muttaqi loogo yaqeenan aman ki jagah (jannat) mein hongey baago aur chashmo mein (mazey karengey) hareer (bareek raisham) aur daiba (moota raisham) pehne aamney saamney baithey honge ye hogi unki shaan aur hum goori goori khoobsurat mooti aankho wali aurato se unka nikah karengey jannati loog har tarah ki lazeez cheez poorey itminaan aur be-fikri se talab karengey (yaani kisi cheez se inkaar hone ya kisi cheez k khatam hone ka khatra nahi hoga) jannat mein loog maut ka maza nahi chakhengey pas pehli (zindagi ki) maut jo aa chuki so aa chuki, Allah ta'ala unhey apne fazal se jahannam k azaab se bacha lega, aur ye bahut badi kaamyaabi hogi". (Surah Dukhaan Surah no. 44 Ayat no. 51-57) JANNAT MEIN SAAF SUTHREY AUR KHALIS PAANI, DOODH, SHARAAB AUR SHAHED KI NEHREY HONGI JINSE JANNATI LOOG PIYENGEY JANNAT KI NEHRO K MASHROBAAT KA RANG AUR ZAIQA HAMESHA EK JESA RAHEGA AHLE JANNAT KO ALLAH TA'ALA TAMAAM GUNAHO SE PAAK SAAF KARKE JANNAT MEIN DAKHIL FARMAYEGA "Muttaqi loogo k liye jis jannat ka wada kiya gaya hai uski shaan to ye hai k usme nehrey beh rahi hongi saaf aur suthrey paani ki aur aese doodh ki jiska zaiqa na badla hua aesi sharaab ki jo peeney walo k liye lazeez ho aur saaf shaffaaf shahed ki, waha unke liye har tarah k phal honge aur unke rabb ki taraf se magfirat hogi". (Surah Muhammad Surah no. 47 Ayat no. 15) NAIK AULAADO KO NAIK AABAA WA AJDAAD K SAATH JANNAT MEIN IKATTHA KAR DIYA JAYEGA AUR AGAR UNKE BA'HAMI DARJAAT MEIN FARQ HOGA TO KAM DARJA WALO K DARJAAT KO ALLAH TA'ALA APNE FAZAL WA KARAM SE BADHA KAR DONO KO UNCHEY DARJEY MEIN MILA DENGE TAKEY JANNAT MEIN WO SAB KHUSH WA KHURRAM RAHEY AUR EK DOOSRE KO DEKH KAR UNKI AANKHEY THANDI HO "JO loog emaan laye hai aur unki aulaad emaan k kisi darja mein unke naksh e qadam par chali hai unki aulaad ko bhi ham (jannat mein) unke saath mila dengey aur unke (yaani aabaa wa ajdaad k) amal mein koi kami nahi karengey har shaks apne aamaal k auz rahan hai". (Surah Tour Surah no. 52 Ayat no. 21) JANNATIYO KO LAZEEZ PHALO K SAATH SAATH UNKA MANPASAND GOOSHT BHI MUHAYYA KIYA JAYEGA JANNATI LOOG KHAATE PEETE WAQT AAPAS MEIN CHEENA JHAPTI KAR KE KHUSH TAB'I KARENGEY JANNATIYO K KHADIM LADKEY IS QADAR HASEEN WA JAMEEL HONGE JESE MEHFOOZ KIYE HUE KHOOBSURAT MOOTI HO "Hum unhey har tarah k lazeez phal aur manpasand goosht dete chale jayengey wo ek doosre se jaam e sharaab ki cheena jhapti karengey, aesi sharaab jiske peene se na to baihudah gooyi hogi na koi gunah sarzad hoga, mehfooz kiye hue mootiyo ki tarah khoobsurat ladkey unki khidmat mein har waqt hazir rahengey". (Surah Tour Surah no. 52 Ayat no. 22-24) JANNAT MEIN MUQARRABEEN (ALLAH K KHAAS NAIK BANDO) K LIYE DO DO BAAGH HONGEY JO NAIMATO K LIHAAZ SE AAM MOMINO (ASHABUL YAMEEN) K BAAGHO SE AFZAL HONGE DONO BAAGHO MEIN DO CHASHMEY, HAR TARAH K LAZEEZ PHAL AUR RAISHMI MUSNADO PAR MUSHTAMIL BAITHAKEY HONGI JANNATIYO KI BEEWIYA INTIHAAYI SHARMEELI, PAAKBAAZ, HEERO AUR MOOTIYO JESI CHAMAKTI DAMAKTI KHOOBSURAT, SIRF APNE SHOHARO KI KHATIRDAARI KARNE WALIYA HONGI JANNATIYO KI BEEWIYO KO JANNAT MEIN DAKHIL HONE SE PEHLE NAYE SIREY SE PAIDA KIYA JAYEGA AUR US PAIDAISH K BAAD UNHEY KISI INSAAN (YA JINNAT KI BEEWIYO KO KISI JINN) NE HAATH TAK NAHI LAGAYA HOGA "Jo shaks apne rabb k huzoor paish hone se darta raha uske liye do baagh honge (ae jinn wa ins!) turn apne rabb ki kin kin naimato ko jhutlaaoge?, dono baagh hari bhari daliyo se bhar-poor honge (to phir ae jinn wa ins) turn apne rabb k kin kin ehsanaat ko jhutlaaogey?, dono baagho mein har phal ki do qismey hongi (ek dunya mein istemaal ki hui doosri us se alag) phir turn apne rabb k kin kin inaamaat ko jhutlaaogey?, jannati loog aese aese farsho par takiya laga kar baithengey jinka astar (andar ka tukda) mootey resham ka hoga aur baagho ki daaliya phalo k boojh se chuki hongi (jannatiyo ko khud phal toodne mein koi diqqat nahi hogi) phir turn apne rabb ki kin kin naimato ko jhutlaaogey?, un naimato k darmiyaan sharmeeli nigaaho wali hongi jinhey us se pehle kisi insaan ya jinn ne chuwa nahi hoga phir turn apne rabb ki kin kin naimato ko jhutlaaogey? (wo beewiya) aesi khoobsurat jese hirey aur mooti phir turn apne rabb k kin kin ehsanaat ko jhutlaaogey?". (Surah Rahman Surah no. 55 Ayat no. 46-59) ASHAABUL YAMEEN (AAM MOMINEEN)KO BHI DO BAAGH ATA KIYE JAYENGEY JO MUQARRABEEN K BAAGHO KI NISBAT MUQAAM AUR MARTABA MEIN KAM HONGEY UN BAAGHO MEIN BHI CHASHMEY AUR LAZEEZ PHAL MOJOOD HONGEY NAIK, PAKBAAZ, HASEEEN WA JAMEEL, MOOTI AANKHO WALI GOORI GOORI AURATEY (HOOREY) UNKI BEEWIYA HONGI JINHEY US SE PEHLE KISI NE CHUWA TAK NAHI HOGA "Un (do baagho) k alawa do baagh aur hongey phir turn apne rabb k kin kin ehsanaat ko jhutlaaogey?, dono baagho mein do chashmey fuwaaro ki tarah ubal rahey hongey phir turn apne rabb k kin kin inamaat ko jhutlaaogey?, dono baagho mein bakasrat phal khajoorey aur anaar hongey phir turn apne rabbb k kin kin ehsanaat ko jhutlaaogey?, un naimato k darmiyaan naik, paakbaaz aur haseen wa jameel beewiya hongi phir turn apne rabb ki kin kin naimato ko jhutlaaogey?, hoorey khaimo mein thehraayi gayi hogi phir turn apne rabb ki kin kin naimato ko jhulaaogey?, jannatiyo se pehle kisi insaan ya jinn ne un (aurato) ko chuwa na hoga phir turn apne rabb k kin kin inamaat ko jhutlaaogey?, jannati loog sabz qaaleeno aur nafees wa nadir farsho par takiye laga kar baithengey phir turn apne rabb k kin kin ehsanaat ko jhutlaaogey?, badi barkat wala hai tere rabb jaleel wa kareem ka naam". (Surah Rahman Surah no. 55 Ayat no. 62-78) SAAR I ZINDAGI NA-JAYEZ KHAWAHISHAAT E NAFS SE RUKEY REHNE WALE AUR ALLAH KI QAYAM KARDAH HUDOOD KI PABANDI KARNE WALE LOOG HI JANNAT MEIN JAYENGEY JANNAT MEIN GARMI Kl SHIDDAT HOGI NA SARDI Kl BALKEY KHUSHGAWAAR SAAYE HONGEY AUR MUSTAQIL MOSAM BAHAAR! JANNAT K KHADIM CHAANDI AUR SHEESHEY K BARTANO MEIN JANNATIYO Kl AAO BHAGAT KARENGEY JANNAT K PHAL IS QADAR NEECHEY HONGEY K JANNATI KHADE, BAITHEY YA LAITEY JAB CHAAHENGEY TOOD SAKENGEY JANNAT K CHASHMA "SALSABEEL" SE AESI SHARAAB BAR'AAMAD HOGI JISME SOONTH Kl AAMAIZISH HOGI, JO JANNATI LOOGO KO PILAAYI JAYEGI HAR JANNATI K BAAGH EK WASEEY WA AZEEZ SALTANAT KA MANZAR PAISH KARENGEY JANNATIYO KO CHAANDI K KANGAN PEHNAAYE JAYENGEY "Allah ta'ala unke sabar k badley mein unhey jannat aur raishmi libaas ata farmayega jaha wo unchi musnado par takiye lagaye baithey hongey na waha sooraj ki garmi hogi na sardi ki shiddat (balkey hamesha mosam bahaar rahega) jannat k darakhto k saaye un jhukey hue hongey piyaaley gardish karaaye ja rahe hongey, shishey bhi wo chaandi ki kism k hongey piyaalo ko (khuddaam ne) theek andaazey k mutabiq bhara hoga (yaani jitna kisi ne peena hoga bas utna hi khuddam daalengey) jannatiyo ko aesi sharaab k jaam pilaaye jayengey jinme soonth ki aamaizish hogi ye jannat ka ek chashma hoga jise "salsabeel" kaha jata hai, jannatiyo ki khidmat k liye aese ladkey doodte phir rahe hongey jo hamesha ladkey hi rahengey turn unhey dekhogey to tu lagega jese bikhrey hue mooti hai, waha jidhar bhi turn nazar daalogey naimatey hi naimatey hongi aur ek badi saltanat ka saro samaan tumhey nazar aayega, jannatiyo k jismo par sabz bareek aur mootey raishami libaas hongey unhey chaandi k kangan pehnaaye jayengey unka rabb unhey nihayat pakeezah sharaab pilayega (unhey bataya jayega) ye hai tumhare aamaal ki jaza, tumhari jadd o jahad qabil e qadr thehri". (Surah Zahar Surah no. 72 Ayat no. 12-22) PUR ROONAQ CHEHREY BAAGHAAT, BAKASRAT PHAL, KHOOBSURAT, NOJAWAAN, KUWAARI AUR APNE SHOHARO Kl HAM-UMAR AURATEY, PAKEEZAH SHARAAB, JHALAKTEY JAAM, HAR QISM Kl LAGU AUR BAIHUDAH BAATO SE PAAK AUR SAAF MAHOOL, BEHTEY CHASHMEY, BULAND WA BALA MUSNADEY, QATAAR DAR QATAAR GAO TAKIYE AUR NADIR WA NAFEES QAALEEN YE SAB JANNAT Kl NAIMATEY HAI, JINSE AHLE JANNAT MUSTAFEED HONGEY "Kuch chehrey is rooz ba-roonaq hongey apne kaarguzaari par khush hongey aalishaan jannat mein, jaha koi baihudah baat nahi sunegey, jannat mein chashmey beh rahe hongey buland wa bala musnadey hondi, saagir rakkhey honge gao takiyo ki qataar lagi hongi aur nafees farsh bichey hue hongey". (Surah Gashiyah Surah no. 88 Ayat no. 8-14) JANNAT MEIN KAANTO K BAGIR BAIRIYA HONGI JANNATI LOOGO Kl NAIK DUNYAAWI BEEWIYO KO ALLAH TA'ALA DOBAARAH PAIDA KAREGEY JINME DARJ ZAIL TEEN KHOOBIYA HONGI, KUWAARI HONGI, APNE SHOHARO Kl HAM-UMAR HONGI, APNE SHOHARO SE JI-BHAR KAR PIYAAR AUR MUHABBAT KARNE WALIYA HONGI "Aur daayi baazu waley unki khushnaseebi ka kya kehna, wo be khaar bairiyo, ta bar ta kailiyo aur door tak phaili hui chaao aur har dar rawa rawa paani aur kabhi khatam na hone wale, be rook took milne wale bakasrat phalo aur unchi nashast gaaho mein hongey unki beewiyo ko hum khaas taur par naye sirey se paida karengey aur unhey pakeezah bana dengey apne shoharo se ji bhar kar muhabbat karne waliyo aur unki ham-umar ye saari naimatey hai daayi baazu walo k liye". (Surah Waqiya Surah no. 56 Ayat no. 27-38) JANNAT K CHASHMA "KAFOOR" SE AESI SHARAAB BAR'AAMAD HOGI JISME KAFOOR Kl AAMAIZISH HOGI JO JANNATIYO KO PILAAYI JAYEGI JANNAT MEIN SAARE KAAM JANNATIYO Kl KHAWAHISH AUR IRADEY PAR HI CHASHM E ZADAN MEIN POOREY HO JAYENGEY "Naik loog (jannat mein) sharaab k aese saagir piyengey jinme kafoor ki aamaizish hogi, kafoor (jannat mein) ek chashma hai jis se Allah k bandey piyengey aur us chashmey ki nadya jidhar chahengey (sirf khawahish karne se hi) baha le jayengey". (Surah Dahar Surah no. 76 Ayat no. 5-6) JANNAT KI NAIMATEY AHLE JANNAT K QALB WA NAZAR KO THANDAK PAHUNCHANEY WALI HOGI JANNAT KI NAIMATO KA IS DUNYA MEIN TASAWWUR KARNA MUMKIN NAHI "Ahle Jannat ki aankho ko thandak pahunchane k liye jo makhfi naimatey tayyar ki gayi hai unka ilm kisi mutnafs ko nahi". (Surah Sajdah Surah no. 32 Ayat no. 17) JANNAT KI SHAAN JANNAT KI NAIMATO AUR KHOOBIYO KA BAYAN KARNA AUR IS DUNYA MEIN UNHEY SAMAJHNA HATTA K UNKA TASAWWUR KARNA BHI NA-MUMKIN HAI Hazrat Sahal bin Saad Saadi Razi Allahu Anhu se riwayat hai k mein Rasool Allah Sallallahu Alaihi Wa Sallam ki ek majlis mein hazir tha us mein Aap Sallallahu Alaihi Wa Sallam ne jannat ka haal bayan kiya yaha tak k be-inteha tareef farmayi aakhir mein farmaya jannat mein aesi aesi naimatey hai jinhey kisi aankh ne dekha nahi na kisi kaan ne unki tareef suni hai na hi unka tasawwur kisi aadmi k dil mein paida hua hai phir Aap Sallallahu Alaihi Wa Sallam ne ye aayat tilawat farmayi (ye jannat un loogo k liye hai) jinkey pehlu bistaro se alag rehte hai apne rabb ko (azaab k) darr se aur (sawaab ki) ummeed se pukaarte hai aur jo rizk hamne unko diya hai usey (Allah ki raah mein) kharch karte hai koi nahi jaanta un naimato ko jo unki aankho ko thandak pahuchane wali hai aur unse chipa kar rakkhi gayi hai ye naimatey badla hai un aamaal ka jo wo (dunya ki zindagi mein) karte rahe hai. (Surah Sajdah Ayat no. 18) (Sahih Muslim Kitabul Bad ul Khalk) JANNAT MEIN CHADI BARABAR JAGAH DUNYA AUR USMEY MOJOOD TAMAAM NAIMATO SE AFZAL HAI Hazrat Sahal bin Saad Saadi Razi Allahu Anhu kehte hai Rasool Allah Sallallahu Alaihi Wa Sallam ne farmaya "Jannat mein chadi k barabar jagah dunya aur dunya ki har cheez se behtar hai". (Sahih Bukhari Kitabul Bad ul Khalk) JANNAT MEIN KAMAAN BARABAR JAGAH DUNYA KI HAR US CHEEZ SE BEHTAR HAI JIS PAR SOORAJ TULU WA GUROOB HOTA HAI Hazrat Abu Hurairah Razi Allahu Anhu se riwayat hai k Nabi E Kareem Sallallahu Alaihi Wa Sallam ne farmaya "Jannat mein ek darakht hai jiske saaye mein ek (ghooda) sawaar 100 baras tak chalta rahey (tab bhi khatam na ho) agar (quran se samajhna) chaaho to (Surah Waqiya Ayat no. 30) (WA ZILLIM MAMDOODAH - aur lamba saaya) padh lo jannat mein kisi shaks ki kamaan rakhne k barabar jagah (dunya ki) har us cheez se behtar hai jis par sooraj tuju ya guroob hota hai". (Sahih Bukhari Kitabul Bad ul Khalk) JANNAT KI NAIMATO MEIN SE KOI EK NAIMAT NAKHUN K BARABAR IS DUNYA MEIN ZAHIR HO JAYE TO ZAMEEN WA AASMAAN ROSHAN HO JAYE Hazrat Abu Hurairah Razi Allahu Anhu kehte hai mene apne doost Sallallahu Alaihi Wa Sallam se suna hai (jannat mein) momin ko waha tak zaiwar pehnaya jayega jaha tak uska wuzu pahunchta hai. (Sahih Muslim Kitabut Taharah) JANNAT MEIN MAUT HOTI TO JANNATI LOOG JANNAT Kl NAIMATO KO DEKH KAR KHUSHI SE MAR JAATE Hazrat Abu Saad Razi Allahu Anhu se riwayat hai k Rasool E Akram Sallallahu Alaihi Wa Sallam ne farmaya "Qayamat k rooz maut ek chitkabrey maindhey ki shakal mein jannat aur jahannam k darmiyaan khadi ki jayegi aur use zibah kiya jayega jannati aur jahannami loog use dekh rahe honge agar khushi se marna mumkin hota to jannati khushi se mar jaate aur gum se marna mumkin hota to jahannami gam se mar jaate". (Sunan Tirmizi Abwabus Sifatul Jannah) JANNAT KI KHUSHBU CHALEES SAAL KI MUSAAFAT SE AAYEGI Hazrat Abdullah bin Umar Razi Allahu Anhu se riwayat hai k Nabi e Akram Sallallahu Alaihi Wa Sallam ne farmaya "Jisne kisi zami ko (na haqq) qatal kiya wo jannat ki khushbu tak nahi payega aur jannat ki khusbu chalees saal ki musaafat se aayegi". (Sahih Bukhari Kitabul Jihaad was Sabr) JANNAT KI TAMAAM ASHYA DUNYA KI TAMAAM CHEEZO SE AALAA AUR AFZAL HAI SIRF NAAM EK JESE HAI Hazrat Abdullah bin Abbas Razi Allahu Anhu kehte hai Rasool E Akram Sallallahu Alaihi Wa Sallam ne farmaya "Jannat ki koi cheez bhi dunya ki cheezo se nahi milti siwaaye naamo k". (Silsila Ahadees E Saheeya Hadees no. 2188) SAAR I ZINDAGI DUKHO AUR MUSEEBATO MEIN BASR KARNE WALA SHAKS JANNAT Kl EK JHALAK DEKHTE HI DUNYA K SAARE DUKH AUR GHAM BHOOL JAYEGA Hazrat Anas bin Malik Razi Allahu Anhu se riwayat hai k Rasool Allah Sallallahu Alaihi Wa Sallam ne farmaya "Qayamat k rooz aese shaks ko laya jayega jiska jahannam mein jana tey ho chuka hoga dunya mein usne badi aesh wa ishrat ki hogi use dozakh mein ek goota diya jayega aur us se pucha jayega "Ae ibne Aadam! kya tumne koi aesh wa ishrat dekhi, kabhi dunya mein tumhara naaz o naam se waasta pada?" wo kahega "Ae mere rabb! teri qasam kabhi nahi" phir ek aese aadmi ko laya jayega jo jannati hoga lekin dunya mein badi takleef ki zindagi basar ki hogi usey jannat mein ek goota diya jayega aur us se pucha jayega "Ae ibne Aadam! kabhi dunya mein tooney koi takleef dekhi ya ranj wa gham se kabhi tumhara waasta pada?" wo kahega "Ae mere rabb! teri qasam kabhi nahi, mujhe to na kabhi ranj wa gham se waasta pada na kabhi koi dukh ya takleef dekhi". (Sahih Muslim Kitbus Sifaatul Munafiqeen) JANNAT KI NAIMATO AUR DARJAAT DEKHNE K BAAD AHLE JANNAT KI HASRAT Hazrat Muaaz Razi Allahu Anhu kehte hai Rasool Allah Sallallahu Alaihi Wa Sallam ne farmaya "Ahle Jannat ko kisi cheez par itni hasrat nahi hogi jitni us lamhey par jo dunya mein Allah ki yaad k bagair guzar gaya". (Tabraani, Sahih Jamey Sageer Hadees no. 5322) JANNAT KI WUS'AT JANNAT KI KAM SE KAM WUS'AT KA TASAWWUR ZAMEEN AUR TAMAAM AASMAANO KI WUS'AT K BARABAR HAI LEKIN ZIYAADAH SE ZIYAADAH WUS'AT KI KOI HADD NAHI "Doodho (bhaago) apne rabb ki magfirat ki taraf aur us jannat ki taraf jiski (sirf) chodaayi aasmaano aur zameen (ki wus'at) jesi hai wo jannat muttaqi loogo k liye tayyar ki gayi hai". (Surah Ale Imran Surah no. 3 Ayat no. 133) "Ahle jannat ki aankho ko thandak pahunchane k liye jo kuch unse chipa kar rakkha gaya hai use koi nahi jaanta ye badla hai un aamaal ka jo wo (dunya mein) karte rahey". (Surah Sajdah Surah no. 32 Ayat no. 17) JANNAT KO DEKHNE K BAAD HI SAHIH TAUR PAR ANDAAZA HOGA K JANNAT KITNI BADI HAI AUR USKI NAIMATEY KITNI AZEEM HAI "Aur jab turn jannat ko dekhogey to har taraf naimatey hi naimatey aur ek badi saltanat ka saro samaan tumhey nazar aayega". (Surah Dahar Surah no. 76 Ayat no. 20) JANNAT K 100 DARJAAT HAI HAR DARJAH K DARMIYAAN ITNA FARQ HAI JITNA ZAMEEN O AASMAAN K DARMIYAAN FAASALA HAI Hazrat Ubada bin Saamit Razi Allahu Anhu se riwayat hai k Rasool Allah Sallallahu Alaihi Wa Sallam ne farmaya "Jannat mein 100 darjey hai har 2 darjo k darmiyaan zameen o aasmaan k barabar faasla hai sab se aalaa tareen darjey ka naam firdoos hai firdoos se jannat ki chaaro nehrey (meehaan, jeehaan, faraat aur nail) jaari hoti hai firdoos k uper Allah ta'ala ka arsh hai jab bhi Allah ta'ala se (jannat ka) sawaal karo to firdoos ka sawaal karo". (Sunan Tirmizi Abwabul Jannah) JANNAT MEIN EK DARAKHT KA SAAYA ITNA LAMBA HOGA K GHOODA SAWAAR 100 BARAS TAK MUSALSAL USKE SAAYE MEIN SAFAR KARTA RAHE TAB BHI KHATAM NAHI HOGA Hazrat Abu Hurairah Razi Allahu Anhu se riwayat hai k Nabi E Kareem Sallallahu Alaihi Wa Sallam ne farmaya "Jannat mein ek darakht hai jiske saaye mein ek (ghooda) sawaar 100 baras tak chalta rahey (tab bhi khatam na ho) agar (quran se samajhna) chaaho to (Surah Waqiya Ayat no. 30) (WA ZILLIM MAMDOODAH - aur lamba saaya) padh lo jannat mein kisi shaks ki kamaan rakhne k barabar jagah (dunya ki) har us cheez se behtar hai jis par sooraj tuju ya guroob hota hai". (Sahih Bukhari Kitabul Bad ul Khalk) SABSE AAKHIR MEIN JANNAT MEIN DAAKHIL HONE WALEY JAN N ATI KO IS DUNYA SE 10 GUNAAH WASEE MAMLAKAT ATA KI JAYEGI Hazrat Abdullah (bin Masood) Razi Allahu Anhu kehte hai Rasool Allah Sallallahu Alaihi Wa Sallam ne farmaya "Jahannam se sabse aakhir mein nikalne wale aadmi ko mein pehchaanta hu wo shaks kohlu k ball gisat'ta hua jayega to dekhega k sab loogo ne apni apni jagah par qabza jama rakkha hai (aur uske liye koi jagah baaqi nahi) us se pucha jayega tumhe wo waqt yaad hai jab turn jahannam mein they? arz karega han yaad hai chunanchey us se kaha jayega khawahish karo (kitni jagah jannat mein chahiye?) chunanchey wo khawahish karega phir use kaha jayega tere liye teri khawahish k mutabiq jannat mein jagah hai aur 10 dunyaao k barabar mazeed bhi tumhare liye jagah hai wo shaks arz karega (ya Allah!) tu baadshah ho kar mere saath mazaaq karta hai (jannat mein to mamooli si jagah bhi baaqi nahi rahi) Hazrat Abdullah bin Masood Razi Allahu Anhu kehte hai (k ye irshad farmane k baad) Rasool E Akram Sallallahu Alaihi Wa Sallam itna hansey k Aap Sa lla lla hu Alaihi Wa Sallam ki dadhi nazar aaney lagi - ek doosri riwayat mein hai k "Allah ta'ala (us aadmi k jawab mein) farmayengey mein tujhse mazaaq nahi kar raha balkey mein jo kaam karna chahta hu us par poori tarah qaadir hu". (Sahih Muslim Kitabul Emaan) Wazahat Rasool E Akram Sa Ha Ha h u Alaihi Wa Sallam ko bandey k jawab par hansi is wajah se aayi k bandey ka Allah ta'ala ki qudrat k baare mein gumaan kis qadar nafiz hai k wo Allah ta'ala k farmaan ko namumkin samajh kar mazaaq keh raha hai. AAKHIRI AADMI KO IS DUNYA SE 10 GUNAAH ZAYADAH JAGAH ATA KARNE K BAWAJOOD JANNAT MEIN JAGAH BACH JAYEGI JISE PUR KARNE K UYE ALLAH TA'ALA NAYI MAKHLOOQ PAIDA FARMAYEGA Hazrat Anas Razi Allahu Anhu kehte hai Rasool Allah Sallallahu Alahi Wa Sallam ne farmaya "Jannat mein jitni jagah Allah chahega khali reh jayegi phir Allah ta'ala uske liye doosri makhlooq paida farmayega". (Sahih Muslim Kitabul Jannah wa Sifaah) JANNAT K DARWAAZEY AHLE JANNAT KI AAMAD PAR FARISHTEY JANNAT K DARWAAZEY KHOLENGEY DARWAAZO SE DAKHIL HOTE WAQT FARISHTE AHLE JANNAT K LIYE SALAMATI KI DUA KARENGEY "Muttaqi loogo ko giroh dar giroh jannat ki taraf le jaya jayega yaha tak k jab wo waha pahunchengey to jannat k darwaazey khool diye ja chukey hongey jannat k khadim (farishte) unse kahengey "Salaal ho turn par bahut acchey rahey dakhil ho jao is jannat mein hamesha hamesha k liye". (Surah Zumar Surah no. 39 Ayat no. 73) SABSE PEHLE JANNAT KA DARWAAZAH RASOOL E AKRAM SALLALLAHU ALAI HI WA SALLAM K LIYE KHOOLA JAYEGA Hazrat Anas bin Malik Razi Allahu Anhu kehte hai Rasool Allah Sallallahu Alaihi Wa Sallam ne irshad farmaya "Qayamat k rooz mein (sabse pehle) jannat k darwaazzey par aayunga aur darwaaza khulwaunga jannat ka khazin (darwaaza khatkhatane par) poochega kaun hai?" mein jawab dunga "Muhammad (Sallallahu Alaihi Wa Sallam)!" khazin kahega "Mujhe isi baat ka hukm diya gaya tha k aapse pehle kisi k liye darwaaza na khoolu". (Sahih Muslim Kitabul Emaan) Hazrat Anas bin Malik Razi Allahu Anhu kehte hai Rasool E Akram Sallallahu Alaihi Wa Sallam ne farmaya "Qayamat k rooz sabse ziyadah ummati mere hongey aur sabse pehle mein jannat ka darwaaza khatkhataunga". (Sahih Muslim Kitabul Emaan) JANNAT K 8 DARWAAZEY HAI Hazrat Sahal bin Saaad Razi Allahu Anhu se riwayat hai k Nabi E Akram Sallallahu Alaihi Wa Sallam ne farmaya "Jannat mein 8 darwaazey hai jinmein se ek ka naam "Rayyaan" hai jisme se sirf roozadaar hi dakhil hongey". (Sahih Bukhari Kitabul Bad ul Khalq) JANNAT K BAAZ DOOSRE DARWAAZO K NAAM YE HAI BABUS SALAAT, BABUL JIHAAD, BABUS SADQA Hazrat Abu Hurairah Razi Allahu Anhu se riwayat hai k Rasool Allah Sallallahu Alaihi Wa Sallam ne farmaya "Jis shaks ne Allah ki raah mein jooda kharch kiya (masalan do ghoode do talwaare wagairah) use jannat mein yu keh kar bulaya jayega Ae Allah k bandey! ye hai behtar sila (tumhare infaaq ka) jo ahle salah se hoga use babus salaat se pukara jayega jo ahle jihaad mein se hoga wo baabul jihaad se pukara jayega jo ahle sadqa se hoga wo babus sadqa se pukara jayega jo ahle siyaam se hoga wo babur rayyaan se pukara jayega" Hazrat Abu Bakr Siddequi Razi Allahu Anhu ne arz kiya Ae Allah k Nabi Sallallahu Alaihi Wa Sallam! aese shaks ko to koi khasarah nahi hoga jo sab darwaazo se pukara jayega aur koi aesa shaks bhi hai jo un sab darwaazo se bulaya jayega?" Aap Sallallahu Alaihi Wa Sallam ne irshad farmaya "Han" aur mujhey ummeed hai k turn unhi mein se hongey". (Sunan Nasayi Kitabul Jihaad) JANNAT K EK DARWAAZEY KI CHOODAYI TAQREEBAN 1200, 1300 KILOMETER K BARABAR HAI BILA HISAAB KITAB JANNAT MEIN JAANE WALE KHUSHNASEEB LOOG JIS DARWAAZEY SE DAKHIL HONGE US KA NAAM "BABUL YAMAN" HAI Hazrat Abu Hurairah Razi Allahu Anhu se hadees shifa'at mein riwayat hai k (Rasool E Akram Sallallahu Alaihi Wa Sallam ki shifarish k baad) Allah ta'ala irshad farmayega "Ae Muhammad (Sallallahu Alaihi Wa Sallam)! apni ummat k un loogo ko baabul yaman se jannat mein dakhil karo jis par koi hisaab kitab nahi hai aur wo jannat k doosre darwaazo mein se dakhil hone wale loogo k saath shareek hai (yaani agar kisi doosre darwaazo mein se dakhil hona chahey to ho sakte hai) Qasam hai us zaat ki jiske haath mein Muhammad (Sallallahu Alaihi Wa Sallam) ki jaan hai jannat ki chokhat k darmiyaan itna fasala hai jitna makka aur hajr (bahreen k ek shehar ka naam hai) darmiyaan hai ya jitna makka aur busra (shaam k ek shehar ka naam hai) k darmiyaan hai". (Sahih Muslim Kitabul Emaan) Wazahat Yaad rahey k makka aur hajr ka darmiyaani fasala 1160 kilometer aur makka wa busra ka darmiyaani fasala 1250 kilometer hai. BILA HISAAB KITAB JANNAT MEIN JAANE WALE 70 HAZAAR IFRAAD BAIK WAQT BABUL YAMAN SE DAKHIL HONGEY KOI AAGEY YA PICHEY NAHI HOGA Hazrat Sahal bin Saad Razi Allahu Anhu se riwayat hai k Rasool Allah Sallallahu Alaihi Wa Sallam ne farmaya "Meri ummat k 70 hazaar ifraad ya 7 lakh (hadees k raavi) abu hazam ko yaad nahi raha k 70 hazaar ya 7 lakh ifraad is tarah jannat mein dwakhil hongey k ek doosre ka haath pakdey hue hongey unme se koi bhi us waqt tak jannat mein dakhil nahi hoga jab tak aakhiri aadmi dakhil na ho jaye (yaani saare baik waqt dakhil hongey) un jannatiyo k chehre choodhvi raat k chand ki tarah chamak rahe hongey". (Sahih Muslim Kitabul Emaan) Wazahat Muslim Shareef ki doosri hadees se 70 hazaar ki tadaad sabit hai. (Wallahu Aalam bis Sawaab) ACCHI TARAH WUZU KARNE K BAAD KALMA E SHAHADAT PADHNE WALA SHAKS JANNAT MEIN AATHO (8) DARWAAZO MEIN SE JIS SE CHAAHEGA DAKHIL HO SAKEGA Hazrat Umar bin Khattab Razi Allahu Anhu kehte hai Rasool E Akram Sallallahu Alaihi Wa Sallam ne farmaya "Turn mein se jo shaks acchi tarah poora wuzu kare phir kahe "ASH'HADU ALLA ILAHA ILLALLAHU WA ANNA MUHAMMADAN ABDUHU WA RASOOLUHU (yaani mein gawahi deta hu k Allah k siwa koi mabood nahi aur Muhammad Sallallahu Alaihi Wa Sallam Allah k bandey aur uske rasool hai)" uske liye jannat k aatho (8) darwaazey khool diye jaate hai jis se chaahey dakhil ho". (Sahih Muslim Kitabut Taharah) PAANCH NAMAZO Kl PABANDI KANRE WALI, RAMAZAAN K ROOZEY RAKHNE WALI, PAAKDAMAN AUR APNE SHOHAR Kl ITA'AT GUZAAR KHATOON JANNAT K AATHO (8) DARWAAZO MEIN SE JIS SE CHAAHEGI DAKHIL HO SAKEGI Hazrat Abu Hurairah Razi Allahu Anhu se riwayat hai k Rasool Allah Sallallahu Alaihi Wa Sallam ne farmaya "Jo aurat paanch namazey ada kare, ramazaan k roozey rakkhey, apni sharmgaah ki hifazat kare aur apne shohar ki farmabardaari kare use (qayamat k rooz) kaha jayega jannat k (aatho) darwaazo mein se j is se chaaho dakhil ho jao". (Sahih Jamey Sageer Hadees no. 683) TEEN NABAALIG BACCHO K FAUT HONE PAR SABR KARNE WALA SHAKS JANNAT K AATHO DARWAAZO MEIN SE JIS SE CHAAHEGA DAKHIL HO SAKEGA Hazrat Anas bin Malik Razi Allahu Anhu se riwayat hai k Nabi E Akram Sallallahu Alaihi Wa Sallam ne farmaya "Jis musalman k teen nabaalig bacchey faut ho gaye (aur usne sabr kiya) to wo bacche use jannat k aatho darwaazo par milengey wo jis darwaazey se chaahega dakhil ho jayega". (Sunan Ibne Maja Kitabul Janaiz) PEER (MONDAY) AUR JUMA-RAAT (THURSDAY) K ROOZ JANNAT K DARWAAZEY KHOOLEY JATE HAI Hazrat Abu Hurairah Razi Allahu Anhu se riwayat hai k Rasool Allah Sallallahu Alaihi Wa Sallam ne farmaya "Jannat k darwaazey peer aur juma-raat ko khool diye jaate hai aur har us shaks ko bakhs diya jata hai jo Allah se shirk na karta ho siwaye us aadmi k jo kisi doosre bhai k saath keena rakhta ho (un dono k baare mein farishto se) kaha jata hai un dono aadmiyo ka intazaar karo yaha tak k ye dono aapas mein mil jaye un dono ka intazaar karo hatta k aapas mein mil jaye". (Sahih Muslim Baab Shahna) RAMAZAAN SHAREEF K POOREY MAHEENEY MEIN JANNAT K AATHO (8) DARWAAZEY KHULEY REHTE HAI Hazrat Abu Hurairah Razi Allahu Anhu se riwayat hai k Rasool Allah Sallallahu Alaihi Wa Sallam ne farmaya "Jab ramazaan aata hai to aasman k darwaazey khool diye jaate hai, jahannam k darwaazey band kar diye jaate hai aur shayateen jakad diye jaate hai". (Al loo loo wal Marjaan Hadees no. 652) JANNAT K DARJAAT JANNAT K BULAND WA BAALA MAHLAAL JANNATIYO K DARJAAT K AETABAAR SE UPER NICHEY BANE HUE HAI "Jo loog apne rabb se darr kar rehe unke liye buland imaratey hai (darja ba darja) manzil ba manzil bani hui hai jinke nichey nehrey beh rahi hai ye Allah ta'ala ka wada hai aur Allah ta'ala apne wadah ki kabhi khilaaf warzi nahi karta". (Surah Zumar Surah no. 39 Ayat no. 20) JANNAT KA AALA TAREEN DARJA "WASEELA" HAI JIS PAR HAMARE PIYAARE RASOOL E AKRAM SALLALLAHU ALAIHI WA SALLAM RONAQ AFROOZ HONGEY Hazrat Abu Hurairah Razi Allahu Anhu se riwayat hai k Rasool E Akram Sallallahu Alaihi Wa Sallam ne farmaya "Jab turn mujh par darood bhejo to mere liye Allah ta'ala se "Waseela" ki dua karo, Sahaba E Kiraam Razi Allahu Anhum ne arz kiya "Ya Rasool Allah Sallallahu Alaihi Wa Sallam! waseela kya hai?" Aap Sallallahu Alaihi Wa Sallam ne irshad farmaya "Jannat mein aala tareen darja jo sirf ek aadmi ko hasil hoga aur mein ummeed karta hu k wo mein hi hu". (Musnad Ahmad Hadees no. 7588) JANNAT K 100 DARJAAT HAI HAR DARJA MEIN ITNA FARQ HAI JITNA ZAMEEN WA AASMAAN K DARMIYAAN HAI JANNAT Kl SABSE UPER WALE DARJA KA NAAM FIRDAUS HAI JIS SE JANNAT Kl CHAAR NEHREY JAARI HOTI HAI HAR MOMIN KO ALLAH TA'ALA SE JANNAT KA SABSE UPER WALA DARJA "FIRDAUS" MAANGNA CHAHIYE FIRDAUS K UPER ALLAH TA'ALA KA ARSH HAI Hazrat Ubada bin Saamit Razi Allahu Anhu se riwayat hai k Rasool Allah Sallallahu Alaihi Wa Sallam ne farmaya "Jannat mein 100 darjey hai har 2 darjo k darmiyaan zameen o aasmaan k barabar faasla hai sab se aalaa tareen darjey ka naam firdoos hai firdoos se jannat ki chaaro nehrey (meehaan, jeehaan, faraat aur nail) jaari hoti hai firdoos k uper Allah ta'ala ka arsh hai jab bhi Allah ta'ala se (jannat ka) sawaal karo to firdoos ka sawaal karo". (Sunan Tirmizi Abwabul Jannah) NICHEY DARJA K MAHLAAT WALE JANNATI UPER WALE DARJAAT K MAHLAAT KO DEKH KAR YUH MEHSOOS KARENGEY JESE DOOR KOI CHAMAKTA HUA SITAARA NAZAR AA RAHA HAI Hazrat Abu Saeed Khudri Razi Allahu Anhu se riwayat hai k Rasool Allah Sallallahu Alaihi Wa Sallam ne farmaya "Jannati loog apne se uper wale mahlaat k jannatiyo ko dekhengey (to aesa mehsoos karengey) jesa k door aasman k mashriqi ya magribi kinaarey par koi tara chamak raha hai itna faasala jannatiyo k ba'hami darjaat k farq ki wajah se hoga" Sahaba E Kiraam Razi Allahu Anhum ne arz kiya "Ya Rasool Allah Sallallahu Alaihi Wa Sallam! us buland muqaam par ambiya k alawa aur kaun pahuncheyga?" Aap Sallallahu Alaihi Wa Sallam ne irshad farmaya "Kyu nahi (pahunchega) qasam us zaat ki jiske haath mein meri jaan hai wo loog un darjaat mein hongey jo Allah par emaan laaye aur Rasoolo ki tasdeeq ki". (Sahih Muslim Kitabul Jannah was Sifaah) JANNAT K 100 DARJEY HAI HAR DO DARJO K DARMIYAAN 100 SAAL Kl MUSAFAT KA FARQ HAI Hazrat Abu Hurairah Razi Allahu Anahu kehte hai Rasool Allah Sallallahu Alaihi Wa Sallam ne farmaya "Jannat mein 100 darjey hai har do darjo k darmiyaan 100 saal (ki musafat) ka farq hai". (Sunan Tirmizi Abwabul Jannah) ALLAH K LIYE EK DOOSRE SE MUHABBAT KARNE WALO K GHAR MASHRIQ YA MAGRIB SE TULU HONEY WALE CHAMAKDAAR SITAARO Kl TARAH NAZAR AAYENGEY Hazrat Abu Saeed Razi Allahu Anhu se riwayat hai k Rasool Allah Sallallahu Alaihi Wa Sallam ne farmaya "Allah k liye ek doosre se muhabbat karne walo k ghar jannat mein tumhey is tarah nazar aayengey jese mashriq ya magrib se tulu hone wala sitaara! loog puchengey ye kaun hai? unhey bataya jayega ye Allah k liye ek doosre se muhabbat karne wale loog hai". (Musnad Ahmad Kitabul Ahle Jannah) "SAABIQOON" K LIYE SOONEY K DO BAAGH "ASHABUL YAMEEN" K LIYE CHANDI K DO BAAGH HONGEY Hazrat Abu Bakr bin Musa (Ash'ari) apne baap se riwayat karte hai k Rasool Allah Sallallahu Alaihi Wa Sallam ne farmaya "Saabiqoon k liye sooney k do baagh aur ashabul yameen k liye chaandi k do baagh". (An Nihaya Li bin Kaseer Hadees no. 346) Wazahat "Saabiqoon" se muraad emaan laane mein pehal karne wale aur ashabul yameen se muraad tamaam naik-o-kaar loog hai, "Saabiqoon" ashabul yameen se afzal hai. (Wallahu Aalam bis Sawaab) JANNAT K MAHLAAT JANNAT K MAHLAAT HAR CHOOTI BADI GALAZAT AUR GANDAGI SE PAAK AUR SAAF HONGEY "Momin mardo aur aurato se Allah ta'ala ne wada kar rakkha hai k wo unhey aese baagh dega jiske nichey nehrey behti hongi aur wo un mein hamesha rahengey un baagho mein unke liye pakeeza qayaam-gaahey hongi aur sab se badh kar ye k unhey Allah ta'ala ki khushnudi hasil hogi yahi badi kaamyabi hai". (Surah Touba Surah no. 9 Ayat no. 72) JANNAT K MAHLAAT MEIN TAMAAM BARTAN SOONEY AUR CHAANDI K HONGEY JANNATIYO K MAHLAAT MEIN HAR WAQT AUOR JALTI RAH EG I JISKI KHUSHBU SE UNKE MAHLAAT MU ATTAR RAHENGEY JANNATIYO K PASEENE SE MUSHK KI KHUSHBU AAYEGI JANNAT MEIN THOOK, NAAK AUR RAFEY-HAAJAT WAGAIRAH NAHI HONGEY TAMAAM JANNATI BAAHAM WA SHAIR O SHUKR HONGEY KISI K DIL MEIN DOOSRE K KHILAAF KOI HASAD YA BUGAZ NAHI HOGA AHLE JANNAT HAR SAANS K SAATH ALLAH KI HAMD AUR TASBEEH KAREGEY Hazrat Abu Hurairah Razi Allahu Anhu kehte hai Rasool Allah Sallallahu Alaihi Wa Sallam ne farmaya "Jannat mein sabse pehle (mardo aur aurato ka) jo garooh dakhil hoga unke chehrey choodvi raat k chand ki tarah (roshan) hongey unhey thook nahi ayega na naak aur rafey-haajat ki zaroorat mehsoos karengey unke bartan sooney k hongey kanghiya (tak) sooney aur chaandi ki hongi, angeethiyo se auos ki khusbu nikal rahi hogi, jannatiyo k paseene se mushk ki khushbu ayegi, har jannati k paas do beewiya aesi hongi jinke husn ki wajah se unki pindali ka gooda goosht k andar se dikhayi dega jannati loogo mein baahami ikhtalaaf nahi hongey na hi bugz hoga, balkey yak jaan hongey subah wa shaam Allah ki tasbeeh karte rahengey". Aap Sallallahu Alaihi Wa Sallam ne irshad farmaya "paaki se" mene arz kiya "jannat kis cheez se bani hai?" Aap Sallallahu Alaihi Wa Sallam ne irshad farmaya "uski ek eent chandi ki hai ek sooney ki, uska seement taiz khushbu wala mushk hai, uske sangreezey moti aur yaqoot k hai uski mitti zaafraan hai, jo shaks usme dakhil hoga wo aish karega kabhi takleef nahi dekhega, hamesha zinda rahega kabhi nahi marega, jannatiyo k kapde kabhi puraane nahi hongey aur unki jawaani kabhi fana nahi hogi". documents: Thousands protest in Delhi after exam paper leaks, opposition leader detained Wednesday, 22 July 2026, 00 08 A massive youth movement confronted police in Delhi over alleged medical exam paper leaks. Tensions grew amid arrests and calls for ministerial resignations. According to Reuters In Delhi, thousands of supporters of the Cockroach Janta Party (CJP) youth movement protested on Tuesday at Jantar Mantar, in what was a demonstration following clashes with police a day earlier, as the government promised to punish those responsible for the leak of exam questions for admission to medical colleges in May. More than five thousand protesters gathered after their march to Parliament ended in clashes with security forces on Monday. The prime minister s comments, provided by one of the government ministers, were his first reaction to the leak of the questions. The leaks affected about 2 million young people and led to suicides of around a dozen students, according to local media. Public discontent and protests over the exams have posed the biggest challenge for Modi in his third term. The Delhi Police said nearly 180 people were injured, including 118 security personnel and 60 protesters. The founder of Cockroach Janta Party (CJP), a movement that began as an online satirical project, said that more than 150 protesters are receiving treatment in hospitals. Independent verification of the injury numbers could not be confirmed, as police used batons and tear gas to disperse people. Opposition leader Rahul Gandhi detained Dozens of members of the main opposition party Congress, including Rahul Gandhi and his sister Priyanka Gandhi Vadra, also briefly protested the dispersal near Modi s residence on Tuesday, after which they were detained. In footage Gandhi lay on the road in his signature white T-shirt and khaki trousers as police tried to lift him he was taken to a police bus along with other party members. One protester held a sign with a message, and footage showed some Congress members being detained during the street protests. According to Parliamentary Affairs Minister Kiren Rijiju, Modi told lawmakers that the government acted promptly after receiving reports of breaches in the education system 13 people were arrested and detained. It was also stated that retesting had been successfully conducted. The Prime Minister said that, to ensure the future of the youth is not at risk, everyone must come together to ensure strict action, punish the guilty, and create a foolproof system, Kiren Rijiju Protesters say they will not march again The CJP movement said it will continue anti-government protests but will not march to Parliament, fearing that their supporters will be beaten by police again. The movement, which has drawn support from millions of young Indians, is demanding the resignation of Dharmendra Pradhan and sees the leak of the questions as a sign of deep corruption in education. The founder Abhijeet Dipke apologized to supporters, particularly to the women who, it is claimed, were beaten by police. The Delhi Police said the protesters demonstrated defiant, aggressive and violent behavior and deliberately violated existing prohibitions. The movement gained momentum after support from activist Sonam Wangchuk, who began a hunger strike on June 28 but was forcibly taken to a hospital by police on Saturday. Court allows activist to be transferred to a private hospital On Tuesday, the Delhi High Court allowed transferring the holder of the Magsaysay Award to a private hospital after a petition by his wife, which claimed he was illegally detained. This court order meets one of the three demands of the protesters. The movement said that Health Minister J.P. Nadda had requested time to discuss their demands in the government after meeting with two leaders on Monday. Among the demands are the release of Wangchuk, the resignation of Pradhan, and a payment of 10 million rupees to each of about a dozen students who died after the leak. The popularity of the CJP reflects discontent among young Indians, particularly due to job shortages and frequent leaks during competitive exams, which they say occur often. We recommend paying attention to Delhi faces severe smog season with hazardous air quality affecting over 34 million residents, prompting protests and government cloud-seeding efforts to combat pollution. Delhi police moved against supporters of the youth Cockroach Janta Party as thousands marched toward parliament despite a ban, intensifying protests over exam leaks and education reforms. Pukhraj ratna , jise Yellow Sapphire bhi kehte hain, aapki kismat badal sakta hai! Aaiye, jante hain "pukhraj ratna pahanne ki vidhi" aur iske benefits ke baare mein. Pukhraj Ratna Ek Powerful Stone Pukhraj, or Yellow Sapphire, Guru graha (Jupiter) ka ratna hai. Astrology mein, Guru wisdom, knowledge, prosperity, aur luck ka pratik hai. Iska matlab hai, pukhraj pahanne se aapko in sabhi cheezon mein fayda mil sakta hai. Lekin, dhyan rahe, ise sahi tareeke se pahnna bahut zaroori hai. Pukhraj Ratna Pahanne Ke Fayde (Benefits of Wearing Pukhraj) Financial Stability Pukhraj dhan aur samriddhi laane mein madad karta hai. Agar aap financially struggle kar rahe hain, toh yeh ratna aapke liye bahut beneficial ho sakta hai. Improved Knowledge and Wisdom Guru graha knowledge ka karak hai, isliye pukhraj pahanne se aapki learning ability aur understanding improve hoti hai. Better Luck and Prosperity Yeh ratna aapki kismat ko chamka sakta hai aur aapko life mein success dila sakta hai. Marriage and Relationship Harmony Jin logon ko marriage mein problems aa rahi hain, unke liye pukhraj bahut acha mana jata hai. Astrological Remedies for Delay in Marriage can provide further guidance. Health Benefits Pukhraj liver aur digestive system ke liye bhi acha mana jata hai. Kya Pukhraj Aapke Liye Sahi Hai? (Is Pukhraj Right For You?) Pukhraj pahanne se pehle, yeh jaanna zaroori hai ki kya yeh aapke liye suitable hai ya nahi. Vedic astrology ke anusar, pukhraj Dhanu (Sagittarius) aur Meen (Pisces) rashi walon ke liye bahut acha mana jata hai. Lekin, agar aapki kundli mein Guru graha weak hai ya aap Guru graha se related koi problem face kar rahe hain, toh bhi aap pukhraj pahan sakte hain. Best hai ki aap ek experienced astrologer se consult karein. You can also Get Free Kundali to better understand your birth chart or Horoscope for daily astrological insights. Consult our expert astrologers . Pukhraj Ratna Pahanne Ki Sahi Vidhi (Right Method to Wear Pukhraj) Pukhraj Ratna Kab Pahne? (When to Wear Pukhraj?) Pukhraj pahanne ke liye sabse acha din Guruvar (Thursday) mana jata hai. Guruvar Guru graha ka din hai, isliye is din pukhraj pahanne se aapko Guru graha ka maximum benefit milta hai. Pukhraj Ratna Kaise Pahne? (How to Wear Pukhraj?) 1. Pukhraj Choose Karein Sabse pehle, ek achi quality ka pukhraj choose karein. Dhyan rahe, pukhraj natural aur certified hona chahiye. How to Purify Gemstone Before Wearing is important before putting it on. Find the right gemstone for you. 2. Weight Generally, yeh kaha jata hai ki aapki weight ke according pukhraj ka weight hona chahiye. For example, if you weigh 60 kgs, aim for a 6-carat pukhraj. 3. Cleanse Karein Pukhraj ko pahanne se pehle, ise gangajal ya kachche doodh se cleanse karein. Isse ratna shudh ho jata hai aur aapko iska maximum benefit milta hai. 4. Mantra Jaap Pukhraj ko apne right hand ki index finger mein pahnne se pehle, Guru mantra ka jaap karein. Aap "Om Gram Greem Groom Sah Gurve Namah" mantra ka 108 baar jaap kar sakte hain. Unlocking Abundance with Mantra for Jupiter 5. Finger and Metal Right hand ki index finger mein pahnna is best. Gold ya silver mein pahnna is considered auspicious. 6. Time Subah ke time, ideally between 5 AM to 7 AM, pukhraj dharan karna shubh hota hai. Consider consulting Panchang . Pukhraj Ratna Pahnne Ke Liye Important Tips Consult an Astrologer Pukhraj pahanne se pehle, ek experienced astrologer se consult karna bahut zaroori hai. Woh aapki kundli ko analyze karke aapko sahi guidance de sakte hain. Quality Matters Hamesha achi quality ka pukhraj choose karein. Low-quality pukhraj aapko benefits dene ki bajaye nuksan bhi pahuncha sakta hai. Regular Cleaning Apne pukhraj ratna ko regularly clean karein. Isse ratna ki energy maintain rehti hai aur aapko iska maximum benefit milta hai. Pukhraj Ratna Myths vs. Reality Kaafi logon ko lagta hai ki pukhraj sirf rich logon ke liye hai. Lekin, yeh sach nahi hai. Pukhraj koi bhi pahan sakta hai, bas yeh dekhna zaroori hai ki kya yeh aapke liye suitable hai ya nahi. Dusra myth yeh hai ki pukhraj pahnne se immediately results milte hain. Dhyan rahe, koi bhi ratna apna asar dikhane mein time leta hai. Patience rakhein aur faith ke saath pukhraj pahnein. Also New Year Resolutions Conclusion Pukhraj ratna ek bahut hi powerful ratna hai jo aapki life mein positive changes la sakta hai. Lekin, iska sahi tareeke se istemal karna bahut zaroori hai. Upar di gayi vidhi ko follow karein aur ek experienced astrologer se consult karna na bhulein. All the best! Movement ki neev 6 June 2026 ko padi, jab pehli baar Jantar Mantar par is naam se pradarshan hua. Us waqt shayad hi kisi ne socha tha ki ye ek chhota sa protest aane wale hafton mein poore desh ko hila dega. Cockroach naam ka matlab kya hai Jab pehli baar ye naam saamne aaya, log ise mazak samajh baithe. Lekin iske peeche ek gehra symbolism hai cockroach wo jeev hai jo har haal mein zinda rehta hai, chahe kitni bhi maar pade. Andolan ki asli wajah NEET paper leak CJP movement ki jaड़ NEET-UG 2026 paper leak scandal mein hai. Students ka aarop hai ki paper leak ke chalte lakhon meharuti candidates ka future daanव par lag gaya, aur 25 se zyada students ab tak suicide kar chuke hain bina kisi insaaf ya muaawze ke. Protesters ki mukhya maangein NEET paper leak ki nishpaksh jaanch Prabhavित parivaron ko insaaf aur muaawza Education Minister Dharmendra Pradhan ka istifa NTA ko bhang karke naya transparent system Paper leak roकne ke liye sakht kanoon Movement ke bade chehre Sonam Wangchuk Ladakh ke jaane-mane education reformer, jinka Jantar Mantar par hunger strike movement ka sabse bada emotional anchor bana. Yogendra Yadav purani India Against Corruption movement se juड़े netritvakarta, jinki maujoodgi ne is andolan ko naya political weight diya. Chalo Sansad march turning point 20 July 2026 ko, Parliament ke Monsoon Session ke pehle hi din, CJP ne Parliament tak march ka aayojan kiya. Delhi Police ne permission nahi di, Section 163 BNSS laagu kiya gaya, lekin hazaron protesters phir bhi sadkon par utar aaye. Barricades tootne, lathicharge, aur tear gas ke bawajood andolan ruka nahi. Police ke mutabik is takrav mein 180 log ghayal hue aur 70 se zyada detain kiye gaye. Ab aage kya 21 July ko CJP delegation ne Union Minister JP Nadda se baatcheet ki aur sarkar ko memorandum saumpa. CJP ne saaf kiya hai ki andolan jaari rahega, lekin abhi ke liye naya march nahi hoga. Rajya Sabha mein bhi is mudde par bhaari hangama hua aur karyawahi sthagit karni pad gayi. Home Politics Jumah claims Malawians are united in suffering, politicians are prospering Politics Jumah claims Malawians are united in suffering, politicians are prospering By 247Malawi 20 07 2026 0 0 Share Facebook X WhatsApp Linkedin Email By Vincent Gunde The Revolutionary leader of Muvi wa Chilungamo Revolutionary Party (MRP) Bantu Saunders Jumah, has claimed that Malawians are united in suffering and the ones who are prospering are the politicians. Jumah said for 62 years of independence, Malawians have been told beautiful stories of one Malawi, one nation and one destiny. He said Malawians are one country, one nation but destiny is not the same, politicians are the ones who are enjoying the country better than the country itself and its citizens. Speaking through the Revolutionary voice, Jumah has questioned Malawians that if they are truly in one Malawi, one nation and one destiny, why are so many Malawians struggling for their everyday needs, electricity is stack at 300 megawatts to 21 million plus citizens? Jumah said Malawi is a nation that cannot dream of its future observing that its dreams are robbed by politicians, assuring Malawians that a nation without dreams, is a nation without the future. He said in Malawi, people are celebrating titles such as Professors, Doctors and Honourable but there s no transformation, there s only the value of education without transformation. The Revolutionary leader said a country led by educated mines must reflect innovations and civilization saying in Malawi, titles are reflecting failure of leadership, vision and integrity. He said time has come, Malawians cannot continue to be voting for empty political slogans saying in 2030 they will not vote for titles for one Malawi, one nation, and one destiny, they will vote for transformative leaders not politicians. Jumah said Malawi can change only with transformational leadership not politicians claiming that the country has a fertile arable land, clean water, and mineral deposits but lack a leadership with consciousness of Steve Biko. He has appealed to Malawians to start rejecting the lie of one Malawi, one nation, and one destiny claiming that Malawians are loyal to suffering while politicians are prospering and in the end describing Malawi as a poor country. Jumah has finally advised Malawians to remove envy, greed and corruption which have blanketed the whole country, saying it is possible for Malawi to change from being the poorest to middle income economy.
